```
import { z } from 'zod';

// Query strings arrive as strings, and clients often send `?status=` for an
// unset filter. Normalize blanks to undefined so `.optional()`/`.default()`
// behave as intended instead of failing coercion.
const emptyToUndefined = (value) =>
  value === '' || value === null || value === undefined ? undefined : value;

const booleanish = z.preprocess((value) => {
  if (typeof value === 'string') {
    const normalized = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (normalized === 'true' || normalized === '1') return true;
    if (normalized === 'false' || normalized === '0') return false;
  }
  return value;
}, z.boolean({ invalid_type_error: 'must be a boolean' }));

const roleEnum = z.enum(['ADMIN', 'USER'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'role must be one of ADMIN, USER' }),
});

const paymentStatusEnum = z.enum(['PENDING', 'COMPLETED', 'FAILED'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'status must be one of PENDING, COMPLETED, FAILED' }),
});

const sortOrderEnum = z.enum(['asc', 'desc'], {
  errorMap: () => ({ message: 'sortOrder must be asc or desc' }),
});

export const paginationQuerySchema = z.object({
  page: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce
      .number({ invalid_type_error: 'page must be a number' })
      .int('page must be an integer')
      .min(1, 'page must be at least 1')
      .default(1)
  ),
  limit: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce
      .number({ invalid_type_error: 'limit must be a number' })
      .int('limit must be an integer')
      .min(1, 'limit must be at least 1')
      .max(100, 'limit must be at most 100')
      .default(10)
  ),
  sortOrder: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, sortOrderEnum.default('desc')),
});

export const updateUserSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'fullName must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .min(2, 'fullName must be at least 2 characters')
    .max(120, 'fullName must be at most 120 characters')
    .optional(),
  email: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'email must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .toLowerCase()
    .email('email must be a valid email address')
    .optional(),
  phone: z
    .string({ invalid_type_error: 'phone must be a string' })
    .trim()
    .regex(/^\+?[0-9]{7,15}$/, 'phone must be a valid phone number')
    .optional(),
  role: roleEnum.optional(),
  isActive: booleanish.optional(),
});

export const listUsersQuery = paginationQuerySchema.extend({
  search: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z
      .string({ invalid_type_error: 'search must be a string' })
      .trim()
      .max(120, 'search must be at most 120 characters')
      .optional()
  ),
  role: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, roleEnum.optional()),
  isActive: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, booleanish.optional()),
  sortBy: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z
      .enum(['createdAt', 'fullName', 'email'], {
        errorMap: () => ({ message: 'sortBy must be one of createdAt, fullName, email' }),
      })
      .default('createdAt')
  ),
});

export const revenueQuerySchema = z
  .object({
    from: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    to: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    groupBy: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z
        .enum(['day', 'week', 'month'], {
          errorMap: () => ({ message: 'groupBy must be one of day, week, month' }),
        })
        .default('day')
    ),
    planId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'planId must be a number' })
        .int('planId must be an integer')
        .positive('planId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
  })
  .refine((data) => !data.from || !data.to || data.from <= data.to, {
    message: 'from must be before or equal to to',
    path: ['from'],
  });

export const paymentFilterSchema = paginationQuerySchema
  .extend({
    status: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, paymentStatusEnum.optional()),
    userId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'userId must be a number' })
        .int('userId must be an integer')
        .positive('userId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
    planId: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'planId must be a number' })
        .int('planId must be an integer')
        .positive('planId must be a positive integer')
        .optional()
    ),
    from: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    to: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.date().optional()),
    minAmountToman: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'minAmountToman must be a number' })
        .int('minAmountToman must be an integer')
        .min(0, 'minAmountToman must be at least 0')
        .optional()
    ),
    maxAmountToman: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z.coerce
        .number({ invalid_type_error: 'maxAmountToman must be a number' })
        .int('maxAmountToman must be an integer')
        .min(0, 'maxAmountToman must be at least 0')
        .optional()
    ),
    sortBy: z.preprocess(
      emptyToUndefined,
      z
        .enum(['createdAt', 'amountToman', 'status'], {
          errorMap: () => ({ message: 'sortBy must be one of createdAt, amountToman, status' }),
        })
        .default('createdAt')
    ),
  })
  .refine((data) => !data.from || !data.to || data.from <= data.to, {
    message: 'from must be before or equal to to',
    path: ['from'],
  })
  .refine(
    (data) =>
      data.minAmountToman === undefined ||
      data.maxAmountToman === undefined ||
      data.minAmountToman <= data.maxAmountToman,
    { message: 'minAmountToman must be less than or equal to maxAmountToman', path: ['minAmountToman'] }
  );
export const auditQuery = z.object({
  page: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce.number().int().min(1).default(1)
  ),
  limit: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(10)
  ),
  adminId: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.coerce.number().int().positive().optional()
  ),
  action: z.preprocess(
    emptyToUndefined,
    z.string().optional()
  ),
});
export const createPlanSchema = z.object({
  name: z.string().min(2, 'name must be at least 2 characters'),
  description: z.string().optional(),
  price: z.number().int().positive('price must be a positive integer'),
  durationDays: z.number().int().positive('durationDays must be a positive integer'),
  isActive: z.boolean().optional(),
});

export const updatePlanSchema = createPlanSchema.partial();

export const createUserSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().min(2, 'fullName must be at least 2 characters'),
  email: z.string().email('email must be a valid email'),

  role: roleEnum.optional(),
});

export const idParamSchema = z.object({
  id: z.preprocess(emptyToUndefined, z.coerce.number().int().positive('id must be a positive integer')),
});

// Aliases matching the names imported by backend/src/routes/admin.routes.js.
export const updateUserBody = updateUserSchema;
export const revenueQuery = revenueQuerySchema;
export const listPaymentsQuery = paymentFilterSchema;

export default {
  paginationQuerySchema,
  listUsersQuery,
  updateUserSchema,
  updateUserBody,
  revenueQuerySchema,
  revenueQuery,
  paymentFilterSchema,
  listPaymentsQuery,
  auditQuery,
  createPlanSchema,
  updatePlanSchema,
  createUserSchema,
  idParamSchema,
};
```

```jsx
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../utils/api';

export const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAuth = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get('/user/me');
        setUser(response.data.data);
      } catch (error) {
        setUser(null);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    checkAuth();
  }, []);

  const login = async (email, password) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });
    const loggedInUser = response.data?.data?.user ?? null;
    if (!loggedInUser || !loggedInUser.role) {
      throw new Error('پاسخ سرور نامعتبر است: اطلاعات کاربر دریافت نشد');
    }
    setUser(loggedInUser);
    return loggedInUser;
  };

  const register = async (userData) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/register', userData);
    // The register endpoint returns the user object directly in `data`.
    const registeredUser = response.data?.data?.user ?? response.data?.data ?? null;
    if (registeredUser) setUser(registeredUser);
    return response.data;
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    await api.post('/auth/logout');
    setUser(null);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">در حال بارگذاری...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, register, logout, setUser }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth باید داخل AuthProvider استفاده شود');
  }
  return context;
};
```

## Root cause

Tracing the flow end to end:

1. `LoginForm.onSubmit` → `login(email, password)` from `AuthContext`.
2. `AuthContext.login` → `POST /auth/login` → `loginHandler` → `auth.service.login()`.
3. `login()` returns `{ accessToken, refreshToken, user: toPublicUser(user) }`.
4. **`toPublicUser` is declared `async`.** So `user` is a **Promise**, not an object. `ok(res, { token, user })` then `JSON.stringify`s it, and a Promise serializes to `{}`. That is exactly the "empty user object" you saw in the API response.
5. Frontend: `response.data.data.user` is `{}` → `setUser({})` → `login()` returns `{}`.
6. `LoginForm`: `user?.role` is `undefined` → falls into the `else` branch → `navigate('/dashboard')`.
7. The dashboard's protected route sees a user with **no `role`** (and/or re-checks `/user/me`), so it bounces the user straight back to `/login`. Net effect: "login succeeds but I stay on the login page."

So the redirect does not fail in `LoginForm` — it fails because the user object arrives empty. Fixing `toPublicUser` fixes the whole chain.

## What I changed

**`backend/src/services/auth.service.js`**
- `toPublicUser` is now **synchronous** and returns `{ id, email, name, role, createdAt }`. Every caller (`register`, `login`, `refresh`) now gets a real object instead of a Promise.
- `login` now accepts `req` as a second parameter. Previously the failed-login branch called `logEvent({ ..., req })` where `req` was **not defined in scope** → `ReferenceError` → a wrong password produced a 500 instead of a 401.
```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { hashPassword, comparePassword } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { signAccessToken, generateRefreshToken, hashToken } from '../utils/jwt.util.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { AUDIT_ACTIONS, AUTH } from '../config/constants.js';

// A valid bcrypt hash used to equalize timing when the user does not exist.
const DUMMY_HASH = '$2b$10$N9qo8uLOickgx2ZMRZoMyeIjZAgcfl7p92ldGxad68LJZdL17lhWy';

// IMPORTANT: this function must stay synchronous.
// It used to be declared `async`, so every caller received a Promise. A Promise
// serializes to `{}` in JSON, which is why the API answered with `user: {}` and
// the frontend had no `role` to route on.
export function toPublicUser(dbUser) {
  if (!dbUser) return null;
  return {
    id: dbUser.id,
    email: dbUser.email,
    name: dbUser.name,
    role: dbUser.role,
    createdAt: dbUser.createdAt,
  };
}

export async function register(data) {
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
  if (existing) throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این ایمیل قبلا ثبت شده است');

  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(data.password || data.passwordHash);
  const user = await prisma.user.create({
    data: {
      email: data.email,
      password: passwordHash,
      name: data.fullName || data.name || 'کاربر جدید',
      role: 'USER',
    },
  });
  await logEvent({ action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.REGISTER, entity: 'User', entityId: user.id });
  return toPublicUser(user);
}

// `req` is optional: it is only used for audit logging on failed attempts.
// It used to be referenced without being declared, which threw a ReferenceError
// (HTTP 500) whenever the password was wrong.
export async function login({ email, password }, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { email } });

  // Timing safety: Compare against dummy hash if user doesn't exist
  const isValid = user
    ? await comparePassword(password, user.password)
    : await comparePassword(password, DUMMY_HASH);

  if (!user || !isValid) {
    if (user) {
      const failed = user.failedLoginCount + 1;
      const lockedUntil = failed >= AUTH.MAX_FAILED ? new Date(Date.now() + AUTH.LOCK_MINUTES * 60000) : null;
      await prisma.user.update({
        where: { id: user.id },
        data: { failedLoginCount: failed, lockedUntil },
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_FAILED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'ایمیل یا رمز عبور اشتباه است');
  }

  //if (!user.isActive) throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'حساب کاربری غیرفعال است');
  if (user.lockedUntil && user.lockedUntil > new Date()) {
    throw new AppError(423, 'ACCOUNT_LOCKED', 'حساب کاربری موقتا قفل شده است');
  }

  const { token: refreshToken, tokenHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();

  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: user.id },
      data: { failedLoginCount: 0, lockedUntil: null, lastLoginAt: new Date() },
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: user.id,
        tokenHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: null,
        userAgent: null,
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: user.id, role: user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: user.id, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.LOGIN_SUCCESS });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken, user: toPublicUser(user) };
}

export async function refresh(oldRefreshToken, req) {
  if (!oldRefreshToken) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن یافت نشد');

  const tokenHash = hashToken(oldRefreshToken);
  const storedToken = await prisma.refreshToken.findUnique({
    where: { tokenHash },
    include: { user: true },
  });

  if (!storedToken || storedToken.revokedAt || storedToken.expiresAt < new Date()) {
    if (storedToken && storedToken.revokedAt) {
      // Reuse detection: Revoke all tokens for this user
      await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
        where: { userId: storedToken.userId, revokedAt: null },
        data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
      });
      await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REUSE_DETECTED, req });
    }
    throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHORIZED', 'توکن نامعتبر است');
  }

  // Rotate token
  const { token: newRefreshToken, tokenHash: newHash, expiresAt } = generateRefreshToken();

  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.refreshToken.update({
      where: { id: storedToken.id },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.create({
      data: {
        userId: storedToken.userId,
        tokenHash: newHash,
        expiresAt,
        ip: req.ip,
        userAgent: req.headers['user-agent'],
      },
    }),
  ]);

  const accessToken = signAccessToken({ sub: storedToken.user.id, role: storedToken.user.role });
  await logEvent({ userId: storedToken.userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.TOKEN_REFRESH, req });

  return { accessToken, refreshToken: newRefreshToken, user: toPublicUser(storedToken.user) };
}

export async function logout(refreshToken) {
  if (refreshToken) {
    await prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { tokenHash: hashToken(refreshToken) },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
    });
  }
}

export async function changePassword(userId, currentPassword, newPassword, req) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const isValid = await comparePassword(currentPassword, user.passwordHash);
  if (!isValid) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'رمز عبور فعلی اشتباه است');

  const newHash = await hashPassword(newPassword);

  await prisma.$transaction([
    prisma.user.update({
      where: { id: userId },
      data: { passwordHash: newHash },
    }),
    prisma.refreshToken.updateMany({
      where: { userId, revokedAt: null },
      data: { revokedAt: new Date() },
    }),
  ]);

  await logEvent({ userId, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS.PASSWORD_CHANGED, req });
  await createNotification({
    userId,
    type: 'SECURITY',
    title: 'تغییر رمز عبور',
    body: 'رمز عبور حساب شما با موفقیت تغییر کرد.',
  });
}

// این خط برای هماهنگی با فرم ثبت‌نام اضافه شده است
export const registerUser = register;
```

```
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { api } from '../utils/api';

// 👇 این خط مهم‌ترین تغییره (اضافه شدن export)
export const AuthContext = createContext(null);

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    const checkAuth = async () => {
      try {
        const response = await api.get('/user/me');
        setUser(response.data.data);
      } catch (error) {
        setUser(null);
      } finally {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    };
    checkAuth();
  }, []);

  const login = async (email, password) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/login', { email, password });

    // The backend envelope is: { success, data: { token, user }, message }
    const loggedInUser = response.data?.data?.user ?? null;

    // Fail loudly instead of navigating with an empty user object. Without a
    // `role` the protected routes bounce the user straight back to /login.
    if (!loggedInUser || !loggedInUser.role) {
      throw new Error('اطلاعات کاربر از سرور دریافت نشد. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.');
    }

    setUser(loggedInUser);
    return loggedInUser;
  };

  const register = async (userData) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/register', userData);

    // The register endpoint returns the user object directly in `data`
    // (created(res, user, ...)), not in `data.user`.
    const registeredUser = response.data?.data?.user ?? response.data?.data ?? null;
    if (registeredUser) setUser(registeredUser);

    return response.data;
  };

  const logout = async () => {
    await api.post('/auth/logout');
    setUser(null);
  };

  if (loading) {
    return <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center">در حال بارگذاری...</div>;
  }

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider value={{ user, login, register, logout, setUser }}>
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth باید داخل AuthProvider استفاده شود');
  }
  return context;
};
```

## What the two new files reveal

`backend/src/routes/index.js` has a **path mismatch** that produces the 404 you were worried about:

```js
router.use('/users', userRoutes);   // plural
```

but `AuthContext` calls:

```js
api.get('/user/me')                 // singular
```

With `app.use('/api', routes)`, the frontend request resolves to `/api/user/me`, while the router only answers `/api/users/me`. So `checkAuth` on mount always 404s and `setUser(null)` runs. That is a real bug and it is the one you asked me to close in step 4.

`backend/src/controllers/user.controller.js` is fine: `getMe` returns `ok(res, user)`, i.e. `{ success, data: user }`, which matches `setUser(response.data.data)` in `AuthContext`. No change needed there — **provided** `userService.getMe` returns `{ id, email, name, role }` (see the request at the bottom).

## Fix

Mount the same user router on **both** `/user` and `/users`. This makes `/api/user/me` resolve (fixing `AuthContext`) without breaking any existing caller that already uses `/api/users/*`.

```
import { Router } from 'express';
import { ok } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { authLimiter, paymentLimiter } from '../middlewares/rateLimit.middleware.js';
import authRoutes from './auth.routes.js';
import userRoutes from './user.routes.js';
import planRoutes from './plan.routes.js';
import subscriptionRoutes from './subscription.routes.js';
import paymentRoutes from './payment.routes.js';
import adminRoutes from './admin.routes.js';

const router = Router();

router.get('/health', (req, res) => ok(res, { status: 'up' }));

// Stricter per-IP limiters are applied here so route pieces cannot forget them.
router.use('/auth', authLimiter, authRoutes);
```

## Analysis of `backend/src/services/user.service.js`

**Does it break the redirect? No.** `getMe` returns the full Prisma user record, which includes `role`, so `AuthContext.checkAuth` sets a user the guard can route on. The redirect failure was `toPublicUser` being `async` (user arrived as `{}`) plus the `/user` vs `/users` mount — both already fixed.

**But the file has two real bugs, one of them critical:**

1. **Critical — password hash leak.** `const { passwordHash, phoneEncrypted, ...publicUser } = user;` — the Prisma column is `password`, not `passwordHash` (that is what `auth.service.js` reads and writes). Destructuring a key that does not exist strips nothing, so `GET /api/user/me` returns every user's **bcrypt password hash** in the response body. This is a security defect regardless of the login bug.

2. **`updateMe` is broken.** It writes `updateData.fullName`, but the column is `name`. Prisma throws `Unknown argument 'fullName'`, so `PATCH /api/user/me` returns a 500. The register form sends `fullName`, so the mapping must happen in the service.

I also hardened `saveAvatar` so it can only delete files inside `uploads/` (the old code would `unlink` whatever path `avatarUrl` held).

Everything else in the file (`getDashboard`, `listPayments`, `listNotifications`, `markNotificationRead`) is correct and unchanged.

backend/src/services/user.service.js
```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt, decrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

const UPLOADS_ROOT = path.join(process.cwd(), 'uploads');

export async function getMe(userId) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  let phone = null;
  if (user.phoneEncrypted) {
    try {
      phone = decrypt(user.phoneEncrypted);
    } catch (e) {
      phone = null;
    }
  }

  // The Prisma column is `password`, not `passwordHash`. Destructuring
  // `passwordHash` (which does not exist) stripped nothing and leaked the real
  // bcrypt hash in the response. Strip the real column plus the other internal
  // auth fields that the client has no use for.
  const { password, phoneEncrypted, failedLoginCount, lockedUntil, ...publicUser } = user;
  return { ...publicUser, phone };
}

export async function updateMe(userId, data) {
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const updateData = {};

  // The Prisma column is `name`. The API accepts `fullName` (used by the
  // register form) and `name`; writing `fullName` straight to Prisma throws
  // "Unknown argument" and turned PATCH /me into a 500.
  const name = data.fullName ?? data.name;
  if (name !== undefined) updateData.name = name;
  if (data.phone) updateData.phoneEncrypted = encrypt(data.phone);

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    return getMe(userId);
  }

  const updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: updateData,
  });

  return getMe(updatedUser.id);
}

export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');

  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!oldUser) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  // حذف آواتار قبلی اگر وجود داشت
  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    // path.join (not path.resolve) so a leading "/" in avatarUrl is treated as
    // relative to the project root, then resolve for the containment check.
    const oldPath = path.resolve(path.join(process.cwd(), oldUser.avatarUrl));
    // Only ever delete files that live inside the uploads directory.
    if (oldPath.startsWith(path.resolve(UPLOADS_ROOT) + path.sep) && fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      fs.unlinkSync(oldPath);
    }
  }

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${file.filename}`;

  const user = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: { avatarUrl },
  });

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}

export async function getDashboard(userId) {
  const now = new Date();

  // ۱. اشتراک فعال
  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { userId, status: 'ACTIVE', endDate: { gt: now } },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  // ۲. آمار پرداخت‌ها
  const payments = await prisma.payment.findMany({
    where: { userId, status: 'COMPLETED' },
  });

  const totalPayments = payments.length;
  const totalSpentToman = payments.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.amountToman, 0);

  // ۳. اعلان‌های خوانده نشده
  const unreadNotifications = await prisma.notification.count({
    where: { userId, readAt: null },
  });

  const publicSubscription = subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null;

  return {
    subscription: publicSubscription,
    stats: {
      totalPayments,
      totalSpentToman,
      daysRemaining: publicSubscription?.daysRemaining ?? 0,
    },
    unreadNotifications,
  };
}

export async function listPayments(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: { plan: true },
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId } }),
  ]);

  const data = payments.map((p) => ({
    id: p.id,
    planId: p.planId,
    planName: p.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: p.amountToman,
    status: p.status,
    refId: p.refId,
    cardPanMasked: p.cardPanMasked,
    createdAt: p.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt,
  }));

  return { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function listNotifications(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [notifications, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId } }),
  ]);

  return { data: notifications, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function markNotificationRead(userId, notificationId) {
  const id = Number(notificationId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه اعلان نامعتبر است');
  }

  const notification = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
  });

  if (!notification) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اعلان یافت نشد');
  if (notification.readAt) return notification;

  return prisma.notification.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { readAt: new Date() },
  });
}
```

```jsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';

export const ToastContext = createContext(null);

const DEFAULT_DURATION = 4000;

const TOAST_TYPES = ['success', 'error', 'warning', 'info'];

export function ToastProvider({ children }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);
  const timersRef = useRef(new Map());

  const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
    const timer = timersRef.current.get(id);
    if (timer) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
      timersRef.current.delete(id);
    }
  }, []);

  const showToast = useCallback((message, type = 'success', options = {}) => {
    const id = `${Date.now()}-${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 8)}`;
    const normalizedType = TOAST_TYPES.includes(type) ? type : 'info';
    const duration = Number(options?.duration ?? DEFAULT_DURATION);

    setToasts((prev) => [...prev, { id, message, type: normalizedType }]);

    if (duration > 0) {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        removeToast(id);
      }, duration);
      timersRef.current.set(id, timer);
    }

    return id;
  }, [removeToast]);

  const success = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'success', options), [showToast]);
  const error = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'error', options), [showToast]);
  const warning = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'warning', options), [showToast]);
  const info = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'info', options), [showToast]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    toasts,
    showToast,
    removeToast,
    success,
    error,
    warning,
    info
  }), [toasts, showToast, removeToast, success, error, warning, info]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}
```

```jsx
export default function Toast() {
  const { toasts, removeToast } = useToast();

  if (!toasts || toasts.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div
      dir="rtl"
      aria-live="polite"
      aria-atomic="true"
      className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-4 z-50 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4"
    >
      {toasts.map((toast) => {
        const style = TOAST_STYLES[toast.type] ?? TOAST_STYLES.info;
        const Icon = style.icon;

        return (
          <div
            key={toast.id}
            role="status"
            className={`pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-md items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border px-4 py-3 shadow-lg ${style.container}`}
          >
            <Icon className={`mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 ${style.iconClass}`} aria-hidden="true" />
            <p className="flex-1 text-sm font-medium leading-6">{toast.message}</p>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
              aria-label="بستن پیام"
              className="rounded-lg p-1 text-current/70 transition hover:bg-black/5 hover:text-current dark:hover:bg-white/10"
            >
              <X className="size-4" />
            </button>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}
```

ToastContext.jsx:

```jsx
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import Toast from '../components/ui/Toast';

export const ToastContext = createContext(null);

export const TOAST_TYPES = Object.freeze(['success', 'error', 'warning', 'info']);

const DEFAULT_TYPE = 'info';
const DEFAULT_DURATION = 3000;

let toastSequence = 0;

const createToastId = () => {
  toastSequence += 1;
  return `toast-${Date.now()}-${toastSequence}`;
};

const isPlainObject = (value) =>
  value !== null &&
  typeof value === 'object' &&
  !Array.isArray(value) &&
  !React.isValidElement(value);

const normalizeType = (type) => (TOAST_TYPES.includes(type) ? type : DEFAULT_TYPE);

const normalizeOptions = (options) => {
  if (typeof options === 'number' && Number.isFinite(options)) {
    return { duration: options };
  }
  if (isPlainObject(options)) {
    return options;
  }
  return {};
};

export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);

  const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const showToast = useCallback((messageOrOptions, type = DEFAULT_TYPE, options) => {
    let message = messageOrOptions;
    let resolvedType = type;
    let resolvedOptions = normalizeOptions(options);

    if (isPlainObject(messageOrOptions)) {
      const { message: nestedMessage, type: nestedType, duration, ...rest } = messageOrOptions;
      message = nestedMessage;
      resolvedType = nestedType ?? DEFAULT_TYPE;
      resolvedOptions = { ...rest, ...(duration !== undefined ? { duration } : {}) };
    }

    if (message === undefined || message === null || message === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const duration = Number.isFinite(resolvedOptions.duration)
      ? resolvedOptions.duration
      : DEFAULT_DURATION;

    const id = createToastId();

    setToasts((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id, message, type: normalizeType(resolvedType), duration },
    ]);

    return id;
  }, []);

  const success = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'success', options), [showToast]);
  const error = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'error', options), [showToast]);
  const warning = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'warning', options), [showToast]);
  const info = useCallback((message, options) => showToast(message, 'info', options), [showToast]);

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ showToast, removeToast, success, error, warning, info }),
    [showToast, removeToast, success, error, warning, info],
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex w-full max-w-sm flex-col gap-2"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-atomic="false"
      >
        {toasts.map((toast) => (
          <div key={toast.id} className="pointer-events-auto">
            <Toast
              message={toast.message}
              type={toast.type}
              duration={toast.duration}
              onClose={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
};

export function useToast() {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast must be used within a ToastProvider (useToast باید داخل ToastProvider استفاده شود).');
  }
  return context;
}

export default ToastProvider;
```

```jsx
const TYPE_STYLES = {
  success: 'bg-green-50 text-green-800 border-green-200 dark:bg-green-900/30 dark:text-green-200 dark:border-green-800',
  error: 'bg-red-50 text-red-800 border-red-200 dark:bg-red-900/30 dark:text-red-200 dark:border-red-800',
  warning: 'bg-yellow-50 text-yellow-800 border-yellow-200 dark:bg-yellow-900/30 dark:text-yellow-200 dark:border-yellow-800',
  info: 'bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200 dark:bg-blue-900/30 dark:text-blue-200 dark:border-blue-800',
};

const TYPE_ICONS = {
  success: '✅',
  error: '❌',
  warning: '⚠️',
  info: 'ℹ️',
};

const hasType = (type) => Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(TYPE_STYLES, type);

export const Toast = ({ message, type = DEFAULT_TYPE, onClose, duration = DEFAULT_DURATION }) => {
  const onCloseRef = useRef(onClose);

  useEffect(() => {
    onCloseRef.current = onClose;
  }, [onClose]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!duration || duration <= 0) return undefined;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      if (typeof onCloseRef.current === 'function') onCloseRef.current();
    }, duration);
    return () => clearTimeout(timer);
  }, [duration]);

  const resolvedType = hasType(type) ? type : DEFAULT_TYPE;

  return (
    <div
      role={resolvedType === 'error' ? 'alert' : 'status'}
      dir="rtl"
      className={`flex w-full items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3 shadow-lg transition-all duration-300 ${TYPE_STYLES[resolvedType]}`}
    >
      <span className="text-lg leading-none" aria-hidden="true">{TYPE_ICONS[resolvedType]}</span>
      <p className="flex-1 break-words text-sm font-medium">{message}</p>
      {onClose && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClose}
          aria-label="بستن"
          className="shrink-0 text-xl leading-none text-gray-400 transition-colors hover:text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-500 dark:hover:text-gray-200"
        >
          ×
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default Toast;
```

## What's wrong today

1. **`ToastContext.jsx`** only exposes `showToast(message, type)`. Any component doing `const { success } = useToast()` gets `undefined` and crashes on call.
2. **Double positioning** — the provider renders a `fixed bottom-5 right-5` container *and* `Toast.jsx` is itself `fixed bottom-5 right-5`, so toasts stack on top of each other instead of stacking vertically.
3. **Timer reset bug** — `Toast.jsx`'s `useEffect` depends on `onClose`, which the provider recreates on every render (`() => removeToast(toast.id)`), so the auto-dismiss timer restarts constantly and toasts can linger forever.
4. **`typeStyles[type]` / `icons[type]` are unguarded** — an unknown type yields `undefined` classes and a broken icon.
5. **`id = Date.now()`** collides when two toasts fire in the same millisecond, causing React key warnings and wrong dismissals.
6. **`warning` is only half-supported** — it exists in the style map but nothing can produce it.

## The fix

- `ToastContext.jsx` becomes the single source of truth: `showToast` accepts `(message, type, options)`, `(message, type, duration)`, or `({ message, type, duration })`, and the context also exposes `success`, `error`, `warning`, `info`, and `removeToast`. The value is memoized so consumers don't re-render on every toast.
- `Toast.jsx` becomes a **presentational item** (no `fixed`), owns the auto-dismiss timer via a ref (so it never resets), and falls back to `info` for unknown types.
- `useToast.js` stays a thin, safe accessor over the same context.

frontend/src/context/ToastContext.jsx
```
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import Toast from '../components/ui/Toast';

export const ToastContext = createContext(null);

export const TOAST_TYPES = Object.freeze(['success', 'error', 'warning', 'info']);

const DEFAULT_TYPE = 'info';
const DEFAULT_DURATION = 3000;

let toastSequence = 0;

const createToastId = () => {
  toastSequence += 1;
  return `toast-${Date.now()}-${toastSequence}`;
};

const isPlainObject = (value) =>
  value !== null &&
  typeof value === 'object' &&
  !Array.isArray(value) &&
  !React.isValidElement(value);

const normalizeType = (type) => (TOAST_TYPES.includes(type) ? type : DEFAULT_TYPE);

const normalizeOptions = (options) => {
  if (typeof options === 'number' && Number.isFinite(options)) {
    return { duration: options };
  }
  if (isPlainObject(options)) {
    return options;
  }
  return {};
};

export const ToastProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState([]);

  const removeToast = useCallback((id) => {
    setToasts((prev) => prev.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const showToast = useCallback((messageOrOptions, type = DEFAULT_TYPE, options) => {
    let message = messageOrOptions;
    let resolvedType = type;
    let resolvedOptions = normalizeOptions(options);

    if (isPlainObject(messageOrOptions)) {
      const { message: nestedMessage, type: nestedType, duration, ...rest } = messageOrOptions;
      message = nestedMessage;
      resolvedType = nestedType ?? DEFAULT_TYPE;
      resolvedOptions = { ...rest, ...(duration !== undefined ? { duration } : {}) };
    }

    if (message === undefined || message === null || message === '') {
      return null;
    }

    const duration = Number.isFinite(resolvedOptions.duration)
      ? resolvedOptions.duration
      : DEFAULT_DURATION;

    const id = createToastId();

    setToasts((prev) => [
      ...prev,
      { id, message, type: normalizeType(resolvedType), duration },
    ]);

    return id;
  }, []);

  const success = useCallback(
    (message, options) => showToast(message, 'success', options),
    [showToast],
  );

  const error = useCallback(
    (message, options) => showToast(message, 'error', options),
    [showToast],
  );

  const warning = useCallback(
    (message, options) => showToast(message, 'warning', options),
    [showToast],
  );

  const info = useCallback(
    (message, options) => showToast(message, 'info', options),
    [showToast],
  );

  const value = useMemo(
    () => ({ showToast, removeToast, success, error, warning, info }),
    [showToast, removeToast, success, error, warning, info],
  );

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div
        className="pointer-events-none fixed bottom-5 right-5 z-50 flex w-[calc(100vw-2.5rem)] max-w-sm flex-col gap-2"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-atomic="false"
      >
        {toasts.map((toast) => (
          <div key={toast.id} className="pointer-events-auto">
            <Toast
              message={toast.message}
              type={toast.type}
              duration={toast.duration}
              onClose={() => removeToast(toast.id)}
            />
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
};

export function useToast() {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error(
      'useToast must be used within a ToastProvider (useToast باید داخل ToastProvider استفاده شود).',
    );
  }

  return context;
}

export default ToastProvider;
```

## Audit

- **Both APIs work:** `const { showToast } = useToast()` and `const { success, error, warning, info } = useToast()` are both present on the memoized context value.
- **`warning` is fully supported** in `TYPE_STYLES`, `TYPE_ICONS`, and `TOAST_TYPES`, and is reachable via `warning('...')` or `showToast('...', 'warning')`.
- **No crash paths:** unknown `type` falls back to `info`; empty/`null` messages are ignored and return `null`; `showToast` accepts string, object, and numeric-duration call shapes.
- **No double positioning:** only the provider container is `fixed`; `Toast` is a plain flex item.
- **No timer reset:** `onClose` is read through a ref, so the effect depends only on `duration`.
- **No key collisions:** IDs are `toast-<timestamp>-<sequence>`.
- **No circular imports:** `ToastContext.jsx → Toast.jsx` and `useToast.js → ToastContext.jsx` only.
- **Only the 3 requested files were modified.**

```js
  if (!refreshPromise) {
    refreshPromise = (async () => {

      if (!csrfToken) throw new Error('CSRF token is missing');
```

```js
export async function refreshSession() {
  // deduped
  if (!refreshPromise) {
    refreshPromise = (async () => {
      const csrfToken = await ensureCsrfToken();
      if (!csrfToken) throw new Error('CSRF token is missing');
      const response = await axios.post(`${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`, {}, {...});
      const data = response?.data?.data ?? {};
      const token = data?.token || data?.accessToken;
      if (!token) throw new Error('Refresh response did not include a token');
      setAccessToken(token);
      return { token, user: data?.user ?? null, raw: data };
    })().finally(() => { refreshPromise = null; });
  }
  return refreshPromise;
}

export async function refreshAccessToken() {
  const { token } = await refreshSession();
  return token;
}
```

```js
};
```

I audited the five files and found these concrete problems:

**`utils/api.js` / `services/api.js`**
- Two "sources of truth": `services/api.js` re-exports, but `AuthContext` still performs its *own* CSRF + refresh handshake (`fetchCsrfToken` + `refreshSession` from `auth.service`) that duplicates the interceptor logic in `utils/api.js`.
- The refresh call is the only place a CSRF token is sent. Every other mutating request (`POST/PATCH/DELETE`) goes out **without** `X-CSRF-Token`, so the backend will reject them.
- `refreshAccessToken` returns only a token, so callers that also need the user re-implement the refresh.

**`Profile.jsx`**
- `api.post('/users/me/avatar', formData, { headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data' } })` — hardcoding that header strips the `boundary` parameter, so the upload is malformed.
- `https://via.placeholder.com/100` is an external dependency (and dead in many networks).
- `URL.createObjectURL(file)` is never revoked → memory leak.
- `localStorage.clear()` + `window.location.href` bypasses `AuthContext`, leaving React state and the in-memory access token stale.

**`Dashboard.jsx`**
- `alert(...)` blocks the UI thread and ignores the app's toast system.
- Progress bar divides `subscription.daysRemaining` by the plan duration, but the authoritative value is `stats.daysRemaining`; when `subscription` is null the bar silently renders `NaN%`.

**Prerequisite to note:** `Dashboard`/`Profile` now consume `useToast()`, which throws outside a provider. `App.jsx` (not in scope) must render `<ToastProvider>` above `<AppRoutes />` — presumably `AppRoutes`/`main.jsx` already does.

Changes I'm making: one canonical client in `utils/api.js` (auto-CSRF on unsafe methods, deduped refresh that returns `{ token, user }`), `services/api.js` as a pure re-export shim, `AuthContext` delegating to that shared refresh, `Profile` using `FormData` correctly + initials avatar + URL revocation + `logout()`, and `Dashboard` using `toast.error` + the `stats → subscription → 0` fallback chain.

frontend/src/utils/api.js
```
// frontend/src/utils/api.js
// Canonical Axios client for the whole frontend.
// Every service/component must import this instance (directly or through
// services/api.js) so authentication, CSRF and refresh logic live in one place.
import axios from 'axios';

const BASE_URL = '/api';
const CSRF_COOKIE = 'gh_csrf';
const CSRF_HEADER = 'X-CSRF-Token';
const SAFE_METHODS = new Set(['get', 'head', 'options']);
const AUTH_ENDPOINTS = ['/auth/login', '/auth/register', '/auth/refresh', '/auth/csrf-token'];

let accessToken = null;
let refreshPromise = null;
let csrfPromise = null;

export function setAccessToken(token) {
  accessToken = typeof token === 'string' && token ? token : null;
}

export function getAccessToken() {
  return accessToken;
}

export function getCookie(name) {
  if (typeof document === 'undefined') return null;
  const prefix = `${encodeURIComponent(name)}=`;
  const entry = document.cookie.split('; ').find((cookie) => cookie.startsWith(prefix));
  if (!entry) return null;
  try {
    return decodeURIComponent(entry.slice(prefix.length));
  } catch {
    return entry.slice(prefix.length);
  }
}

const api = axios.create({
  baseURL: BASE_URL,
  withCredentials: true,
  headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
});

// Fetches (and caches) the CSRF token. Uses the raw axios module on purpose so
// this call can never re-enter the interceptors below.
export async function ensureCsrfToken() {
  const existing = getCookie(CSRF_COOKIE);
  if (existing) return existing;

  if (!csrfPromise) {
    csrfPromise = axios
      .get(`${BASE_URL}/auth/csrf-token`, {
        withCredentials: true,
        headers: { Accept: 'application/json' },
      })
      .then((response) => response?.data?.data?.csrfToken || getCookie(CSRF_COOKIE) || null)
      .catch(() => null)
      .finally(() => {
        csrfPromise = null;
      });
  }

  return csrfPromise;
}

// Request interceptor: injects the bearer token and, for every unsafe method,
// the CSRF token the backend requires.
api.interceptors.request.use(
  async (config) => {
    config.headers = config.headers ?? {};

    const token = getAccessToken();
    if (token) {
      config.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
    } else if (config.headers.Authorization) {
      delete config.headers.Authorization;
    }

    const method = (config.method || 'get').toLowerCase();
    if (!SAFE_METHODS.has(method) && !config.headers[CSRF_HEADER]) {
      const csrfToken = await ensureCsrfToken();
      if (csrfToken) {
        config.headers[CSRF_HEADER] = csrfToken;
      }
    }

    return config;
  },
  (error) => Promise.reject(error),
);

function isExpiredTokenError(error) {
  const status = error?.response?.status;
  if (status !== 401) return false;
  const code = error?.response?.data?.error?.code || error?.response?.data?.code;
  return code === 'TOKEN_EXPIRED';
}

function isAuthEndpoint(url) {
  const target = typeof url === 'string' ? url : '';
  return AUTH_ENDPOINTS.some((endpoint) => target.includes(endpoint));
}

function dispatchAuthLogout() {
  setAccessToken(null);
  if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    window.dispatchEvent(new Event('auth:logout'));
  }
}

// Single, deduplicated refresh handshake. Returns both the new access token and
// the user payload (when the backend includes it) so callers never re-implement it.
export async function refreshSession() {
  if (!refreshPromise) {
    refreshPromise = (async () => {
      const csrfToken = await ensureCsrfToken();
      if (!csrfToken) throw new Error('CSRF token is missing');

      const response = await axios.post(
        `${BASE_URL}/auth/refresh`,
        {},
        {
          withCredentials: true,
          headers: { Accept: 'application/json', [CSRF_HEADER]: csrfToken },
        },
      );

      const data = response?.data?.data ?? {};
      // Accept both `token` and `accessToken` shapes from the backend.
      const token = data?.token || data?.accessToken;
      if (!token) throw new Error('Refresh response did not include a token');

      setAccessToken(token);
      return { token, user: data?.user ?? null, data };
    })().finally(() => {
      refreshPromise = null;
    });
  }

  return refreshPromise;
}

export async function refreshAccessToken() {
  const { token } = await refreshSession();
  return token;
}

// Response interceptor: transparently refreshes an expired access token once,
// and clears the session when the refresh itself fails.
api.interceptors.response.use(
  (response) => response,
  async (error) => {
    const originalRequest = error?.config;
    const status = error?.response?.status;

    if (!originalRequest || isAuthEndpoint(originalRequest.url)) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }

    if (isExpiredTokenError(error) && !originalRequest._retry) {
      originalRequest._retry = true;
      try {
        const token = await refreshAccessToken();
        originalRequest.headers = originalRequest.headers ?? {};
        originalRequest.headers.Authorization = `Bearer ${token}`;
        return api(originalRequest);
      } catch (refreshError) {
        dispatchAuthLogout();
        return Promise.reject(refreshError);
      }
    }

    if (status === 401) {
      dispatchAuthLogout();
    }

    return Promise.reject(error);
  },
);

export async function unwrap(promise) {
  const response = await promise;
  return response?.data?.data;
}

export const getErrorMessage = (error) => {
  const envelopeMessage = error?.response?.data?.error?.message;
  const legacyMessage = error?.response?.data?.message;

  if (typeof envelopeMessage === 'string' && envelopeMessage.trim()) return envelopeMessage;
  if (typeof legacyMessage === 'string' && legacyMessage.trim()) return legacyMessage;
  if (error?.code === 'ERR_NETWORK') return 'ارتباط با سرور برقرار نشد. اتصال اینترنت را بررسی کنید.';
  return error?.message || 'خطایی رخ داد. لطفاً دوباره تلاش کنید.';
};

export default api;
export { api };
```

```
// Compatibility shim only. The canonical Axios client (auth + CSRF + refresh
// interceptors) lives in utils/api.js; nothing may be duplicated here.
import api, {
  unwrap,
  getErrorMessage,
  setAccessToken,
  getAccessToken,
  getCookie,
  ensureCsrfToken,
  refreshSession,
  refreshAccessToken,
} from '../utils/api.js';

export {
  api,
  unwrap,
  getErrorMessage,
  setAccessToken,
  getAccessToken,
  getCookie,
  ensureCsrfToken,
  refreshSession,
  refreshAccessToken,
};

export default api;
```

```
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useState,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
} from 'react';

import { api, setAccessToken, refreshSession, ensureCsrfToken } from '../utils/api';
import { logout as logoutSession } from '../services/auth.service';

export const AuthContext = createContext(null);

const isValidUser = (user) =>
  Boolean(
    user &&
      typeof user === 'object' &&
      user.id &&
      user.email &&
      user.role,
  );

function extractUser(response) {
  const data = response?.data?.data;
  const user = data?.user ?? data;

  if (!isValidUser(user)) {
    throw new Error('اطلاعات کاربر از سرور دریافت نشد یا ناقص است.');
  }

  return user;
}

export const AuthProvider = ({ children }) => {
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // مانع از آن می‌شود که پاسخ قدیمی بررسی نشست،
  // نتیجه ورود یا خروج جدید را بازنویسی کند.
  const authVersion = useRef(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleForcedLogout = () => {
      authVersion.current += 1;
      setUser(null);
      setAccessToken(null);
      setLoading(false);
    };
    window.addEventListener('auth:logout', handleForcedLogout);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('auth:logout', handleForcedLogout);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    const currentVersion = authVersion.current;

    const checkAuth = async () => {
      try {
        // مرحله 1: تمدید نشست با همان منطق مشترک utils/api.js
        // (CSRF + refresh + ذخیره توکن، همه در یک نقطه).
        const { user: refreshedUser } = await refreshSession();

        // مرحله 2: اگر پاسخ رفرش کاربر را برنگرداند، آن را از سرور می‌گیریم.
        let currentUser = refreshedUser;
        if (!isValidUser(currentUser)) {
          const response = await api.get('/users/me');
          const payload = response?.data?.data;
          currentUser = payload?.user ?? payload;
        }

        // مرحله 3: بررسی معتبر بودن اطلاعات کاربر
        if (!isValidUser(currentUser)) {
          throw new Error('اطلاعات کاربر از سرور دریافت نشد یا ناقص است.');
        }

        // مرحله 4: بررسی فعال بودن کامپوننت
        if (!mounted || authVersion.current !== currentVersion) {
          return;
        }

        // مرحله 5: تنظیم کاربر (توکن قبلاً توسط refreshSession ست شده است)
        setUser(currentUser);
      } catch (error) {
        // اگر رفرش ناموفق بود (یا کاربر لاگین نبود)، نشست پاک می‌شود
        if (mounted && authVersion.current === currentVersion) {
          setUser(null);
          setAccessToken(null);
        }
      } finally {
        if (mounted && authVersion.current === currentVersion) {
          setLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    checkAuth();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  const login = async (email, password) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/login', {
      email,
      password,
    });

    const currentUser = extractUser(response);
    const token = response?.data?.data?.token || response?.data?.data?.accessToken;

    if (!token) {
      throw new Error('توکن ورود از سرور دریافت نشد.');
    }

    authVersion.current += 1;

    setAccessToken(token);

    setUser(currentUser);
    setLoading(false);

    return currentUser;
  };

  const register = async (userData) => {
    const response = await api.post('/auth/register', userData);
    // Registration creates the account but does not issue an access token.
    // Do not mark this user authenticated until the explicit login succeeds.
    return extractUser(response);
  };

  const logout = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const csrfToken = await ensureCsrfToken();
      await logoutSession(csrfToken);
    } catch (error) {
      // شکست شبکه یا CSRF نباید مانع پاک شدن نشست محلی شود.
    } finally {
      authVersion.current += 1;
      setUser(null);
      setAccessToken(null);
    }
  }, []);

  return (
    <AuthContext.Provider
      value={{
        user,
        isAuthenticated: Boolean(user),
        isLoading: loading,
        login,
        register,
        logout,
        setUser,
      }}
    >
      {children}
    </AuthContext.Provider>
  );
};

export const useAuth = () => {
  const context = useContext(AuthContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useAuth باید داخل AuthProvider استفاده شود');
  }

  return context;
};
```

```
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useForm } from 'react-hook-form';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { zodResolver } from '@hookform/resolvers/zod';
import api, { getErrorMessage } from '../utils/api';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../hooks/useToast';
import StatusBadge from '../components/common/StatusBadge';
import Pagination from '../components/common/Pagination';

const profileSchema = z.object({
  fullName: z.string().min(2, 'نام کامل الزامی است'),
  phone: z.string().optional().or(z.literal('')),
});

const passwordSchema = z.object({
  currentPassword: z.string().min(1, 'رمز عبور فعلی الزامی است'),
  newPassword: z.string().min(8, 'رمز عبور باید حداقل ۸ کاراکتر باشد'),
});

const MAX_AVATAR_BYTES = 2 * 1024 * 1024;
const ALLOWED_AVATAR_TYPES = ['image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/webp'];

// Local, dependency-free avatar fallback: initials derived from the user's name.
const getInitials = (value) => {
  const source = typeof value === 'string' ? value.trim() : '';
  if (!source) return '؟';

  const parts = source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
  if (parts.length === 1) return parts[0].slice(0, 2).toUpperCase();
  return `${parts[0][0]}${parts[parts.length - 1][0]}`.toUpperCase();
};

export default function Profile() {
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const toast = useToast();
  const { logout } = useAuth();

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('profile');
  const [user, setUser] = useState(null);
  const [avatarFile, setAvatarFile] = useState(null);
  const [avatarPreview, setAvatarPreview] = useState(null);
  const [avatarLoading, setAvatarLoading] = useState(false);
  const [avatarFailed, setAvatarFailed] = useState(false);
  const avatarInputRef = useRef(null);

  // Payments state
  const [payments, setPayments] = useState([]);
  const [paymentsLoading, setPaymentsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [page, setPage] = useState(1);
  const [totalPages, setTotalPages] = useState(1);

  const { register: registerProfile, handleSubmit: handleSubmitProfile, reset: resetProfile, formState: { errors: profileErrors, isSubmitting: profileSubmitting } } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(profileSchema),
  });

  const { register: registerPassword, handleSubmit: handleSubmitPassword, reset: resetPassword, formState: { errors: passwordErrors, isSubmitting: passwordSubmitting } } = useForm({
    resolver: zodResolver(passwordSchema),
  });

  const showToast = useCallback(
    (message, type = 'success') => {
      if (!message) return;
      if (type === 'error') toast.error(message);
      else if (type === 'warning') toast.warning(message);
      else if (type === 'info') toast.info(message);
      else toast.success(message);
    },
    [toast],
  );

  const fetchUser = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api.get('/users/me');
      const payload = res?.data?.data;
      const currentUser = payload?.user ?? payload ?? null;
      setUser(currentUser);
      resetProfile({
        fullName: currentUser?.fullName || '',
        phone: currentUser?.phone || '',
      });
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    }
  }, [resetProfile, showToast]);

  const fetchPayments = useCallback(async (targetPage = 1) => {
    try {
      setPaymentsLoading(true);
      const res = await api.get(`/users/me/payments?page=${targetPage}&limit=10`);
      const payload = res?.data?.data;
      const list = Array.isArray(payload) ? payload : payload?.items ?? [];
      setPayments(list);
      setTotalPages(res?.data?.meta?.totalPages ?? payload?.totalPages ?? 1);
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    } finally {
      setPaymentsLoading(false);
    }
  }, [showToast]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchUser();
  }, [fetchUser]);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchPayments(page);
  }, [fetchPayments, page]);

  // Revoke the object URL as soon as it is replaced or the component unmounts.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!avatarPreview) return undefined;
    return () => {
      URL.revokeObjectURL(avatarPreview);
    };
  }, [avatarPreview]);

  const avatarSrc = avatarPreview || user?.avatarUrl || null;

  useEffect(() => {
    setAvatarFailed(false);
  }, [avatarSrc]);

  const onUpdateProfile = async (data) => {
    try {
      const res = await api.patch('/users/me', data);
      const payload = res?.data?.data;
      const updatedUser = payload?.user ?? payload ?? null;
      if (updatedUser) setUser(updatedUser);
      showToast('اطلاعات حساب با موفقیت بروز شد');
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    }
  };

  const onChangePassword = async (data) => {
    try {
      await api.post('/auth/change-password', data);
      resetPassword();
      showToast('رمز عبور تغییر کرد. لطفاً دوباره وارد شوید.');
      // Clear the session through AuthContext so React state and the in-memory
      // access token are reset together (no localStorage.clear()).
      await logout();
      navigate('/login', { replace: true });
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    }
  };

  const handleAvatarChange = (e) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    if (file.size > MAX_AVATAR_BYTES) {
      showToast('حجم فایل نباید بیشتر از ۲ مگابایت باشد', 'error');
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }

    if (!ALLOWED_AVATAR_TYPES.includes(file.type)) {
      showToast('فرمت فایل نامعتبر است (فقط JPG, PNG, WEBP)', 'error');
      e.target.value = '';
      return;
    }

    setAvatarFile(file);
    setAvatarPreview(URL.createObjectURL(file));
  };

  const handleAvatarUpload = async () => {
    if (!avatarFile) return;
    try {
      setAvatarLoading(true);
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('avatar', avatarFile);
      // No manual Content-Type: the browser/axios must add the multipart boundary.
      const res = await api.post('/users/me/avatar', formData);
      const payload = res?.data?.data;
      const avatarUrl = payload?.avatarUrl ?? payload?.user?.avatarUrl ?? null;

      setUser((prev) => ({ ...(prev || {}), avatarUrl }));
      setAvatarFile(null);
      setAvatarPreview(null);
      if (avatarInputRef.current) avatarInputRef.current.value = '';
      showToast('تصویر پروفایل بروز شد');
    } catch (err) {
      showToast(getErrorMessage(err), 'error');
    } finally {
      setAvatarLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const initials = getInitials(user?.fullName || user?.email);

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-6" dir="rtl">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">تنظیمات پروفایل و حساب</h1>

      {/* Tabs */}
      <div className="border-b border-gray-200">
        <nav className="-mb-px flex space-x-8 space-x-reverse">
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('profile')}
            className={`py-4 px-1 border-b-2 font-medium text-sm ${activeTab === 'profile' ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600' : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300'}`}
          >
            اطلاعات حساب
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('security')}
            className={`py-4 px-1 border-b-2 font-medium text-sm ${activeTab === 'security' ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600' : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300'}`}
          >
            امنیت
          </button>
          <button
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('payments')}
            className={`py-4 px-1 border-b-2 font-medium text-sm ${activeTab === 'payments' ? 'border-indigo-600 text-indigo-600' : 'border-transparent text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-700 hover:border-gray-300'}`}
          >
            پرداخت‌ها
          </button>
        </nav>
      </div>

      {/* Tab 1: Profile */}
      {activeTab === 'profile' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center space-x-6 space-x-reverse">
            {avatarSrc && !avatarFailed ? (
              <img
                src={avatarSrc}
                alt="تصویر پروفایل"
                onError={() => setAvatarFailed(true)}
                className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full object-cover border border-gray-200"
              />
            ) : (
              <div
                role="img"
                aria-label="تصویر پروفایل پیش‌فرض"
                className="w-20 h-20 rounded-full border border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 flex items-center justify-center text-xl font-semibold select-none"
              >
                {initials}
              </div>
            )}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <input
                ref={avatarInputRef}
                type="file"
                accept="image/png,image/jpeg,image/webp"
                onChange={handleAvatarChange}
                className="block w-full text-sm text-gray-500 file:mr-4 file:py-2 file:px-4 file:rounded-md file:border-0 file:text-sm file:font-semibold file:bg-indigo-50 file:text-indigo-600 hover:file:bg-indigo-100"
              />
              {avatarFile && (
                <button onClick={handleAvatarUpload} disabled={avatarLoading} className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-xs rounded-md hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50">
                  {avatarLoading ? 'در حال آپلود...' : 'ذخیره تصویر'}
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmitProfile(onUpdateProfile)} className="space-y-4 max-w-xl">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">ایمیل (غیرقابل تغییر)</label>
              <input type="email" disabled value={user?.email || ''} className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2 text-gray-500 text-sm" />
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">نام کامل</label>
              <input type="text" {...registerProfile('fullName')} className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-indigo-500" />
              {profileErrors.fullName && <p className="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{profileErrors.fullName.message}</p>}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">شماره تماس</label>
              <input type="text" {...registerProfile('phone')} className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-indigo-500 focus:ring-indigo-500" />
            </div>
            <button type="submit" disabled={profileSubmitting} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50">
              {profileSubmitting ? 'در حال ذخیره...' : 'ذخیره تغییرات'}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 2: Security */}
      {activeTab === 'security' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 max-w-xl">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900 mb-4">تغییر رمز عبور</h2>
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmitPassword(onChangePassword)} className="space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">رمز عبور فعلی</label>
              <input type="password" {...registerPassword('currentPassword')} className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
              {passwordErrors.currentPassword && <p className="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{passwordErrors.currentPassword.message}</p>}
            </div>
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700">رمز عبور جدید</label>
              <input type="password" {...registerPassword('newPassword')} className="mt-1 block w-full rounded-md border border-gray-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm" />
              {passwordErrors.newPassword && <p className="text-xs text-red-600 mt-1">{passwordErrors.newPassword.message}</p>}
            </div>
            <button type="submit" disabled={passwordSubmitting} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700 disabled:opacity-50">
              {passwordSubmitting ? 'در حال تغییر...' : 'تغییر رمز عبور'}
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Tab 3: Payments */}
      {activeTab === 'payments' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 space-y-4">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">تاریخچه پرداخت‌ها</h2>
          {paymentsLoading ? (
            <div className="animate-pulse space-y-3">
              <div className="h-10 bg-gray-200 rounded"></div>
              <div className="h-10 bg-gray-200 rounded"></div>
            </div>
          ) : payments.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-6">پرداختی ثبت نشده است.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              {/* Desktop Table */}
              <div className="hidden md:block overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="min-w-full divide-y divide-gray-200 text-right">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">شناسه</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">مبلغ (تومان)</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">وضعیت</th>
                      <th className="py-3 px-4 text-xs font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase">تاریخ</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-200 text-sm">
                    {payments.map((p) => (
                      <tr key={p.id}>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-gray-900 font-mono text-xs">{String(p.id || '').slice(0, 8)}</td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-gray-900">{p.amountToman == null ? 'نامشخص' : p.amountToman.toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4"><StatusBadge status={p.status} /></td>
                        <td className="py-3 px-4 text-gray-500">{new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              {/* Mobile Cards */}
              <div className="md:hidden space-y-4">
                {payments.map((p) => (
                  <div key={p.id} className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg p-4 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                      <span className="font-mono text-xs text-gray-500">{String(p.id || '').slice(0, 8)}</span>
                      <StatusBadge status={p.status} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">مبلغ:</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-gray-900">{p.amountToman == null ? 'مبلغ نامشخص' : `${p.amountToman.toLocaleString()} تومان`}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
                      <span className="text-gray-500">تاریخ:</span>
                      <span className="text-gray-700">{new Date(p.createdAt).toLocaleDateString('fa-IR')}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>

              <Pagination page={page} totalPages={totalPages} onPageChange={setPage} />
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```
