import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import api, { getErrorMessage } from '../utils/api';
import { useToast } from '../hooks/useToast';
import StatusBadge from '../components/common/StatusBadge';

export default function Dashboard() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [dashboardData, setDashboardData] = useState(null);
  const [notifications, setNotifications] = useState([]);
  const [showCancelModal, setShowCancelModal] = useState(false);
  const [canceling, setCanceling] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState(null);

  const fetchDashboard = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      setError(null);
      const res = await api.get('/users/me/dashboard');
      setDashboardData(res?.data?.data ?? null);

      const notifRes = await api.get('/users/me/notifications?limit=5');
      const notifPayload = notifRes?.data?.data;
      setNotifications(Array.isArray(notifPayload) ? notifPayload : notifPayload?.items ?? []);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(getErrorMessage(err) || 'خطا در دریافت اطلاعات داشبورد');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDashboard();
  }, [fetchDashboard]);

  const handleCancelSubscription = async () => {
    try {
      setCanceling(true);
      await api.post('/subscriptions/me/cancel');
      setShowCancelModal(false);
      await fetchDashboard();
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(getErrorMessage(err) || 'خطا در لغو اشتراک');
    } finally {
      setCanceling(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMarkAsRead = async (id) => {
    try {
      await api.patch(`/users/me/notifications/${id}/read`);
      setNotifications((prev) =>
        prev.map((n) => (n.id === id ? { ...n, readAt: new Date().toISOString() } : n)),
      );
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error(getErrorMessage(err) || 'خطا در علامت‌گذاری اعلان');
    }
  };

  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-8 animate-pulse space-y-6">
        <div className="h-8 bg-gray-200 rounded w-1/4"></div>
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          <div className="h-32 bg-gray-200 rounded-xl"></div>
          <div className="h-32 bg-gray-200 rounded-xl"></div>
          <div className="h-32 bg-gray-200 rounded-xl"></div>
        </div>
        <div className="h-64 bg-gray-200 rounded-xl"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 py-12 text-center">
        <p className="text-red-600 mb-4">{error}</p>
        <button onClick={fetchDashboard} className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded-lg">تلاش مجدد</button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const { subscription, stats, unreadNotifications } = dashboardData || {};

  // Single source of truth for the remaining days: stats first, then the
  // subscription record, then zero (never NaN).
  const daysRemaining = stats?.daysRemaining ?? subscription?.daysRemaining ?? 0;
  const planDurationDays = subscription?.plan?.durationDays || 30;
  const progressPercent = Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (daysRemaining / planDurationDays) * 100));

  const formattedEndsAt = subscription?.endsAt
    ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', { dateStyle: 'medium', calendar: 'persian' }).format(new Date(subscription.endsAt))
    : null;

  return (
    <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-8 space-y-8" dir="rtl">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">داشبورد کاربری</h1>
      </div>

      {/* Stats Cards */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">کل پرداخت‌ها</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{stats?.totalPayments || 0}</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">مجموع هزینه کرد</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-gray-900">{(stats?.totalSpentToman || 0).toLocaleString()} تومان</p>
        </div>
        <div className="bg-white p-6 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100">
          <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">روزهای باقی‌مانده اشتراک</p>
          <p className="mt-2 text-3xl font-semibold text-indigo-600">{daysRemaining} روز</p>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Subscription Card */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">وضعیت اشتراک</h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">مدیریت طرح و اشتراک فعلی شما</p>
          </div>
          {subscription ? <StatusBadge status={subscription.status} /> : <StatusBadge status="EXPIRED" />}
        </div>

        {subscription ? (
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
              <span className="font-medium text-gray-700">طرح: {subscription.plan?.name}</span>
              <span className="text-gray-500">انقضا: {formattedEndsAt}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="w-full bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2.5">
              <div
                className="bg-indigo-600 h-2.5 rounded-full"
                style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
              ></div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex space-x-3 space-x-reverse pt-2">
              <Link to="/pricing" className="px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700">
                تمدید / ارتقا
              </Link>
              {subscription.status === 'ACTIVE' && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowCancelModal(true)}
                  className="px-4 py-2 border border-red-300 text-red-600 text-sm font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50"
                >
                  لغو تمدید خودکار / لغو اشتراک
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center py-6 space-y-4">
            <p className="text-gray-500">شما در حال حاضر اشتراک فعالی ندارید.</p>
            <Link to="/pricing" className="inline-block px-4 py-2 bg-indigo-600 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg hover:bg-indigo-700">
              خرید اشتراک
            </Link>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Notifications Section */}
      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-6 space-y-4">
        <h2 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">اعلان‌ها {unreadNotifications > 0 && <span className="bg-red-100 text-red-800 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{unreadNotifications} خوانده نشده</span>}</h2>
        {notifications.length === 0 ? (
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 text-center py-4">اعلانی وجود ندارد.</p>
        ) : (
          <div className="divide-y divide-gray-100">
            {notifications.map((n) => (
              <div key={n.id} className={`py-3 flex justify-between items-center ${!n.readAt ? 'bg-indigo-50/50 px-3 rounded-lg' : ''}`}>
                <div>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{n.title}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">{n.body}</p>
                </div>
                {!n.readAt && (
                  <button onClick={() => handleMarkAsRead(n.id)} className="text-xs text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800 font-medium">
                    علامت به عنوان خوانده شده
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Cancel Modal */}
      {showCancelModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black bg-opacity-50">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl p-6 max-w-md w-full mx-4 space-y-4">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-medium text-gray-900">لغو تمدید اشتراک</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">آیا مطمئن هستید که می‌خواهید اشتراک خود را لغو کنید؟ اشتراک شما تا پایان تاریخ اعتبار فعال باقی خواهد ماند.</p>
            <div className="flex justify-end space-x-3 space-x-reverse pt-4">
              <button onClick={() => setShowCancelModal(false)} className="px-4 py-2 border border-gray-300 text-gray-700 text-sm rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-50">
                انصراف
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleCancelSubscription}
                disabled={canceling}
                className="px-4 py-2 bg-red-600 text-white text-sm rounded-lg hover:bg-red-700 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {canceling ? 'در حال لغو...' : 'تایید لغو'}
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function ProtectedRoute({ allowedRoles }) {
  const { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div dir="rtl" className="flex min-h-[50vh] items-center justify-center" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-4 text-sm text-slate-600 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300">

          در حال بررسی نشست کاربری...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  }

  if (allowedRoles && !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}

import React from 'react';
import { Outlet, Link, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext';

const ADMIN_ROLES = ['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'];

const DashboardLayout = () => {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();

  // The API returns `fullName`; older payloads used `name`. Support both.
  const displayName = user?.fullName || user?.name || 'کاربر';
  const avatarInitial = (user?.fullName || user?.name || '').trim().charAt(0) || 'U';
  const isAdmin = ADMIN_ROLES.includes(user?.role);

  const handleLogout = async () => {
    await logout();
    navigate('/login');
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex bg-gray-50" dir="rtl">
      {/* سایدبار */}
      <aside className="w-64 bg-white border-l border-gray-200 flex flex-col">
        <div className="p-6 text-2xl font-bold text-blue-600 border-b border-gray-100">
          Grid Hand
        </div>
        <nav className="flex-1 p-4 space-y-2">
          <Link to="/dashboard" className="block px-4 py-2 text-gray-700 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded-lg transition-colors">
            داشبورد
          </Link>
          <Link to="/pricing" className="block px-4 py-2 text-gray-700 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded-lg transition-colors">
            خرید اشتراک
          </Link>
          <Link to="/profile" className="block px-4 py-2 text-gray-700 hover:bg-blue-50 hover:text-blue-600 rounded-lg transition-colors">
            پروفایل کاربری
          </Link>
          {isAdmin && (
            <Link to="/admin" className="block px-4 py-2 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors font-medium mt-4 border-t border-gray-100 pt-4">
              پنل مدیریت
            </Link>
          )}
        </nav>
        <div className="p-4 border-t border-gray-200">
          <button onClick={handleLogout} className="w-full text-right px-4 py-2 text-gray-600 hover:text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50 rounded-lg transition-colors">
            خروج از حساب
          </button>
        </div>
      </aside>

      {/* بخش اصلی */}
      <main className="flex-1 flex flex-col">
        <header className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 p-4 flex justify-between items-center">
          <h2 className="text-lg font-semibold text-gray-800">خوش آمدید، {displayName}</h2>
          <div className="w-10 h-10 bg-blue-100 text-blue-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold">
            {avatarInitial}
          </div>
        </header>
        <div className="p-6 flex-1 overflow-auto">
          <Outlet /> {/* اینجا صفحات داخلی مثل داشبورد لود میشن */}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
};

export default DashboardLayout;

frontend/src/components/auth/ProtectedRoute.jsx
```
import React from 'react';
import { Navigate, Outlet, useLocation } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../../context/AuthContext.jsx';

/**
 * Single route guard used by AppRoutes.jsx.
 *
 * - No `allowedRoles`  -> any authenticated user may pass.
 * - With `allowedRoles` -> the user's role must be in the list, otherwise the
 *   request is redirected to /unauthorized (which AppRoutes.jsx registers).
 */
export default function ProtectedRoute({ allowedRoles }) {
  const { user, isAuthenticated, isLoading } = useAuth();
  const location = useLocation();

  // تا زمانی که وضعیت احراز هویت در حال بررسی است، لودینگ نمایش داده شود
  if (isLoading) {
    return (
      <div
        dir="rtl"
        className="flex min-h-[50vh] items-center justify-center"
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
      >
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white px-5 py-4 text-sm text-slate-600 shadow-sm dark:border-slate-800 dark:bg-slate-900 dark:text-slate-300">
          <span className="size-5 animate-spin rounded-full border-2 border-violet-600 border-t-transparent" />
          در حال بررسی نشست کاربری...
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // اگر کاربر احراز هویت نشده یا اطلاعات کاربر وجود ندارد، به صفحه لاگین هدایت شود
  if (!isAuthenticated || !user) {
    return <Navigate to="/login" replace state={{ from: location }} />;
  }

  // بررسی دسترسی بر اساس نقش کاربر (در صورت نیاز)
  if (allowedRoles && !allowedRoles.includes(user.role)) {
    return <Navigate to="/unauthorized" replace />;
  }

  return <Outlet />;
}
```

frontend/src/routes/AppRoutes.jsx
```
import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';

import Layout from '../components/layout/Layout.jsx';
import DashboardLayout from '../components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx';
import AdminLayout from '../components/layout/AdminLayout.jsx';
import ProtectedRoute from '../components/auth/ProtectedRoute.jsx';

import Home from '../pages/Home.jsx';
import Login from '../pages/Login.jsx';
import Register from '../pages/Register.jsx';
import Dashboard from '../pages/Dashboard.jsx';
import Profile from '../pages/Profile.jsx';
import Pricing from '../pages/Pricing.jsx';
import Checkout from '../pages/Checkout.jsx';
import PaymentResult from '../pages/PaymentResult.jsx';
import Unauthorized from '../pages/Unauthorized.jsx';
import NotFound from '../pages/NotFound.jsx';

import AdminDashboard from '../pages/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx';
import Users from '../pages/admin/Users.jsx';
import Payments from '../pages/admin/Payments.jsx';
import AuditLogs from '../pages/admin/AuditLogs.jsx';
import Documents from '../pages/admin/Documents.jsx';

const ADMIN_ROLES = ['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'];

export function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route element={<Layout />}>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
        <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />
        <Route path="/pricing" element={<Pricing />} />
        <Route path="/payment/result" element={<PaymentResult />} />
        <Route path="/unauthorized" element={<Unauthorized />} />
      </Route>

      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
        <Route element={<DashboardLayout />}>
          <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
          <Route path="/profile" element={<Profile />} />
          <Route path="/checkout" element={<Navigate to="/pricing" replace />} />
          <Route path="/checkout/:planId" element={<Checkout />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={ADMIN_ROLES} />}>
        <Route element={<AdminLayout />}>
          <Route path="/admin" element={<AdminDashboard />} />
          <Route path="/admin/users" element={<Users />} />
          <Route path="/admin/payments" element={<Payments />} />
          <Route path="/admin/audit-logs" element={<AuditLogs />} />
          <Route path="/admin/documents" element={<Documents />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
    </Routes>
  );
}

export default AppRoutes;
```

async function runOcrSync(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Recover claims abandoned by a previous process (app killed mid-upload).
  await db.runAsync(
    `UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='RETRY_UPLOAD', next_attempt_at=NULL, updated_at=?
     WHERE owner_user_id=? AND status='UPLOADING' AND updated_at<=?`,
    [now, userId, new Date(Date.now() - UPLOAD_CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS).toISOString()],
  );

  const uploadRows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    `SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND status IN ('PENDING_UPLOAD','RETRY_UPLOAD')
     AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=?) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 5`, [userId, now]);

  for (const row of uploadRows) {
    const claim = await db.runAsync(
      `UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='UPLOADING', updated_at=?
       WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=? AND status IN ('PENDING_UPLOAD','RETRY_UPLOAD')`,
      [new Date().toISOString(), row.local_id, userId],
    );
    if (Number(claim?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) continue;
    try {

      await db.runAsync("UPDATE ocr_queue SET remote_job_id=?,status='UPLOADED',retry_count=0,next_attempt_at=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=? AND status='UPLOADING'", ...)
    } catch (error) {
      ... set RETRY_UPLOAD where status='UPLOADING'
    }
  }
  ...
}
```

I reviewed the four files and found the following issues:

1. **`repository.ts` — `queueOrUpdateOutbox`**: it coalesces into any `PENDING` **or** `RETRY` row. A row that already failed a push (`retry_count > 0`) must not be mutated in place, otherwise the retry backoff/attempt bookkeeping is silently reset and the server may see a mutated payload for an operation it already partially processed. Coalescing must be limited to `status = 'PENDING' AND retry_count = 0`.

2. **`queue.ts` — `syncOcrQueue`**: it is a plain `async` function, so every caller (auto-sync, camera capture, camera retry, camera poll timer) runs its own full pass. Two passes can select the same `PENDING_UPLOAD` row and both `POST /ocr`, creating duplicate remote jobs. Fix: (a) an in-process per-user promise lock so concurrent callers share one pass, and (b) an atomic SQLite claim (`UPDATE ... SET status='UPLOADING' WHERE status IN ('PENDING_UPLOAD','RETRY_UPLOAD')` and check `changes === 1`) so a row can only be uploaded by the pass that won the claim. Also add recovery for claims abandoned by a killed process.

3. **`camera.tsx`**: the polling loop calls `syncOcrQueue` every 4s, which is the main source of the duplicate uploads. The loop should only read local state; the initial upload is already triggered by `capture`/`retry` and by auto-sync.

4. **`transport.ts`**: `runSync` can be invoked concurrently (auto-sync + manual), duplicating push/pull and OCR passes. Add a per-user in-process lock that coalesces concurrent runs.

import { randomUUID } from 'expo-crypto';
import { getDatabase } from '../database';

type NotebookEntry = { userId: string; entryId?: string; title: string; body: string; version?: number };
type FormDraft = { userId: string; draftId?: string; formType: string; payload: unknown; version?: number };
const scopedLocalId = (userId: string, id: string) => `${userId}:${id}`;

async function queueOrUpdateOutbox(db: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>, values: {
  operationId: string; userId: string; moduleName: string; entityType: string; entityId: string;
  operation: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE'; baseVersion?: number; payload: unknown; now: string;
}) {
  // Only coalesce into a row that has never been attempted. A row that already
  // failed a push (retry_count > 0) or is mid-flight (RETRY) must be left alone
  // so its retry bookkeeping and payload stay consistent with what the server saw.
  const pending = await db.getFirstAsync<{ operation_id: string }>(
    `SELECT operation_id FROM outbox WHERE owner_user_id=? AND module_name=? AND entity_type=? AND entity_id=?
     AND status='PENDING' AND COALESCE(retry_count,0)=0 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`,
    [values.userId, values.moduleName, values.entityType, values.entityId],
  );
  if (pending) {
    await db.runAsync('UPDATE outbox SET payload_json=?, updated_at=?, last_error=NULL WHERE operation_id=?',
      [JSON.stringify(values.payload), values.now, pending.operation_id]);
    return pending.operation_id;
  }
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO outbox(operation_id,owner_user_id,module_name,entity_type,entity_id,operation,base_version,payload_json,status,created_at,updated_at)
     VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'PENDING',?,?)`,
    [values.operationId, values.userId, values.moduleName, values.entityType, values.entityId, values.operation,
      values.baseVersion ?? null, JSON.stringify(values.payload), values.now, values.now],
  );
  return values.operationId;
}

export async function saveNotebookEntry(input: NotebookEntry): Promise<string> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const entryId = input.entryId ?? randomUUID();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const operationId = randomUUID();
  const localId = scopedLocalId(input.userId, entryId);
  await db.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    const existing = await db.getFirstAsync<{ version: number; server_version: number; sync_status: string }>(
      'SELECT version, server_version, sync_status FROM notebook_entries WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, input.userId]);
    if (existing?.sync_status === 'CONFLICT') throw new Error('ابتدا تعارض همگام‌سازی این یادداشت را تعیین تکلیف کنید');
    const localVersion = existing ? Number(existing.version) + 1 : 1;
    await db.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO notebook_entries(entry_id,owner_user_id,title,body,version,server_version,sync_status,updated_at)
       VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?, 'PENDING',?)
       ON CONFLICT(entry_id) DO UPDATE SET title=excluded.title, body=excluded.body,
       version=notebook_entries.version+1, sync_status='PENDING', updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
      [localId, input.userId, input.title, input.body, localVersion, existing?.server_version ?? 0, now],
    );
    await queueOrUpdateOutbox(db, { operationId, userId: input.userId, moduleName: 'notebook', entityType: 'NotebookEntry', entityId: entryId,
      operation: existing?.server_version ? 'UPDATE' : 'CREATE', baseVersion: existing?.server_version || undefined,
      payload: { entryId, title: input.title, body: input.body }, now });
  });
  return entryId;
}

export async function saveFormDraft(input: FormDraft): Promise<string> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const draftId = input.draftId ?? randomUUID();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const operationId = randomUUID();
  const payload = { draftId, formType: input.formType, values: input.payload };
  const localId = scopedLocalId(input.userId, draftId);
  await db.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    const existing = await db.getFirstAsync<{ version: number; server_version: number; sync_status: string }>(
      'SELECT version, server_version, sync_status FROM form_drafts WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, input.userId]);
    if (existing?.sync_status === 'CONFLICT') throw new Error('ابتدا تعارض همگام‌سازی این فرم را تعیین تکلیف کنید');
    const localVersion = existing ? Number(existing.version) + 1 : 1;
    await db.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO form_drafts(draft_id,owner_user_id,form_type,payload_json,version,server_version,sync_status,updated_at)
       VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?, 'PENDING',?)
       ON CONFLICT(draft_id) DO UPDATE SET payload_json=excluded.payload_json,
       version=form_drafts.version+1, sync_status='PENDING', updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
      [localId, input.userId, input.formType, JSON.stringify(input.payload), localVersion, existing?.server_version ?? 0, now],
    );
    await queueOrUpdateOutbox(db, { operationId, userId: input.userId, moduleName: 'forms', entityType: 'FormDraft', entityId: draftId,
      operation: existing?.server_version ? 'UPDATE' : 'CREATE', baseVersion: existing?.server_version || undefined, payload, now });
  });
  return draftId;
}

export async function saveCalculation(input: {
  userId: string; calculatorId: string; formulaVersion: string; inputs: unknown; result: unknown; source?: unknown;
}): Promise<string> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const calculationId = randomUUID();
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history(calculation_id,owner_user_id,calculator_id,formula_version,inputs_json,result_json,source_json,created_at)
     VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)`,
    [calculationId, input.userId, input.calculatorId, input.formulaVersion, JSON.stringify(input.inputs),
      JSON.stringify(input.result), input.source === undefined ? null : JSON.stringify(input.source), new Date().toISOString()],
  );
  await db.runAsync(
    `DELETE FROM calculation_history WHERE owner_user_id=? AND calculation_id NOT IN
     (SELECT calculation_id FROM calculation_history WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 100)`,
    [input.userId, input.userId],
  );
  return calculationId;
}


export async function listCalculations(userId: string): Promise<Array<{ id: string; expression: string; result: string; createdAt: string }>> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    'SELECT calculation_id,inputs_json,result_json,created_at FROM calculation_history WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50',
    [userId],
  );
  return rows.map((row: any) => {
    const inputs = JSON.parse(row.inputs_json);
    const result = JSON.parse(row.result_json);
    return { id: row.calculation_id, expression: String(inputs.expression ?? ''), result: String(result.value ?? ''), createdAt: row.created_at };
  });
}

export async function cacheDocument(input: {
  userId: string; documentId: string; metadata: unknown; localUri?: string; contentHash?: string; version?: string; sizeBytes?: number;
}): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO cached_documents(document_id,owner_user_id,metadata_json,local_uri,content_hash,document_version,size_bytes,last_accessed_at,cached_at)
     VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(document_id) DO UPDATE SET metadata_json=excluded.metadata_json,
     local_uri=COALESCE(excluded.local_uri,cached_documents.local_uri),
     content_hash=COALESCE(excluded.content_hash,cached_documents.content_hash),
     document_version=CASE WHEN excluded.local_uri IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.document_version ELSE cached_documents.document_version END,
     size_bytes=CASE WHEN excluded.local_uri IS NOT NULL THEN excluded.size_bytes ELSE cached_documents.size_bytes END,
     last_accessed_at=excluded.last_accessed_at,cached_at=excluded.cached_at`,
    [scopedLocalId(input.userId, input.documentId), input.userId, JSON.stringify(input.metadata), input.localUri ?? null, input.contentHash ?? null,
      input.version ?? null, Math.max(0, Math.floor(input.sizeBytes ?? 0)), now, now],
  );
  await db.runAsync(
    `DELETE FROM cached_documents WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_uri IS NULL AND document_id NOT IN
     (SELECT document_id FROM cached_documents WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_uri IS NULL ORDER BY cached_at DESC LIMIT 200)`,
    [input.userId, input.userId],
  );
}

export async function getCachedDocumentEvictions(userId: string, keepDocumentId: string, maxDocuments = 25, maxBytes = 100 * 1024 * 1024): Promise<Array<{ documentId: string; localUri: string }>> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    `SELECT document_id,local_uri,size_bytes FROM cached_documents WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_uri IS NOT NULL
     ORDER BY COALESCE(last_accessed_at,cached_at) ASC`, [userId],
  );
  let count = rows.length;
  let bytes = rows.reduce((sum: number, row: any) => sum + Math.max(0, Number(row.size_bytes) || 0), 0);
  const keepId = scopedLocalId(userId, keepDocumentId);
  const evictions: Array<{ documentId: string; localUri: string }> = [];
  for (const row of rows) {
    if (count <= maxDocuments && bytes <= maxBytes) break;
    if (row.document_id === keepId) continue;
    evictions.push({ documentId: row.document_id.slice(userId.length + 1), localUri: row.local_uri });
    count -= 1;
    bytes -= Math.max(0, Number(row.size_bytes) || 0);
  }
  return evictions;
}

export async function listNotebookEntries(userId: string): Promise<Array<{ entryId: string; title: string; body: string; version: number; serverVersion: number; syncStatus: string; updatedAt: string }>> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    "SELECT entry_id,title,body,version,server_version,sync_status,updated_at FROM notebook_entries WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY updated_at DESC",
    [userId],
  );
  return rows.map((row: any) => ({ entryId: row.entry_id.slice(userId.length + 1), title: row.title, body: row.body,
    version: Number(row.version), serverVersion: Number(row.server_version), syncStatus: row.sync_status, updatedAt: row.updated_at }));
}

    payload: JSON.parse(row.payload_json), version: Number(row.version), serverVersion: Number(row.server_version),
    syncStatus: row.sync_status, updatedAt: row.updated_at }));

export async function listCalculationHistory(userId: string): Promise<Array<{ calculationId: string; calculatorId: string; formulaVersion: string; inputs: unknown; result: unknown; source: unknown; createdAt: string }>> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    'SELECT calculation_id,calculator_id,formula_version,inputs_json,result_json,source_json,created_at FROM calculation_history WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC',
    [userId],

    inputs: JSON.parse(row.inputs_json), result: JSON.parse(row.result_json), source: row.source_json ? JSON.parse(row.source_json) : null, createdAt: row.created_at }));

  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    'SELECT document_id,metadata_json,local_uri,document_version,cached_at FROM cached_documents WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY cached_at DESC',
    [userId],

  return rows.map((row: any) => ({ documentId: row.document_id.slice(userId.length + 1), metadata: JSON.parse(row.metadata_json),
    localUri: row.local_uri, version: row.document_version, cachedAt: row.cached_at }));

  const db = await getDatabase();
  const row = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT metadata_json,local_uri,document_version FROM cached_documents WHERE document_id=? AND owner_user_id=?',
    [scopedLocalId(userId, documentId), userId]);
  if (!row) return null;
  await db.runAsync('UPDATE cached_documents SET last_accessed_at=? WHERE document_id=? AND owner_user_id=?',
    [new Date().toISOString(), scopedLocalId(userId, documentId), userId]);
  return { metadata: JSON.parse(row.metadata_json), localUri: row.local_uri, version: row.document_version };
}

  const db = await getDatabase();
  await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM cached_documents WHERE document_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [scopedLocalId(userId, documentId), userId]);
}

```
import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy';
import { randomUUID } from 'expo-crypto';
import { api } from '../network/api';
import { getDatabase } from '../database';

export type LocalOcrJob = {
  localId: string; remoteJobId: string | null; status: string; resultText: string | null;
  confidence: number | null; errorMessage: string | null; createdAt: string;
};

function mapRow(row: any): LocalOcrJob {
  return { localId: row.local_id, remoteJobId: row.remote_job_id, status: row.status,
    resultText: row.result_text, confidence: row.confidence == null ? null : Number(row.confidence),
    errorMessage: row.error_message, createdAt: row.created_at };
}

// In-process, per-user lock. Every caller (auto-sync, camera capture, camera retry)
// shares a single in-flight pass so the same row can never be uploaded twice.
const OCR_SYNC_LOCKS = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();

// A row claimed as UPLOADING for longer than this is considered abandoned
// (app killed / crashed mid-upload) and is released back to the retry queue.
const UPLOAD_CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;

export async function enqueueOcrPhoto(userId: string, sourceUri: string): Promise<LocalOcrJob> {
  if (!FileSystem.documentDirectory) throw new Error('فضای پایدار ذخیره‌سازی فایل در دسترس نیست');
  const directory = `${FileSystem.documentDirectory}handbook-ocr/`;
  await FileSystem.makeDirectoryAsync(directory, { intermediates: true }).catch(() => {});
  const localId = randomUUID();
  const localUri = `${directory}${localId}.jpg`;
  await FileSystem.copyAsync({ from: sourceUri, to: localUri });
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO ocr_queue(local_id,owner_user_id,local_uri,status,created_at,updated_at)
     VALUES(?,?,?,'PENDING_UPLOAD',?,?)`, [localId, userId, localUri, now, now],
  );
  return { localId, remoteJobId: null, status: 'PENDING_UPLOAD', resultText: null, confidence: null, errorMessage: null, createdAt: now };
}

export async function listOcrJobs(userId: string): Promise<LocalOcrJob[]> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<any>('SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 30', [userId]);
  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

export async function getOcrJobLocal(userId: string, localId: string): Promise<LocalOcrJob | null> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const row = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_id=?', [userId, localId]);
  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}

async function runOcrSync(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();

  // Release claims abandoned by a previous process so they can be retried.
  await db.runAsync(
    `UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='RETRY_UPLOAD', next_attempt_at=NULL, updated_at=?
     WHERE owner_user_id=? AND status='UPLOADING' AND updated_at<=?`,
    [now, userId, new Date(Date.now() - UPLOAD_CLAIM_TIMEOUT_MS).toISOString()],
  );

  const uploadRows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    `SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND status IN ('PENDING_UPLOAD','RETRY_UPLOAD')
     AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at<=?) ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 5`, [userId, now]);

  for (const row of uploadRows) {
    // Atomic claim: only the caller whose UPDATE actually changed the row may upload it.
    const claim = await db.runAsync(
      `UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='UPLOADING', updated_at=?
       WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=? AND status IN ('PENDING_UPLOAD','RETRY_UPLOAD')`,
      [new Date().toISOString(), row.local_id, userId],
    );
    if (Number(claim?.changes ?? 0) !== 1) continue;

    try {
      const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(row.local_uri);
      if (!info.exists) throw new Error('تصویر ذخیره‌شده روی گوشی پیدا نشد');
      const form = new FormData();
      form.append('file', { uri: row.local_uri, name: `${row.local_id}.jpg`, type: 'image/jpeg' } as any);
      const response = await api.post('/ocr', form, { timeout: 45000 });
      const remoteJobId = response.data?.data?.id;
      if (!remoteJobId) throw new Error('شناسه درخواست OCR از سرور دریافت نشد');
      await db.runAsync("UPDATE ocr_queue SET remote_job_id=?,status='UPLOADED',retry_count=0,next_attempt_at=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=? AND status='UPLOADING'",
        [remoteJobId, new Date().toISOString(), row.local_id, userId]);
    } catch (error: any) {
      const retries = Number(row.retry_count) + 1;
      const delay = Math.min(6 * 60 * 60 * 1000, 2000 * (2 ** Math.min(retries, 12)));
      await db.runAsync("UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='RETRY_UPLOAD',retry_count=?,next_attempt_at=?,error_message=?,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=? AND status='UPLOADING'",
        [retries, new Date(Date.now() + delay).toISOString(), String(error?.response?.data?.error?.message || error?.message || 'خطای شبکه').slice(0, 400), new Date().toISOString(), row.local_id, userId]);
    }
  }

  const remoteRows = await db.getAllAsync<any>(
    "SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND status IN ('UPLOADED','RUNNING') AND remote_job_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 10", [userId]);
  for (const row of remoteRows) {
    try {
      const response = await api.get(`/ocr/${row.remote_job_id}`, { timeout: 15000 });
      const remote = response.data?.data;
      if (!remote) continue;
      const status = remote.status === 'DONE' ? 'DONE' : remote.status === 'FAILED' ? 'FAILED' : remote.status === 'CANCELLED' ? 'CANCELLED' : 'RUNNING';
      await db.runAsync('UPDATE ocr_queue SET status=?,result_text=?,confidence=?,error_message=?,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=?',
        [status, remote.resultText ?? null, remote.confidence ?? null, remote.errorMessage ?? null, new Date().toISOString(), row.local_id, userId]);
    } catch { /* Keep the local job and retry status polling on the next sync cycle. */ }
  }
}

export function syncOcrQueue(userId: string): Promise<void> {
  if (!userId) return Promise.resolve();
  const existing = OCR_SYNC_LOCKS.get(userId);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const run = runOcrSync(userId);
  OCR_SYNC_LOCKS.set(userId, run);
  const release = () => {
    if (OCR_SYNC_LOCKS.get(userId) === run) OCR_SYNC_LOCKS.delete(userId);
  };
  run.then(release, release);
  return run;
}

export async function retryOcrJobLocal(userId: string, localId: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const row = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT * FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_id=?', [userId, localId]);
  if (!row) throw new Error('درخواست OCR محلی پیدا نشد');
  if (row.remote_job_id) {
    await api.post(`/ocr/${row.remote_job_id}/retry`);
    await db.runAsync("UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='UPLOADED',error_message=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=?", [new Date().toISOString(), localId, userId]);
  } else {
    await db.runAsync("UPDATE ocr_queue SET status='PENDING_UPLOAD',next_attempt_at=NULL,error_message=NULL,updated_at=? WHERE local_id=? AND owner_user_id=?", [new Date().toISOString(), localId, userId]);
  }
}

export async function deleteOcrJobLocal(userId: string, localId: string): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const row = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT local_uri,remote_job_id FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_id=?', [userId, localId]);
  if (!row) return;
  if (row.remote_job_id) await api.delete(`/ocr/${row.remote_job_id}`).catch(() => {});
  await FileSystem.deleteAsync(row.local_uri, { idempotent: true }).catch(() => {});
  await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM ocr_queue WHERE owner_user_id=? AND local_id=?', [userId, localId]);
}

import React, { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { ActivityIndicator, Pressable, ScrollView, Share, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { CameraView, useCameraPermissions } from 'expo-camera';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useAuth } from '../core/auth/AuthContext';
import { deleteOcrJobLocal, enqueueOcrPhoto, getOcrJobLocal, listOcrJobs, retryOcrJobLocal, syncOcrQueue } from '../core/ocr/queue';
import type { LocalOcrJob } from '../core/ocr/queue';
import { useAppSettings } from '../core/settings/AppSettingsContext';

export default function CameraScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { user } = useAuth();
  const { t, isDark, direction } = useAppSettings();
  const cameraRef = useRef<CameraView>(null);
  const [permission, requestPermission] = useCameraPermissions();
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);
  const [capturing, setCapturing] = useState(false);
  const [job, setJob] = useState<LocalOcrJob | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!user?.id) return;
    listOcrJobs(user.id).then(items => { if (active && items.length) setJob(items[0]); }).catch(() => {});
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [user?.id]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!job?.localId || !user?.id) return;
    let active = true;
    let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout>;
    // Read-only local polling. Uploads/status refreshes are driven by capture(),
    // retry() and the background auto-sync, never by this timer.
    const pollLocal = async () => {
      const latest = await getOcrJobLocal(user.id, job.localId).catch(() => null);
      if (!active) return;
      if (latest) setJob(latest);
      if (latest && !['DONE', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED'].includes(latest.status)) {
        timer = setTimeout(pollLocal, 4000);
      }
    };
    timer = setTimeout(pollLocal, 800);
    return () => { active = false; clearTimeout(timer); };
  }, [job?.localId, job?.status, user?.id]);

  const capture = async () => {
    if (!cameraRef.current || !ready || capturing || !user) return;
    setCapturing(true); setError('');
    try {
      const photo = await cameraRef.current.takePictureAsync({ quality: 0.82, skipProcessing: false });
      if (!photo?.uri) throw new Error('تصویر دوربین دریافت نشد');
      // Copy into the app's persistent documents directory before any network request.
      const local = await enqueueOcrPhoto(user.id, photo.uri);
      setJob(local);
      await syncOcrQueue(user.id);
      let latest = await getOcrJobLocal(user.id, local.localId);
      // The first call may have joined an already-running pass that had not yet
      // seen this row; one follow-up pass picks it up. The per-user lock plus the
      // atomic UPLOADING claim guarantee this cannot double-upload.
      if (latest && (latest.status === 'PENDING_UPLOAD' || latest.status === 'RETRY_UPLOAD')) {
        await syncOcrQueue(user.id).catch(() => {});
        latest = await getOcrJobLocal(user.id, local.localId);
      }
      if (latest) setJob(latest);
    } catch (e: any) {
      setError(e?.message || t('cameraCaptureError'));
    } finally { setCapturing(false); }
  };

  const retry = async () => {
    if (!job || !user) return;
    setError('');
    try {
      await retryOcrJobLocal(user.id, job.localId);
      await syncOcrQueue(user.id);
      const latest = await getOcrJobLocal(user.id, job.localId);
      if (latest) setJob(latest);
    } catch (e: any) { setError(e?.message || t('retryError')); }
  };

  const clearJob = async () => {
    if (job && user) await deleteOcrJobLocal(user.id, job.localId).catch(() => {});
    setJob(null);
  };

  if (!user) {
    return <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, isDark && styles.safeDark]}><View style={[styles.header, direction === 'ltr' && styles.rowLtr]}><Pressable onPress={() => router.back()}><Text style={styles.back}>{t('back')}</Text></Pressable><Text style={[styles.heading, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('cameraTitle')}</Text></View><View style={styles.permissionBox}><Text style={[styles.infoTitle, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('loginForOcr')}</Text><Text style={[styles.infoText, isDark && styles.mutedDark]}>{t('ocrNeedsAccount')}</Text><Pressable style={styles.primary} onPress={() => router.push('/login')}><Text style={styles.primaryText}>{t('login')}</Text></Pressable></View></SafeAreaView>;
  }

  if (!permission) return <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, isDark && styles.safeDark]}><ActivityIndicator color="#00A86B" /></SafeAreaView>;
  if (!permission.granted) {
    return <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, isDark && styles.safeDark]}><View style={[styles.header, direction === 'ltr' && styles.rowLtr]}><Pressable onPress={() => router.back()}><Text style={styles.back}>{t('back')}</Text></Pressable><Text style={[styles.heading, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('camera')}</Text></View><View style={styles.permissionBox}><Text style={[styles.infoTitle, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('cameraPermission')}</Text><Text style={[styles.infoText, isDark && styles.mutedDark]}>{t('cameraPermissionText')}</Text><Pressable style={styles.primary} onPress={requestPermission}><Text style={styles.primaryText}>{t('enableCamera')}</Text></Pressable></View></SafeAreaView>;
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, isDark && styles.safeDark]}>
      <View style={[styles.header, direction === 'ltr' && styles.rowLtr]}><Pressable onPress={() => router.back()}><Text style={styles.back}>{t('back')}</Text></Pressable><Text style={[styles.heading, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('cameraTitle')}</Text></View>
      <Text style={[styles.hint, isDark && styles.mutedDark, { textAlign: direction === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left' }]}>{t('cameraHint')}</Text>
      {!job || job.status === 'FAILED' || job.status === 'CANCELLED' ? <View style={styles.cameraWrap}>
        <CameraView ref={cameraRef} style={styles.camera} facing="back" onCameraReady={() => setReady(true)} />
        <View style={styles.frame} pointerEvents="none" />
        <Pressable style={[styles.capture, (!ready || capturing) && styles.disabled]} onPress={capture} disabled={!ready || capturing}>
          {capturing ? <ActivityIndicator color="#fff" /> : <Text style={styles.captureText}>●</Text>}
        </Pressable>
      </View> : <View style={[styles.jobCard, isDark && styles.cardDark]}>
        {job.status !== 'DONE' ? <><ActivityIndicator color="#00A86B" size="large" /><Text style={[styles.jobTitle, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{job.status === 'PENDING_UPLOAD' || job.status === 'RETRY_UPLOAD' ? t('imageSaved') : t('processingImage')}</Text><Text style={[styles.infoText, isDark && styles.mutedDark]}>{job.status === 'PENDING_UPLOAD' || job.status === 'RETRY_UPLOAD' ? t('autoSend') : t('ocrProcessing')}</Text></>
          : <><Text style={[styles.jobTitle, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{t('extractedText')}</Text>{job.confidence != null && <Text style={styles.confidence}>{t('confidence')}: {job.confidence}%</Text>}<ScrollView style={[styles.resultScroll, isDark && styles.resultScrollDark]}><Text selectable style={[styles.resultText, isDark && styles.textDark, { textAlign: direction === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left' }]}>{job.resultText}</Text></ScrollView><Pressable style={styles.primary} onPress={() => Share.share({ message: job.resultText || '' })}><Text style={styles.primaryText}>{t('shareText')}</Text></Pressable><Pressable style={styles.secondary} onPress={() => router.push({ pathname: '/search', params: { q: (job.resultText || '').slice(0, 200) } })}><Text style={styles.secondaryText}>{t('searchText')}</Text></Pressable><Pressable style={styles.secondary} onPress={clearJob}><Text style={styles.secondaryText}>{t('newImage')}</Text></Pressable></>}
      </View>}
      {!!job?.errorMessage && <Text style={[styles.error, { textAlign: direction === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left' }]}>{job.errorMessage}</Text>}
      {!!error && <Text style={[styles.error, { textAlign: direction === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left' }]}>{error}</Text>}
      {(job?.status === 'FAILED' || job?.status === 'RETRY_UPLOAD') && <Pressable style={styles.retry} onPress={retry}><Text style={styles.retryText}>{t('retry')}</Text></Pressable>}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: { flex: 1, backgroundColor: '#F5F7F8', paddingHorizontal: 16 }, safeDark: { backgroundColor: '#121212' }, textDark: { color: '#F4F7F5' }, cardDark: { backgroundColor: '#1E1E1E', borderColor: '#343A37' }, resultScrollDark: { backgroundColor: '#292F2C' }, mutedDark: { color: '#B4BDB8' }, rowLtr: { flexDirection: 'row' }, header: { flexDirection: 'row-reverse', justifyContent: 'space-between', alignItems: 'center', paddingVertical: 12 }, heading: { fontSize: 19, fontWeight: '800', color: '#17231E' }, back: { color: '#0077C8', fontWeight: '700' },
  hint: { textAlign: 'right', color: '#65736C', lineHeight: 21, fontSize: 12, marginBottom: 12 }, cameraWrap: { flex: 1, minHeight: 360, maxHeight: 580, borderRadius: 22, overflow: 'hidden', backgroundColor: '#101815', justifyContent: 'center' }, camera: { flex: 1 }, frame: { position: 'absolute', left: '10%', right: '10%', top: '25%', bottom: '25%', borderWidth: 2, borderColor: '#00D68A', borderRadius: 16 }, capture: { position: 'absolute', bottom: 22, alignSelf: 'center', width: 70, height: 70, borderRadius: 35, backgroundColor: '#00A86B', borderWidth: 5, borderColor: '#FFFFFF', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center' }, captureText: { color: '#fff', fontSize: 32, lineHeight: 36 }, disabled: { opacity: 0.55 },
  permissionBox: { flex: 1, justifyContent: 'center', alignItems: 'center', padding: 24 }, infoTitle: { color: '#17231E', fontSize: 18, fontWeight: '800', textAlign: 'center' }, infoText: { color: '#65736C', fontSize: 13, lineHeight: 22, textAlign: 'center', marginTop: 10, marginBottom: 18 }, primary: { backgroundColor: '#00A86B', borderRadius: 13, padding: 14, alignItems: 'center', marginTop: 12 }, primaryText: { color: '#fff', fontWeight: '800' }, secondary: { padding: 14, alignItems: 'center' }, secondaryText: { color: '#0077C8', fontWeight: '700' },

```
import { api } from '../network/api';
import { getDatabase } from '../database';
import { randomUUID } from 'expo-crypto';
import { syncOutbox } from './outbox';
import type { OutboxOperation, PushResult } from './outbox';
import { syncOcrQueue } from '../ocr/queue';
const scopedLocalId = (userId: string, id: string) => `${userId}:${id}`;

type PullRecord = {
  moduleName: 'notebook' | 'forms';
  entityType: 'NotebookEntry' | 'FormDraft';
  entityId: string;
  version: number;
  deleted: boolean;
  payload: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  updatedAt: string;
};

type PullPage = { items: PullRecord[]; nextCursor: string | null; hasMore: boolean };

type SyncResult = { accepted: number; conflicts: number; pulled: number };

// In-process, per-user lock so concurrent runSync callers (auto-sync, manual
// refresh, conflict resolution) share one pass instead of duplicating push/pull
// and OCR work.
const ACTIVE_SYNCS = new Map<string, Promise<SyncResult>>();

const transport = {
  async push(operations: OutboxOperation[]): Promise<PushResult> {
    const response = await api.post('/sync/push', { operations });
    return response.data?.data as PushResult;
  },
};

async function pullPage(cursor: string | null): Promise<PullPage> {
  const response = await api.get('/sync/pull', { params: { cursor: cursor ?? undefined, limit: 100 } });
  return {
    items: response.data?.data ?? [],
    nextCursor: response.data?.meta?.nextCursor ?? cursor,
    hasMore: Boolean(response.data?.meta?.hasMore),
  };
}

async function enqueueResolvedOperation(db: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>, input: {
  userId: string; moduleName: string; entityType: string; entityId: string; operation: 'CREATE' | 'UPDATE';
  baseVersion?: number; payload: unknown;
}): Promise<void> {
  const operationId = randomUUID();
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO outbox(operation_id,owner_user_id,module_name,entity_type,entity_id,operation,base_version,payload_json,status,created_at,updated_at)
     VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,'PENDING',?,?)`,
    [operationId, input.userId, input.moduleName, input.entityType, input.entityId, input.operation,
      input.baseVersion ?? null, JSON.stringify(input.payload), now, now],
  );
}

async function applyRemotePage(userId: string, records: PullRecord[]): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  await db.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    for (const record of records) {
      if (record.moduleName === 'notebook' && record.entityType === 'NotebookEntry') {
        const local = await db.getFirstAsync<{ sync_status: string }>(
          'SELECT sync_status FROM notebook_entries WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId]);
        if (local?.sync_status === 'PENDING' || local?.sync_status === 'CONFLICT') continue;
        if (record.deleted) {
          await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM notebook_entries WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId]);
        } else {
          const payload = record.payload ?? {};
          await db.runAsync(
            `INSERT INTO notebook_entries(entry_id,owner_user_id,title,body,version,server_version,sync_status,updated_at)
             VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?, 'SYNCED',?) ON CONFLICT(entry_id) DO UPDATE SET
             title=excluded.title, body=excluded.body, version=excluded.version,
             server_version=excluded.server_version, sync_status='SYNCED', updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
            [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId, String(payload.title ?? ''), String(payload.body ?? ''), record.version, record.version, record.updatedAt],
          );
        }
      } else if (record.moduleName === 'forms' && record.entityType === 'FormDraft') {
        const local = await db.getFirstAsync<{ sync_status: string }>(
          'SELECT sync_status FROM form_drafts WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId]);
        if (local?.sync_status === 'PENDING' || local?.sync_status === 'CONFLICT') continue;
        if (record.deleted) {
          await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM form_drafts WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId]);
        } else {
          const payload = record.payload ?? {};
          await db.runAsync(
            `INSERT INTO form_drafts(draft_id,owner_user_id,form_type,payload_json,version,server_version,sync_status,updated_at)
             VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?, 'SYNCED',?) ON CONFLICT(draft_id) DO UPDATE SET
             form_type=excluded.form_type, payload_json=excluded.payload_json, version=excluded.version,
             server_version=excluded.server_version, sync_status='SYNCED', updated_at=excluded.updated_at`,
            [scopedLocalId(userId, record.entityId), userId, String(payload.formType ?? ''), JSON.stringify(payload.values ?? {}), record.version, record.version, record.updatedAt],
          );
        }
      }
    }
  });
}

async function performSync(userId: string): Promise<SyncResult> {
  let accepted = 0;
  let conflicts = 0;
  for (let batch = 0; batch < 10; batch += 1) {
    const result = await syncOutbox(userId, transport, 50);
    accepted += result.accepted;
    conflicts += result.conflicts;
    if (result.accepted === 0) break;
  }
  await syncOcrQueue(userId).catch(() => {});
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const scope = `user:${userId}`;
  const state = await db.getFirstAsync<{ cursor: string | null }>('SELECT cursor FROM sync_state WHERE scope=?', [scope]);
  let cursor = state?.cursor ?? null;
  let pulled = 0;
  let hasMore = true;
  let pages = 0;
  while (hasMore && pages < 20) {
    const page = await pullPage(cursor);
    await applyRemotePage(userId, page.items);
    pulled += page.items.length;
    cursor = page.nextCursor;
    hasMore = page.hasMore;
    pages += 1;
    await db.runAsync(
      `INSERT INTO sync_state(scope,cursor,last_success_at) VALUES(?,?,?)
       ON CONFLICT(scope) DO UPDATE SET cursor=excluded.cursor,last_success_at=excluded.last_success_at`,
      [scope, cursor, new Date().toISOString()],
    );
    if (!page.items.length) break;
  }
  return { accepted, conflicts, pulled };
}

export function runSync(userId: string): Promise<SyncResult> {
  if (!userId) throw new Error('برای همگام‌سازی شناسه کاربر الزامی است');
  const existing = ACTIVE_SYNCS.get(userId);
  if (existing) return existing;
  const run = performSync(userId);
  ACTIVE_SYNCS.set(userId, run);
  const release = () => {
    if (ACTIVE_SYNCS.get(userId) === run) ACTIVE_SYNCS.delete(userId);
  };
  run.then(release, release);
  return run;
}


export async function resolveNotebookConflict(userId: string, entryId: string, strategy: 'LOCAL' | 'SERVER'): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const localId = scopedLocalId(userId, entryId);
  const local = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT title,body,server_version FROM notebook_entries WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, userId]);
  if (!local) throw new Error('یادداشت محلی برای حل تعارض پیدا نشد');
  const response = await api.get(`/sync/record/notebook/NotebookEntry/${encodeURIComponent(entryId)}`);
  const remote = response.data?.data as PullRecord;
  await db.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    await db.runAsync("UPDATE outbox SET status='RESOLVED', updated_at=? WHERE owner_user_id=? AND module_name='notebook' AND entity_type='NotebookEntry' AND entity_id=? AND status='CONFLICT'",
      [new Date().toISOString(), userId, entryId]);
    if (strategy === 'SERVER') {
      if (remote.deleted || !remote.payload) {
        await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM notebook_entries WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, userId]);
      } else {
        await db.runAsync("UPDATE notebook_entries SET title=?,body=?,version=?,server_version=?,sync_status='SYNCED',updated_at=? WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?",
          [String(remote.payload.title ?? ''), String(remote.payload.body ?? ''), remote.version, remote.version, remote.updatedAt, localId, userId]);
      }
    } else {
      await db.runAsync("UPDATE notebook_entries SET server_version=?,sync_status='PENDING' WHERE entry_id=? AND owner_user_id=?",
        [remote.version, localId, userId]);
      await enqueueResolvedOperation(db, { userId, moduleName: 'notebook', entityType: 'NotebookEntry', entityId: entryId,
        operation: remote.deleted ? 'CREATE' : 'UPDATE', baseVersion: remote.deleted ? undefined : remote.version,
        payload: { entryId, title: local.title, body: local.body } });
    }
  });
}

export async function resolveFormConflict(userId: string, draftId: string, strategy: 'LOCAL' | 'SERVER'): Promise<void> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const localId = scopedLocalId(userId, draftId);
  const local = await db.getFirstAsync<any>('SELECT form_type,payload_json,server_version FROM form_drafts WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, userId]);
  if (!local) throw new Error('پیش‌نویس محلی برای حل تعارض پیدا نشد');
  const response = await api.get(`/sync/record/forms/FormDraft/${encodeURIComponent(draftId)}`);
  const remote = response.data?.data as PullRecord;
  await db.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    await db.runAsync("UPDATE outbox SET status='RESOLVED', updated_at=? WHERE owner_user_id=? AND module_name='forms' AND entity_type='FormDraft' AND entity_id=? AND status='CONFLICT'",
      [new Date().toISOString(), userId, draftId]);
    if (strategy === 'SERVER') {
      if (remote.deleted || !remote.payload) {
        await db.runAsync('DELETE FROM form_drafts WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?', [localId, userId]);
      } else {
        await db.runAsync("UPDATE form_drafts SET form_type=?,payload_json=?,version=?,server_version=?,sync_status='SYNCED',updated_at=? WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?",
          [String(remote.payload.formType ?? ''), JSON.stringify(remote.payload.values ?? {}), remote.version, remote.version, remote.updatedAt, localId, userId]);
      }
    } else {
      await db.runAsync("UPDATE form_drafts SET server_version=?,sync_status='PENDING' WHERE draft_id=? AND owner_user_id=?",
        [remote.version, localId, userId]);
      await enqueueResolvedOperation(db, { userId, moduleName: 'forms', entityType: 'FormDraft', entityId: draftId,
        operation: remote.deleted ? 'CREATE' : 'UPDATE', baseVersion: remote.deleted ? undefined : remote.version,
        payload: { draftId, formType: local.form_type, values: JSON.parse(local.payload_json) } });
    }
  });
}
```

Notes on behavior changes to be aware of:

- `syncOcrQueue` and `runSync` now return the shared in-flight promise when a pass is already running, so callers may observe the result of a pass that started before their call. `camera.tsx` compensates with a single follow-up pass after capture.
- Rows stuck in `UPLOADING` for more than 10 minutes are released back to `RETRY_UPLOAD` on the next pass, so a killed app cannot permanently strand an upload.
- `queueOrUpdateOutbox` now inserts a new outbox row when the previous one has `retry_count > 0`; this assumes the `outbox` table has a `retry_count` column (as the task specifies).

```ts
/**
 * Single source of truth for the mobile module registry.
 *
 * This file replaces the previous trio of `registry.js`, `registry.d.ts` and
 * `registry.ts`, which all resolved to the same module specifier and shadowed
 * each other (Metro prefers `.js` over `.ts`, so the TypeScript file was dead
 * code at runtime). `registry.js` and `registry.d.ts` must be deleted.
 */

export type ModuleStatus = 'active' | 'coming-soon' | 'disabled';

export interface AppModule {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  status: ModuleStatus;
  route?: `/${string}`;
  visibleOnHome?: boolean;
}

export type ModuleDefinition = AppModule;

const MODULE_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/;

function validateModule(definition: AppModule): Readonly<AppModule> {
  if (!definition || typeof definition !== 'object') throw new TypeError('Module definition must be an object');
  if (!MODULE_ID_PATTERN.test(definition.id || '')) throw new TypeError('Invalid module id');
  if (typeof definition.label !== 'string' || !definition.label.trim()) throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires a label`);
  if (typeof definition.icon !== 'string' || !definition.icon.trim()) throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires an icon`);
  if (!['active', 'coming-soon', 'disabled'].includes(definition.status)) throw new TypeError(`Invalid status for module ${definition.id}`);
  if (definition.status === 'active' && (typeof definition.route !== 'string' || !definition.route.startsWith('/'))) throw new TypeError(`Active module ${definition.id} requires an absolute route`);
  if (definition.route && !definition.route.startsWith('/')) throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} route must be absolute`);
  return Object.freeze({ visibleOnHome: true, ...definition });
}

export function createModuleRegistry(definitions: AppModule[]): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(definitions)) throw new TypeError('Module definitions must be an array');
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const routes = new Set<string>();
  const modules = definitions.map(validateModule);
  for (const module of modules) {
    if (ids.has(module.id)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module id: ${module.id}`);
    ids.add(module.id);
    if (module.route) {
      if (routes.has(module.route)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module route: ${module.route}`);
      routes.add(module.route);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(modules);
}

export const MODULE_REGISTRY: readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] = createModuleRegistry([...]);

export function getHomeModules(): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.filter(module => module.visibleOnHome && module.status !== 'disabled');
}

export function getModuleById(id: string): Readonly<AppModule> | null {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.find(module => module.id === id) ?? null;
}
```

## What I found

**1. Registry collision (real, and it was silently breaking things).** Three files resolved to the same specifier `../core/modules/registry`:

- `registry.js` — the actual module registry (`MODULE_REGISTRY`, `getHomeModules`, `getModuleById`)
- `registry.d.ts` — hand-written types for that `.js` file
- `registry.ts` — a *different* API (`registerFeature`, `listFeatures`, `isFeatureEnabled`)

Metro's `sourceExts` order puts `js` before `ts`, so `registry.js` always won and `registry.ts` was dead code at runtime. `index.tsx` even had to import `'../core/modules/registry.js'` with an explicit extension to make that work. Fix: make `registry.ts` the single source of truth (module registry **and** the feature-manifest API, so no existing import breaks), delete the other two, and import extensionless.

**2. Label fallback.** `t(moduleKeys[item.id])` returns `undefined` at runtime for any module id missing from the translation dictionary (and `t(undefined)` for an unmapped id), which renders an empty tile. I added a `moduleLabel()` helper that falls back to `item.label`.

**3. `"type": "module"` — yes, it breaks Expo.** Expo CLI loads `babel.config.js` (and `metro.config.js`) through Node's `require`. With `"type": "module"`, Node treats those `.js` files as ESM, so `module.exports = function (api) {...}` throws `ReferenceError: module is not defined` and the bundler never starts. Removing it is safe for app code: Babel/Metro still transpile ESM syntax in `src/**/*.js` regardless of the package `type` field. For tests, I changed the script to `node --test tests/`, which recursively picks up `*.test.js`, `*.test.mjs`, and `*.test.cjs` — so any ESM test file just needs renaming to `.mjs` and it keeps running.

/**
 * Single source of truth for the mobile module registry.
 *
 * This file replaces the previous trio of `registry.js`, `registry.d.ts` and
 * `registry.ts`, which all resolved to the same module specifier and shadowed
 * each other (Metro prefers `.js` over `.ts`, so this file was dead code at
 * runtime). `registry.js` and `registry.d.ts` must be deleted.
 *
 * Import it extensionless: `import { getHomeModules } from '../core/modules/registry';`
 */

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Module registry (home screen tiles)                                        */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type ModuleStatus = 'active' | 'coming-soon' | 'disabled';

export interface AppModule {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  status: ModuleStatus;
  route?: `/${string}`;
  visibleOnHome?: boolean;
}

const MODULE_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/;
const MODULE_STATUSES: readonly ModuleStatus[] = ['active', 'coming-soon', 'disabled'];

function validateModule(definition: AppModule): Readonly<AppModule> {
  if (!definition || typeof definition !== 'object') {
    throw new TypeError('Module definition must be an object');
  }
  if (!MODULE_ID_PATTERN.test(definition.id || '')) {
    throw new TypeError('Invalid module id');
  }
  if (typeof definition.label !== 'string' || !definition.label.trim()) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires a label`);
  }
  if (typeof definition.icon !== 'string' || !definition.icon.trim()) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires an icon`);
  }
  if (!MODULE_STATUSES.includes(definition.status)) {
    throw new TypeError(`Invalid status for module ${definition.id}`);
  }
  if (definition.status === 'active' && (typeof definition.route !== 'string' || !definition.route.startsWith('/'))) {
    throw new TypeError(`Active module ${definition.id} requires an absolute route`);
  }
  if (definition.route && !definition.route.startsWith('/')) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} route must be absolute`);
  }
  return Object.freeze({ visibleOnHome: true, ...definition });
}

export function createModuleRegistry(definitions: AppModule[]): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(definitions)) throw new TypeError('Module definitions must be an array');
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const routes = new Set<string>();
  const modules = definitions.map(validateModule);
  for (const module of modules) {
    if (ids.has(module.id)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module id: ${module.id}`);
    ids.add(module.id);
    if (module.route) {
      if (routes.has(module.route)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module route: ${module.route}`);
      routes.add(module.route);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(modules);
}

export const MODULE_REGISTRY: readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] = createModuleRegistry([
  { id: 'bill-payment', label: 'پرداخت قبض', icon: '💳', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'bill-calculator', label: 'محاسبه قبض', icon: '🧾', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'engineering', label: 'محاسبات فنی', icon: '⚡', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'safety', label: 'پیام‌ها و اصول ایمنی', icon: '🦺', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'forms', label: 'فرم‌ها و چک‌لیست‌ها', icon: '📝', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'notebook', label: 'دفترچه فنی', icon: '📒', status: 'active', route: '/notebook' },
]);

export function getHomeModules(): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.filter(module => module.visibleOnHome && module.status !== 'disabled');
}

export function getModuleById(id: string): Readonly<AppModule> | null {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.find(module => module.id === id) ?? null;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Feature manifest registry                                                  */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Kept here so existing imports of `registerFeature` / `listFeatures` /       */
/* `isFeatureEnabled` from this module keep working. It can be split into its  */
/* own `features.ts` later without touching the module registry above.         */

export type FeatureManifest = {
  id: string;
  version: string;
  title: string;
  enabledByDefault: boolean;
  dependencies?: string[];
};

const featureRegistry = new Map<string, FeatureManifest>();

export function registerFeature(manifest: FeatureManifest): void {
  if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/.test(manifest.id)) throw new Error(`Invalid feature id: ${manifest.id}`);
  if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(manifest.version)) throw new Error(`Invalid feature version: ${manifest.version}`);
  if (featureRegistry.has(manifest.id)) throw new Error(`Feature already registered: ${manifest.id}`);
  featureRegistry.set(manifest.id, Object.freeze({ ...manifest, dependencies: [...(manifest.dependencies ?? [])] }));
}

export function listFeatures(): FeatureManifest[] {
  return [...featureRegistry.values()].map(feature => ({ ...feature, dependencies: [...(feature.dependencies ?? [])] }));
}

export function isFeatureEnabled(id: string, flags: Record<string, boolean> = {}): boolean {
  const feature = featureRegistry.get(id);
  if (!feature) return false;
  return flags[id] ?? feature.enabledByDefault;
}

        <View style={[styles.grid, direction === 'ltr' && styles.rowLtr]}>
          {modules.map(item => item.status === 'active' && item.route ? (
            <Pressable key={item.id} style={[styles.moduleCard, isDark && styles.cardDark]} onPress={() => router.push(item.route as Href)}>
              <Text style={styles.moduleIcon}>{item.icon}</Text><Text style={[styles.moduleLabel, isDark && styles.textDark]}>{moduleLabel(item)}</Text>

'right' : 'left' }]}>{t('chat')}</Text><Text style={[styles.chatSubtitle, isDark && styles.mutedDark, { textAlign: direction === 'rtl' ? 'right' : 'left' }]}>{t('chatSubtitle')}</Text></View></View>

You're right — I had a bare code block (the `git rm` command) that wasn't a file listing. Here is the corrected response with only properly formatted file listings.

## What I found

**1. Registry collision (real, and it was silently breaking things).** Three files resolved to the same specifier `../core/modules/registry`:

- `registry.js` — the actual module registry (`MODULE_REGISTRY`, `getHomeModules`, `getModuleById`)
- `registry.d.ts` — hand-written types for that `.js` file
- `registry.ts` — a *different* API (`registerFeature`, `listFeatures`, `isFeatureEnabled`)

Metro's `sourceExts` order puts `js` before `ts`, so `registry.js` always won and `registry.ts` was dead code at runtime. `index.tsx` even had to import `'../core/modules/registry.js'` with an explicit extension to make that work. Fix: make `registry.ts` the single source of truth (module registry **and** the feature-manifest API, so no existing import breaks), delete the other two, and import extensionless.

**2. Label fallback.** `t(moduleKeys[item.id])` returns `undefined` at runtime for any module id missing from the translation dictionary (and `t(undefined)` for an unmapped id), which renders an empty tile. I added a `moduleLabel()` helper that falls back to `item.label`.

**3. `"type": "module"` — yes, it breaks Expo.** Expo CLI loads `babel.config.js` (and `metro.config.js`) through Node's `require`. With `"type": "module"`, Node treats those `.js` files as ESM, so `module.exports = function (api) {...}` throws `ReferenceError: module is not defined` and the bundler never starts. Removing it is safe for app code: Babel/Metro still transpile ESM syntax in `src/**/*.js` regardless of the package `type` field. For tests, I changed the script to `node --test tests/`, which recursively picks up `*.test.js`, `*.test.mjs`, and `*.test.cjs` — so any ESM test file just needs renaming to `.mjs` and it keeps running.

## Action required outside the file listings

The listing format can't express deletion, and leaving these files in place would keep shadowing `registry.ts`. Please delete them with `git rm mobile/src/core/modules/registry.js mobile/src/core/modules/registry.d.ts`, then clear the Metro cache once with `npx expo start --clear`.

/**
 * Single source of truth for the mobile module registry.
 *
 * This file replaces the previous trio of `registry.js`, `registry.d.ts` and
 * `registry.ts`, which all resolved to the same module specifier and shadowed
 * each other (Metro prefers `.js` over `.ts`, so this file was dead code at
 * runtime). `registry.js` and `registry.d.ts` must be deleted.
 *
 * Import it extensionless: `import { getHomeModules } from '../core/modules/registry';`
 */

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Module registry (home screen tiles)                                        */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export type ModuleStatus = 'active' | 'coming-soon' | 'disabled';

export interface AppModule {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: string;
  status: ModuleStatus;
  route?: `/${string}`;
  visibleOnHome?: boolean;
}

const MODULE_ID_PATTERN = /^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/;
const MODULE_STATUSES: readonly ModuleStatus[] = ['active', 'coming-soon', 'disabled'];

function validateModule(definition: AppModule): Readonly<AppModule> {
  if (!definition || typeof definition !== 'object') {
    throw new TypeError('Module definition must be an object');
  }
  if (!MODULE_ID_PATTERN.test(definition.id || '')) {
    throw new TypeError('Invalid module id');
  }
  if (typeof definition.label !== 'string' || !definition.label.trim()) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires a label`);
  }
  if (typeof definition.icon !== 'string' || !definition.icon.trim()) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} requires an icon`);
  }
  if (!MODULE_STATUSES.includes(definition.status)) {
    throw new TypeError(`Invalid status for module ${definition.id}`);
  }
  if (definition.status === 'active' && (typeof definition.route !== 'string' || !definition.route.startsWith('/'))) {
    throw new TypeError(`Active module ${definition.id} requires an absolute route`);
  }
  if (definition.route && !definition.route.startsWith('/')) {
    throw new TypeError(`Module ${definition.id} route must be absolute`);
  }
  return Object.freeze({ visibleOnHome: true, ...definition });
}

export function createModuleRegistry(definitions: AppModule[]): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(definitions)) throw new TypeError('Module definitions must be an array');
  const ids = new Set<string>();
  const routes = new Set<string>();
  const modules = definitions.map(validateModule);
  for (const module of modules) {
    if (ids.has(module.id)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module id: ${module.id}`);
    ids.add(module.id);
    if (module.route) {
      if (routes.has(module.route)) throw new Error(`Duplicate module route: ${module.route}`);
      routes.add(module.route);
    }
  }
  return Object.freeze(modules);
}

export const MODULE_REGISTRY: readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] = createModuleRegistry([
  { id: 'bill-payment', label: 'پرداخت قبض', icon: '💳', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'bill-calculator', label: 'محاسبه قبض', icon: '🧾', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'engineering', label: 'محاسبات فنی', icon: '⚡', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'safety', label: 'پیام‌ها و اصول ایمنی', icon: '🦺', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'forms', label: 'فرم‌ها و چک‌لیست‌ها', icon: '📝', status: 'coming-soon' },
  { id: 'notebook', label: 'دفترچه فنی', icon: '📒', status: 'active', route: '/notebook' },
]);

export function getHomeModules(): readonly Readonly<AppModule>[] {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.filter(module => module.visibleOnHome && module.status !== 'disabled');
}

export function getModuleById(id: string): Readonly<AppModule> | null {
  return MODULE_REGISTRY.find(module => module.id === id) ?? null;
}

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Feature manifest registry                                                  */
/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* Kept here so existing imports of `registerFeature` / `listFeatures` /       */
/* `isFeatureEnabled` from this module keep working. It can be split into its  */
/* own `features.ts` later without touching the module registry above.         */

export type FeatureManifest = {
  id: string;
  version: string;
  title: string;
  enabledByDefault: boolean;
  dependencies?: string[];
};

const featureRegistry = new Map<string, FeatureManifest>();

export function registerFeature(manifest: FeatureManifest): void {
  if (!/^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,63}$/.test(manifest.id)) throw new Error(`Invalid feature id: ${manifest.id}`);
  if (!/^\d+\.\d+\.\d+$/.test(manifest.version)) throw new Error(`Invalid feature version: ${manifest.version}`);
  if (featureRegistry.has(manifest.id)) throw new Error(`Feature already registered: ${manifest.id}`);
  featureRegistry.set(manifest.id, Object.freeze({ ...manifest, dependencies: [...(manifest.dependencies ?? [])] }));
}

export function listFeatures(): FeatureManifest[] {
  return [...featureRegistry.values()].map(feature => ({ ...feature, dependencies: [...(feature.dependencies ?? [])] }));
}

export function isFeatureEnabled(id: string, flags: Record<string, boolean> = {}): boolean {
  const feature = featureRegistry.get(id);
  if (!feature) return false;
  return flags[id] ?? feature.enabledByDefault;
}
