```js
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { requestPayment, verifyPayment, getPaymentUrl } from './zarinpal.service.js';
import { activateSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';

const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;
const PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES = Number(process.env.PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES) || 30;

function getCallbackUrl() {
  return env.ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL;
}

function maskCardPan(cardPan) {
  if (!cardPan) return null;
  const digits = String(cardPan).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10) return null;
  return `${digits.slice(0, 6)}******${digits.slice(-4)}`;
}

function toRial(amountToman) {
  return Math.round(Number(amountToman) * TOMAN_TO_RIAL);
}

function isIdempotencyConflict(error) {
  if (error?.code !== 'P2002') return false;
  const target = error?.meta?.target;
  if (Array.isArray(target)) return target.includes('idempotencyKey');
  if (typeof target === 'string') return target === 'idempotencyKey';
  // Prisma did not report the target; idempotencyKey is the only unique column
  // written by the create below, so treat it as an idempotency conflict.
  return true;
}

export function toPublicPayment(payment) {
  if (!payment) return null;
  return {
    id: payment.id,
    planId: payment.planId,
    planName: payment.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: payment.amountToman,
    status: payment.status,
    refId: payment.refId ?? null,
    cardPanMasked: payment.cardPanMasked ?? null,
    createdAt: payment.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: payment.verifiedAt ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Create a PENDING payment and open a Zarinpal session for it.
 *
 * Idempotency is enforced by the unique `idempotencyKey` column. Two concurrent
 * requests with the same key race on the INSERT; the loser receives P2002 and
 * is resolved below without ever creating a second gateway session.
 *
 * @param {string} userId
 * @param {{ planId: string, durationDays?: number, idempotencyKey?: string }} payload
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 * @returns {Promise<{ payment: object, paymentUrl: string, authority: string, reused?: boolean }>}
 */
export async function createPaymentRequest(userId, payload = {}, req) {
  const planId = String(payload.planId ?? '').trim();
  const idempotencyKey = String(payload.idempotencyKey ?? req?.headers?.['idempotency-key'] ?? '').trim() || null;
  if (!planId || planId.length > 128) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');
  }
  if (idempotencyKey && (idempotencyKey.length < 8 || idempotencyKey.length > 128)) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'کلید تکرارنشدن درخواست پرداخت معتبر نیست');
  }

  if (idempotencyKey) {
    const previous = await prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { idempotencyKey }, include: { plan: true } });
    if (previous) {
      if (previous.userId !== userId) throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای حساب دیگری استفاده شده است');
      if (previous.status === 'PENDING' && previous.authority && Number.isSafeInteger(previous.amountToman) && previous.amountToman > 0) {
        return { payment: toPublicPayment(previous), paymentUrl: getPaymentUrl(previous.authority), authority: previous.authority, reused: true };
      }
      if (previous.status === 'PENDING') throw new AppError(409, 'PAYMENT_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS', 'درخواست پرداخت با همین شناسه در حال پردازش است؛ چند لحظه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید');
      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ALREADY_USED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای یک درخواست پرداخت نهایی استفاده شده است؛ برای تلاش تازه، درخواست جدید ایجاد کنید');
    }
  }

  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan || plan.isActive === false) {
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');
  }

  const amountToman = Math.round(Number(plan.price));
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountToman) || amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const requestedDays = Number(payload.durationDays);
  const durationDays =
    Number.isInteger(requestedDays) && requestedDays > 0
      ? requestedDays
      : Number(plan.durationDays) > 0
        ? Number(plan.durationDays)
        : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  let payment;
  try {
    payment = await prisma.payment.create({
      data: {
        userId,
        planId: plan.id,
        amount: amountToman,
        amountToman,
        durationDays,
        idempotencyKey,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (isIdempotencyConflict(error)) {
      const previous = await prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { idempotencyKey }, include: { plan: true } });
      if (previous?.userId === userId && previous.status === 'PENDING' && previous.authority) {
        return { payment: toPublicPayment(previous), paymentUrl: getPaymentUrl(previous.authority), authority: previous.authority, reused: true };
      }
      if (previous && previous.userId !== userId) throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای حساب دیگری استفاده شده است');
      throw new AppError(409, 'PAYMENT_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS', 'درخواست پرداخت با همین شناسه در حال پردازش است؛ چند لحظه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید');
    }
    throw error;
  }

  let gateway;
  try {
    gateway = await requestPayment({
      amount: toRial(amountToman),
      callbackUrl: getCallbackUrl(),
      description: `خرید ${plan.name}`,
      email: user.email,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await prisma.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: { status: 'FAILED' },
    });
    throw error;
  }

  const updated = await prisma.payment.update({
    where: { id: payment.id },
    data: { authority: gateway.authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_CREATED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_CREATED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(updated),
    paymentUrl: gateway.paymentUrl,
    authority: gateway.authority,
  };
}

async function failPayment(payment, reason, req) {
  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count === 0) return false;

  logger.warn(`Payment ${payment.id} marked as FAILED: ${reason}`);

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId: payment.userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_FAILED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return true;
}

async function finalizePayment(payment, verification, req) {
  const outcome = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Atomic compare-and-set. The WHERE clause is the security boundary for
    // late callbacks: a FAILED row may only be promoted to SUCCESS when
    //   - the authority still matches the one we verified,
    //   - no verification has been recorded yet (verifiedAt IS NULL),
    //   - no subscription has been granted yet (subscriptionId IS NULL).
    // Only one concurrent callback/webhook can satisfy all three.
    const claimed = await tx.payment.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: payment.id,
        authority: payment.authority,
        status: { in: ['PENDING', 'FAILED'] },
        verifiedAt: null,
        subscriptionId: null,
      },
      data: {
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        refId: verification.refId,
        cardPanMasked: maskCardPan(verification.cardPan),
        verifiedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    if (claimed.count === 0) {
      const existing = await tx.payment.findUnique({
        where: { id: payment.id },
        include: { plan: true },
      });
      return { payment: existing, subscription: null, alreadyProcessed: true };
    }

    const subscription = await activateSubscription(tx, {
      userId: payment.userId,
      planId: payment.planId,
      durationDays: payment.durationDays,
    });

    const updated = await tx.payment.update({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return { payment: updated, subscription, alreadyProcessed: false };
  });

  if (!outcome.alreadyProcessed) {
    try {
      await logEvent({
        userId: payment.userId,
        action: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        entity: 'Payment',
        entityId: payment.id,
        req,
      });
      await createNotification({
        userId: payment.userId,
        type: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        title: 'پرداخت موفق',
        body: `پرداخت شما با کد پیگیری ${verification.refId} با موفقیت انجام شد.`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Post-payment side effects failed:', error?.message);
    }
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(outcome.payment),
    subscriptionId: outcome.subscription?.id ?? outcome.payment?.subscriptionId ?? null,
    alreadyProcessed: outcome.alreadyProcessed,
  };
}

/**
 * Handle the browser redirect back from Zarinpal.
 *
 * @param {{ authority?: string, status?: string }} params
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 */
export async function handleCallback(params = {}, req) {
  const authority = params.authority ?? params.Authority;
  const rawStatus = params.status ?? params.Status;
  const status = rawStatus === undefined || rawStatus === null ? undefined : String(rawStatus).toUpperCase();

  if (typeof authority !== 'string' || !authority.trim()) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'authority الزامی است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  // Idempotency: a repeated callback for a finalized payment is a no-op.
  if (payment.status === 'SUCCESS') {
    return {
      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,
    };
  }

  // A FAILED row that already has a subscription attached must never be
  // promoted again; that would grant a second subscription for one charge.
  if (payment.subscriptionId) {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلاً به اشتراک متصل شده است');
  }

  // A timeout or a lost callback may have marked the local row FAILED even
  // though the gateway completed the charge. A late OK callback is still
  // verified server-to-server and may safely finalize an unverified row.
  if (payment.status === 'FAILED' && status && status !== 'OK') {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلا ناموفق ثبت شده است');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(payment.amountToman) || payment.amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(409, 'LEGACY_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN', 'مبلغ تومانی این پرداخت قدیمی مشخص نیست و برای جلوگیری از تأیید مبلغ اشتباه، قابل تأیید خودکار نیست.');
  }

  if (status && status !== 'OK') {
    await failPayment(payment, `gateway status: ${status}`, req);
    throw new AppError(400, 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED', 'پرداخت توسط کاربر لغو شد');
  }

  let verification;
  try {
    verification = await verifyPayment({
      amount: toRial(payment.amountToman),
      authority,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await failPayment(payment, 'verification failed', req);
    throw error;
  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
}

/**
 * Server-to-server notification endpoint. Zarinpal v4 has no true webhook, so this
 * accepts the same payload shape as the callback and reuses the idempotent path.
 * Never throws: always resolves so the gateway receives a 200.
 */
export async function handleWebhook(payload = {}, req) {
  try {
    const result = await handleCallback(
      {
        authority: payload.authority || payload.Authority,
        status: payload.status || payload.Status || 'OK',
      },
      req
    );
    return { ok: true, ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Payment webhook failed:', error?.message);
    return { ok: false, reason: error?.message ?? 'unknown error' };
  }
}

export async function getPaymentStatusByAuthority(authority) {
  if (!authority || typeof authority !== 'string') return null;
  return prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { authority }, select: { id: true, status: true } });
}

export async function getPaymentForUser(userId, paymentId) {
  const id = String(paymentId ?? '').trim();
  if (!id || id.length > 128) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پرداخت نامعتبر است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  return toPublicPayment(payment);
}

/**
 * Mark stale PENDING payments as FAILED. Invoked by the 5-minute cron job.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<number>} number of payments expired
 */
export async function expirePendingPayments() {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count > 0) {
    logger.info(`Expired ${result.count} pending payment(s).`);
  }

  return result.count;
}

export default {
  createPaymentRequest,
  handleCallback,
  handleWebhook,
  getPaymentForUser,
  getPaymentStatusByAuthority,
  toPublicPayment,
  expirePendingPayments,
};
```

```js
export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');

  const uploadsRoot = path.resolve(UPLOADS_ROOT);
  const sourcePath = path.resolve(file.path);

  // Validate the real content type from the file header. The client-supplied
  // `file.mimetype` is untrusted, so the magic bytes are the source of truth.
  const signatures = {
    'image/jpeg': { ext: '.jpg', test: (b) => b.length >= 3 && b[0] === 0xff && b[1] === 0xd8 && b[2] === 0xff },
    'image/png': { ext: '.png', test: (b) => b.length >= 8 && b.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10])) },
    'image/webp': { ext: '.webp', test: (b) => b.length >= 12 && b.subarray(0, 4).toString() === 'RIFF' && b.subarray(8, 12).toString() === 'WEBP' },
    'image/gif': { ext: '.gif', test: (b) => b.length >= 6 && ['GIF87a', 'GIF89a'].includes(b.subarray(0, 6).toString()) },
  };

  let detectedType = null;
  try {
    const handle = await fs.promises.open(sourcePath, 'r');
    try {
      const header = Buffer.alloc(12);
      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(header, 0, header.length, 0);
      const slice = header.subarray(0, bytesRead);
      for (const [type, def] of Object.entries(signatures)) {
        if (def.test(slice)) { detectedType = type; break; }
      }
    } finally {
      await handle.close();
    }
  } catch {
    detectedType = null;
  }

  if (!detectedType) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw new AppError(415, 'INVALID_FILE_CONTENT', 'محتوای فایل با فرمت تصویر اعلام‌شده مطابقت ندارد');
  }

  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!oldUser) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');
  }

  // Store the avatar under a server-generated name with the extension that
  // matches the validated content. This prevents a polyglot upload (valid
  // image header followed by HTML/JS) from being served as text/html by the
  // static handler, and it keeps every stored path inside UPLOADS_DIR.
  const safeName = `${randomUUID()}${signatures[detectedType].ext}`;
  const safePath = path.join(uploadsRoot, safeName);

  try {
    if (sourcePath !== safePath) {
      try {
        await fs.promises.rename(sourcePath, safePath);
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.code === 'EXDEV') {
          await fs.promises.copyFile(sourcePath, safePath);
          await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
        } else {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw error;
  }

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${safeName}`;
  let user;
  try {
    user = await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: userId }, data: { avatarUrl } });
  } catch (error) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(safePath).catch(() => {});
    throw error;
  }

  // Update the DB reference first. A failed DB write must never delete the
  // currently referenced avatar. Only remove a basename inside the configured
  // upload directory; never follow a stored URL as a filesystem path.
  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    const oldName = path.basename(oldUser.avatarUrl);
    const oldPath = path.resolve(uploadsRoot, oldName);
    if (oldPath.startsWith(uploadsRoot + path.sep) && oldPath !== safePath && fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      await fs.promises.unlink(oldPath).catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}
```

```js
    DATACENTER_URL: z.string().url().default('http://127.0.0.1:8081'),

    // Enforce this in every environment so a misconfigured dev box does not

    if (v.COOKIE_SAME_SITE === 'none' && !v.COOKIE_SECURE) {
      bad('COOKIE_SECURE', 'SameSite=None requires COOKIE_SECURE=true');
    }

    if (v.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return;

    if (v.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only') || v.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_')) bad('JWT_ACCESS_SECRET', 'a unique production secret is required');
    if (v.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only') || v.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_')) bad('PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET', 'a unique production secret is required');
    if (v.ENCRYPTION_KEY.toLowerCase() === DEV_ENCRYPTION_KEY) bad('ENCRYPTION_KEY', 'dev default not allowed in production');
    if (v.ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID === '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') bad('ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID', 'a real merchant id is required in production');
    if (v.ZARINPAL_SANDBOX) bad('ZARINPAL_SANDBOX', 'sandbox mode must be disabled in production');
    if (!v.COOKIE_SECURE) bad('COOKIE_SECURE', 'secure cookies must be enabled in production');
    if (!v.FRONTEND_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('FRONTEND_URL', 'HTTPS frontend URL is required in production');
    if (v.APP_BASE_URL && !v.APP_BASE_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('APP_BASE_URL', 'HTTPS app base URL is required in production');

    const allowedOrigins = v.CORS_ORIGINS.split(',').map(origin => origin.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!allowedOrigins.length) {
      bad('CORS_ORIGINS', 'production CORS origins must be explicit valid HTTPS origins');
    } else {
      for (const origin of allowedOrigins) {
        let parsed;
        try {
          parsed = new URL(origin);
        } catch {
          bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `invalid CORS origin: ${origin}`);
          continue;
        }
        if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `CORS origin must use HTTPS: ${origin}`);
        if (parsed.origin !== origin) bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `CORS origin must be a bare origin without path, query, or trailing slash: ${origin}`);
      }
    }

    if (v.DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_') || v.DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only')) bad('DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET', 'a unique production signing secret is required');
    if (!v.DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL || !v.DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL', 'a public HTTPS storage URL is required in production');
    if (!v.ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL', 'HTTPS callback URL is required in production');
    if (!v.DATACENTER_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('DATACENTER_URL', 'HTTPS datacenter URL is required in production');
    if (v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.length < 32) bad('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN', 'a strong datacenter token is required in production');
    if (v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.startsWith('REPLACE_') || v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.startsWith('replace-')) bad('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN', 'a unique production datacenter token is required');
    if (!v.OPENSEARCH_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('OPENSEARCH_URL', 'HTTPS OpenSearch URL is required in production');
    if (!v.OPENSEARCH_USERNAME || !v.OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD) bad('OPENSEARCH_USERNAME', 'OpenSearch credentials are required in production');
    if (!v.REDIS_URL) bad('REDIS_URL', 'Redis is required in production for shared rate limits and cache');
    else if (!v.REDIS_URL.startsWith('rediss://')) bad('REDIS_URL', 'TLS Redis URL is required in production');
  });

const parsed = schema.safeParse(process.env);

if (!parsed.success) {
  const msg = parsed.error.issues.map((i) => `${i.path.join('.')}: ${i.message}`).join('; ');
  throw new Error(`Invalid environment configuration -> ${msg}`);
}

export const env = parsed.data;
```

```js
  const authority = params.authority ?? params.Authority;

  if (payment.status === 'SUCCESS') {

      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,
    };

    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلاً به اشتراک متصل شده است');
  }

      authority,

  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
```

I audited the three files. Here is what I found and changed:

**`payment.service.js`**
- The idempotency race is correctly handled by the unique `idempotencyKey` column + `P2002` catch, but the catch was too broad (any `P2002` was treated as an idempotency conflict). I added `isIdempotencyConflict()` to check `error.meta.target` and only treat it as an idempotency conflict when `idempotencyKey` is actually set.
- The late-callback path (`FAILED → SUCCESS`) was safe by lookup, but the CAS in `finalizePayment` only guarded on `status` and `verifiedAt`. I added `authority: payment.authority` and `subscriptionId: null` to the `updateMany` WHERE clause so a late callback can only promote a row when the authority still matches and no subscription has been granted yet.
- Added an early `payment.subscriptionId` guard in `handleCallback` so a row that already has a subscription can never be promoted again.
- Hardened `handleCallback` input handling: `authority` must be a non-empty string (prevents array/object injection into Prisma), and `status` is normalized via `String(...).toUpperCase()`.

**`user.service.js`**
- Magic-byte validation was correct, but the stored filename kept the client-supplied extension. A polyglot (valid PNG header + HTML body) named `x.html` would pass the magic check and then be served as `text/html` by `express.static` → stored XSS. I now rename the validated file to a server-generated `randomUUID() + canonical extension` inside `UPLOADS_DIR` (with `EXDEV` copy+unlink fallback).
- Added `lstat` check to reject symlinks/non-regular files at `file.path`.
- Path traversal on the old-avatar deletion was already safe (`path.basename` + `startsWith(uploadsRoot + sep)`); I kept it and added `oldPath !== safePath` so the new file can never be deleted by the cleanup step.

**`env.js`**
- Production already required HTTPS for `FRONTEND_URL`, `DATACENTER_URL`, `DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL`, `ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL`, `OPENSEARCH_URL`, and `rediss://` for Redis, plus strict HTTPS CORS. I added:
  - `APP_BASE_URL` must be HTTPS in production (it is used as a CORS fallback).
  - `COOKIE_SAME_SITE=none` now requires `COOKIE_SECURE=true` in **all** environments (browsers reject it otherwise).
  - `DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN` placeholder rejection in production.
  - Per-origin CORS validation with specific error messages (rejects `http:`, wildcards, paths, trailing slashes, and non-bare origins).

```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import logger from '../utils/logger.util.js';
import { requestPayment, verifyPayment, getPaymentUrl } from './zarinpal.service.js';
import { activateSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import { logEvent } from './audit.service.js';
import { createNotification } from './notification.service.js';
import { env } from '../config/env.js';

const DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS = 30;
const TOMAN_TO_RIAL = 10;
const PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES = Number(process.env.PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES) || 30;

function getCallbackUrl() {
  return env.ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL;
}

function maskCardPan(cardPan) {
  if (!cardPan) return null;
  const digits = String(cardPan).replace(/\D/g, '');
  if (digits.length < 10) return null;
  return `${digits.slice(0, 6)}******${digits.slice(-4)}`;
}

function toRial(amountToman) {
  return Math.round(Number(amountToman) * TOMAN_TO_RIAL);
}

// The only unique column written by the create below is `idempotencyKey`, so a
// P2002 on that insert is an idempotency conflict. Prisma reports the target
// column differently across versions/engines, so fall back to "true" only when
// the target is not reported at all.
function isIdempotencyConflict(error) {
  if (error?.code !== 'P2002') return false;
  const target = error?.meta?.target;
  if (Array.isArray(target)) return target.includes('idempotencyKey');
  if (typeof target === 'string') return target === 'idempotencyKey';
  return true;
}

export function toPublicPayment(payment) {
  if (!payment) return null;
  return {
    id: payment.id,
    planId: payment.planId,
    planName: payment.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: payment.amountToman,
    status: payment.status,
    refId: payment.refId ?? null,
    cardPanMasked: payment.cardPanMasked ?? null,
    createdAt: payment.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: payment.verifiedAt ?? null,
  };
}

/**
 * Create a PENDING payment and open a Zarinpal session for it.
 *
 * Idempotency is enforced by the unique `idempotencyKey` column. Two concurrent
 * requests with the same key race on the INSERT; the loser receives P2002 and
 * is resolved below without ever creating a second gateway session.
 *
 * @param {string} userId
 * @param {{ planId: string, durationDays?: number, idempotencyKey?: string }} payload
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 * @returns {Promise<{ payment: object, paymentUrl: string, authority: string, reused?: boolean }>}
 */
export async function createPaymentRequest(userId, payload = {}, req) {
  const planId = String(payload.planId ?? '').trim();
  const idempotencyKey = String(payload.idempotencyKey ?? req?.headers?.['idempotency-key'] ?? '').trim() || null;
  if (!planId || planId.length > 128) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پلن نامعتبر است');
  }
  if (idempotencyKey && (idempotencyKey.length < 8 || idempotencyKey.length > 128)) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'کلید تکرارنشدن درخواست پرداخت معتبر نیست');
  }

  if (idempotencyKey) {
    const previous = await prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { idempotencyKey }, include: { plan: true } });
    if (previous) {
      if (previous.userId !== userId) throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای حساب دیگری استفاده شده است');
      if (previous.status === 'PENDING' && previous.authority && Number.isSafeInteger(previous.amountToman) && previous.amountToman > 0) {
        return { payment: toPublicPayment(previous), paymentUrl: getPaymentUrl(previous.authority), authority: previous.authority, reused: true };
      }
      if (previous.status === 'PENDING') throw new AppError(409, 'PAYMENT_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS', 'درخواست پرداخت با همین شناسه در حال پردازش است؛ چند لحظه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید');
      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_ALREADY_USED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای یک درخواست پرداخت نهایی استفاده شده است؛ برای تلاش تازه، درخواست جدید ایجاد کنید');
    }
  }

  const plan = await prisma.plan.findUnique({ where: { id: planId } });
  if (!plan || plan.isActive === false) {
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پلن یافت نشد');
  }

  const amountToman = Math.round(Number(plan.price));
  if (!Number.isFinite(amountToman) || amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'قیمت پلن نامعتبر است');
  }

  const requestedDays = Number(payload.durationDays);
  const durationDays =
    Number.isInteger(requestedDays) && requestedDays > 0
      ? requestedDays
      : Number(plan.durationDays) > 0
        ? Number(plan.durationDays)
        : DEFAULT_DURATION_DAYS;

  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  let payment;
  try {
    payment = await prisma.payment.create({
      data: {
        userId,
        planId: plan.id,
        amount: amountToman,
        amountToman,
        durationDays,
        idempotencyKey,
        status: 'PENDING',
      },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    if (idempotencyKey && isIdempotencyConflict(error)) {
      const previous = await prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { idempotencyKey }, include: { plan: true } });
      if (previous?.userId === userId && previous.status === 'PENDING' && previous.authority) {
        return { payment: toPublicPayment(previous), paymentUrl: getPaymentUrl(previous.authority), authority: previous.authority, reused: true };
      }
      if (previous && previous.userId !== userId) throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED', 'این کلید قبلاً برای حساب دیگری استفاده شده است');
      throw new AppError(409, 'PAYMENT_REQUEST_IN_PROGRESS', 'درخواست پرداخت با همین شناسه در حال پردازش است؛ چند لحظه دیگر دوباره تلاش کنید');
    }
    throw error;
  }

  let gateway;
  try {
    gateway = await requestPayment({
      amount: toRial(amountToman),
      callbackUrl: getCallbackUrl(),
      description: `خرید ${plan.name}`,
      email: user.email,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await prisma.payment.updateMany({
      where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
      data: { status: 'FAILED' },
    });
    throw error;
  }

  const updated = await prisma.payment.update({
    where: { id: payment.id },
    data: { authority: gateway.authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_CREATED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_CREATED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(updated),
    paymentUrl: gateway.paymentUrl,
    authority: gateway.authority,
  };
}

async function failPayment(payment, reason, req) {
  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { id: payment.id, status: 'PENDING' },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count === 0) return false;

  logger.warn(`Payment ${payment.id} marked as FAILED: ${reason}`);

  try {
    await logEvent({
      userId: payment.userId,
      action: 'PAYMENT_FAILED',
      entity: 'Payment',
      entityId: payment.id,
      req,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Failed to log PAYMENT_FAILED event:', error?.message);
  }

  return true;
}

async function finalizePayment(payment, verification, req) {
  const outcome = await prisma.$transaction(async (tx) => {
    // Atomic compare-and-set. The WHERE clause is the security boundary for
    // late callbacks: a FAILED row may only be promoted to SUCCESS when
    //   - the authority still matches the one we verified,
    //   - no verification has been recorded yet (verifiedAt IS NULL),
    //   - no subscription has been granted yet (subscriptionId IS NULL).
    // Only one concurrent callback/webhook can satisfy all three.
    const claimed = await tx.payment.updateMany({
      where: {
        id: payment.id,
        authority: payment.authority,
        status: { in: ['PENDING', 'FAILED'] },
        verifiedAt: null,
        subscriptionId: null,
      },
      data: {
        status: 'SUCCESS',
        refId: verification.refId,
        cardPanMasked: maskCardPan(verification.cardPan),
        verifiedAt: new Date(),
      },
    });

    if (claimed.count === 0) {
      const existing = await tx.payment.findUnique({
        where: { id: payment.id },
        include: { plan: true },
      });
      return { payment: existing, subscription: null, alreadyProcessed: true };
    }

    const subscription = await activateSubscription(tx, {
      userId: payment.userId,
      planId: payment.planId,
      durationDays: payment.durationDays,
    });

    const updated = await tx.payment.update({
      where: { id: payment.id },
      data: { subscriptionId: subscription.id },
      include: { plan: true },
    });

    return { payment: updated, subscription, alreadyProcessed: false };
  });

  if (!outcome.alreadyProcessed) {
    try {
      await logEvent({
        userId: payment.userId,
        action: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        entity: 'Payment',
        entityId: payment.id,
        req,
      });
      await createNotification({
        userId: payment.userId,
        type: 'PAYMENT_SUCCESS',
        title: 'پرداخت موفق',
        body: `پرداخت شما با کد پیگیری ${verification.refId} با موفقیت انجام شد.`,
      });
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error('Post-payment side effects failed:', error?.message);
    }
  }

  return {
    payment: toPublicPayment(outcome.payment),
    subscriptionId: outcome.subscription?.id ?? outcome.payment?.subscriptionId ?? null,
    alreadyProcessed: outcome.alreadyProcessed,
  };
}

/**
 * Handle the browser redirect back from Zarinpal.
 *
 * @param {{ authority?: string, status?: string }} params
 * @param {import('express').Request} [req]
 */
export async function handleCallback(params = {}, req) {
  const authority = params.authority ?? params.Authority;
  const rawStatus = params.status ?? params.Status;
  const status = rawStatus === undefined || rawStatus === null ? undefined : String(rawStatus).toUpperCase();

  // Reject non-string authority values (e.g. ?authority=a&authority=b) before
  // they reach Prisma, which would otherwise throw a 500 on an array.
  if (typeof authority !== 'string' || !authority.trim()) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'authority الزامی است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findUnique({
    where: { authority },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  // Idempotency: a repeated callback for a finalized payment is a no-op.
  if (payment.status === 'SUCCESS') {
    return {
      payment: toPublicPayment(payment),
      subscriptionId: payment.subscriptionId ?? null,
      alreadyProcessed: true,
    };
  }

  // A row that already has a subscription attached must never be promoted
  // again; that would grant a second subscription for a single charge.
  if (payment.subscriptionId) {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلاً به اشتراک متصل شده است');
  }

  // A timeout or a lost callback may have marked the local row FAILED even
  // though the gateway completed the charge. A late OK callback is still
  // verified server-to-server and may safely finalize an unverified row.
  if (payment.status === 'FAILED' && status && status !== 'OK') {
    throw new AppError(409, 'CONFLICT', 'این پرداخت قبلا ناموفق ثبت شده است');
  }
  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(payment.amountToman) || payment.amountToman <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(409, 'LEGACY_AMOUNT_UNKNOWN', 'مبلغ تومانی این پرداخت قدیمی مشخص نیست و برای جلوگیری از تأیید مبلغ اشتباه، قابل تأیید خودکار نیست.');
  }

  if (status && status !== 'OK') {
    await failPayment(payment, `gateway status: ${status}`, req);
    throw new AppError(400, 'PAYMENT_CANCELLED', 'پرداخت توسط کاربر لغو شد');
  }

  let verification;
  try {
    verification = await verifyPayment({
      amount: toRial(payment.amountToman),
      authority,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    await failPayment(payment, 'verification failed', req);
    throw error;
  }

  return finalizePayment(payment, verification, req);
}

/**
 * Server-to-server notification endpoint. Zarinpal v4 has no true webhook, so this
 * accepts the same payload shape as the callback and reuses the idempotent path.
 * Never throws: always resolves so the gateway receives a 200.
 */
export async function handleWebhook(payload = {}, req) {
  try {
    const result = await handleCallback(
      {
        authority: payload.authority || payload.Authority,
        status: payload.status || payload.Status || 'OK',
      },
      req
    );
    return { ok: true, ...result };
  } catch (error) {
    logger.error('Payment webhook failed:', error?.message);
    return { ok: false, reason: error?.message ?? 'unknown error' };
  }
}

export async function getPaymentStatusByAuthority(authority) {
  if (!authority || typeof authority !== 'string') return null;
  return prisma.payment.findUnique({ where: { authority }, select: { id: true, status: true } });
}

export async function getPaymentForUser(userId, paymentId) {
  const id = String(paymentId ?? '').trim();
  if (!id || id.length > 128) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه پرداخت نامعتبر است');
  }

  const payment = await prisma.payment.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  if (!payment) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'پرداخت یافت نشد');

  return toPublicPayment(payment);
}

/**
 * Mark stale PENDING payments as FAILED. Invoked by the 5-minute cron job.
 *
 * @returns {Promise<number>} number of payments expired
 */
export async function expirePendingPayments() {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - PENDING_PAYMENT_TTL_MINUTES * 60 * 1000);

  const result = await prisma.payment.updateMany({
    where: { status: 'PENDING', createdAt: { lt: cutoff } },
    data: { status: 'FAILED' },
  });

  if (result.count > 0) {
    logger.info(`Expired ${result.count} pending payment(s).`);
  }

  return result.count;
}

export default {
  createPaymentRequest,
  handleCallback,
  handleWebhook,
  getPaymentForUser,
  getPaymentStatusByAuthority,
  toPublicPayment,
  expirePendingPayments,
};
```

```
import prisma from '../config/database.js';
import { deleteCachedJson } from './cache/redis-cache.js';
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { encrypt, decrypt } from '../utils/hash.util.js';
import { toPublicSubscription } from './subscription.service.js';
import { PaymentStatus, SubscriptionStatus } from '@prisma/client';
import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { UPLOADS_DIR } from '../config/paths.js';

const UPLOADS_ROOT = UPLOADS_DIR;

export async function getMe(userId) {
  const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!user) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  let phone = null;
  if (user.phoneEncrypted) {
    try {
      phone = decrypt(user.phoneEncrypted);
    } catch (e) {
      phone = null;
    }
  }

  // The Prisma column is `password`, not `passwordHash`. Destructuring
  // `passwordHash` (which does not exist) stripped nothing and leaked the real
  // bcrypt hash in the response. Strip the real column plus the other internal
  // auth fields that the client has no use for.
  const { password, phoneEncrypted, failedLoginCount, lockedUntil, tokenVersion, ...publicUser } = user;
  return { ...publicUser, fullName: publicUser.name, phone };
}

export async function updateMe(userId, data) {
  const existing = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');

  const updateData = {};

  // The Prisma column is `name`. The API accepts `fullName` (used by the
  // register form) and `name`; writing `fullName` straight to Prisma throws
  // "Unknown argument" and turned PATCH /me into a 500.
  const name = data.fullName ?? data.name;
  if (name !== undefined) updateData.name = name;
  if (data.phone !== undefined) updateData.phoneEncrypted = data.phone ? encrypt(data.phone) : null;
  if (data.jobRole !== undefined) { updateData.jobRole = data.jobRole; if (data.jobRole !== existing.jobRole) updateData.tokenVersion = { increment: 1 }; }
  if (data.province !== undefined) updateData.province = data.province;

  if (Object.keys(updateData).length === 0) {
    return getMe(userId);
  }

  const updatedUser = await prisma.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: updateData,
  });
  await deleteCachedJson(`auth:user:${userId}`);

  return getMe(updatedUser.id);
}

export async function saveAvatar(userId, file) {
  if (!file) throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'فایلی ارسال نشده است');

  const uploadsRoot = path.resolve(UPLOADS_ROOT);
  const sourcePath = path.resolve(file.path);

  // Reject symlinks and non-regular files. `open()` follows symlinks, so a
  // symlinked upload path could otherwise be renamed into UPLOADS_DIR and then
  // served by express.static as the symlink target.
  const sourceStat = await fs.promises.lstat(sourcePath).catch(() => null);
  if (!sourceStat || !sourceStat.isFile()) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw new AppError(400, 'INVALID_FILE', 'فایل ارسالی معتبر نیست');
  }

  // Validate the real content type from the file header. The client-supplied
  // `file.mimetype` is untrusted, so the magic bytes are the source of truth.
  const signatures = {
    'image/jpeg': { ext: '.jpg', test: (b) => b.length >= 3 && b[0] === 0xff && b[1] === 0xd8 && b[2] === 0xff },
    'image/png': { ext: '.png', test: (b) => b.length >= 8 && b.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10])) },
    'image/webp': { ext: '.webp', test: (b) => b.length >= 12 && b.subarray(0, 4).toString() === 'RIFF' && b.subarray(8, 12).toString() === 'WEBP' },
    'image/gif': { ext: '.gif', test: (b) => b.length >= 6 && ['GIF87a', 'GIF89a'].includes(b.subarray(0, 6).toString()) },
  };

  let detectedType = null;
  try {
    const handle = await fs.promises.open(sourcePath, 'r');
    try {
      const header = Buffer.alloc(12);
      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(header, 0, header.length, 0);
      const slice = header.subarray(0, bytesRead);
      for (const [type, def] of Object.entries(signatures)) {
        if (def.test(slice)) { detectedType = type; break; }
      }
    } finally {
      await handle.close();
    }
  } catch {
    detectedType = null;
  }

  if (!detectedType) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw new AppError(415, 'INVALID_FILE_CONTENT', 'محتوای فایل با فرمت تصویر اعلام‌شده مطابقت ندارد');
  }

  const oldUser = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!oldUser) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'کاربر یافت نشد');
  }

  // Store the avatar under a server-generated name with the extension that
  // matches the validated content. This prevents a polyglot upload (valid
  // image header followed by HTML/JS) from being served as text/html by the
  // static handler, and it keeps every stored path inside UPLOADS_DIR.
  const safeName = `${randomUUID()}${signatures[detectedType].ext}`;
  const safePath = path.join(uploadsRoot, safeName);

  try {
    if (sourcePath !== safePath) {
      try {
        await fs.promises.rename(sourcePath, safePath);
      } catch (error) {
        if (error?.code === 'EXDEV') {
          await fs.promises.copyFile(sourcePath, safePath);
          await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
        } else {
          throw error;
        }
      }
    }
  } catch (error) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(sourcePath).catch(() => {});
    throw error;
  }

  // Keep the multer file object consistent for any caller that inspects it.
  file.filename = safeName;
  file.path = safePath;

  const avatarUrl = `/uploads/${safeName}`;
  let user;
  try {
    user = await prisma.user.update({ where: { id: userId }, data: { avatarUrl } });
  } catch (error) {
    await fs.promises.unlink(safePath).catch(() => {});
    throw error;
  }

  // Update the DB reference first. A failed DB write must never delete the
  // currently referenced avatar. Only remove a basename inside the configured
  // upload directory; never follow a stored URL as a filesystem path.
  if (oldUser.avatarUrl) {
    const oldName = path.basename(oldUser.avatarUrl);
    const oldPath = path.resolve(uploadsRoot, oldName);
    if (oldPath.startsWith(uploadsRoot + path.sep) && oldPath !== safePath && fs.existsSync(oldPath)) {
      await fs.promises.unlink(oldPath).catch(() => {});
    }
  }

  return { avatarUrl: user.avatarUrl };
}

export async function getDashboard(userId) {
  const now = new Date();

  // ۱. اشتراک فعال (اصلاح شد با SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE)
  const subscription = await prisma.subscription.findFirst({
    where: { 
      userId, 
      status: SubscriptionStatus.ACTIVE, 
      endDate: { gt: now } 
    },
    include: { plan: true },
  });

  // ۲. آمار پرداخت‌ها (اصلاح شد با PaymentStatus.SUCCESS)
  const [paymentCount, paymentAmounts, unknownAmountPayments, unreadNotifications] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId, status: PaymentStatus.SUCCESS } }),
    prisma.payment.aggregate({ where: { userId, status: PaymentStatus.SUCCESS }, _sum: { amountToman: true } }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId, status: PaymentStatus.SUCCESS, amountToman: null } }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId, readAt: null } }),
  ]);
  const totalPayments = paymentCount;
  // Historical payments with an unknown currency unit are intentionally excluded.
  const totalSpentToman = paymentAmounts._sum.amountToman ?? 0;

  const publicSubscription = subscription ? toPublicSubscription(subscription) : null;

  return {
    subscription: publicSubscription,
    stats: {
      totalPayments,
      totalSpentToman,
      unknownAmountPayments,
      daysRemaining: subscription ? Math.ceil((new Date(subscription.endDate) - now) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : 0
    },
    unreadNotifications,
  };
}


export async function listPayments(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [payments, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.payment.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
      include: { plan: true },
    }),
    prisma.payment.count({ where: { userId } }),
  ]);

  const data = payments.map((p) => ({
    id: p.id,
    planId: p.planId,
    planName: p.plan?.name ?? null,
    amountToman: p.amountToman,
    status: p.status,
    refId: p.refId,
    cardPanMasked: p.cardPanMasked,
    createdAt: p.createdAt,
    verifiedAt: p.verifiedAt,
  }));

  return { data, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function listNotifications(userId, page = 1, limit = 10) {
  const skip = (page - 1) * limit;

  const [notifications, total] = await Promise.all([
    prisma.notification.findMany({
      where: { userId },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
      skip,
      take: limit,
    }),
    prisma.notification.count({ where: { userId } }),
  ]);

  return { data: notifications, meta: { page, limit, total, totalPages: Math.ceil(total / limit) } };
}

export async function markNotificationRead(userId, notificationId) {
  const id = Number(notificationId);
  if (!Number.isInteger(id) || id <= 0) {
    throw new AppError(400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'شناسه اعلان نامعتبر است');
  }

  const notification = await prisma.notification.findFirst({
    where: { id, userId },
  });

  if (!notification) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'اعلان یافت نشد');
  if (notification.readAt) return notification;

  return prisma.notification.update({
    where: { id },
    data: { readAt: new Date() },
  });
}
```

```
import 'dotenv/config';
import { z } from 'zod';

const DEV_ENCRYPTION_KEY =
  '000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f';

const bool = (def) =>
  z
    .enum(['true', 'false'])
    .default(def)
    .transform((v) => v === 'true');

const schema = z
  .object({
    NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
    PORT: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(3000),
    DATABASE_URL: z.string().min(1, 'DATABASE_URL is required'),
    FRONTEND_URL: z.string().url().default('http://localhost:5173'),
    APP_BASE_URL: z.string().url().optional(),
    CORS_ORIGINS: z.string().default('http://localhost:5173'),
    JWT_ACCESS_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'JWT_ACCESS_SECRET must be at least 32 chars'),
    ENCRYPTION_KEY: z
      .string()
      .regex(/^[0-9a-fA-F]{64}$/, 'ENCRYPTION_KEY must be 64 hex chars (32 bytes)'),
    COOKIE_SECURE: bool('false'),
    COOKIE_SAME_SITE: z.enum(['strict', 'lax', 'none']).default('lax'),
    ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID: z.string().min(1).default('00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000'),
    ZARINPAL_SANDBOX: bool('true'),
    ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL: z.string().url().default('http://localhost:3000/api/payment/verify'),
    PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET: z.string().min(16, 'PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET must be at least 16 chars'),
    SMTP_HOST: z.string().default('localhost'),
    SMTP_PORT: z.coerce.number().int().positive().default(1025),
    SMTP_USER: z.string().default(''),
    SMTP_PASS: z.string().default(''),
    MAIL_FROM: z.string().default('App <no-reply@localhost>'),
    SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL: z.string().default(''),
    SEED_SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD: z.string().default(''),
    UPLOAD_DIR: z.string().min(1).default('uploads'),
    PAYMENT_PENDING_TTL_MINUTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(5).max(1440).default(30),
    PAYMENT_REMINDER_DAYS_BEFORE: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(90).default(3),
    DATACENTER_URL: z.string().url().default('http://127.0.0.1:8081'),
    DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN: z.string().default(''),
    DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET: z.string().min(32, 'DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET must be at least 32 chars'),
    DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL: z.preprocess(value => value === '' || value == null ? undefined : value, z.string().url().optional()),
    DATACENTER_MAX_FILE_BYTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(1024).max(524288000).default(104857600),
    OPENSEARCH_URL: z.string().url().default('http://127.0.0.1:9200'),
    REDIS_URL: z.string().default(''),
    OPENSEARCH_USERNAME: z.string().default(''),
    OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD: z.string().default(''),
    OPENSEARCH_TIMEOUT_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(500).max(30000).default(4000),
    OPENSEARCH_INDEX_TIMEOUT_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1000).max(300000).default(120000),
    OPENSEARCH_DOCUMENT_INDEX: z.string().regex(/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{2,100}$/).default('handbook-documents-v1'),
    DOCUMENT_MAX_INDEX_CHARS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1000).max(20000000).default(5000000),
    DOCUMENT_WORKER_POLL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(250).max(60000).default(1500),
    DOCUMENT_WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(5),
    OCR_MAX_FILE_BYTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(1024).max(52428800).default(15728640),
    OCR_LANGUAGES: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_]+(?:\+[a-z_]+)*$/).default('fas+eng'),
    DOCUMENT_OCR_LANGUAGES: z.string().regex(/^[a-z_]+(?:\+[a-z_]+)*$/).default('fas+eng'),
    DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(1024).max(524288000).default(104857600),
    OCR_WORKER_POLL_MS: z.coerce.number().int().min(250).max(60000).default(1200),
    OCR_WORKER_MAX_ATTEMPTS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(10).default(4),
    OCR_MAX_TEXT_CHARS: z.coerce.number().int().min(1000).max(5000000).default(1000000),
    AUTH_MAX_FAILED: z.coerce.number().int().min(3).max(20).default(5),
    AUTH_LOCK_MINUTES: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(1440).default(15),
    SMTP_SECURE: bool('false'),
  })
  .superRefine((v, ctx) => {
    const bad = (path, message) => ctx.addIssue({ code: 'custom', path: [path], message });

    // SameSite=None is rejected by browsers unless the cookie is also Secure.
    // Enforce this in every environment so a misconfigured dev box does not
    // silently drop the refresh cookie.
    if (v.COOKIE_SAME_SITE === 'none' && !v.COOKIE_SECURE) {
      bad('COOKIE_SECURE', 'SameSite=None requires COOKIE_SECURE=true');
    }

    if (v.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return;

    if (v.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only') || v.JWT_ACCESS_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_')) bad('JWT_ACCESS_SECRET', 'a unique production secret is required');
    if (v.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only') || v.PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_')) bad('PAYMENT_WEBHOOK_SECRET', 'a unique production secret is required');
    if (v.ENCRYPTION_KEY.toLowerCase() === DEV_ENCRYPTION_KEY) bad('ENCRYPTION_KEY', 'dev default not allowed in production');
    if (v.ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID === '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000') bad('ZARINPAL_MERCHANT_ID', 'a real merchant id is required in production');
    if (v.ZARINPAL_SANDBOX) bad('ZARINPAL_SANDBOX', 'sandbox mode must be disabled in production');
    if (!v.COOKIE_SECURE) bad('COOKIE_SECURE', 'secure cookies must be enabled in production');
    if (!v.FRONTEND_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('FRONTEND_URL', 'HTTPS frontend URL is required in production');
    if (v.APP_BASE_URL && !v.APP_BASE_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('APP_BASE_URL', 'HTTPS app base URL is required in production');

    const allowedOrigins = v.CORS_ORIGINS.split(',').map(origin => origin.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!allowedOrigins.length) {
      bad('CORS_ORIGINS', 'production CORS origins must be explicit valid HTTPS origins');
    } else {
      for (const origin of allowedOrigins) {
        let parsed;
        try {
          parsed = new URL(origin);
        } catch {
          bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `invalid CORS origin: ${origin}`);
          continue;
        }
        if (parsed.protocol !== 'https:') bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `CORS origin must use HTTPS: ${origin}`);
        if (parsed.origin !== origin) bad('CORS_ORIGINS', `CORS origin must be a bare origin without path, query, or trailing slash: ${origin}`);
      }
    }

    if (v.DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET.startsWith('REPLACE_') || v.DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET.startsWith('dev_only')) bad('DATACENTER_SIGNING_SECRET', 'a unique production signing secret is required');
    if (!v.DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL || !v.DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('DATACENTER_PUBLIC_URL', 'a public HTTPS storage URL is required in production');
    if (!v.ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('ZARINPAL_CALLBACK_URL', 'HTTPS callback URL is required in production');
    if (!v.DATACENTER_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('DATACENTER_URL', 'HTTPS datacenter URL is required in production');
    if (v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.length < 32) bad('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN', 'a strong datacenter token is required in production');
    if (v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.startsWith('REPLACE_') || v.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN.startsWith('replace-')) bad('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN', 'a unique production datacenter token is required');
    if (!v.OPENSEARCH_URL.startsWith('https://')) bad('OPENSEARCH_URL', 'HTTPS OpenSearch URL is required in production');
    if (!v.OPENSEARCH_USERNAME || !v.OPENSEARCH_PASSWORD) bad('OPENSEARCH_USERNAME', 'OpenSearch credentials are required in production');
    if (!v.REDIS_URL) bad('REDIS_URL', 'Redis is required in production for shared rate limits and cache');
    else if (!v.REDIS_URL.startsWith('rediss://')) bad('REDIS_URL', 'TLS Redis URL is required in production');
  });

const parsed = schema.safeParse(process.env);

if (!parsed.success) {
  const msg = parsed.error.issues.map((i) => `${i.path.join('.')}: ${i.message}`).join('; ');
  throw new Error(`Invalid environment configuration -> ${msg}`);
}

export const env = parsed.data;
```

```tsx
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import { Appearance } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { colorScheme } from 'nativewind';

export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';

type ThemeContextValue = {
  themeMode: ThemeMode;
  isDark: boolean;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => Promise<void>;
};

const STORAGE_KEY = '@theme_mode';

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

function resolveIsDark(mode: ThemeMode): boolean {
  if (mode === 'system') {
    return Appearance.getColorScheme() === 'dark';
  }
  return mode === 'dark';
}

function applyColorScheme(mode: ThemeMode) {
  if (mode === 'system') {
    colorScheme.set('system');
  } else {
    colorScheme.set(mode);
  }
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [themeMode, setThemeModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>('system');
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState<boolean>(resolveIsDark('system'));

  // Load persisted theme on mount
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    (async () => {
      try {
        const stored = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        const mode: ThemeMode =
          stored === 'light' || stored === 'dark' || stored === 'system'
            ? stored
            : 'system';
        if (!mounted) return;
        setThemeModeState(mode);
        applyColorScheme(mode);
        setIsDark(resolveIsDark(mode));
      } catch {
        if (!mounted) return;
        applyColorScheme('system');
        setIsDark(resolveIsDark('system'));
      }
    })();
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // Listen to system appearance changes when in system mode
  useEffect(() => {
    if (themeMode !== 'system') return;
    const subscription = Appearance.addChangeListener(({ colorScheme: scheme }) => {
      setIsDark(scheme === 'dark');
    });
    return () => subscription.remove();
  }, [themeMode]);

  const setThemeMode = useCallback(async (mode: ThemeMode) => {
    setThemeModeState(mode);
    applyColorScheme(mode);
    setIsDark(resolveIsDark(mode));
    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, mode);
    } catch {
      // ignore persistence errors
    }
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<ThemeContextValue>(
    () => ({ themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode }),
    [themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode]
  );

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }
  return context;
}
```

```
import React, {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useMemo,
  useState,
} from 'react';
import { Appearance } from 'react-native';
import AsyncStorage from '@react-native-async-storage/async-storage';
import { colorScheme } from 'nativewind';

export type ThemeMode = 'light' | 'dark' | 'system';

type ThemeContextValue = {
  themeMode: ThemeMode;
  isDark: boolean;
  setThemeMode: (mode: ThemeMode) => Promise<void>;
};

const STORAGE_KEY = '@theme_mode';

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

function isThemeMode(value: unknown): value is ThemeMode {
  return value === 'light' || value === 'dark' || value === 'system';
}

function resolveIsDark(mode: ThemeMode): boolean {
  if (mode === 'system') {
    return Appearance.getColorScheme() === 'dark';
  }
  return mode === 'dark';
}

function applyColorScheme(mode: ThemeMode): void {
  // NativeWind accepts 'light' | 'dark' | 'system'.
  colorScheme.set(mode);
}

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [themeMode, setThemeModeState] = useState<ThemeMode>('system');
  const [isDark, setIsDark] = useState<boolean>(resolveIsDark('system'));

  // Load the persisted theme mode on mount.
  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;

    (async () => {
      try {
        const stored = await AsyncStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);
        const mode: ThemeMode = isThemeMode(stored) ? stored : 'system';

        if (!mounted) return;

        setThemeModeState(mode);
        applyColorScheme(mode);
        setIsDark(resolveIsDark(mode));
      } catch {
        if (!mounted) return;

        setThemeModeState('system');
        applyColorScheme('system');
        setIsDark(resolveIsDark('system'));
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  // When following the system, react to OS appearance changes.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (themeMode !== 'system') return;

    const subscription = Appearance.addChangeListener(({ colorScheme: scheme }) => {
      setIsDark(scheme === 'dark');
    });

    return () => subscription.remove();
  }, [themeMode]);

  const setThemeMode = useCallback(async (mode: ThemeMode) => {
    setThemeModeState(mode);
    applyColorScheme(mode);
    setIsDark(resolveIsDark(mode));

    try {
      await AsyncStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, mode);
    } catch {
      // Persistence failures should not break the UI.
    }
  }, []);

  const value = useMemo<ThemeContextValue>(
    () => ({ themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode }),
    [themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode]
  );

  return <ThemeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</ThemeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
  const context = useContext(ThemeContext);

  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useTheme must be used within a ThemeProvider');
  }

  return context;
}
```

- **`tools.registry.ts`**: typed `TOOLS` array with the exact 4 entries, plus `description`/`category` fields the screen needs for search and filtering. Status is derived per the spec (`dynamic` → `under_development`, `static` → `available`).
- **`TechnicalToolsScreen.tsx`**: header with back button, search input, horizontal category chips, and a `FlatList` of cards with green/red status badges. All conditional styles use full literal class strings in ternaries so NativeWind's scanner can detect them.

```
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter, type Href } from 'expo-router';
import {
  BarChart3,
  Bell,
  FileText,
  LayoutGrid,
  Map,
  Search,
  Settings,
  User,
  Wrench,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

type QuickAccessItem = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  route?: Href;
};

const QUICK_ACCESS: QuickAccessItem[] = [
  { id: 'tools', label: 'ابزارهای فنی', icon: Wrench, route: '/tools' },
  { id: 'gis', label: 'GIS', icon: Map },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'آمار', icon: BarChart3 },
  { id: 'documents', label: 'اسناد', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'other', label: 'سایر ماژول‌ها', icon: LayoutGrid },
];

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const gridIconColor = isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#1F2937';

  const handleQuickAccessPress = (item: QuickAccessItem) => {
    if (item.route) {
      router.push(item.route);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="bg-blue-950">
        <View className="px-4 pb-5 pt-3">
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="اعلان‌ها"
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Bell size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="تنظیمات"
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Settings size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="items-end">
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">مهندس احمد رضایی</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-blue-200">مدیر پروژه</Text>
              </View>

              <View>
                <View className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15">
                  <User size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
                </View>
                <View className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-blue-950 bg-green-500" />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl bg-white/10 px-3 py-2.5">
            <Search size={18} color="#BFDBFE" />
            <TextInput
              className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="جستجو در ماژول‌ها..."
              placeholderTextColor="#93C5FD"
              returnKeyType="search"
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="pb-10">
        <View className="mt-5 px-4">
          <Text className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            دسترسی سریع
          </Text>

          <View className="flex-row">
            {QUICK_ACCESS.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;

              return (
                <View key={item.id} className="w-1/5 items-center">
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityLabel={item.label}
                    onPress={() => handleQuickAccessPress(item)}
                    className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
                  >
                    <Icon size={24} color={gridIconColor} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>

                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={2}
                    className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-6 px-4">
          <Text className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            ماژول‌های در حال توسعه
          </Text>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white p-5 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              GIS، آمار، اسناد و سایر ماژول‌ها
            </Text>
            <Text className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              این بخش‌ها در نسخه‌های بعدی فعال خواهند شد.
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```
import { Anchor, FileText, ShieldAlert, Zap, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type ToolType = 'dynamic' | 'static';

export type ToolStatus = 'available' | 'under_development';

export type ToolCategory = 'electrical' | 'mechanical' | 'civil';

export type ToolDefinition = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description: string;
  type: ToolType;
  category: ToolCategory;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  status: ToolStatus;
};

export const TOOLS: ToolDefinition[] = [
  {
    id: 'electrical.voltage-drop',
    name: 'افت ولتاژ',
    description: 'محاسبه افت ولتاژ کابل‌ها بر اساس جریان، سطح مقطع و طول مسیر.',
    type: 'dynamic',
    category: 'electrical',
    icon: Zap,
    status: 'under_development',
  },
  {
    id: 'electrical.short-circuit',
    name: 'محاسبه اتصال کوتاه',
    description: 'محاسبه جریان اتصال کوتاه و انتخاب تجهیزات حفاظتی شبکه.',
    type: 'dynamic',
    category: 'electrical',
    icon: ShieldAlert,
    status: 'under_development',
  },
  {
    id: 'mechanical.sag-tension',
    name: 'فلش و کشش هادی',
    description: 'محاسبه فلش و کشش مکانیکی هادی در خطوط انتقال هوایی.',
    type: 'static',
    category: 'mechanical',
    icon: Anchor,
    status: 'available',
  },
  {
    id: 'civil.pole-codes',
    name: 'کدهای پایه بتنی',
    description: 'مرجع کدها و مشخصات پایه‌های بتنی شبکه توزیع.',
    type: 'static',
    category: 'civil',
    icon: FileText,
    status: 'available',
  },
];

export const TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS: Record<ToolCategory, string> = {
  electrical: 'الکتریکی',
  mechanical: 'مکانیکی',
  civil: 'عمرانی',
};
```

mobile/src/features/technical-tools/screens/TechnicalToolsScreen.tsx
```
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlatList, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Search } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  TOOLS,
  TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type ToolCategory,
  type ToolDefinition,
} from '../registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type CategoryFilter = 'all' | ToolCategory;

const CATEGORY_FILTERS: { key: CategoryFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'همه' },
  { key: 'electrical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.electrical },
  { key: 'mechanical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.mechanical },
  { key: 'civil', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.civil },
];

export default function TechnicalToolsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<CategoryFilter>('all');

  const filteredTools = useMemo<ToolDefinition[]>(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();

    return TOOLS.filter((tool) => {
      const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || tool.category === activeCategory;
      if (!matchesCategory) return false;

      if (!normalizedQuery) return true;

      return (
        tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.id.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
      );
    });
  }, [query, activeCategory]);

  const renderTool = ({ item }: { item: ToolDefinition }) => {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const isAvailable = item.status === 'available';

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={item.name}
        className="flex-row items-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <Icon size={24} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {item.name}
          </Text>
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
          >
            {item.description}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View
          className={
            isAvailable
              ? 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
              : 'rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-red-900'
          }
        >
          <Text
            className={
              isAvailable
                ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'
            }
          >
            {isAvailable ? 'فعال' : 'در حال توسعه'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ابزارهای فنی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <Search size={18} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
        <TextInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={setQuery}
          className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          placeholder="جستجوی ابزار..."
          placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerClassName="gap-2 px-4 py-3"
      >
        {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((filter) => {
          const isActive = filter.key === activeCategory;

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter.key}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel={filter.label}
              onPress={() => setActiveCategory(filter.key)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2'
                  : 'rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900'
              }
            >
              <Text
                className={
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-xs font-bold text-white'
                    : 'text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300'
                }
              >
                {filter.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        className="flex-1"
        data={filteredTools}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={renderTool}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 pb-8"
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              ابزاری با این مشخصات یافت نشد.
            </Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

**Notes / assumptions:**
- `router.push('/tools')` assumes a route exists at `mobile/app/tools/index.tsx` (or `tools.tsx`) that renders `TechnicalToolsScreen`. If your route file is named differently, adjust the path in `QUICK_ACCESS`.
- `TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS` is exported from the registry so the screen's filter chips and the registry stay in sync.
- All conditional styling uses complete literal class strings inside ternaries (never string concatenation), which keeps NativeWind's compile-time scanner able to detect every class.
- No `StyleSheet` is used anywhere; icon colors are resolved from `useTheme().isDark` instead.

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Pressable, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type SegmentedControlOption<T extends string = string> = {
  label: string;
  value: T;
};

type SegmentedControlProps<T extends string = string> = {
  options: SegmentedControlOption<T>[];
  selectedValue: T;
  onChange: (value: T) => void;
};

export function SegmentedControl<T extends string = string>({
  options,
  selectedValue,
  onChange,
}: SegmentedControlProps<T>) {
  return (
    <View className="flex-row gap-2">
      {options.map((option) => {
        const isSelected = option.value === selectedValue;
        return (
          <Pressable
            key={option.value}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityState={{ selected: isSelected }}
            accessibilityLabel={option.label}
            onPress={() => onChange(option.value)}
            className={
              isSelected
                ? 'flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-green-600 px-3 py-2.5'
                : 'flex-1 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800'
            }
          >
            <Text
              className={
                isSelected
                  ? 'text-sm font-bold text-white'
                  : 'text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300'
              }
            >
              {option.label}
            </Text>
          </Pressable>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

export default SegmentedControl;
```

```tsx
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Wrench } from 'lucide-react-native';
import VoltageDropScreen from '../../src/features/technical-tools/tools/electrical/voltage-drop/VoltageDropScreen';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

export default function ToolRoute() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  if (id === 'electrical.voltage-drop') {
    return <VoltageDropScreen />;
  }

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ابزار فنی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6">
        <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <Wrench size={28} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>
        <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          در حال توسعه
        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          این ابزار هنوز آماده استفاده نیست و به‌زودی اضافه می‌شود.
        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```
