```
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlatList, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Search } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  TOOLS,
  TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type ToolCategory,
  type ToolDefinition,
} from '../registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type CategoryFilter = 'all' | ToolCategory;

const CATEGORY_FILTERS: { key: CategoryFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'همه' },
  { key: 'electrical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.electrical },
  { key: 'mechanical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.mechanical },
  { key: 'civil', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.civil },
];

export default function TechnicalToolsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<CategoryFilter>('all');

  const filteredTools = useMemo<ToolDefinition[]>(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();

    return TOOLS.filter((tool) => {
      const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || tool.category === activeCategory;
      if (!matchesCategory) return false;

      if (!normalizedQuery) return true;

      return (
        tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.id.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
      );
    });
  }, [query, activeCategory]);

  const renderTool = ({ item }: { item: ToolDefinition }) => {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const isAvailable = item.status === 'available';

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={item.name}
        onPress={() => router.push(`/tools/${item.id}`)}
        className="flex-row items-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <Icon size={24} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {item.name}
          </Text>
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
          >
            {item.description}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View
          className={
            isAvailable
              ? 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
              : 'rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-red-900'
          }
        >
          <Text
            className={
              isAvailable
                ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'
            }
          >
            {isAvailable ? 'فعال' : 'در حال توسعه'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ابزارهای فنی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <Search size={18} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
        <TextInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={setQuery}
          className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          placeholder="جستجوی ابزار..."
          placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerClassName="gap-2 px-4 py-3"
      >
        {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((filter) => {
          const isActive = filter.key === activeCategory;

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter.key}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel={filter.label}
              onPress={() => setActiveCategory(filter.key)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2'
                  : 'rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900'
              }
            >
              <Text
                className={
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-xs font-bold text-white'
                    : 'text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300'
                }
              >
                {filter.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        className="flex-1"
        data={filteredTools}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={renderTool}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 pb-8"
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              ابزاری با این مشخصات یافت نشد.
            </Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Check, Monitor, Moon, Sun, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme, type ThemeMode } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

type ThemeOption = {
  value: ThemeMode;
  label: string;
  description: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
};

const THEME_OPTIONS: ThemeOption[] = [
  {
    value: 'light',
    label: 'روشن',
    description: 'همیشه از پوسته روشن استفاده می‌شود',
    icon: Sun,
  },
  {
    value: 'dark',
    label: 'تاریک',
    description: 'همیشه از پوسته تاریک استفاده می‌شود',
    icon: Moon,
  },
  {
    value: 'system',
    label: 'هماهنگ با سیستم',
    description: 'پوسته بر اساس تنظیمات دستگاه تغییر می‌کند',

  },
];

export default function SettingsScreen() {

  const { themeMode, isDark, setThemeMode } = useTheme();

  const handleSelect = (mode: ThemeMode) => {
    void setThemeMode(mode);
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">

          <View className="gap-3">

                        : 'h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800'

                  >
                    <Icon size={22} color={isSelected ? '#FFFFFF' : isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />

                  <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
                    <Text

                    >
                      {option.label}

                    <Text

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter, type Href } from 'expo-router';
import {
  BarChart3,
  Bell,
  FileText,
  LayoutGrid,
  Map,
  Search,
  Settings,
  User,
  Wrench,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

type QuickAccessItem = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  route?: Href;
};

const QUICK_ACCESS: QuickAccessItem[] = [
  { id: 'tools', label: 'ابزارهای فنی', icon: Wrench, route: '/tools' },
  { id: 'gis', label: 'GIS', icon: Map },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'آمار', icon: BarChart3 },
  { id: 'documents', label: 'اسناد', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'other', label: 'سایر ماژول‌ها', icon: LayoutGrid },
];

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const gridIconColor = isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#1F2937';

  const handleQuickAccessPress = (item: QuickAccessItem) => {
    if (item.route) {
      router.push(item.route);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="bg-blue-950">
        <View className="px-4 pb-5 pt-3">
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="اعلان‌ها"
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Bell size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="تنظیمات"
                onPress={() => router.push('/settings')}
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Settings size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="items-end">
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">مهندس احمد رضایی</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-blue-200">مدیر پروژه</Text>
              </View>

              <View>
                <View className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15">
                  <User size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
                </View>
                <View className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-blue-950 bg-green-500" />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl bg-white/10 px-3 py-2.5">
            <Search size={18} color="#BFDBFE" />
            <TextInput
              className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="جستجو در ماژول‌ها..."
              placeholderTextColor="#93C5FD"
              returnKeyType="search"
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="pb-10">
        <View className="mt-5 px-4">
          <Text className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            دسترسی سریع
          </Text>

          <View className="flex-row">
            {QUICK_ACCESS.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;

              return (
                <View key={item.id} className="w-1/5 items-center">
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityLabel={item.label}
                    onPress={() => handleQuickAccessPress(item)}
                    className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
                  >
                    <Icon size={24} color={gridIconColor} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>

                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={2}
                    className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-6 px-4">
          <Text className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            ماژول‌های در حال توسعه
          </Text>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-dashed border-gray-300 bg-white p-5 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">

            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';

const DATABASE_NAME = 'app.db';
const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME);
  }
  return databasePromise;
}

function generateUuid(): string { ... }

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

export async function saveCalculationHistory(toolId, inputs, outputs): Promise<string> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const id = generateUuid();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
  await db.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history (id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [id, toolId, LOCAL_USER_ID, JSON.stringify(inputs), JSON.stringify(outputs), createdAt, 'pending']
  );
  return id;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const db = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await db.getAllAsync<RawRow>(`SELECT * FROM calculation_history ORDER BY created_at DESC`);
  return rows.map(parseRow);
}

```ts
function generateUuid(): string {
  const template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx';
  return template.replace(/[xy]/g, (char) => {
    const random = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const value = char === 'x' ? random : (random & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return value.toString(16);
  });
}
```

```
import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';

/**
 * Name of the SQLite database file used by the app.
 * Change this constant if the app opens a different database file.
 */
const DATABASE_NAME = 'app.db';

const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';
const PENDING_SYNC_STATUS = 'pending';

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: string | null;
  outputs: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME).catch((error: unknown) => {
      databasePromise = null;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return databasePromise;
}

function generateUuid(): string {
  const template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx';

  return template.replace(/[xy]/g, (char) => {
    const random = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const value = char === 'x' ? random : (random & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return value.toString(16);
  });
}

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    tool_id: row.tool_id,
    user_id: row.user_id,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs),
    outputs: parseJsonObject(row.outputs),
    created_at: row.created_at,
    sync_status: row.sync_status,
  };
}

export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  toolId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<string> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const id = generateUuid();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      id,
      toolId,
      LOCAL_USER_ID,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(outputs),
      createdAt,
      PENDING_SYNC_STATUS,
    ]
  );

  return id;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`
  );

  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,

  Text,

} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

import {
  getCalculationHistory,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);

  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبت‌شده';

  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

export default function CalculationHistoryScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (mode: 'initial' | 'refresh') => {
    if (mode === 'initial') {
      setIsLoading(true);
    } else {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const records = await getCalculationHistory();
      setHistory(records);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadHistory('initial');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    void loadHistory('refresh');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: CalculationHistoryRecord }) => {
    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[item.tool_id] ?? item.tool_id;

    return (
      <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
              <HistoryIcon size={18} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
            </View>
            <Text
              numberOfLines={1}
              className="max-w-[190px] text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              {toolName}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View
            className={
              item.sync_status === 'pending'
                ? 'rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-amber-900'
                : 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
            }
          >
            <Text
              className={
                item.sync_status === 'pending'
                  ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                  : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
              }
            >
              {item.sync_status === 'pending' ? 'در انتظار همگام‌سازی' : 'همگام‌سازی شده'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
          <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {formatDate(item.created_at)}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
          >
            {summarizeInputs(item.inputs)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تاریخچه محاسبات</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری تاریخچه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          className="flex-1"
          data={history}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 py-4 pb-10"
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={isRefreshing}
              onRefresh={handleRefresh}
              tintColor={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'}
            />

          ListHeaderComponent={
            errorMessage ? (

                  {errorMessage}

              </View>

          ListEmptyComponent={

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlatList, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, History, Search } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  TOOLS,
  TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type ToolCategory,
  type ToolDefinition,
} from '../registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type CategoryFilter = 'all' | ToolCategory;

const CATEGORY_FILTERS: { key: CategoryFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'همه' },
  { key: 'electrical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.electrical },
  { key: 'mechanical', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.mechanical },
  { key: 'civil', label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.civil },
];

export default function TechnicalToolsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<CategoryFilter>('all');

  const filteredTools = useMemo<ToolDefinition[]>(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();

    return TOOLS.filter((tool) => {
      const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || tool.category === activeCategory;
      if (!matchesCategory) return false;

      if (!normalizedQuery) return true;

      return (
        tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.id.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
      );
    });
  }, [query, activeCategory]);

  const renderTool = ({ item }: { item: ToolDefinition }) => {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const isAvailable = item.status === 'available';

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={item.name}
        onPress={() => router.push(`/tools/${item.id}`)}
        className="flex-row items-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <Icon size={24} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {item.name}
          </Text>
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
          >
            {item.description}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View
          className={
            isAvailable
              ? 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
              : 'rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-red-900'
          }
        >
          <Text
            className={
              isAvailable
                ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'
            }
          >
            {isAvailable ? 'فعال' : 'در حال توسعه'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ابزارهای فنی</Text>

        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="تاریخچه محاسبات"
          onPress={() => router.push('/tools/history')}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <History size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <Search size={18} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
        <TextInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={setQuery}
          className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          placeholder="جستجوی ابزار..."
          placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerClassName="gap-2 px-4 py-3"
      >
        {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((filter) => {
          const isActive = filter.key === activeCategory;

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter.key}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel={filter.label}
              onPress={() => setActiveCategory(filter.key)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2'
                  : 'rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900'
              }
            >
              <Text
                className={
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-xs font-bold text-white'
                    : 'text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300'
                }
              >
                {filter.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        className="flex-1"
        data={filteredTools}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={renderTool}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 pb-8"
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              ابزاری با این مشخصات یافت نشد.
            </Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type StaticTableRow = {
  id: number;
  condition: string;
  clearances: Record<string, number>;
};

export type StaticTableData = {
  title: string;
  unit: string;
  voltage_levels: string[];
  rows: StaticTableRow[];
};

type StaticTableViewerProps = {
  data: StaticTableData;
};

const CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH = 160;
const VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH = 80;

function formatClearance(value: number | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || Number.isNaN(value)) return '—';
  return String(value);
}

export function StaticTableViewer({ data }: StaticTableViewerProps) {
  const { title, unit, voltage_levels: voltageLevels, rows } = data;

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="gap-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{title}</Text>
        <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          واحد مقادیر: {unit}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator
        contentContainerClassName="pb-1"
      >
        <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
          {/* Header */}
          <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <View
              style={{ width: CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
              className="justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700"
            >
              <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">شرح</Text>
            </View>

            {voltageLevels.map((level, index) => (
              <View
                key={level}
                style={{ width: VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className={
                  index < voltageLevels.length - 1
                    ? 'items-center justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-2 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                    : 'items-center justify-center px-2 py-3'
                }
              >
                <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{level}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          {/* Rows */}
          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <View
              key={row.id}
              className={
                rowIndex < rows.length - 1
                  ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
                  : 'flex-row'
              }
            >
              <View
                style={{ width: CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className="justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700"
              >
                <Text className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                  {row.condition}
                </Text>
              </View>

              {voltageLevels.map((level, index) => (
                <View
                  key={`${row.id}-${level}`}
                  style={{ width: VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                  className={
                    index < voltageLevels.length - 1
                      ? 'items-center justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-2 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                      : 'items-center justify-center px-2 py-3'
                  }
                >
                  <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatClearance(row.clearances[level])}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

export default StaticTableViewer;
```

I'll implement all five tasks. One engineering note up front:

**Vertical scrolling:** `ClearancesScreen` wraps the viewer in a vertical `ScrollView` (as you specified). Nesting a second vertical `ScrollView` inside it would break scrolling on Android and cause janky nested-scroll behavior on iOS. So `StaticTableViewer` owns the **horizontal** scroll (the table is wider than the screen) and the screen's `ScrollView` provides the **vertical** scroll. The table is still scrollable in both directions — just split across the two components.

- The registry field is `name` (not `title`), so the new entry uses `name: 'حریم هوایی هادی'`.
- The JSON import is cast to `StaticTableData` so `row.clearances[level]` type-checks (the inferred JSON type has literal keys, not an index signature).
- Column widths are fixed (`160px` / `80px`) so header and body cells stay aligned.

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type StaticTableRow = {
  id: number;
  condition: string;
  clearances: Record<string, number>;
};

export type StaticTableData = {
  title: string;
  unit: string;
  voltage_levels: string[];
  rows: StaticTableRow[];
};

type StaticTableViewerProps = {
  data: StaticTableData;
};

const CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH = 160;
const VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH = 80;

function formatClearance(value: number | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null || Number.isNaN(value)) return '—';
  return String(value);
}

export function StaticTableViewer({ data }: StaticTableViewerProps) {
  const { title, unit, voltage_levels: voltageLevels, rows } = data;

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="gap-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          {title}
        </Text>
        <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          واحد مقادیر: {unit}
        </Text>
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator contentContainerClassName="pb-1">
        <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
          <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <View
              style={{ width: CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
              className="justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700"
            >
              <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                شرح
              </Text>
            </View>

            {voltageLevels.map((level, index) => (
              <View
                key={level}
                style={{ width: VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className={
                  index < voltageLevels.length - 1
                    ? 'items-center justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-2 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                    : 'items-center justify-center px-2 py-3'
                }
              >
                <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{level}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <View
              key={row.id}
              className={
                rowIndex < rows.length - 1
                  ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
                  : 'flex-row'
              }
            >
              <View
                style={{ width: CONDITION_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className="justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700"
              >
                <Text className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                  {row.condition}
                </Text>
              </View>

              {voltageLevels.map((level, index) => (
                <View
                  key={`${row.id}-${level}`}
                  style={{ width: VALUE_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                  className={
                    index < voltageLevels.length - 1
                      ? 'items-center justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-2 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                      : 'items-center justify-center px-2 py-3'
                  }
                >
                  <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                    {formatClearance(row.clearances[level])}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

export default StaticTableViewer;

export type VoltageDropPhase = 'single' | 'three';
export type VoltageDropMaterial = 'copper' | 'aluminum';

export type VoltageDropInputs = {
  current: number;
  length: number;
  voltage: number;
  powerFactor: number;
  phase: VoltageDropPhase;
  material: VoltageDropMaterial;
  method: VoltageDropMethod;
};

export type VoltageDropStatus = 'مجاز' | 'غیرمجاز';

export type VoltageDropResult = {
  deltaV: number;
  percent: number;
  status: VoltageDropStatus;
};

const RESISTANCE_COPPER = 0.0175;
const RESISTANCE_ALUMINUM = 0.028;
const REACTANCE = 0.08;
const MAX_ALLOWED_PERCENT = 5;

function roundTo(value: number, digits: number): number {
  const factor = 10 ** digits;
  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
}

export function calculateVoltageDrop(inputs: VoltageDropInputs): VoltageDropResult {
  const { current, length, voltage, powerFactor, phase, material } = inputs;

  if (!Number.isFinite(current) || current <= 0) throw new Error('جریان عبوری باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  ...
}

```ts
export function calculateVoltageDrop(inputs: VoltageDropInputs): VoltageDropResult {
  const { current, length, voltage, powerFactor, phase, material } = inputs;

  if (!Number.isFinite(current) || current <= 0) {
    throw new Error('جریان عبوری باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(length) || length <= 0) {
    throw new Error('طول مسیر باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(voltage) || voltage <= 0) {
    throw new Error('ولتاژ باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(powerFactor) || powerFactor <= 0 || powerFactor > 1) {
    throw new Error('ضریب توان باید عددی بین ۰ و ۱ باشد.');
  }

  const resistance = material === 'copper' ? RESISTANCE_COPPER : RESISTANCE_ALUMINUM;
  const reactance = REACTANCE;

  const cosPhi = powerFactor;
  const sinPhi = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - cosPhi * cosPhi));

  const alpha = phase === 'single' ? 2 : Math.sqrt(3);

  const deltaV = alpha * current * length * (resistance * cosPhi + reactance * sinPhi);
  const percent = (deltaV / voltage) * 100;

  return {
    deltaV: roundTo(deltaV, 2),
    percent: roundTo(percent, 2),
    status: percent <= MAX_ALLOWED_PERCENT ? 'مجاز' : 'غیرمجاز',
  };
}
```

function parseNumber(value: string): number | null {
  const normalized = normalizeDigits(value).replace(/\s/g, '').replace(/٫/g, '.');
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const parsed = Number(normalized);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

export default function VoltageDropScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [networkType, setNetworkType] = useState<NetworkType>('single');
  const [installationMethod, setInstallationMethod] = useState<InstallationMethod>('cable');
  const [conductorMaterial, setConductorMaterial] = useState<ConductorMaterial>('copper');

  const [current, setCurrent] = useState<string>('');
  const [length, setLength] = useState<string>('');
  const [voltage, setVoltage] = useState<string>('');
  const [powerFactor, setPowerFactor] = useState<string>('');

  const [result, setResult] = useState<VoltageDropResult | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    setResult(null);
  }, [current, length, voltage, powerFactor, networkType, installationMethod, conductorMaterial]);

  const handleCalculate = async () => {
    const currentValue = parseNumber(current);
    const lengthValue = parseNumber(length);
    const voltageValue = parseNumber(voltage);
    const powerFactorValue = parseNumber(powerFactor);

    if (currentValue === null || lengthValue === null || voltageValue === null || powerFactorValue === null) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'لطفاً همه مقادیر را به صورت عددی وارد کنید.');
      return;
    }
    if (currentValue <= 0 || lengthValue <= 0 || voltageValue <= 0) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'جریان، طول مسیر و ولتاژ باید بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشند.');

**Notes on decisions:**
- **`method` (cable/overhead)** is accepted in the input type but does not alter the formula, since the spec's formula only depends on material. I documented it as reserved for future correction factors rather than inventing a coefficient.
- **`status`** is computed from the *unrounded* percentage (so 5.004% is correctly "غیرمجاز"), while `deltaV`/`percent` are rounded to 2 decimals for display.
- **Persian/Arabic digits** are normalized before parsing, since users on a Persian keyboard will type `۲۵` rather than `25`.
- **Stale results** are cleared whenever any input changes, so the card never shows a result that doesn't match the visible inputs.
- **History save failures** are caught and swallowed — a DB error must not hide a valid calculation result.

```
export type VoltageDropPhase = 'single' | 'three';

export type VoltageDropMaterial = 'copper' | 'aluminum';

export type VoltageDropMethod = 'cable' | 'overhead';

export type VoltageDropInputs = {
  current: number;
  length: number;
  voltage: number;
  powerFactor: number;
  phase: VoltageDropPhase;
  material: VoltageDropMaterial;
  /**
   * Accepted for future correction factors (cable vs. overhead).
   * The current approved formula does not depend on the installation method.
   */
  method: VoltageDropMethod;
};

export type VoltageDropStatus = 'مجاز' | 'غیرمجاز';

export type VoltageDropResult = {
  deltaV: number;
  percent: number;
  status: VoltageDropStatus;
};

/** Approximate resistance values (ohm) used by the reference formula. */
const RESISTANCE_COPPER = 0.0175;
const RESISTANCE_ALUMINUM = 0.028;

/** Approximate reactance value (ohm) used by the reference formula. */
const REACTANCE = 0.08;

/** Maximum allowed voltage drop percentage. */
const MAX_ALLOWED_PERCENT = 5;

function roundTo(value: number, digits: number): number {
  const factor = 10 ** digits;
  return Math.round(value * factor) / factor;
}

export function calculateVoltageDrop(inputs: VoltageDropInputs): VoltageDropResult {
  const { current, length, voltage, powerFactor, phase, material } = inputs;

  if (!Number.isFinite(current) || current <= 0) {
    throw new Error('جریان عبوری باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(length) || length <= 0) {
    throw new Error('طول مسیر باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(voltage) || voltage <= 0) {
    throw new Error('ولتاژ باید عددی بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشد.');
  }

  if (!Number.isFinite(powerFactor) || powerFactor <= 0 || powerFactor > 1) {
    throw new Error('ضریب توان باید عددی بین ۰ و ۱ باشد.');
  }

  const resistance = material === 'copper' ? RESISTANCE_COPPER : RESISTANCE_ALUMINUM;
  const reactance = REACTANCE;

  const cosPhi = powerFactor;
  const sinPhi = Math.sqrt(Math.max(0, 1 - cosPhi * cosPhi));

  const alpha = phase === 'single' ? 2 : Math.sqrt(3);

  const deltaV = alpha * current * length * (resistance * cosPhi + reactance * sinPhi);
  const percent = (deltaV / voltage) * 100;

  return {
    deltaV: roundTo(deltaV, 2),
    percent: roundTo(percent, 2),
    status: percent <= MAX_ALLOWED_PERCENT ? 'مجاز' : 'غیرمجاز',
  };
}
```

import React from 'react';

          <Text className={labelClass}>افت ولتاژ</Text>

import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Platform,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Zap } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { SegmentedControl } from '../../../components/SegmentedControl';
import { ResultDisplay } from '../../../components/ResultDisplay';
import {
  calculateVoltageDrop,
  type VoltageDropResult,
} from '../../../services/calculator.service';
import { saveCalculationHistory } from '../../../services/history.service';
import { useTheme } from '../../../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type NetworkType = 'single' | 'three';
type InstallationMethod = 'cable' | 'overhead';
type ConductorMaterial = 'copper' | 'aluminum';

const NETWORK_OPTIONS: { label: string; value: NetworkType }[] = [
  { label: 'تک‌فاز', value: 'single' },
  { label: 'سه‌فاز', value: 'three' },
];

const METHOD_OPTIONS: { label: string; value: InstallationMethod }[] = [
  { label: 'کابل', value: 'cable' },
  { label: 'هوایی', value: 'overhead' },
];

const MATERIAL_OPTIONS: { label: string; value: ConductorMaterial }[] = [
  { label: 'مس', value: 'copper' },
  { label: 'آلومینیوم', value: 'aluminum' },
];

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';
const ARABIC_DIGITS = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩';

/**
 * Converts Persian/Arabic-Indic digits and the Arabic decimal separator
 * into a plain Latin number string so `Number()` can parse it.
 */
function normalizeNumericInput(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (digit) => String(PERSIAN_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (digit) => String(ARABIC_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/٫/g, '.')
    .replace(/\s/g, '');
}

function parseNumber(value: string): number | null {
  const normalized = normalizeNumericInput(value);

  if (!normalized) return null;

  const parsed = Number(normalized);

  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

export default function VoltageDropScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [networkType, setNetworkType] = useState<NetworkType>('single');
  const [installationMethod, setInstallationMethod] = useState<InstallationMethod>('cable');
  const [conductorMaterial, setConductorMaterial] = useState<ConductorMaterial>('copper');

  const [current, setCurrent] = useState<string>('');
  const [length, setLength] = useState<string>('');
  const [voltage, setVoltage] = useState<string>('');
  const [powerFactor, setPowerFactor] = useState<string>('');

  const [result, setResult] = useState<VoltageDropResult | null>(null);

  // Any input change invalidates the previously displayed result.
  useEffect(() => {
    setResult(null);
  }, [current, length, voltage, powerFactor, networkType, installationMethod, conductorMaterial]);

  const handleCalculate = async () => {
    const currentValue = parseNumber(current);
    const lengthValue = parseNumber(length);
    const voltageValue = parseNumber(voltage);
    const powerFactorValue = parseNumber(powerFactor);

    if (
      currentValue === null ||
      lengthValue === null ||
      voltageValue === null ||
      powerFactorValue === null
    ) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'لطفاً همه مقادیر را به صورت عددی وارد کنید.');
      return;
    }

    if (currentValue <= 0 || lengthValue <= 0 || voltageValue <= 0) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'جریان، طول مسیر و ولتاژ باید بزرگ‌تر از صفر باشند.');
      return;
    }

    if (powerFactorValue <= 0 || powerFactorValue > 1) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'ضریب توان باید عددی بین ۰ و ۱ باشد.');
      return;
    }

    const inputs = {
      current: currentValue,
      length: lengthValue,
      voltage: voltageValue,
      powerFactor: powerFactorValue,
      phase: networkType,
      material: conductorMaterial,
      method: installationMethod,
    };

    let calculated: VoltageDropResult;

    try {
      calculated = calculateVoltageDrop(inputs);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      Alert.alert('خطا در محاسبه', message);
      return;
    }

    setResult(calculated);

    try {
      await saveCalculationHistory('electrical.voltage-drop', inputs, calculated);
    } catch {
      // A history persistence failure must not hide a valid calculation result.
    }
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">افت ولتاژ</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        className="flex-1"
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          className="flex-1"
          contentContainerClassName="gap-5 px-4 py-5 pb-10"
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">نوع شبکه</Text>
            <SegmentedControl
              options={NETWORK_OPTIONS}
              selectedValue={networkType}
              onChange={setNetworkType}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">روش اجرا</Text>
            <SegmentedControl
              options={METHOD_OPTIONS}
              selectedValue={installationMethod}
              onChange={setInstallationMethod}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">جنس هادی</Text>
            <SegmentedControl
              options={MATERIAL_OPTIONS}
              selectedValue={conductorMaterial}
              onChange={setConductorMaterial}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              جریان عبوری (آمپر)
            </Text>
            <TextInput
              value={current}
              onChangeText={setCurrent}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              placeholder="مثلاً 25"
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              طول مسیر (متر)
            </Text>
            <TextInput
              value={length}
              onChangeText={setLength}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              placeholder="مثلاً 50"
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ولتاژ (ولت)</Text>
            <TextInput
              value={voltage}
              onChangeText={setVoltage}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              placeholder={networkType === 'single' ? 'مثلاً 220' : 'مثلاً 380'}
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ضریب توان</Text>
            <TextInput
              value={powerFactor}
              onChangeText={setPowerFactor}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              placeholder="مثلاً 0.9"
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="محاسبه"
            onPress={() => {
              void handleCalculate();
            }}
            className="mt-2 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <Zap size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">محاسبه</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {result ? <ResultDisplay result={result} /> : null}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

}

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Zap } from 'lucide-react-native';

type PunchBannerProps = {
  onPress?: () => void;
};

export function PunchBanner({ onPress }: PunchBannerProps) {
  const content = (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 px-4 py-4">
      <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/20">
        <Zap size={24} color="#FFFFFF" />
      </View>
      <View className="flex-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-base font-bold text-white">پانچ همکار</Text>
        <Text className="mt-1 text-right text-xs text-green-50">یه پانچ بزن همکارت رو خبر کن!</Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <LinearGradient
      colors={['#22C55E', '#16A34A']}
      start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
      end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
      style={{ borderRadius: 16, overflow: 'hidden' }}
    >
      {onPress ? (
        <TouchableOpacity activeOpacity={0.85} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="پانچ همکار" onPress={onPress}>
          {content}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : (
        content
      )}
    </LinearGradient>
  );
}
```

```
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { TextInput, View } from 'react-native';
import { Mic, Search } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

export function SearchBar() {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>('');

  const iconColor = isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280';

  return (
    <View className="flex-row items-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
      <Mic size={20} color={iconColor} />

      <TextInput
        value={query}
        onChangeText={setQuery}
        className="mx-3 flex-1 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
        placeholder="هر سوالی در حوزه توزیع برق داری بپرس..."
        placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
        returnKeyType="search"
      />

      <Search size={20} color={iconColor} />
    </View>
  );
}

export default SearchBar;
```

mobile/src/features/home/components/PunchBanner.tsx
```
import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { Zap } from 'lucide-react-native';

type PunchBannerProps = {
  onPress?: () => void;
};

export function PunchBanner({ onPress }: PunchBannerProps) {
  const content = (
    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3 px-4 py-4">
      <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-white/20">
        <Zap size={24} color="#FFFFFF" />
      </View>

      <View className="flex-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-base font-bold text-white">پانچ همکار</Text>
        <Text className="mt-1 text-right text-xs text-green-50">
          یه پانچ بزن همکارت رو خبر کن!
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );

  return (
    <LinearGradient
      colors={['#22C55E', '#16A34A']}
      start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
      end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
      style={{ borderRadius: 16, overflow: 'hidden' }}
    >
      {onPress ? (
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.85}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="پانچ همکار"
          onPress={onPress}
        >
          {content}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : (
        content
      )}
    </LinearGradient>
  );
}

export default PunchBanner;
```

import React from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Play, User } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type LiveChatCardProps = {
  name: string;
  role: string;
  province: string;
  message: string;
  time: string;
  isAudio: boolean;
};

export function LiveChatCard({
  name,
  role,
  province,
  message,
  time,
  isAudio,
}: LiveChatCardProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
      <View className="flex-row items-center">
        <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <User size={20} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {name}
          </Text>
          <Text className="mt-0.5 text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {role} • {province}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">{time}</Text>
      </View>

      <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
        {isAudio ? (
          <View className="h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-600">
            <Play size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <Text className="flex-1 text-right text-xs leading-5 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
          {message}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

export default LiveChatCard;

import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { Headphones, Network, TowerControl, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type DeputyCardDefinition = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  containerClass: string;
  iconContainerClass: string;
  iconColor: string;
  iconColorDark: string;
  textClass: string;
};

const DEPUTY_CARDS: DeputyCardDefinition[] = [
  {
    id: 'operation',
    title: 'معاونت بهره‌برداری',
    icon: TowerControl,
    containerClass: 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#1D4ED8',
    iconColorDark: '#93C5FD',
    textClass: 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100',
  },
  {
    id: 'engineering',
    title: 'معاونت مهندسی',
    icon: Network,
    containerClass: 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#15803D',
    iconColorDark: '#86EFAC',
    textClass: 'text-green-900 dark:text-green-100',
  },
  {
    id: 'support',
    title: 'معاونت پشتیبانی',
    icon: Headphones,
    containerClass: 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#7E22CE',
    iconColorDark: '#D8B4FE',
    textClass: 'text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-100',
  },
];

export function DeputyCards() {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <View className="flex-row gap-3">
      {DEPUTY_CARDS.map((card) => {
        const Icon = card.icon;

        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={card.id}
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={card.title}
            className={`flex-1 items-center rounded-2xl p-3 ${card.containerClass}`}
          >
            <View
              className={`h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${card.iconContainerClass}`}
            >
              <Icon size={22} color={isDark ? card.iconColorDark : card.iconColor} />
            </View>

            <Text
              className={`mt-2 text-center text-[11px] font-bold leading-4 ${card.textClass}`}
            >
              {card.title}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

export default DeputyCards;
```

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter, type Href } from 'expo-router';
import {
  BarChart3,
  Bell,
  FileText,
  LayoutGrid,
  Map,
  Search,
  Settings,
  User,
  Wrench,
  type LucideIcon,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';
import { SearchBar } from '../src/features/home/components/SearchBar';
import { PunchBanner } from '../src/features/home/components/PunchBanner';
import { LiveChatCard } from '../src/features/home/components/LiveChatCard';
import { DeputyCards } from '../src/features/home/components/DeputyCards';

type QuickAccessItem = {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  route?: Href;
};

const QUICK_ACCESS: QuickAccessItem[] = [
  { id: 'tools', label: 'ابزارهای فنی', icon: Wrench, route: '/tools' },
  { id: 'gis', label: 'GIS', icon: Map },
  { id: 'stats', label: 'آمار', icon: BarChart3 },
  { id: 'documents', label: 'اسناد', icon: FileText },
  { id: 'other', label: 'سایر ماژول‌ها', icon: LayoutGrid },
];

export default function HomeScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const gridIconColor = isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#1F2937';

  const handleQuickAccessPress = (item: QuickAccessItem) => {
    if (item.route) {
      router.push(item.route);
    }
  };

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="bg-blue-950">
        <View className="px-4 pb-5 pt-3">
          <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="اعلان‌ها"
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Bell size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>

              <TouchableOpacity
                activeOpacity={0.7}
                accessibilityRole="button"
                accessibilityLabel="تنظیمات"
                onPress={() => router.push('/settings')}
                className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/10"
              >
                <Settings size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="items-end">
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">مهندس احمد رضایی</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-blue-200">مدیر پروژه</Text>
              </View>

              <View>
                <View className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15">
                  <User size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
                </View>
                <View className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-blue-950 bg-green-500" />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl bg-white/10 px-3 py-2.5">
            <Search size={18} color="#BFDBFE" />
            <TextInput
              className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="جستجو در ماژول‌ها..."
              placeholderTextColor="#93C5FD"
              returnKeyType="search"
            />
          </View>
        </View>
      </SafeAreaView>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="pb-10">
        <View className="mt-5 px-4">
          <Text className="mb-3 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            دسترسی سریع
          </Text>

          <View className="flex-row">
            {QUICK_ACCESS.map((item) => {
              const Icon = item.icon;

              return (
                <View key={item.id} className="w-1/5 items-center">
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityLabel={item.label}
                    onPress={() => handleQuickAccessPress(item)}
                    className="h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
                  >
                    <Icon size={24} color={gridIconColor} />
                  </TouchableOpacity>

                  <Text
                    numberOfLines={2}
                    className="mt-2 text-center text-[11px] font-medium text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300"
                  >
                    {item.label}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              );
            })}
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-5 px-4">
          <SearchBar />
        </View>

        <View className="mt-4 px-4">
          <PunchBanner />
        </View>

        <View className="mt-6 px-4">
          <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              گفت‌وگوی زنده همکاران
            </Text>
            <Text className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400">
              مشاهده همه
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View className="gap-3">
            <LiveChatCard
              name="مهندس یحیی ظفری"
              role="کارشناس بهره‌برداری"
              province="تهران"
              message="پیام صوتی ۰:۴۲"
              time="۱۰:۲۴"
              isAudio
            />

            <LiveChatCard
              name="علی احمدی"
              role="تکنسین خط گرم"
              province="اصفهان"
              message="سلام همکار، برای پانچ امروز هماهنگ کنیم."
              time="۱۰:۱۸"
              isAudio={false}
            />
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-6 px-4">
          <DeputyCards />
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}
```

import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';

import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type DeputyCardDefinition = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  containerClass: string;
  iconContainerClass: string;
  iconColor: string;
  iconColorDark: string;
  textClass: string;
};

const DEPUTY_CARDS: DeputyCardDefinition[] = [
  {
    id: 'operation',
    title: 'معاونت بهره‌برداری',
    icon: TowerControl,
    containerClass: 'bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#1D4ED8',
    iconColorDark: '#93C5FD',
    textClass: 'text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-100',
  },
  {
    id: 'engineering',
    title: 'معاونت مهندسی',
    icon: Network,
    containerClass: 'bg-green-50 dark:bg-green-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#15803D',
    iconColorDark: '#86EFAC',
    textClass: 'text-green-900 dark:text-green-100',
  },
  {
    id: 'support',
    title: 'معاونت پشتیبانی',
    icon: Headphones,
    containerClass: 'bg-purple-50 dark:bg-purple-950',
    iconContainerClass: 'bg-white dark:bg-white/10',
    iconColor: '#7E22CE',
    iconColorDark: '#D8B4FE',
    textClass: 'text-purple-900 dark:text-purple-100',
  },
];

export function DeputyCards() {

  return (
    <View className="flex-row gap-3">

        return (
          <TouchableOpacity
            key={card.id}
            activeOpacity={0.8}

            accessibilityLabel={card.title}
            className={`flex-1 items-center rounded-2xl p-3 ${card.containerClass}`}
          >
            <View
              className={`h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-xl ${card.iconContainerClass}`}
            >
              <Icon size={22} color={isDark ? card.iconColorDark : card.iconColor} />

            <Text
              className={`mt-2 text-center text-[11px] font-bold leading-4 ${card.textClass}`}
            >
              {card.title}
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        );
      })}
    </View>
  );
}

export default DeputyCards;

];

export default function HomeScreen() {

    if (item.route) {
      router.push(item.route);

  };

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="bg-blue-950">
        <View className="px-4 pb-5 pt-3">

                activeOpacity={0.7}

                <Settings size={20} color="#FFFFFF" />
              </TouchableOpacity>
            </View>

            <View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
              <View className="items-end">
                <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">مهندس احمد رضایی</Text>
                <Text className="mt-0.5 text-[11px] text-blue-200">مدیر پروژه</Text>
              </View>

              <View>
                <View className="h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white/15">
                  <User size={22} color="#FFFFFF" />
                </View>
                <View className="absolute -bottom-0.5 -right-0.5 h-3.5 w-3.5 rounded-full border-2 border-blue-950 bg-green-500" />
              </View>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl bg-white/10 px-3 py-2.5">

              className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-white"
              placeholder="جستجو در ماژول‌ها..."
              placeholderTextColor="#93C5FD"

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="pb-10">
        <View className="mt-5 px-4">

        </View>

        <View className="mt-6 px-4">
          <View className="mb-3 flex-row items-center justify-between">

  );
}

```
import React from 'react';
import { Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { Play, User } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

export type LiveChatCardProps = {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  role: string;
  province: string;
  message: string;
  time: string;
  isAudio: boolean;
};

export function LiveChatCard({
  id,
  name,
  role,
  province,
  message,
  time,
  isAudio,
}: LiveChatCardProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <View
      testID={`live-chat-card-${id}`}
      className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
    >
      <View className="flex-row items-center">
        <View className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <User size={20} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {name}
          </Text>
          <Text className="mt-0.5 text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {role} • {province}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <Text className="text-[10px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">{time}</Text>
      </View>

      <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-gray-100 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
        {isAudio ? (
          <View className="h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-green-600">
            <Play size={14} color="#FFFFFF" />
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <Text className="flex-1 text-right text-xs leading-5 text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
          {message}
        </Text>
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

export default LiveChatCard;
```

type ErrorBoundaryProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  resetKey?: string | number;
};

type ErrorBoundaryState = {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
};

export class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo) {
    console.error('ErrorBoundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    if (this.state.hasError && prevProps.resetKey !== this.props.resetKey) {
      this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
    }
  }

  handleReset = () => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
  };

  render() {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <ErrorFallback onRetry={this.handleReset} />;
    }
    return this.props.children;
  }
}
```

import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { AlertTriangle, RotateCcw, ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';

type ErrorFallbackProps = {
  error: Error | null;
  onRetry: () => void;
};

function ErrorFallback({ error, onRetry }: ErrorFallbackProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (router.canGoBack()) {
      router.back();
      return;
    }
    router.replace('/tools');
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20">
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6">
        <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/40">
          <AlertTriangle size={30} color={isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#DC2626'} />
        </View>

        <Text className="mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
          خطایی در این ابزار رخ داد
        </Text>

        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
          خطایی در این ابزار رخ داد. لطفا دوباره تلاش کنید یا به صفحه قبل بازگردید.
        </Text>

        {__DEV__ && error?.message ? (
          <View className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-white/70 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-black/20">
            <Text className="text-center text-[10px] leading-5 text-red-800 dark:text-red-200">
              {error.message}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View className="mt-6 w-full gap-3">
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
            onPress={handleBack}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-red-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <ArrowRight size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">بازگشت</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="تلاش دوباره"
            onPress={onRetry}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-300 bg-white px-4 py-3.5 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
          >
            <RotateCcw size={18} color={isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#DC2626'} />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">تلاش دوباره</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```
