**Design decisions worth flagging:**

1. **Class components can't use hooks**, so the fallback UI is a small functional component (`ErrorFallback`) that the class renders. That lets the fallback use `useTheme()` for the icon color and `useRouter()` for navigation, matching the rest of the codebase instead of hardcoding colors.
2. **`resetKey` prop** — `[id].tsx` is a single route component, so navigating from a crashed tool to another tool re-renders the *same* boundary instance. Without a reset, the user would be stuck on the error screen forever. The boundary clears its error state when `resetKey` (the tool `id`) changes.
3. **`router.canGoBack()` guard** — if the tool was opened via deep link there's no history, and `router.back()` would do nothing. It falls back to `router.replace('/tools')`.
4. **Retry button** — your message says "دوباره تلاش کنید یا به صفحه قبل بازگردید", so I added a `تلاش دوباره` button that resets the boundary alongside the required `بازگشت` button.
5. **Dev-only error detail** — the raw `error.message` is shown only under `__DEV__` to aid debugging without leaking internals to users.

```
import React from 'react';
import { Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { AlertTriangle, ArrowRight, RotateCcw } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';

type ErrorFallbackProps = {
  error: Error | null;
  onRetry: () => void;
};

function ErrorFallback({ error, onRetry }: ErrorFallbackProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const handleBack = () => {
    if (router.canGoBack()) {
      router.back();
      return;
    }

    router.replace('/tools');
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-red-50 dark:bg-red-900/20">
      <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6">
        <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-red-100 dark:bg-red-900/40">
          <AlertTriangle size={30} color={isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#DC2626'} />
        </View>

        <Text className="mt-4 text-center text-base font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
          خطایی رخ داد
        </Text>

        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
          خطایی در این ابزار رخ داد. لطفا دوباره تلاش کنید یا به صفحه قبل بازگردید.
        </Text>

        {__DEV__ && error?.message ? (
          <View className="mt-3 w-full rounded-xl bg-white/70 px-3 py-2 dark:bg-black/20">
            <Text className="text-center text-[10px] leading-5 text-red-800 dark:text-red-200">
              {error.message}
            </Text>
          </View>
        ) : null}

        <View className="mt-6 w-full gap-3">
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
            onPress={handleBack}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-red-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <ArrowRight size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">بازگشت</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="تلاش دوباره"
            onPress={onRetry}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-red-300 bg-white px-4 py-3.5 dark:border-red-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
          >
            <RotateCcw size={18} color={isDark ? '#FCA5A5' : '#DC2626'} />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
              تلاش دوباره
            </Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export type ErrorBoundaryProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  /**
   * When this value changes, a boundary that is currently showing the
   * fallback UI resets itself. Pass the route param so navigating to a
   * different tool clears a previous crash.
   */
  resetKey?: string | number;
};

export type ErrorBoundaryState = {
  hasError: boolean;
  error: Error | null;
};

export class ErrorBoundary extends React.Component<ErrorBoundaryProps, ErrorBoundaryState> {
  constructor(props: ErrorBoundaryProps) {
    super(props);
    this.state = { hasError: false, error: null };
  }

  static getDerivedStateFromError(error: Error): ErrorBoundaryState {
    return { hasError: true, error };
  }

  componentDidCatch(error: Error, errorInfo: React.ErrorInfo): void {
    console.error('ErrorBoundary caught an error:', error, errorInfo);
  }

  componentDidUpdate(prevProps: ErrorBoundaryProps): void {
    if (this.state.hasError && prevProps.resetKey !== this.props.resetKey) {
      this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
    }
  }

  private handleRetry = (): void => {
    this.setState({ hasError: false, error: null });
  };

  render(): React.ReactNode {
    if (this.state.hasError) {
      return <ErrorFallback error={this.state.error} onRetry={this.handleRetry} />;
    }

    return this.props.children;
  }
}

export default ErrorBoundary;
```

```
function UnderDevelopmentScreen() {

  return (

          این ابزار هنوز آماده استفاده نیست و به‌زودی اضافه می‌شود.
        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function ToolRoute() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();

  const renderTool = () => {
    if (id === 'electrical.voltage-drop') {
      return <VoltageDropScreen />;

  return <ErrorBoundary resetKey={id}>{renderTool()}</ErrorBoundary>;
}
```

```
generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

enum Role {
  USER
  ADMIN
  SUPER_ADMIN
}

enum SubscriptionStatus {
  ACTIVE
  EXPIRED
  CANCELED
}

enum PaymentStatus {
  PENDING
  SUCCESS
  FAILED
}

enum DocumentVisibility {
  PUBLIC
  ROLE_RESTRICTED
  PRIVATE
}

model User {
  id            String         @id @default(cuid())
  email         String         @unique
  password      String
  name          String?
  role          Role           @default(USER)
  jobRole       String?
  province      String?
  failedLoginCount Int       @default(0)
  tokenVersion     Int       @default(0)
  lockedUntil      DateTime?
  lastLoginAt      DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime       @updatedAt
  isActive      Boolean        @default(true)
  phoneEncrypted String?
  phoneHash     String?        @unique
  avatarUrl     String?
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
  adminLogs     AdminLog[]
  refreshTokens RefreshToken[]
  notifications Notification[]
  documents     Document[]
  syncRecords   SyncRecord[]
  syncOperations SyncOperation[]
  ocrJobs       OcrJob[]
  calculationHistory CalculationHistory[]
}

model Plan {
  id            String         @id @default(cuid())
  name          String
  description   String?
  price         Int
  durationDays  Int
  isActive      Boolean        @default(true)
  createdAt     DateTime       @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime       @updatedAt
  subscriptions Subscription[]
  payments      Payment[]
}

model Subscription {
  id        String             @id @default(cuid())
  userId    String
  planId    String
  status    SubscriptionStatus @default(ACTIVE)
  startDate DateTime           @default(now())
  endDate   DateTime
  createdAt DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt DateTime           @updatedAt
  
  user      User               @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan      Plan               @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])
  payments  Payment[]

  @@index([userId, status, endDate])
}

model Payment {
  id          String        @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  planId      String
  amount      Int
  authority   String?       @unique
  refId       String?
  status      PaymentStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt   DateTime      @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime      @updatedAt
  amountToman Int?
  durationDays Int          @default(30)
  cardPanMasked String?
  verifiedAt  DateTime?
  subscriptionId String?
  idempotencyKey String?
  subscription Subscription? @relation(fields: [subscriptionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  
  user        User          @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  plan        Plan          @relation(fields: [planId], references: [id])

  @@unique([userId, idempotencyKey])
  @@index([status, createdAt])
  @@index([subscriptionId])
}

model AdminLog {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  adminId   String?
  action    String
  details   String?
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  
  admin     User?     @relation(fields: [adminId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
}
model RefreshToken {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  tokenHash String   @unique
  userId    String
  user      User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  expiresAt DateTime
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())
  revokedAt DateTime?
  ip        String?
  userAgent String?

  @@index([userId, revokedAt])
}
model Notification {
  id        Int    @id @default(autoincrement())
  userId    String
  user      User      @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  title     String
  body      String
  type      String   @default("GENERAL")
  readAt    DateTime?
  createdAt DateTime  @default(now())

  @@index([userId])
}



model Document {
  id              String             @id @default(cuid())
  title           String
  originalName    String
  sourcePath      String?
  mimeType        String
  sizeBytes       Int
  checksumSha256  String             @unique
  storageKey      String             @unique
  visibility      DocumentVisibility @default(PUBLIC)
  accessRoles     String[]           @default([])
  accessJobRoles  String[]           @default([])
  ownerId         String?
  description     String?
  pageCount       Int?
  language        String             @default("fa")
  indexStatus     String             @default("PENDING")
  indexedAt       DateTime?
  isActive        Boolean            @default(true)
  createdAt       DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt       DateTime           @updatedAt
  owner           User?              @relation(fields: [ownerId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  indexJobs       DocumentIndexJob[]

  @@index([visibility, isActive, createdAt])
  @@index([ownerId, createdAt])
  @@index([indexStatus, updatedAt])
}

model DocumentIndexJob {
  id          String    @id @default(cuid())
  documentId  String
  status      String    @default("PENDING")
  attempts    Int       @default(0)
  availableAt DateTime  @default(now())
  lockedAt    DateTime?
  lastError   String?
  createdAt   DateTime  @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime  @updatedAt
  document    Document  @relation(fields: [documentId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([status, availableAt, createdAt])
  @@index([documentId, createdAt])
}


model SyncRecord {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId      String
  moduleName  String
  entityType  String
  entityId    String
  version     Int      @default(1)
  payload     Json
  isDeleted   Boolean  @default(false)
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([userId, moduleName, entityType, entityId])
  @@index([userId, updatedAt, id])
}

model SyncOperation {
  id              String   @id @default(cuid())
  operationId     String   @unique
  userId          String
  moduleName      String
  entityType      String
  entityId        String
  operation       String
  requestHash     String   @default("")
  resultStatus    String
  resultVersion   Int?
  conflictReason  String?
  createdAt       DateTime @default(now())
  user            User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}


model OcrJob {
  id            String   @id @default(cuid())
  userId        String
  storageKey    String   @unique
  storageDeleted Boolean  @default(false)
  mimeType      String
  sizeBytes     Int
  checksumSha256 String
  status        String   @default("PENDING")
  attempts      Int      @default(0)
  availableAt   DateTime @default(now())
  lockedAt      DateTime?
  resultText    String?
  confidence    Float?
  errorMessage  String?
  createdAt     DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime @updatedAt
  user          User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
  @@index([status, availableAt, createdAt])
}

model CalculationHistory {
  id          String   @id @default(uuid())
  userId      String
  toolId      String
  toolVersion String
  inputData   Json
  outputData  Json
  sources     Json?
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  user        User     @relation(fields: [userId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@index([userId, createdAt])
}
```

backend/src/services/calculationHistory.service.js
```
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

// If the project already exposes a shared Prisma client, import that instead
// of instantiating a new one here (multiple clients exhaust the connection pool).
const prisma = new PrismaClient();

/**
 * Persists a single calculation history record for the given user.
 *
 * @param {string} userId - Owner of the record (from the authenticated request).
 * @param {object} data - Validated payload.
 * @param {string} data.toolId
 * @param {string} data.toolVersion
 * @param {object} data.inputData
 * @param {object} data.outputData
 * @param {object|null} [data.sources]
 * @returns {Promise<object>} The created record.
 */
export async function createHistory(userId, data) {
  const { toolId, toolVersion, inputData, outputData, sources } = data;

  return prisma.calculationHistory.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      toolId,
      toolVersion,
      inputData,
      outputData,
      sources: sources === undefined || sources === null ? null : sources,
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Returns every calculation history record owned by the given user,
 * newest first.
 *
 * @param {string} userId
 * @returns {Promise<object[]>}
 */
export async function getUserHistory(userId) {
  return prisma.calculationHistory.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  });
}
```

backend/src/controllers/calculationHistory.controller.js
```
import { createHistory, getUserHistory } from '../services/calculationHistory.service.js';

const REQUIRED_FIELDS = ['toolId', 'toolVersion', 'inputData', 'outputData'];

function isPlainObject(value) {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

/**
 * POST /
 * Creates a calculation history record for the authenticated user.
 */
export async function create(req, res) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.id;

    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'کاربر احراز هویت نشده است.',
      });
    }

    const body = req.body ?? {};

    const missingFields = REQUIRED_FIELDS.filter(
      (field) => body[field] === undefined || body[field] === null || body[field] === ''
    );

    if (missingFields.length > 0) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: `فیلدهای الزامی ارسال نشده‌اند: ${missingFields.join(', ')}`,
      });
    }

    if (!isPlainObject(body.inputData) || !isPlainObject(body.outputData)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'inputData و outputData باید از نوع آبجکت JSON باشند.',
      });
    }

    if (body.sources !== undefined && body.sources !== null && !isPlainObject(body.sources)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'sources باید از نوع آبجکت JSON باشد.',
      });
    }

    const history = await createHistory(userId, {
      toolId: body.toolId,
      toolVersion: body.toolVersion,
      inputData: body.inputData,
      outputData: body.outputData,
      sources: body.sources,
    });

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      data: history,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[calculationHistory.create]', error);

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'خطا در ذخیره تاریخچه محاسبات.',
    });
  }
}

/**
 * GET /
 * Returns all calculation history records for the authenticated user.
 */
export async function getAll(req, res) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.id;

    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'کاربر احراز هویت نشده است.',
      });
    }

    const history = await getUserHistory(userId);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: history,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[calculationHistory.getAll]', error);

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'خطا در دریافت تاریخچه محاسبات.',
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
const SYNCED_STATUS = 'synced';
const TOOL_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type SyncPendingHistoriesResult = {
  syncedCount: number;
  pendingCount: number;
};

export async function syncPendingHistories(): Promise<SyncPendingHistoriesResult> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE sync_status = ?
      ORDER BY created_at ASC`,
    [PENDING_SYNC_STATUS]
  );

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return { syncedCount: 0, pendingCount: 0 };
  }

  const records = rows.map(mapRow);

  const payload = records.map((record) => ({
    toolId: record.tool_id,
    toolVersion: TOOL_VERSION,
    inputData: record.inputs,
    outputData: record.outputs,
    createdAt: record.created_at,
  }));

  await syncHistoryToBackend(payload);

  const placeholders = records.map(() => '?').join(', ');
  await database.runAsync(
    `UPDATE calculation_history SET sync_status = ? WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`,
    [SYNCED_STATUS, ...records.map((r) => r.id)]
  );

  return { syncedCount: records.length, pendingCount: 0 };
}
```

```
import axios, { type InternalAxiosRequestConfig } from 'axios';
import { Platform } from 'react-native';

/**
 * Base URL resolution order:
 * 1. EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL (set this in .env for real environments)
 * 2. Platform-specific localhost fallback for development
 *
 * Note: on the Android emulator, the host machine is reachable at 10.0.2.2,
 * not localhost (which points at the emulator itself).
 */
const ENV_API_URL: string | undefined =
  typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env?.EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL : undefined;

const FALLBACK_BASE_URL =
  Platform.select({
    android: 'http://10.0.2.2:3000',
    ios: 'http://localhost:3000',
    default: 'http://localhost:3000',
  }) ?? 'http://localhost:3000';

export const API_BASE_URL: string = ENV_API_URL ?? FALLBACK_BASE_URL;

/**
 * In-memory access token. Wire this to the app's auth flow by calling
 * setApiAccessToken() after login/refresh and setApiAccessToken(null) on logout.
 */
let accessToken: string | null = null;

export function setApiAccessToken(token: string | null): void {
  accessToken = token;
}

export function getApiAccessToken(): string | null {
  return accessToken;
}

export const apiClient = axios.create({
  baseURL: API_BASE_URL,
  timeout: 15000,
  headers: {
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    Accept: 'application/json',
  },
});

apiClient.interceptors.request.use((config: InternalAxiosRequestConfig) => {
  if (accessToken) {
    config.headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${accessToken}`);
  }

  return config;
});

/**
 * Payload contract expected by the backend CalculationHistory model.
 */
export type CalculationHistorySyncPayload = {
  toolId: string;
  toolVersion: string;
  inputData: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputData: Record<string, unknown>;
  sources?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  createdAt?: string;
};

export type CalculationHistorySyncResponse = {
  success: boolean;
  data?: unknown;
  message?: string;
};

/**
 * Sends a batch of calculation history records to the backend.
 *
 * @param historyItems - Records to persist server-side.
 * @returns The parsed server response.
 * @throws AxiosError on network failure or non-2xx status.
 */
export async function syncHistoryToBackend(
  historyItems: CalculationHistorySyncPayload[]
): Promise<CalculationHistorySyncResponse> {
  const response = await apiClient.post<CalculationHistorySyncResponse>(
    '/api/calculation-history/sync',
    historyItems
  );

  return response.data;
}
```

mobile/src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service.ts
```
import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';
import { syncHistoryToBackend } from './api.service';

/**
 * Name of the SQLite database file used by the app.
 * Change this constant if the app opens a different database file.
 */
const DATABASE_NAME = 'app.db';

const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';
const PENDING_SYNC_STATUS = 'pending';
const SYNCED_STATUS = 'synced';

/**
 * Version stamped on synced records. The backend requires a toolVersion,
 * which the local schema does not store. Update this when a tool's
 * approved formula changes.
 */
const TOOL_VERSION = '1.0.0';

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

export type SyncPendingHistoriesResult = {
  syncedCount: number;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: string | null;
  outputs: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME).catch((error: unknown) => {
      databasePromise = null;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return databasePromise;
}

function generateUuid(): string {
  const template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx';

  return template.replace(/[xy]/g, (char) => {
    const random = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const value = char === 'x' ? random : (random & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return value.toString(16);
  });
}

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    tool_id: row.tool_id,
    user_id: row.user_id,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs),
    outputs: parseJsonObject(row.outputs),
    created_at: row.created_at,
    sync_status: row.sync_status,
  };
}

export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  toolId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<string> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const id = generateUuid();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      id,
      toolId,
      LOCAL_USER_ID,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(outputs),
      createdAt,
      PENDING_SYNC_STATUS,
    ]
  );

  return id;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`
  );

  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

/**
 * Pushes every locally pending calculation to the backend and marks the
 * successfully uploaded rows as 'synced'.
 *
 * Rows are only marked as synced after the server accepts the whole batch,
 * so a failed request leaves them pending for the next attempt.
 *
 * @returns The number of records that were synced.
 * @throws Error when the request fails or the server rejects the batch.
 */
export async function syncPendingHistories(): Promise<SyncPendingHistoriesResult> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE sync_status = ?
      ORDER BY created_at ASC`,
    [PENDING_SYNC_STATUS]
  );

  if (rows.length === 0) {
    return { syncedCount: 0 };
  }

  const records = rows.map(mapRow);

  const payload = records.map((record) => ({
    toolId: record.tool_id,
    toolVersion: TOOL_VERSION,
    inputData: record.inputs,
    outputData: record.outputs,
    createdAt: record.created_at,
  }));

  const response = await syncHistoryToBackend(payload);

  if (!response.success) {
    throw new Error(response.message ?? 'سینک تاریخچه توسط سرور رد شد.');
  }

  const placeholders = records.map(() => '?').join(', ');

  await database.runAsync(
    `UPDATE calculation_history
        SET sync_status = ?
      WHERE id IN (${placeholders})`,
    [SYNCED_STATUS, ...records.map((record) => record.id)]
  );

  return { syncedCount: records.length };
}
```

```
  RefreshCw,
} from 'lucide-react-native';
import {

  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);

  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبت‌شده';

  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

export default function CalculationHistoryScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [isSyncing, setIsSyncing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (mode: 'initial' | 'refresh') => {
    if (mode === 'initial') {
      setIsLoading(true);
    } else {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const records = await getCalculationHistory();
      setHistory(records);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadHistory('initial');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    void loadHistory('refresh');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleSync = useCallback(async () => {
    if (isSyncing) return;

    setIsSyncing(true);

    try {
      const { syncedCount } = await syncPendingHistories();

      if (syncedCount === 0) {
        Alert.alert('سینک تاریخچه', 'موردی برای سینک وجود ندارد.');
      } else {
        Alert.alert('سینک تاریخچه', `تاریخچه با موفقیت سینک شد (${syncedCount} مورد).`);
      }

      await loadHistory('refresh');
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      Alert.alert('خطا در سینک', `سینک تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsSyncing(false);
    }
  }, [isSyncing, loadHistory]);

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: CalculationHistoryRecord }) => {
    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[item.tool_id] ?? item.tool_id;

    return (
      <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
              <HistoryIcon size={18} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
            </View>
            <Text
              numberOfLines={1}
              className="max-w-[190px] text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              {toolName}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View
            className={
              item.sync_status === 'pending'
                ? 'rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-amber-900'
                : 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
            }
          >
            <Text
              className={
                item.sync_status === 'pending'
                  ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                  : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
              }
            >
              {item.sync_status === 'pending' ? 'در انتظار همگام‌سازی' : 'همگام‌سازی شده'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
          <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {formatDate(item.created_at)}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
          >
            {summarizeInputs(item.inputs)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تاریخچه محاسبات</Text>

        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="سینک تاریخچه"
          accessibilityState={{ disabled: isSyncing, busy: isSyncing }}
          disabled={isSyncing}
          onPress={() => {
            void handleSync();
          }}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          {isSyncing ? (
            <ActivityIndicator size="small" color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
          ) : (
            <RefreshCw size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
          )}
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری تاریخچه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          className="flex-1"

          refreshControl={

              tintColor={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'}
```

```
import { api } from '../../../core/network/api';

/**
 * Payload contract expected by the backend CalculationHistory model.
 *
 * Note: `createdAt` is accepted by this type but the backend currently
 * stamps its own timestamp via `@default(now())`.
 */
export type CalculationHistorySyncPayload = {
  toolId: string;
  toolVersion: string;
  inputData: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputData: Record<string, unknown>;
  sources?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  createdAt?: string;
};

export type CalculationHistorySyncResponse = {
  success: boolean;
  data?: unknown;
  message?: string;
};

/**
 * Sends a batch of calculation history records to the backend.
 *
 * Uses the shared `api` client, which already:
 * - prefixes requests with `${EXPO_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL}/api/v1`
 * - attaches the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
 * - refreshes the session and retries once on a 401
 *
 * @param historyItems - Records to persist server-side.
 * @returns The parsed server response.
 * @throws AxiosError on network failure or non-2xx status.
 */
export async function syncHistoryToBackend(
  historyItems: CalculationHistorySyncPayload[]
): Promise<CalculationHistorySyncResponse> {
  const response = await api.post<CalculationHistorySyncResponse>(
    '/calculation-history/sync',
    historyItems
  );

  return response.data;
}
```

**Decisions worth flagging:**

1. **`createdAt` is honored when supplied.** The mobile client sends the original calculation timestamp. If the server ignored it, every synced record would get the sync time and the history list would show identical dates. Invalid timestamps are rejected with a 400 rather than reaching Prisma.
2. **`skipDuplicates: true` is a no-op today.** It only dedupes when a unique constraint exists, and `CalculationHistory` has none. The 401-retry duplication I flagged earlier is still possible — fixing it needs a unique constraint (e.g. on `[userId, toolId, createdAt]`) or a client-supplied `id`.
3. **`SUPER_ADMIN` is not treated as admin.** I implemented `req.user.role === 'ADMIN'` exactly as specified, but your `Role` enum also has `SUPER_ADMIN`, so those users will only see their own history. Change to `['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'].includes(req.user.role)` if that's not intended.

```
import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';

// If the project already exposes a shared Prisma client, import that instead
// of instantiating a new one here (multiple clients exhaust the connection pool).
const prisma = new PrismaClient();

const USER_SELECT = { select: { name: true, email: true } };

/**
 * Persists a single calculation history record for the given user.
 *
 * @param {string} userId - Owner of the record (from the authenticated request).
 * @param {object} data - Validated payload.
 * @param {string} data.toolId
 * @param {string} data.toolVersion
 * @param {object} data.inputData
 * @param {object} data.outputData
 * @param {object|null} [data.sources]
 * @returns {Promise<object>} The created record.
 */
export async function createHistory(userId, data) {
  const { toolId, toolVersion, inputData, outputData, sources } = data;

  return prisma.calculationHistory.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      toolId,
      toolVersion,
      inputData,
      outputData,
      sources: sources === undefined || sources === null ? null : sources,
    },
  });
}

/**
 * Bulk-inserts calculation history records for the sync endpoint.
 *
 * `createdAt` is preserved when the client supplies a valid timestamp so that
 * offline records keep their original calculation time. When it is omitted,
 * the database default (`now()`) applies.
 *
 * `skipDuplicates` only has an effect if a unique constraint exists on the
 * model; CalculationHistory currently has none, so it is a no-op today.
 *
 * @param {string} userId - Owner of every record in the batch.
 * @param {object[]} items - Validated payloads.
 * @returns {Promise<{ count: number }>} Number of inserted rows.
 */
export async function createHistoryItems(userId, items) {
  const data = items.map((item) => ({
    userId,
    toolId: item.toolId,
    toolVersion: item.toolVersion,
    inputData: item.inputData,
    outputData: item.outputData,
    sources: item.sources === undefined || item.sources === null ? null : item.sources,
    ...(item.createdAt ? { createdAt: new Date(item.createdAt) } : {}),
  }));

  return prisma.calculationHistory.createMany({
    data,
    skipDuplicates: true,
  });
}

/**
 * Returns calculation history records, newest first.
 *
 * @param {string} userId - The authenticated user's id.
 * @param {boolean} [isAdmin=false] - When true, returns records for all users.
 * @returns {Promise<object[]>}
 */
export async function getUserHistory(userId, isAdmin = false) {
  if (isAdmin) {
    return prisma.calculationHistory.findMany({
      include: { user: USER_SELECT },
      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
    });
  }

  return prisma.calculationHistory.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    include: { user: USER_SELECT },
    orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
  });
}
```

backend/src/controllers/calculationHistory.controller.js
```
import {
  createHistory,
  createHistoryItems,
  getUserHistory,
} from '../services/calculationHistory.service.js';

const REQUIRED_FIELDS = ['toolId', 'toolVersion', 'inputData', 'outputData'];

const MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE = 500;

function isPlainObject(value) {
  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

function isNonEmptyString(value) {
  return typeof value === 'string' && value.trim() !== '';
}

/**
 * Validates a single sync item.
 *
 * @param {unknown} item
 * @returns {string|null} An error message, or null when the item is valid.
 */
function validateHistoryItem(item) {
  if (!isPlainObject(item)) {
    return 'هر آیتم باید از نوع آبجکت باشد.';
  }

  const missingFields = REQUIRED_FIELDS.filter(
    (field) => item[field] === undefined || item[field] === null || item[field] === ''
  );

  if (missingFields.length > 0) {
    return `فیلدهای الزامی ارسال نشده‌اند: ${missingFields.join(', ')}`;
  }

  if (!isNonEmptyString(item.toolId) || !isNonEmptyString(item.toolVersion)) {
    return 'toolId و toolVersion باید رشته غیرخالی باشند.';
  }

  if (!isPlainObject(item.inputData) || !isPlainObject(item.outputData)) {
    return 'inputData و outputData باید از نوع آبجکت JSON باشند.';
  }

  if (item.sources !== undefined && item.sources !== null && !isPlainObject(item.sources)) {
    return 'sources باید از نوع آبجکت JSON باشد.';
  }

  if (item.createdAt !== undefined && item.createdAt !== null) {
    if (typeof item.createdAt !== 'string' || Number.isNaN(new Date(item.createdAt).getTime())) {
      return 'createdAt باید یک تاریخ معتبر ISO باشد.';
    }
  }

  return null;
}

/**
 * POST /
 * Creates a calculation history record for the authenticated user.
 */
export async function create(req, res) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.id;

    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'کاربر احراز هویت نشده است.',
      });
    }

    const body = req.body ?? {};

    const validationError = validateHistoryItem(body);

    if (validationError) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: validationError,
      });
    }

    const history = await createHistory(userId, {
      toolId: body.toolId,
      toolVersion: body.toolVersion,
      inputData: body.inputData,
      outputData: body.outputData,
      sources: body.sources,
    });

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      data: history,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[calculationHistory.create]', error);

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'خطا در ذخیره تاریخچه محاسبات.',
    });
  }
}

/**
 * GET /
 * Returns calculation history records for the authenticated user.
 * Admins receive records for all users.
 */
export async function getAll(req, res) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.id;

    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'کاربر احراز هویت نشده است.',
      });
    }

    const isAdmin = req.user?.role === 'ADMIN';

    const history = await getUserHistory(userId, isAdmin);

    return res.status(200).json({
      success: true,
      data: history,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[calculationHistory.getAll]', error);

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'خطا در دریافت تاریخچه محاسبات.',
    });
  }
}

/**
 * POST /sync
 * Bulk-inserts a batch of offline calculation history records.
 *
 * The request body is a JSON array of history items.
 */
export async function syncHistory(req, res) {
  try {
    const userId = req.user?.id;

    if (!userId) {
      return res.status(401).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'کاربر احراز هویت نشده است.',
      });
    }

    const items = req.body;

    if (!Array.isArray(items)) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: 'بدنه درخواست باید آرایه‌ای از تاریخچه محاسبات باشد.',
      });
    }

    if (items.length === 0) {
      return res.status(200).json({
        success: true,
        data: { count: 0 },
      });
    }

    if (items.length > MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE) {
      return res.status(400).json({
        success: false,
        message: `حداکثر ${MAX_SYNC_BATCH_SIZE} مورد در هر درخواست سینک مجاز است.`,
      });
    }

    for (let index = 0; index < items.length; index += 1) {
      const validationError = validateHistoryItem(items[index]);

      if (validationError) {
        return res.status(400).json({
          success: false,
          message: `آیتم شماره ${index + 1} نامعتبر است: ${validationError}`,
        });
      }
    }

    const result = await createHistoryItems(userId, items);

    return res.status(201).json({
      success: true,
      data: { count: result.count },
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[calculationHistory.syncHistory]', error);

    return res.status(500).json({
      success: false,
      message: 'خطا در سینک تاریخچه محاسبات.',
    });
  }
}
```

frontend/src/features/technical-tools/services/historyApi.ts
```
import { api, unwrap } from '../../services/api';

/**
 * Path of the calculation history endpoint, relative to the Axios baseURL.
 *
 * The shared client in `utils/api.js` is expected to already include the
 * `/api/v1` prefix in its baseURL. If your baseURL is the bare origin
 * (e.g. `http://localhost:3000`), change this to:
 *   '/api/v1/calculation-history'
 */
const CALCULATION_HISTORY_PATH = '/calculation-history';

export type CalculationHistoryUser = {
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
};

export type CalculationHistoryItem = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  toolId: string;
  toolVersion: string;
  inputData: unknown;
  outputData: unknown;
  sources: unknown | null;
  createdAt: string;
  user?: CalculationHistoryUser | null;
};

/**
 * Fetches calculation history records.
 *
 * Admins receive records for all users; regular users receive only their own
 * (the backend decides based on the authenticated role).
 *
 * @returns The list of history records, newest first.
 * @throws AxiosError on network failure or non-2xx status.
 */
export async function fetchCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryItem[]> {
  const response = await api.get(CALCULATION_HISTORY_PATH);
  const payload: unknown = unwrap(response);

  // `unwrap` may return either the payload itself or the full
  // `{ success, data }` envelope depending on the shared client's contract.
  if (Array.isArray(payload)) {
    return payload as CalculationHistoryItem[];
  }

  if (
    payload !== null &&
    typeof payload === 'object' &&
    Array.isArray((payload as { data?: unknown }).data)
  ) {
    return (payload as { data: CalculationHistoryItem[] }).data;
  }

  return [];
}
```

```
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

import { getErrorMessage } from '../../../services/api';
import {
  fetchCalculationHistory,
  type CalculationHistoryItem,
} from '../services/historyApi';

const dateFormatter = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
  year: 'numeric',
  month: '2-digit',
  day: '2-digit',
  hour: '2-digit',
  minute: '2-digit',
});

function formatDate(value: string): string {
  const date = new Date(value);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return value;

  try {
    return dateFormatter.format(date);
  } catch {
    return value;
  }
}

function formatJsonValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';

  if (typeof value === 'string') return value;
  if (typeof value === 'number' || typeof value === 'boolean') return String(value);

  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value.map(formatJsonValue).join('، ');
  }

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);

    if (entries.length === 0) return '—';

    return entries
      .map(([key, entryValue]) => `${key}: ${formatJsonValue(entryValue)}`)
      .join(' • ');
  }

  return String(value);
}

function getUserLabel(item: CalculationHistoryItem): string {
  return item.user?.name || item.user?.email || item.userId;
}

        <button
```

```
import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';

import Layout from '../components/layout/Layout.jsx';
import DashboardLayout from '../components/layout/DashboardLayout.jsx';
import AdminLayout from '../components/layout/AdminLayout.jsx';
import ProtectedRoute from '../components/auth/ProtectedRoute.jsx';

import Home from '../pages/Home.jsx';
import Login from '../pages/Login.jsx';
import Register from '../pages/Register.jsx';
import Dashboard from '../pages/Dashboard.jsx';
import Profile from '../pages/Profile.jsx';
import Pricing from '../pages/Pricing.jsx';
import Checkout from '../pages/Checkout.jsx';
import PaymentResult from '../pages/PaymentResult.jsx';
import Unauthorized from '../pages/Unauthorized.jsx';
import NotFound from '../pages/NotFound.jsx';

import AdminDashboard from '../pages/admin/AdminDashboard.jsx';
import Users from '../pages/admin/Users.jsx';
import Payments from '../pages/admin/Payments.jsx';
import AuditLogs from '../pages/admin/AuditLogs.jsx';
import Documents from '../pages/admin/Documents.jsx';
import AdminHistoryPage from '../features/technical-tools/pages/AdminHistoryPage.tsx';

const ADMIN_ROLES = ['ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN'];

export function AppRoutes() {
  return (
    <Routes>
      <Route element={<Layout />}>
        <Route path="/" element={<Home />} />
        <Route path="/login" element={<Login />} />
        <Route path="/register" element={<Register />} />
        <Route path="/pricing" element={<Pricing />} />
        <Route path="/payment/result" element={<PaymentResult />} />
        <Route path="/unauthorized" element={<Unauthorized />} />
      </Route>

      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute />}>
        <Route element={<DashboardLayout />}>
          <Route path="/dashboard" element={<Dashboard />} />
          <Route path="/profile" element={<Profile />} />
          <Route path="/checkout" element={<Navigate to="/pricing" replace />} />
          <Route path="/checkout/:planId" element={<Checkout />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route element={<ProtectedRoute allowedRoles={ADMIN_ROLES} />}>
        <Route element={<AdminLayout />}>
          <Route path="/admin" element={<AdminDashboard />} />
          <Route path="/admin/users" element={<Users />} />
          <Route path="/admin/payments" element={<Payments />} />
          <Route path="/admin/audit-logs" element={<AuditLogs />} />
          <Route path="/admin/documents" element={<Documents />} />
          <Route path="/admin/history" element={<AdminHistoryPage />} />
        </Route>
      </Route>

      <Route path="*" element={<NotFound />} />
    </Routes>
  );
}

export default AppRoutes;
```

```
import { api, unwrap } from '../../../services/api';

/**
 * Path of the calculation history endpoint, relative to the Axios baseURL.
 *
 * The shared client in `utils/api.js` uses `baseURL = '/api'`, so this
 * resolves to `/api/calculation-history`.
 */
const CALCULATION_HISTORY_PATH = '/calculation-history';

export type CalculationHistoryUser = {
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
};

export type CalculationHistoryItem = {
  id: string;
  userId: string;
  toolId: string;
  toolVersion: string;
  inputData: unknown;
  outputData: unknown;
  sources: unknown | null;
  createdAt: string;
  user?: CalculationHistoryUser | null;
};

/**
 * Fetches calculation history records.
 *
 * Admins receive records for all users; regular users receive only their own
 * (the backend decides based on the authenticated role).
 *
 * @returns The list of history records, newest first.
 * @throws AxiosError on network failure or non-2xx status.
 * @throws Error when the server responds with an unexpected payload shape.
 */
export async function fetchCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryItem[]> {
  // `unwrap` accepts the request promise and returns `response.data.data`,
  // i.e. the `data` field of the `{ success, data }` envelope.
  const payload: unknown = await unwrap(api.get(CALCULATION_HISTORY_PATH));

  if (!Array.isArray(payload)) {
    throw new Error('پاسخ سرور در قالب مورد انتظار نیست.');
  }

  return payload as CalculationHistoryItem[];
}
```

```tsx
                    </View>
                    {isSelected ? <Check size={16} color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} /> : null}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}
```

Let me write the parse function:

```ts
const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';
const ARABIC_DIGITS = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩';

function normalizeNumericInput(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (digit) => String(PERSIAN_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (digit) => String(ARABIC_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/٫/g, '.')
    .replace(/\s/g, '');
}

function parseNumber(value: string): number | null {
  const normalized = normalizeNumericInput(value);
  if (!normalized) return null;
  const parsed = Number(normalized);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}
```

```
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';
import polesData from '../../../data/poles_table.json';

type PolesTableRow = {
  capacity: string;
  male: string;
  female: string;
  round: string;
};

type PolesTableData = {
  title: string;
  columns: string[];
  rows: PolesTableRow[];
};

const TABLE_DATA = polesData as PolesTableData;

/**
 * Row keys in the same order as `TABLE_DATA.columns`, so header cells and
 * body cells stay aligned.
 */
const ROW_KEYS: (keyof PolesTableRow)[] = ['capacity', 'male', 'female', 'round'];

const COLUMN_WIDTHS: number[] = [140, 120, 120, 140];

const DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH = 120;

export default function PolesScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const lastColumnIndex = TABLE_DATA.columns.length - 1;

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">جدول انتخاب پایه</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="px-4 py-5 pb-10">
        <View className="gap-3">
          <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {TABLE_DATA.title}
          </Text>

          <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator contentContainerClassName="pb-1">
            <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
              <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
                {TABLE_DATA.columns.map((column, index) => (
                  <View
                    key={column}
                    style={{ width: COLUMN_WIDTHS[index] ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                    className={
                      index < lastColumnIndex
                        ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                        : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                    }
                  >
                    <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                      {column}
                    </Text>
                  </View>
                ))}
              </View>

              {TABLE_DATA.rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
                <View
                  key={row.capacity}
                  className={
                    rowIndex < TABLE_DATA.rows.length - 1
                      ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
                      : 'flex-row'
                  }
                >
                  {ROW_KEYS.map((key, index) => (
                    <View
                      key={key}
                      style={{ width: COLUMN_WIDTHS[index] ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                      className={
                        index < lastColumnIndex
                          ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                          : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                      }
                    >
                      <Text className="text-right text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                        {row[key]}
                      </Text>
                    </View>
                  ))}
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          </ScrollView>
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

```
import React, { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Alert,
  KeyboardAvoidingView,
  Modal,
  Platform,
  Pressable,
  ScrollView,
  Text,
  TextInput,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Check, ChevronDown, RefreshCw } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../../../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type PowerUnitKey = 'w' | 'kw' | 'mw' | 'hp_metric' | 'hp_mechanical' | 'kcal_h' | 'btu_h';

type PowerUnit = {
  key: PowerUnitKey;
  label: string;
  symbol: string;
  /** Conversion factor to watts. */
  toWatt: number;
};

const POWER_UNIT_BY_KEY: Record<PowerUnitKey, PowerUnit> = {
  w: { key: 'w', label: 'وات', symbol: 'W', toWatt: 1 },
  kw: { key: 'kw', label: 'کیلووات', symbol: 'kW', toWatt: 1000 },
  mw: { key: 'mw', label: 'مگاوات', symbol: 'MW', toWatt: 1000000 },
  hp_metric: { key: 'hp_metric', label: 'اسب بخار متریک', symbol: 'PS', toWatt: 735.49875 },
  hp_mechanical: {
    key: 'hp_mechanical',
    label: 'اسب بخار مکانیکی',
    symbol: 'HP',
    toWatt: 745.6998715822702,
  },
  kcal_h: { key: 'kcal_h', label: 'کیلوکالری بر ساعت', symbol: 'kcal/h', toWatt: 1.163 },
  btu_h: { key: 'btu_h', label: 'بی‌تی‌یو بر ساعت', symbol: 'BTU/h', toWatt: 0.2930710701722222 },
};

const POWER_UNITS: PowerUnit[] = Object.values(POWER_UNIT_BY_KEY);

const PERSIAN_DIGITS = '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹';
const ARABIC_DIGITS = '٠١٢٣٤٥٦٧٨٩';

type ConversionResult = {
  input: number;
  output: number;
  from: PowerUnit;
  to: PowerUnit;
};

/**
 * Converts Persian/Arabic-Indic digits and the Arabic decimal separator
 * into a plain Latin number string so `Number()` can parse it.
 */
function normalizeNumericInput(value: string): string {
  return value
    .replace(/[۰-۹]/g, (digit) => String(PERSIAN_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/[٠-٩]/g, (digit) => String(ARABIC_DIGITS.indexOf(digit)))
    .replace(/٫/g, '.')
    .replace(/\s/g, '');
}

function parseNumber(value: string): number | null {
  const normalized = normalizeNumericInput(value);

  if (!normalized) return null;

  const parsed = Number(normalized);

  return Number.isFinite(parsed) ? parsed : null;
}

function formatNumber(value: number): string {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value)) return '—';

  const rounded = Number(value.toPrecision(10));

  try {
    return new Intl.NumberFormat('fa-IR', { maximumFractionDigits: 6 }).format(rounded);
  } catch {
    return String(rounded);
  }
}

type UnitPickerProps = {
  label: string;
  units: PowerUnit[];
  selectedKey: PowerUnitKey;
  onSelect: (key: PowerUnitKey) => void;
};

function UnitPicker({ label, units, selectedKey, onSelect }: UnitPickerProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState<boolean>(false);

  const selected = units.find((unit) => unit.key === selectedKey) ?? units[0];

  const handleSelect = (key: PowerUnitKey) => {
    onSelect(key);
    setIsOpen(false);
  };

  return (
    <View className="flex-1 gap-2">
      <Text className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">{label}</Text>

      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`${label}: ${selected.label}`}
        onPress={() => setIsOpen(true)}
        className="flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <Text
          numberOfLines={1}
          className="flex-1 text-right text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
        >

          <Pressable

            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="بستن فهرست واحدها"
            onPress={() => setIsOpen(false)}
          />

          <View className="max-h-[70%] overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-white p-2 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="px-3 py-2 text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              {label}
            </Text>

            <ScrollView>
              {units.map((unit) => {
                const isSelected = unit.key === selectedKey;

                return (
                  <TouchableOpacity
                    key={unit.key}
                    activeOpacity={0.7}
                    accessibilityRole="button"
                    accessibilityState={{ selected: isSelected }}
                    onPress={() => handleSelect(unit.key)}
                    className={
                      isSelected
                        ? 'flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-xl bg-green-50 px-3 py-3 dark:bg-green-950'
                        : 'flex-row items-center justify-between rounded-xl px-3 py-3'
                    }
                  >
                    <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
                      <Text
                        className={
                          isSelected
                            ? 'text-sm font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                            : 'text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 dark:text-white'
                        }
                      >
                        {unit.label}
                      </Text>
                      <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 dark:text-gray-500">
                        {unit.symbol}
                      </Text>
                    </View>

                    {isSelected ? (
                      <Check size={16} color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
                    ) : null}
                  </TouchableOpacity>
                );
              })}
            </ScrollView>
          </View>
        </View>
      </Modal>
    </View>
  );
}

export default function UnitConverterScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState<string>('');
  const [fromUnit, setFromUnit] = useState<PowerUnitKey>('kw');
  const [toUnit, setToUnit] = useState<PowerUnitKey>('hp_metric');
  const [result, setResult] = useState<ConversionResult | null>(null);

  // Any input change invalidates the previously displayed result.
  useEffect(() => {
    setResult(null);
  }, [inputValue, fromUnit, toUnit]);

  const handleConvert = () => {
    const parsed = parseNumber(inputValue);

    if (parsed === null) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'لطفاً یک مقدار عددی معتبر وارد کنید.');
      return;
    }

    if (parsed < 0) {
      Alert.alert('ورودی نامعتبر', 'مقدار ورودی نمی‌تواند منفی باشد.');
      return;
    }

    const from = POWER_UNIT_BY_KEY[fromUnit];
    const to = POWER_UNIT_BY_KEY[toUnit];

    const output = (parsed * from.toWatt) / to.toWatt;

    setResult({ input: parsed, output, from, to });
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">مبدل واحدهای فنی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <KeyboardAvoidingView
        className="flex-1"
        behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}
      >
        <ScrollView
          className="flex-1"
          contentContainerClassName="gap-5 px-4 py-5 pb-10"
          keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        >
          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">مقدار ورودی</Text>
            <TextInput
              value={inputValue}
              onChangeText={setInputValue}
              keyboardType="numeric"
              placeholder="مثلاً 25"
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <View className="flex-row gap-3">
            <UnitPicker
              label="از واحد"
              units={POWER_UNITS}
              selectedKey={fromUnit}
              onSelect={setFromUnit}
            />

            <UnitPicker
              label="به واحد"
              units={POWER_UNITS}
              selectedKey={toUnit}
              onSelect={setToUnit}
            />
          </View>

          <View className="gap-2">
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">مقدار خروجی</Text>
            <TextInput
              value={result ? formatNumber(result.output) : ''}
              editable={false}
              placeholder="—"
              placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
              className="rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-gray-100 px-4 py-3 text-right text-sm text-gray-900 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-800 dark:text-white"
            />
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="تبدیل"
            onPress={handleConvert}
            className="mt-2 flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <RefreshCw size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">تبدیل</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>

          {result ? (
            <View className="rounded-2xl border border-green-200 bg-green-50 p-4 dark:border-green-800 dark:bg-green-900/20">
              <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-400">
                نتیجه تبدیل
              </Text>

              <Text className="mt-2 text-right text-base font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-400">
                {formatNumber(result.input)} {result.from.label} = {formatNumber(result.output)}{' '}
                {result.to.label}
              </Text>

              <Text className="mt-2 text-right text-[10px] leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                این تبدیل صرفا جنبه راهنما دارد و مقادیر بر اساس ضرایب استاندارد محاسبه شده‌اند.
              </Text>
            </View>
          ) : null}
        </ScrollView>
      </KeyboardAvoidingView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

```
import UnitConverterScreen from '../../src/features/technical-tools/tools/economic/unit-converter/UnitConverterScreen';
import { ErrorBoundary } from '../../src/core/components/ErrorBoundary';

function UnderDevelopmentScreen() {

          <Wrench size={28} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>
        <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          در حال توسعه
        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          این ابزار هنوز آماده استفاده نیست و به‌زودی اضافه می‌شود.
        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function ToolRoute() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();

  const renderTool = () => {
    if (id === 'electrical.voltage-drop') {
      return <VoltageDropScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.clearances') {
      return <ClearancesScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.poles') {
      return <PolesScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'economic.unit-converter') {
      return <UnitConverterScreen />;
    }

    return <UnderDevelopmentScreen />;
  };

  return <ErrorBoundary resetKey={id}>{renderTool()}</ErrorBoundary>;
}
```

```
import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { FlatList, ScrollView, Text, TextInput, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, History, Search } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  TOOLS,
  TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS,
  type ToolCategory,
  type ToolDefinition,
} from '../registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';

type CategoryFilter = 'all' | ToolCategory;

/**
 * Derived from TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS so that registering a new category
 * automatically produces a filter chip. Order follows the declaration
 * order of TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS.
 */
const CATEGORY_FILTERS: { key: CategoryFilter; label: string }[] = [
  { key: 'all', label: 'همه' },
  ...(Object.keys(TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS) as ToolCategory[]).map((category) => ({
    key: category,
    label: TOOL_CATEGORY_LABELS[category],
  })),
];

export default function TechnicalToolsScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [query, setQuery] = useState<string>('');
  const [activeCategory, setActiveCategory] = useState<CategoryFilter>('all');

  const filteredTools = useMemo<ToolDefinition[]>(() => {
    const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLowerCase();

    return TOOLS.filter((tool) => {
      const matchesCategory = activeCategory === 'all' || tool.category === activeCategory;
      if (!matchesCategory) return false;

      if (!normalizedQuery) return true;

      return (
        tool.name.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.description.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery) ||
        tool.id.toLowerCase().includes(normalizedQuery)
      );
    });
  }, [query, activeCategory]);

  const renderTool = ({ item }: { item: ToolDefinition }) => {
    const Icon = item.icon;
    const isAvailable = item.status === 'available';

    return (
      <TouchableOpacity
        activeOpacity={0.8}
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={item.name}
        onPress={() => router.push(`/tools/${item.id}`)}
        className="flex-row items-center rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <View className="h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
          <Icon size={24} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>

        <View className="mx-3 flex-1">
          <Text className="text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {item.name}
          </Text>
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="mt-1 text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400"
          >
            {item.description}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View
          className={
            isAvailable
              ? 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
              : 'rounded-full bg-red-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-red-900'
          }
        >
          <Text
            className={
              isAvailable
                ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-red-700 dark:text-red-300'
            }
          >
            {isAvailable ? 'فعال' : 'در حال توسعه'}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </TouchableOpacity>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">ابزارهای فنی</Text>

        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="تاریخچه محاسبات"
          onPress={() => router.push('/tools/history')}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <History size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>
      </View>

      <View className="mx-4 mt-4 flex-row items-center rounded-xl border border-gray-200 bg-white px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <Search size={18} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
        <TextInput
          value={query}
          onChangeText={setQuery}
          className="ml-2 flex-1 text-sm text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
          placeholder="جستجوی ابزار..."
          placeholderTextColor={isDark ? '#6B7280' : '#9CA3AF'}
          returnKeyType="search"
        />
      </View>

      <ScrollView
        horizontal
        showsHorizontalScrollIndicator={false}
        contentContainerClassName="gap-2 px-4 py-3"
      >
        {CATEGORY_FILTERS.map((filter) => {
          const isActive = filter.key === activeCategory;

          return (
            <TouchableOpacity
              key={filter.key}
              activeOpacity={0.7}
              accessibilityRole="button"
              accessibilityLabel={filter.label}
              onPress={() => setActiveCategory(filter.key)}
              className={
                isActive
                  ? 'rounded-full bg-blue-600 px-4 py-2'
                  : 'rounded-full border border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-2 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900'
              }
            >
              <Text
                className={
                  isActive
                    ? 'text-xs font-bold text-white'
                    : 'text-xs font-semibold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300'
                }
              >
                {filter.label}
              </Text>
            </TouchableOpacity>
          );
        })}
      </ScrollView>

      <FlatList
        className="flex-1"
        data={filteredTools}
        keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
        renderItem={renderTool}
        keyboardShouldPersistTaps="handled"
        contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 pb-8"
        ListEmptyComponent={
          <View className="items-center justify-center py-16">
            <Text className="text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
              ابزاری با این مشخصات یافت نشد.
            </Text>
          </View>
        }
      />
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

Now the generalized StaticTableViewer:

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type StaticTableColumn = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  width?: number;
};

export type StaticTableRow = Record<string, string | number>;

export type StaticTableData = {
  title: string;
  unit?: string;
  columns: StaticTableColumn[];
  rows: StaticTableRow[];
};

const DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH = 110;

function formatCell(value: string | number | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isNaN(value)) return '—';
  return String(value);
}

export function StaticTableViewer({ data }: { data: StaticTableData }) {
  const { title, unit, columns, rows } = data;
  const lastColumnIndex = columns.length - 1;

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="gap-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{title}</Text>
        {unit ? (
          <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">واحد مقادیر: {unit}</Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator contentContainerClassName="pb-1">
        <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
          <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
            {columns.map((column, index) => (
              <View
                key={column.key}
                style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className={index < lastColumnIndex ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700' : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'}
              >
                <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">{column.label}</Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <View
              key={rowIndex}
              className={rowIndex < rows.length - 1 ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700' : 'flex-row'}
            >
              {columns.map((column, index) => (
                <View
                  key={column.key}
                  style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                  className={index < lastColumnIndex ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700' : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'}
                >
                  <Text className="text-right text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    {formatCell(row[column.key])}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

export default StaticTableViewer;
```

Note: `key={rowIndex}` — using index as key. Rows don't have an id in the new shape. That's acceptable for static data. Could add an optional `id`. I'll use index and note it.

Hmm, actually for React keys, index is fine for static non-reordered data.

I'll add both data tables, both screens, and wire the routes. One structural change is unavoidable, and I want to be explicit about it.

**`StaticTableViewer` cannot render either table as written.** Its type is hardcoded to `voltage_levels` + `clearances` — a voltage-matrix shape. ACSR rows are `name_en / nominal_size / allowable_current / …` and transformer rows are `capacity / phase / breaker_amperage / …`. Neither fits.

Rather than duplicate the table markup a third and fourth time (as `PolesScreen` already does), I generalized `StaticTableViewer` to a column-driven shape: `columns: { key, label, width? }[]` + `rows: Record<string, string | number>[]`. This is a **breaking change**, so I also updated `ClearancesScreen` to adapt its existing JSON to the new API — its JSON file is untouched.

**On the data values:** you specified field names and nominal sizes but not the actual numbers, so I filled in standard reference values (BS 215 for ACSR; 20 kV/400 V three-phase for transformers). **These must be verified against your official distribution-company tables before production use** — I've flagged the specific ones I'm least confident about below.

**Column widths use inline `style={{ width }}`**, not `className`. NativeWind can't express dynamic widths, and this is the same approach already in `StaticTableViewer` and `PolesScreen`.
