import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type StaticTableColumn = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Column width in points. Falls back to DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH. */
  width?: number;
};

export type StaticTableRow = Record<string, string | number>;

export type StaticTableData = {
  title: string;
  unit?: string;
  columns: StaticTableColumn[];
  rows: StaticTableRow[];
};

const DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH = 110;

function formatCell(value: string | number | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isNaN(value)) return '—';
  return String(value);
}

export function StaticTableViewer({ data }: { data: StaticTableData }) {
  const { title, unit, columns, rows } = data;
  const lastColumnIndex = columns.length - 1;

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="gap-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          {title}
        </Text>
        {unit ? (
          <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            واحد مقادیر: {unit}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator contentContainerClassName="pb-1">
        <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
          <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
            {columns.map((column, index) => (
              <View
                key={column.key}
                style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className={
                  index < lastColumnIndex
                    ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                    : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                }
              >
                <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                  {column.label}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <View
              key={rowIndex}
              className={
                rowIndex < rows.length - 1
                  ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
                  : 'flex-row'
              }
            >
              {columns.map((column, index) => (
                <View
                  key={column.key}
                  style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                  className={
                    index < lastColumnIndex
                      ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                      : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                  }
                >
                  <Text className="text-right text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    {formatCell(row[column.key])}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

export default StaticTableViewer;
```

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { StaticTableViewer, type StaticTableData } from '../../../components/StaticTableViewer';
import { useTheme } from '../../../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';
import clearancesData from '../../../data/clearances_table.json';

/**
 * The clearances JSON stores a voltage matrix (voltage_levels + clearances).
 * StaticTableViewer expects a column-driven shape, so the matrix is flattened
 * into one column per voltage level here. The JSON file itself is unchanged.
 */
const TABLE_DATA: StaticTableData = {
  title: clearancesData.title,
  unit: clearancesData.unit,
  columns: [
    { key: 'condition', label: 'شرح', width: 160 },
    ...clearancesData.voltage_levels.map((level) => ({
      key: level,
      label: level,
      width: 80,
    })),
  ],
  rows: clearancesData.rows.map((row) => ({
    condition: row.condition,
    ...row.clearances,
  })),
};

export default function ClearancesScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">حریم هوایی هادی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="px-4 py-5 pb-10">
        <StaticTableViewer data={TABLE_DATA} />
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

          activeOpacity={0.7}

          <Wrench size={28} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
        </View>
        <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          در حال توسعه
        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">

        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function ToolRoute() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();

  const renderTool = () => {
    if (id === 'electrical.voltage-drop') {
      return <VoltageDropScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'electrical.transformer') {
      return <TransformerScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.clearances') {
      return <ClearancesScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.poles') {
      return <PolesScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.acsr') {
      return <AcsrScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'economic.unit-converter') {
      return <UnitConverterScreen />;
    }

    return <UnderDevelopmentScreen />;
  };

  return <ErrorBoundary resetKey={id}>{renderTool()}</ErrorBoundary>;
}
```

## Values to verify before production

- **ACSR `Dog` vs `Hyena`** — both are 120 mm² nominal with 118.5 mm² actual, but I gave them different weights (394 vs 460 kg/km). If your table has identical weights, one of these is wrong.
- **ACSR `allowable_current`** — current ratings depend on ambient temperature, wind speed, and conductor temperature. The values above assume a common 40 °C ambient / 70 °C conductor basis. Your table's basis may differ.
- **Transformer `breaker_amperage`** — I used the next standard breaker size above the secondary current. If your table uses a different rule (e.g. 1.25× current), these will differ.
- **Transformer `incoming_cable`** — sized from the secondary current with a typical derating. Cable sizing is the most installation-specific column here.

```tsx
export default function HistoryDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [record, setRecord] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const load = async () => {
      if (!id) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setErrorMessage('شناسه محاسبه یافت نشد.');
        }
        return;
      }

      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      try {
        const item = await getHistoryById(id);
        if (!isMounted) return;
        if (!item) {
          setErrorMessage('محاسبه مورد نظر یافت نشد.');
          setRecord(null);
        } else {
          setRecord(item);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!isMounted) return;
        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
        setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری محاسبه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) setIsLoading(false);
      }
    };

    void load();

    return () => { isMounted = false; };
  }, [id]);
```

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  Share,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, FileQuestion, Share2 } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getHistoryById,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function buildShareMessage(record: CalculationHistoryRecord): string {
  const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.tool_id] ?? record.tool_id;

  const inputLines =
    Object.entries(record.inputs)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  const outputLines =
    Object.entries(record.outputs)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  return [
    `محاسبه ${toolName}`,
    `تاریخ: ${formatDate(record.created_at)}`,
    '',
    'ورودی‌ها:',
    inputLines,
    '',
    'خروجی‌ها:',
    outputLines,
  ].join('\n');
}

function KeyValueList({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const entries = Object.entries(data);

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
        موردی ثبت نشده است.
      </Text>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="gap-2">
      {entries.map(([key, value]) => (
        <View
          key={key}
          className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {key}
          </Text>
          <Text className="flex-1 text-left text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {formatValue(value)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

```
import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';

/**
 * Name of the SQLite database file used by the app.
 * Change this constant if the app opens a different database file.
 */
const DATABASE_NAME = 'app.db';

const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';
const PENDING_SYNC_STATUS = 'pending';

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: string | null;
  outputs: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME).catch((error: unknown) => {
      databasePromise = null;
      throw error;
    });
  }

  return databasePromise;
}

function generateUuid(): string {
  const template = 'xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx';

  return template.replace(/[xy]/g, (char) => {
    const random = (Math.random() * 16) | 0;
    const value = char === 'x' ? random : (random & 0x3) | 0x8;
    return value.toString(16);
  });
}

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    tool_id: row.tool_id,
    user_id: row.user_id,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs),
    outputs: parseJsonObject(row.outputs),
    created_at: row.created_at,
    sync_status: row.sync_status,
  };
}

export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  toolId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<string> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const id = generateUuid();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      id,
      toolId,
      LOCAL_USER_ID,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(outputs),
      createdAt,
      PENDING_SYNC_STATUS,
    ]
  );

  return id;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`
  );

  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

/**
 * Fetches a single calculation history record by its id.
 *
 * @param id - The record's primary key.
 * @returns The parsed record, or null when no row matches.
 */
export async function getHistoryById(id: string): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord | null> {
  const database = await getDatabase();

  const row = await database.getFirstAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE id = ?`,
    [id]
  );

  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}
```

export default function HistoryDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [record, setRecord] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const load = async () => {
      if (!id) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setErrorMessage('شناسه محاسبه یافت نشد.');
        }
        return;
      }

      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      try {
        const item = await getHistoryById(id);

        if (!isMounted) return;

        if (!item) {
          setRecord(null);
          setErrorMessage('محاسبه مورد نظر یافت نشد یا حذف شده است.');
        } else {
          setRecord(item);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!isMounted) return;

        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
        setRecord(null);
        setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری محاسبه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    void load();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [id]);

  const handleShare = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!record) return;

    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.tool_id] ?? record.tool_id;

    try {
      await Share.share({
        title: `محاسبه ${toolName}`,
        message: buildShareMessage(record),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      Alert.alert('خطا در اشتراک‌گذاری', message);
    }
  }, [record]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">جزئیات محاسبه</Text>

        {record ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.7}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="اشتراک‌گذاری محاسبه"
            onPress={() => {
              void handleShare();
            }}
            className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
          >
            <Share2 size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <View className="h-10 w-10" />
        )}
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری محاسبه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : !record ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6">
          <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <FileQuestion size={28} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          </View>

          <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            محاسبه یافت نشد
          </Text>

          <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {errorMessage ?? 'محاسبه مورد نظر یافت نشد یا حذف شده است.'}
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="بازگشت به تاریخچه"
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-6 py-3"
          >
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">بازگشت به تاریخچه</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="gap-4 px-4 py-5 pb-10">
          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <Text className="flex-1 text-right text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                {TOOL_NAMES[record.tool_id] ?? record.tool_id}
              </Text>

              <View
                className={
                  record.sync_status === 'pending'
                    ? 'rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-amber-900'
                    : 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
                }
              >
                <Text
                  className={
                    record.sync_status === 'pending'
                      ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                      : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
                  }
                >
                  {record.sync_status === 'pending' ? 'در انتظار همگام‌سازی' : 'همگام‌سازی شده'}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View className="mt-2 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
              <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
              <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                {formatDate(record.created_at)}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              ورودی‌ها
            </Text>
            <KeyValueList data={record.inputs} />
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              خروجی‌ها
            </Text>
            <KeyValueList data={record.outputs} />
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="اشتراک‌گذاری محاسبه"
            onPress={() => {
              void handleShare();
            }}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <Share2 size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">اشتراک‌گذاری</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

mobile/app/tools/history.tsx
```
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, History as HistoryIcon, Inbox } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getCalculationHistory,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);

  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبت‌شده';

  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

export default function CalculationHistoryScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (mode: 'initial' | 'refresh') => {
    if (mode === 'initial') {
      setIsLoading(true);
    } else {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const records = await getCalculationHistory();
      setHistory(records);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadHistory('initial');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    void loadHistory('refresh');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: CalculationHistoryRecord }) => {
    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[item.tool_id] ?? item.tool_id;

    return (
      <Pressable
        accessibilityRole="button"
        accessibilityLabel={`جزئیات محاسبه ${toolName}`}
        onPress={() => router.push(`/tools/history/${item.id}`)}
        style={({ pressed }) => ({ opacity: pressed ? 0.7 : 1 })}
        className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"
      >
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
              <HistoryIcon size={18} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
            </View>
            <Text
              numberOfLines={1}
              className="max-w-[190px] text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              {toolName}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View
            className={
              item.sync_status === 'pending'
                ? 'rounded-full bg-amber-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-amber-900'
                : 'rounded-full bg-green-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-green-900'
            }
          >
            <Text
              className={
                item.sync_status === 'pending'
                  ? 'text-[10px] font-bold text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-300'
                  : 'text-[10px] font-bold text-green-700 dark:text-green-300'
              }
            >
              {item.sync_status === 'pending' ? 'در انتظار همگام‌سازی' : 'همگام‌سازی شده'}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
          <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {formatDate(item.created_at)}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
          >
            {summarizeInputs(item.inputs)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </Pressable>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تاریخچه محاسبات</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری تاریخچه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          className="flex-1"
          data={history}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.id}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 py-4 pb-10"
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={isRefreshing}
              onRefresh={handleRefresh}
              tintColor={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'}
            />
          }
          ListHeaderComponent={
            errorMessage ? (
              <View className="mb-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950">
                <Text className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                  {errorMessage}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View className="items-center justify-center py-20">
              <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
                <Inbox size={28} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
              </View>
              <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                هیچ محاسبه‌ای ثبت نشده است
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-2 px-8 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                پس از انجام محاسبات در ابزارهای فنی، نتایج در این بخش نمایش داده می‌شود.
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

## State of the repo — several earlier features are not on disk

The "true contents" you just sent differ substantially from what earlier commits claimed. Worth knowing before you test:

- **Sync is absent.** `history.service.ts` has no `syncPendingHistories`, and `history.tsx` has no sync button. `api.service.ts` isn't in the file list at all.
- **The registry is back to 5 tools.** `mechanical.poles`, `mechanical.acsr`, `electrical.transformer`, and `economic.unit-converter` are gone, and `[id].tsx` routes only `voltage-drop` and `clearances`. The corresponding screen and JSON files are listed as empty.
- **The backend routes are unmounted.** Neither `routes/index.js` nor `routes/v1/index.js` mounts `calculationHistory.routes.js`, so every history endpoint 404s.
- **NativeWind is still not wired.** `babel.config.js` is `presets: ['babel-preset-expo']` with no `jsxImportSource: 'nativewind'` and no `nativewind/babel`, and `mobile/package.json` lists no `nativewind`, `lucide-react-native`, or `tailwindcss`. Every `className` in the files above will be ignored until that's fixed.

None of these block the three files above from compiling, but the detail screen will show "محاسبه یافت نشد" for any record whose `tool_id` isn't in the current 5-tool registry — it falls back to the raw id, so it still renders.

import { randomUUID } from 'expo-crypto';
import { getDatabase } from '../../../core/database';

const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';
const PENDING_SYNC_STATUS = 'pending';

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  id: string;
  tool_id: string;
  user_id: string;
  inputs: string | null;
  outputs: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  sync_status: string;
};

/**
 * The shared connection opened by `core/database`, so this module and
 * `core/offline/repository` always read and write the same SQLite file.
 */
type Database = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>;

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    tool_id: row.tool_id,
    user_id: row.user_id,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs),
    outputs: parseJsonObject(row.outputs),
    created_at: row.created_at,
    sync_status: row.sync_status,
  };
}

export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  toolId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  outputs: Record<string, unknown>
): Promise<string> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const id = randomUUID();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      id,
      toolId,
      LOCAL_USER_ID,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(outputs),
      createdAt,
      PENDING_SYNC_STATUS,
    ]
  );

  return id;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`
  );

  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

/**
 * Fetches a single calculation history record by its id.
 *
 * @param id - The record's primary key.
 * @returns The parsed record, or null when no row matches.
 */
export async function getHistoryById(id: string): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord | null> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const row = await database.getFirstAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT id, tool_id, user_id, inputs, outputs, created_at, sync_status
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE id = ?`,
    [id]
  );

  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}
```

  owner_user_id: string;
  calculator_id: string;
  formula_version: string;
  inputs_json: string | null;
  result_json: string | null;
  source_json: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

type Database = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>;

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function parseNullableJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (!value) return null;
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    calculationId: row.calculation_id,
    ownerUserId: row.owner_user_id,
    calculatorId: row.calculator_id,
    formulaVersion: row.formula_version,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs_json),
    result: parseJsonObject(row.result_json),
    source: parseNullableJsonObject(row.source_json),
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  };
}

export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  calculatorId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  result: Record<string, unknown>,
  options?: { formulaVersion?: string; source?: Record<string, unknown> | null; userId?: string }
): Promise<string> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();
  const calculationId = randomUUID();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const ownerUserId = options?.userId ?? LOCAL_USER_ID;
  const formulaVersion = options?.formulaVersion ?? '1.0.0';
  const source = options?.source ?? null;

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      calculationId,
      ownerUserId,
      calculatorId,
      formulaVersion,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(result),
      source === null ? null : JSON.stringify(source),
      createdAt,
    ]
  );

  return calculationId;
}

export async function getCalculationHistory(userId: string = LOCAL_USER_ID): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();
  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE owner_user_id = ?
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
    [userId]
  );
  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

export async function getHistoryById(id: string): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord | null> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();
  const row = await database.getFirstAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE calculation_id = ?`,
    [id]
  );
  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}
```

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);
  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبتشده';
  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

export default function CalculationHistoryScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (mode: 'initial' | 'refresh') => {
    if (mode === 'initial') {
      setIsLoading(true);
    } else {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const records = await getCalculationHistory();
      setHistory(records);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadHistory('initial');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    void loadHistory('refresh');
  }, [loadHistory]);

        className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900"

            <Text

            >
              {toolName}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
              v{item.formulaVersion}

          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {formatDate(item.createdAt)}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
          >
            {summarizeInputs(item.inputs)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </Pressable>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تاریخچه محاسبات</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری تاریخچه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          className="flex-1"
          data={history}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.calculationId}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 py-4 pb-10"
          refreshControl={

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  Share,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, FileQuestion, Share2 } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getHistoryById,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;
  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function buildShareMessage(record: CalculationHistoryRecord): string {
  const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.calculatorId] ?? record.calculatorId;

  const inputLines =
    Object.entries(record.inputs)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  const resultLines =
    Object.entries(record.result)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  return [
    `محاسبه ${toolName}`,
    `تاریخ: ${formatDate(record.createdAt)}`,
    `نسخه فرمول: ${record.formulaVersion}`,
    '',
    'ورودیها:',
    inputLines,
    '',
    'خروجیها:',
    resultLines,
  ].join('\n');
}

function KeyValueList({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const entries = Object.entries(data);

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
        موردی ثبت نشده است.
      </Text>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="gap-2">
      {entries.map(([key, value]) => (
        <View
          key={key}
          className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {key}
          </Text>
          <Text className="flex-1 text-left text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {formatValue(value)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

```
import { randomUUID } from 'expo-crypto';
import { getDatabase } from '../../../core/database';

/**
 * Default owner id. `repository.ts` scopes every row by `owner_user_id` and
 * receives that id from its caller, so once the app has an authenticated
 * session these helpers must be given the same id or the two paths will
 * write to different partitions of the same table.
 */
const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';

/**
 * Stamped on rows saved without an explicit version. The voltage-drop formula
 * is still under review, so this deliberately signals "unapproved".
 */
const DEFAULT_FORMULA_VERSION = '0.0.0-draft';

export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  calculationId: string;
  ownerUserId: string;
  calculatorId: string;
  formulaVersion: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  result: Record<string, unknown>;
  source: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  calculation_id: string;
  owner_user_id: string;
  calculator_id: string;
  formula_version: string;
  inputs_json: string | null;
  result_json: string | null;
  source_json: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

/**
 * The shared connection opened by `core/database`, so this module and
 * `core/offline/repository` always read and write the same SQLite file.
 */
type Database = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>;

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function parseNullableJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    calculationId: row.calculation_id,
    ownerUserId: row.owner_user_id,
    calculatorId: row.calculator_id,
    formulaVersion: row.formula_version,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs_json),
    result: parseJsonObject(row.result_json),
    source: parseNullableJsonObject(row.source_json),
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  };
}

export type SaveCalculationHistoryOptions = {
  formulaVersion?: string;
  source?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  userId?: string;
};

/**
 * Persists one calculation using the exact column set defined by
 * `core/offline/repository.ts`.
 *
 * @returns The generated `calculation_id`.
 */
export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  calculatorId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  result: Record<string, unknown>,
  options?: SaveCalculationHistoryOptions
): Promise<string> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const calculationId = randomUUID();
  const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
  const ownerUserId = options?.userId ?? LOCAL_USER_ID;
  const formulaVersion = options?.formulaVersion ?? DEFAULT_FORMULA_VERSION;
  const source = options?.source ?? null;

  await database.runAsync(
    `INSERT INTO calculation_history
       (calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at)
     VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,
    [
      calculationId,
      ownerUserId,
      calculatorId,
      formulaVersion,
      JSON.stringify(inputs),
      JSON.stringify(result),
      source === null ? null : JSON.stringify(source),
      createdAt,
    ]
  );

  return calculationId;
}

/**
 * Returns the owner's calculation history, newest first.
 *
 * @param userId - Owner scope. Defaults to the local owner id.
 */
export async function getCalculationHistory(
  userId: string = LOCAL_USER_ID
): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const rows = await database.getAllAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE owner_user_id = ?
      ORDER BY created_at DESC`,
    [userId]
  );

  return rows.map(mapRow);
}

/**
 * Fetches a single calculation history record by its primary key.
 *
 * @param id - The record's `calculation_id`.
 * @returns The parsed record, or null when no row matches.
 */
export async function getHistoryById(id: string): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord | null> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const row = await database.getFirstAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE calculation_id = ?`,
    [id]
  );

  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  Pressable,
  RefreshControl,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, History as HistoryIcon, Inbox } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getCalculationHistory,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);

  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبت‌شده';

  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {

          <View className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-gray-800">

import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Alert,
  ScrollView,
  Share,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useLocalSearchParams, useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, FileQuestion, Share2 } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getHistoryById,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }

  return String(value);
}

function buildShareMessage(record: CalculationHistoryRecord): string {
  const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.calculatorId] ?? record.calculatorId;

  const inputLines =
    Object.entries(record.inputs)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  const resultLines =
    Object.entries(record.result)
      .map(([key, value]) => `• ${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
      .join('\n') || '—';

  return [
    `محاسبه ${toolName}`,
    `تاریخ: ${formatDate(record.createdAt)}`,
    `نسخه فرمول: ${record.formulaVersion}`,
    '',
    'ورودی‌ها:',
    inputLines,
    '',
    'خروجی‌ها:',
    resultLines,
  ].join('\n');
}

function KeyValueList({ data }: { data: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const entries = Object.entries(data);

  if (entries.length === 0) {
    return (
      <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
        موردی ثبت نشده است.
      </Text>
    );
  }

  return (
    <View className="gap-2">
      {entries.map(([key, value]) => (
        <View
          key={key}
          className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <Text className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {key}
          </Text>
          <Text className="flex-1 text-left text-[11px] font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            {formatValue(value)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      ))}
    </View>
  );
}

export default function HistoryDetailScreen() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [record, setRecord] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    let isMounted = true;

    const load = async () => {
      if (!id) {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
          setErrorMessage('شناسه محاسبه یافت نشد.');
        }
        return;
      }

      setIsLoading(true);
      setErrorMessage(null);

      try {
        const item = await getHistoryById(id);

        if (!isMounted) return;

        if (!item) {
          setRecord(null);
          setErrorMessage('محاسبه مورد نظر یافت نشد یا حذف شده است.');
        } else {
          setRecord(item);
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (!isMounted) return;

        const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
        setRecord(null);
        setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری محاسبه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
      } finally {
        if (isMounted) {
          setIsLoading(false);
        }
      }
    };

    void load();

    return () => {
      isMounted = false;
    };
  }, [id]);

  const handleShare = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!record) return;

    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.calculatorId] ?? record.calculatorId;

    try {
      await Share.share({
        title: `محاسبه ${toolName}`,
        message: buildShareMessage(record),
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      Alert.alert('خطا در اشتراک‌گذاری', message);
    }
  }, [record]);

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">جزئیات محاسبه</Text>

        {record ? (
          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.7}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="اشتراک‌گذاری محاسبه"
            onPress={() => {
              void handleShare();
            }}
            className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
          >
            <Share2 size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
          </TouchableOpacity>
        ) : (
          <View className="h-10 w-10" />
        )}
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری محاسبه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : !record ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-6">
          <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <FileQuestion size={28} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          </View>

          <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
            محاسبه یافت نشد
          </Text>

          <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {errorMessage ?? 'محاسبه مورد نظر یافت نشد یا حذف شده است.'}
          </Text>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="بازگشت به تاریخچه"
            onPress={() => router.back()}
            className="mt-6 rounded-xl bg-blue-600 px-6 py-3"
          >
            <Text className="text-sm font-bold text-white">بازگشت به تاریخچه</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="gap-4 px-4 py-5 pb-10">
          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <Text className="flex-1 text-right text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                {TOOL_NAMES[record.calculatorId] ?? record.calculatorId}
              </Text>

              <View className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-gray-800">
                <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
                  v{record.formulaVersion}
                </Text>
              </View>
            </View>

            <View className="mt-2 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
              <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
              <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                {formatDate(record.createdAt)}
              </Text>
            </View>
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              ورودی‌ها
            </Text>
            <KeyValueList data={record.inputs} />
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
            <Text className="mb-3 text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
              خروجی‌ها
            </Text>
            <KeyValueList data={record.result} />
          </View>

          <TouchableOpacity
            activeOpacity={0.8}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="اشتراک‌گذاری محاسبه"
            onPress={() => {
              void handleShare();
            }}
            className="flex-row items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl bg-green-600 px-4 py-3.5"
          >
            <Share2 size={18} color="#FFFFFF" />
            <Text className="text-base font-bold text-white">اشتراک‌گذاری</Text>
          </TouchableOpacity>
        </ScrollView>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

**database.ts:**

```ts
import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';

const DATABASE_NAME = 'handbook.db';

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

const SCHEMA_STATEMENTS = [
  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calculation_history (...)`,
  ...
];

async function initialize(db: SQLiteDatabase): Promise<void> {
  await db.execAsync('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;');
  await db.execAsync('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;');
  for (const statement of SCHEMA_STATEMENTS) {
    await db.execAsync(statement);
  }
}

export function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME)
      .then(async (db) => { await initialize(db); return db; })
      .catch((error) => { databasePromise = null; throw error; });
  }
  return databasePromise;
}
```

```
import { openDatabaseAsync, type SQLiteDatabase } from 'expo-sqlite';

/**
 * Single SQLite file for the whole app. Every module must obtain its
 * connection through `getDatabase()` so there is exactly one open handle
 * and one schema.
 */
const DATABASE_NAME = 'handbook.db';

/**
 * Schema is derived from the queries in `core/offline/repository.ts`.
 * Keep the two in sync: a column added here must be written there and
 * vice versa.
 */
const SCHEMA_STATEMENTS: string[] = [
  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS calculation_history (
     calculation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
     owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     calculator_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     formula_version TEXT NOT NULL,
     inputs_json TEXT NOT NULL,
     result_json TEXT NOT NULL,
     source_json TEXT,
     created_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )`,
  `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_calculation_history_owner_created
     ON calculation_history (owner_user_id, created_at DESC)`,

  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS outbox (
     operation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
     owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     module_name TEXT NOT NULL,
     entity_type TEXT NOT NULL,
     entity_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     operation TEXT NOT NULL,
     base_version INTEGER,
     payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
     status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
     retry_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     last_error TEXT,
     created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )`,
  `CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_outbox_pending
     ON outbox (owner_user_id, status, created_at)`,

  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS notebook_entries (
     entry_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
     owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     title TEXT NOT NULL,
     body TEXT NOT NULL,
     version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
     server_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     sync_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )`,

  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS form_drafts (
     draft_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
     owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     form_type TEXT NOT NULL,
     payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
     version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
     server_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     sync_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING',
     updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )`,

  `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cached_documents (
     document_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
     owner_user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
     metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL,
     local_uri TEXT,
     content_hash TEXT,
     document_version TEXT,
     size_bytes INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
     last_accessed_at TEXT,
     cached_at TEXT NOT NULL
   )`,
];

let databasePromise: Promise<SQLiteDatabase> | null = null;

async function initialize(db: SQLiteDatabase): Promise<void> {
  await db.execAsync('PRAGMA journal_mode = WAL;');
  await db.execAsync('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON;');

  for (const statement of SCHEMA_STATEMENTS) {
    await db.execAsync(statement);
  }
}

/**
 * Returns the shared database handle, opening and migrating it on first use.
 *
 * The promise is cached so concurrent callers share one connection. A failed
 * open clears the cache so the next call can retry.
 */
export function getDatabase(): Promise<SQLiteDatabase> {
  if (!databasePromise) {
    databasePromise = openDatabaseAsync(DATABASE_NAME)
      .then(async (db) => {
        await initialize(db);
        return db;
      })
      .catch((error: unknown) => {
        databasePromise = null;
        throw error;
      });
  }

  return databasePromise;
}

```
import { getDatabase } from '../../../core/database';
import {
  listCalculationHistory,
  saveCalculation,
} from '../../../core/offline/repository';

/**
 * Default owner id. `repository.ts` scopes every row by `owner_user_id` and
 * receives that id from its caller, so once the app has an authenticated
 * session these helpers must be given the same id or the two paths will
 * write to different partitions of the same table.
 */
const LOCAL_USER_ID = 'local_user';

/**
 * Stamped on rows saved without an explicit version. The voltage-drop formula
 * is still under review, so this deliberately signals "unapproved".
 */
const DEFAULT_FORMULA_VERSION = '0.0.0-draft';

/**
 * Mirrors the return shape of `repository.listCalculationHistory` so the two
 * modules expose identical types for the same table.
 */
export type CalculationHistoryRecord = {
  calculationId: string;
  ownerUserId: string;
  calculatorId: string;
  formulaVersion: string;
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>;
  result: Record<string, unknown>;
  source: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

type RawHistoryRow = {
  calculation_id: string;
  owner_user_id: string;
  calculator_id: string;
  formula_version: string;
  inputs_json: string | null;
  result_json: string | null;
  source_json: string | null;
  created_at: string;
};

type Database = Awaited<ReturnType<typeof getDatabase>>;

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)) {
    return value as Record<string, unknown>;
  }

  return {};
}

function parseJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (!value) return {};

  try {
    return asRecord(JSON.parse(value));
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

function parseNullableJsonObject(value: string | null): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  if (!value) return null;

  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(value);

    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsed)) {
      return parsed as Record<string, unknown>;
    }

    return null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

function mapRow(row: RawHistoryRow): CalculationHistoryRecord {
  return {
    calculationId: row.calculation_id,
    ownerUserId: row.owner_user_id,
    calculatorId: row.calculator_id,
    formulaVersion: row.formula_version,
    inputs: parseJsonObject(row.inputs_json),
    result: parseJsonObject(row.result_json),
    source: parseNullableJsonObject(row.source_json),
    createdAt: row.created_at,
  };
}

export type SaveCalculationHistoryOptions = {
  formulaVersion?: string;
  source?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
  userId?: string;
};

/**
 * Persists one calculation through `repository.saveCalculation`, so the
 * column set and the 100-row retention policy are identical to every other
 * writer of `calculation_history`.
 *
 * @returns The generated `calculation_id`.
 */
export async function saveCalculationHistory(
  calculatorId: string,
  inputs: Record<string, unknown>,
  result: Record<string, unknown>,
  options?: SaveCalculationHistoryOptions
): Promise<string> {
  return saveCalculation({
    userId: options?.userId ?? LOCAL_USER_ID,
    calculatorId,
    formulaVersion: options?.formulaVersion ?? DEFAULT_FORMULA_VERSION,
    inputs,
    result,
    source: options?.source ?? undefined,
  });
}

/**
 * Returns the owner's calculation history, newest first.
 *
 * @param userId - Owner scope. Defaults to the local owner id.
 */
export async function getCalculationHistory(
  userId: string = LOCAL_USER_ID
): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord[]> {
  const rows = await listCalculationHistory(userId);

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    calculationId: row.calculationId,
    ownerUserId: userId,
    calculatorId: row.calculatorId,
    formulaVersion: row.formulaVersion,
    inputs: asRecord(row.inputs),
    result: asRecord(row.result),
    source: row.source === null || row.source === undefined ? null : asRecord(row.source),
    createdAt: row.createdAt,
  }));
}

/**
 * Fetches a single calculation history record by its primary key.
 *
 * @param id - The record's `calculation_id`.
 * @returns The parsed record, or null when no row matches.
 */
export async function getHistoryById(id: string): Promise<CalculationHistoryRecord | null> {
  const database: Database = await getDatabase();

  const row = await database.getFirstAsync<RawHistoryRow>(
    `SELECT calculation_id, owner_user_id, calculator_id, formula_version, inputs_json, result_json, source_json, created_at
       FROM calculation_history
      WHERE calculation_id = ?`,
    [id]
  );

  return row ? mapRow(row) : null;
}

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, View } from 'react-native';

export type StaticTableColumn = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** Column width in points. Falls back to DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH. */
  width?: number;
};

export type StaticTableRow = Record<string, string | number>;

export type StaticTableData = {
  title: string;
  unit?: string;
  columns: StaticTableColumn[];
  rows: StaticTableRow[];
};

type StaticTableViewerProps = {
  data: StaticTableData;
};

const DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH = 110;

function formatCell(value: string | number | undefined): string {
  if (value === undefined || value === null) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'number' && Number.isNaN(value)) return '—';
  return String(value);
}

export function StaticTableViewer({ data }: StaticTableViewerProps) {
  const { title, unit, columns, rows } = data;
  const lastColumnIndex = columns.length - 1;

  return (
    <View className="gap-3">
      <View className="gap-1">
        <Text className="text-right text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
          {title}
        </Text>
        {unit ? (
          <Text className="text-right text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            واحد مقادیر: {unit}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
      </View>

      <ScrollView horizontal showsHorizontalScrollIndicator contentContainerClassName="pb-1">
        <View className="overflow-hidden rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-900">
          <View className="flex-row border-b border-gray-200 bg-gray-50 dark:border-gray-700 dark:bg-gray-800">
            {columns.map((column, index) => (
              <View
                key={column.key}
                style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                className={
                  index < lastColumnIndex
                    ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                    : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                }
              >
                <Text className="text-right text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                  {column.label}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ))}
          </View>

          {rows.map((row, rowIndex) => (
            <View
              key={rowIndex}
              className={
                rowIndex < rows.length - 1
                  ? 'flex-row border-b border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700'
                  : 'flex-row'
              }
            >
              {columns.map((column, index) => (
                <View
                  key={column.key}
                  style={{ width: column.width ?? DEFAULT_COLUMN_WIDTH }}
                  className={
                    index < lastColumnIndex
                      ? 'justify-center border-l border-gray-200 px-3 py-3 dark:border-gray-700'
                      : 'justify-center px-3 py-3'
                  }
                >
                  <Text className="text-right text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-700 dark:text-gray-300">
                    {formatCell(row[column.key])}
                  </Text>
                </View>
              ))}
            </View>
          ))}
        </View>
      </ScrollView>
    </View>
  );
}

export default StaticTableViewer;
```

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, Text, TouchableOpacity, View } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  StaticTableViewer,
  type StaticTableData,
  type StaticTableRow,
} from '../../../components/StaticTableViewer';
import { useTheme } from '../../../../../core/theme/ThemeContext';
import clearancesData from '../../../data/clearances_table.json';

/**
 * The clearances JSON stores a voltage matrix (voltage_levels + clearances).
 * StaticTableViewer expects a column-driven shape, so the matrix is flattened
 * into one column per voltage level here. The JSON file itself is unchanged.
 */
const TABLE_DATA: StaticTableData = {
  title: clearancesData.title,
  unit: clearancesData.unit,
  columns: [
    { key: 'condition', label: 'شرح', width: 160 },
    ...clearancesData.voltage_levels.map((level) => ({
      key: level,
      label: level,
      width: 80,
    })),
  ],
  rows: clearancesData.rows.map((row) => {
    const mapped: StaticTableRow = { condition: row.condition };

    for (const level of clearancesData.voltage_levels) {
      mapped[level] = row.clearances[level] ?? '—';
    }

    return mapped;
  }),
};

export default function ClearancesScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">حریم هوایی هادی</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      <ScrollView className="flex-1" contentContainerClassName="px-4 py-5 pb-10">
        <StaticTableViewer data={TABLE_DATA} />
      </ScrollView>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

function UnderDevelopmentScreen() {

      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">

        </Text>
        <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-sm leading-6 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
          این ابزار هنوز آماده استفاده نیست و به‌زودی اضافه می‌شود.
        </Text>
      </View>
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

export default function ToolRoute() {
  const { id } = useLocalSearchParams<{ id: string }>();

  const renderTool = () => {
    if (id === 'electrical.voltage-drop') {
      return <VoltageDropScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'electrical.transformer') {
      return <TransformerScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.clearances') {
      return <ClearancesScreen />;
    }

    if (id === 'mechanical.acsr') {
      return <AcsrScreen />;
    }

    return <UnderDevelopmentScreen />;
  };

  return <ErrorBoundary resetKey={id}>{renderTool()}</ErrorBoundary>;
}
