```
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  FlatList,
  RefreshControl,
  Text,
  TouchableOpacity,
  View,
} from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ArrowRight, Clock, History as HistoryIcon, Inbox } from 'lucide-react-native';
import {
  getCalculationHistory,
  type CalculationHistoryRecord,
} from '../../src/features/technical-tools/services/history.service';
import { TOOLS } from '../../src/features/technical-tools/registry/tools.registry';
import { useTheme } from '../../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';

const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';
  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }
  return String(value);
}

function summarizeInputs(inputs: Record<string, unknown>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(inputs);

  if (entries.length === 0) return 'بدون ورودی ثبت‌شده';

  return entries
    .slice(0, 3)
    .map(([key, value]) => `${key}: ${formatValue(value)}`)
    .join(' • ');
}

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

export default function CalculationHistoryScreen() {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark } = useTheme();

  const [history, setHistory] = useState<CalculationHistoryRecord[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState<boolean>(true);
  const [isRefreshing, setIsRefreshing] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadHistory = useCallback(async (mode: 'initial' | 'refresh') => {
    if (mode === 'initial') {
      setIsLoading(true);
    } else {
      setIsRefreshing(true);
    }

    try {
      const records = await getCalculationHistory();
      setHistory(records);
      setErrorMessage(null);
    } catch (error) {
      const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'خطای ناشناخته';
      setErrorMessage(`بارگذاری تاریخچه با خطا مواجه شد: ${message}`);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
      setIsRefreshing(false);
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadHistory('initial');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const handleRefresh = useCallback(() => {
    void loadHistory('refresh');
  }, [loadHistory]);

  const renderItem = ({ item }: { item: CalculationHistoryRecord }) => {
    const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[item.calculatorId] ?? item.calculatorId;

    return (
      <View className="rounded-2xl border border-gray-200 bg-white p-4 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <View className="flex-row items-center gap-2">
            <View className="h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-blue-50 dark:bg-blue-950">
              <HistoryIcon size={18} color={isDark ? '#93C5FD' : '#1D4ED8'} />
            </View>
            <Text
              numberOfLines={1}
              className="max-w-[190px] text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white"
            >
              {toolName}
            </Text>
          </View>

          <View className="rounded-full bg-gray-100 px-2.5 py-1 dark:bg-gray-800">
            <Text className="text-[10px] font-bold text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300">
              v{item.formulaVersion}
            </Text>
          </View>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 flex-row items-center gap-1.5">
          <Clock size={13} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
          <Text className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            {formatDate(item.createdAt)}
          </Text>
        </View>

        <View className="mt-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800">
          <Text
            numberOfLines={2}
            className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-gray-600 dark:text-gray-300"
          >
            {summarizeInputs(item.inputs)}
          </Text>
        </View>
      </View>
    );
  };

  return (
    <SafeAreaView edges={['top']} className="flex-1 bg-gray-50 dark:bg-gray-950">
      <View className="flex-row items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-200 bg-white px-4 py-3 dark:border-gray-800 dark:bg-gray-900">
        <TouchableOpacity
          activeOpacity={0.7}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="بازگشت"
          onPress={() => router.back()}
          className="h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800"
        >
          <ArrowRight size={20} color={isDark ? '#E5E7EB' : '#111827'} />
        </TouchableOpacity>

        <Text className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">تاریخچه محاسبات</Text>

        <View className="h-10 w-10" />
      </View>

      {isLoading ? (
        <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator size="large" color={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'} />
          <Text className="mt-3 text-sm text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
            در حال بارگذاری تاریخچه...
          </Text>
        </View>
      ) : (
        <FlatList
          className="flex-1"
          data={history}
          keyExtractor={(item) => item.calculationId}
          renderItem={renderItem}
          contentContainerClassName="gap-3 px-4 py-4 pb-10"
          refreshControl={
            <RefreshControl
              refreshing={isRefreshing}
              onRefresh={handleRefresh}
              tintColor={isDark ? '#4ADE80' : '#16A34A'}
            />
          }
          ListHeaderComponent={
            errorMessage ? (
              <View className="mb-3 rounded-xl border border-red-200 bg-red-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:border-red-900 dark:bg-red-950">
                <Text className="text-right text-[11px] leading-5 text-red-700 dark:text-red-300">
                  {errorMessage}
                </Text>
              </View>
            ) : null
          }
          ListEmptyComponent={
            <View className="items-center justify-center py-20">
              <View className="h-16 w-16 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-gray-100 dark:bg-gray-800">
                <Inbox size={28} color={isDark ? '#9CA3AF' : '#6B7280'} />
              </View>
              <Text className="mt-4 text-base font-bold text-gray-900 dark:text-white">
                هیچ محاسبه‌ای ثبت نشده است
              </Text>
              <Text className="mt-2 px-8 text-center text-xs leading-5 text-gray-500 dark:text-gray-400">
                پس از انجام محاسبات در ابزارهای فنی، نتایج در این بخش نمایش داده می‌شود.
              </Text>
            </View>
          }
        />
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

## What changed and why

**Task 1 — registry.** `electrical.voltage-drop` is now `available`. `mechanical.sag-tension` and `civil.pole-codes` are demoted to `under_development` because they have no screen; leaving them `available` would show a green "فعال" badge that opens the "در حال توسعه" fallback. `mechanical.acsr` and `electrical.transformer` are added as `available` with real routes. Every `available` id now has a branch in `[id].tsx`.

**Task 2 — `StaticTableViewer`.** Column-driven: `columns: { key, label, width? }[]` + `rows: Record<string, string | number>[]`. `unit` is optional, so ACSR and transformer tables don't need a fake unit.

**Task 3 — three screens.** `ClearancesScreen` flattens the voltage matrix into columns at module load (the JSON is untouched). `AcsrScreen` and `TransformerScreen` were empty files; both are now complete and cast their JSON to `StaticTableData`.

**Task 4 — schema alignment.** `database.ts` now exists and defines `calculation_history` with the exact columns `repository.ts` writes: `calculation_id`, `owner_user_id`, `calculator_id`, `formula_version`, `inputs_json`, `result_json`, `source_json`, `created_at`. It also creates the other four tables `repository.ts` queries (`outbox`, `notebook_entries`, `form_drafts`, `cached_documents`) — without them, `repository.ts` would fail on first use. `history.service.ts` delegates to `repository.saveCalculation` / `repository.listCalculationHistory`, so there is one code path and the 100-row prune applies to both.

## Two things to verify

1. **The transformer and ACSR numbers are my reference values, not your official tables.** I flagged the specific ones I'm least sure of earlier (`Dog` vs `Hyena` weights, breaker sizing rule, cable sizing). Please check them against your distribution-company data before this ships.

2. **`mobile/app/tools/history/[id].tsx` is still an empty file.** Expo Router treats every file under `app/` as a route, and an empty module has no default export — that's a build-time error, not a runtime one. It's outside this task's scope, so I left it alone. Say the word and I'll either write the detail screen or delete the file.

```tsx
function formatDate(iso: string): string {

function buildShareMessage(record: CalculationHistoryRecord): string {
```

```
const TOOL_NAMES: Record<string, string> = TOOLS.reduce<Record<string, string>>((acc, tool) => {
  acc[tool.id] = tool.name;
  return acc;
}, {});

function formatDate(iso: string): string {
  const date = new Date(iso);

  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return iso;

  try {
    return new Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', {
      year: 'numeric',
      month: '2-digit',
      day: '2-digit',
      hour: '2-digit',
      minute: '2-digit',
    }).format(date);
  } catch {
    return date.toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ');
  }
}

function formatValue(value: unknown): string {
  if (value === null || value === undefined) return '—';

  if (typeof value === 'object') {
    try {
      return JSON.stringify(value);
    } catch {
      return '—';
    }
  }

  return String(value);
}

function buildShareMessage(record: CalculationHistoryRecord): string {
  const toolName = TOOL_NAMES[record.calculatorId] ?? record.calculatorId;

      </Text>
    );

  return (
    <View className="gap-2">
      {entries.map(([key, value]) => (

          className="flex-row items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-xl bg-gray-50 px-3 py-2.5 dark:bg-gray-800"
```

## Notes on the implementation

**Import depth is three levels, not two.** The file sits at `mobile/app/tools/history/[id].tsx`, so `../../../src/...` reaches `mobile/src/`. The sibling list screen at `mobile/app/tools/history.tsx` uses `../../src/...` because it is one level shallower — copying its imports verbatim would have broken this file.

**Field names match the real schema.** The record exposes `result`, not `outputs`, and `calculatorId`, not `tool_id`. Both come straight from `CalculationHistoryRecord` in `history.service.ts`, which delegates to `repository.listCalculationHistory`.

**`getHistoryById` returns `null`, not a throw, for a missing row.** The screen distinguishes three states: loading, not-found (with the specific message), and loaded. A thrown error is caught separately and surfaced with its message.

**`isMounted` guard.** The async load can resolve after the user navigates back. Without the flag, `setState` on an unmounted component warns in development and can leak. The cleanup function flips it.

**Share is offered twice** — a header icon and a full-width button at the bottom — because the header icon is easy to miss on a long scroll. Both call the same `handleShare`, which is memoized on `record`.

**`Share.share` rejects on some platforms when the user dismisses the sheet.** That is caught and shown as an alert rather than crashing. Note that on iOS a dismissal resolves with `action: 'dismissedAction'` rather than rejecting, so no alert appears there — which is the desired behavior.

**`Intl.DateTimeFormat('fa-IR', …)` is wrapped in try/catch.** Hermes ships `Intl` on modern Expo SDKs, but the fallback to an ISO slice keeps the screen rendering if a build lacks full locale data. This mirrors the existing `history.tsx`.

import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';

const isWeb = Platform.OS === 'web';

// Web fallback is for development testing only; localStorage is not secure.
async function getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return null;
      return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch { return null; }
  }
  return SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
}

async function setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return;
  }
  await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value, { keychainAccessible: SecureStore.WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY });
}

async function deleteItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
      window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch { /* ignore */ }
    return;
  }
  await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key);
}

```
import { Platform } from 'react-native';
import * as SecureStore from 'expo-secure-store';

const REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY = 'handbook.refresh-token.v1';

const isWeb = Platform.OS === 'web';

// Web fallback is for development testing only; localStorage is not secure storage.
async function getItem(key: string): Promise<string | null> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return null;
      return window.localStorage.getItem(key);
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  }
  return SecureStore.getItemAsync(key);
}

async function setItem(key: string, value: string): Promise<void> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
      window.localStorage.setItem(key, value);
    } catch {
      // Ignore web storage failures in development fallback.
    }
    return;
  }
  await SecureStore.setItemAsync(key, value, {
    keychainAccessible: SecureStore.WHEN_UNLOCKED_THIS_DEVICE_ONLY,
  });
}

async function deleteItem(key: string): Promise<void> {
  if (isWeb) {
    try {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || !window.localStorage) return;
      window.localStorage.removeItem(key);
    } catch {
      // Ignore web storage failures in development fallback.
    }
    return;
  }
  await SecureStore.deleteItemAsync(key);
}

export async function saveRefreshToken(token: string): Promise<void> {
  await setItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export async function readRefreshToken(): Promise<string | null> {
  return getItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
}

export async function clearRefreshToken(): Promise<void> {
  await deleteItem(REFRESH_TOKEN_KEY);
}

const USER_CACHE_KEY = 'handbook_user_v1';

export async function saveCachedUser(user: { id: string; email: string; name: string; role: string; jobRole: string | null; province: string | null }): Promise<void> {
  await setItem(USER_CACHE_KEY, JSON.stringify(user));
}

export async function readCachedUser(): Promise<{ id: string; email: string; name: string; role: 'USER' | 'ADMIN' | 'SUPER_ADMIN'; jobRole: string | null; province: string | null } | null> {
  const raw = await getItem(USER_CACHE_KEY);
  if (!raw) return null;
  try {
    const user = JSON.parse(raw);
    if (typeof user.id !== 'string' || typeof user.email !== 'string') return null;
    return { ...user, jobRole: typeof user.jobRole === 'string' ? user.jobRole : null, province: typeof user.province === 'string' ? user.province : null };
  } catch { return null; }
}

export async function clearCachedUser(): Promise<void> {
  await deleteItem(USER_CACHE_KEY);
}
```

## Audit (read-only)

### (1) 20 GB recursive import — resumable, streaming, fault-isolated
**Verdict: OK (with caveats)** — `backend/scripts/import-documents.js` → `walk`, `sha256`, `importOne`, `worker`

- Recursion: `walk` is recursive and handles nested dirs. OK.
- Memory: `sha256` streams via `createReadStream`; `verifySignature` reads 1 KB. OK.
- Fault isolation: `worker` wraps each `importOne` in try/catch, increments `counters.failed`, continues. OK.
- Resumability: dedupe on `checksumSha256` (`prisma.document.findUnique`) makes re-runs idempotent. OK.
- Caveats: `output.push(...await walk(fullPath))` can throw `RangeError` on very large directories; no checkpoint file (relies on DB); orphaned storage objects if the process dies between `putDocumentFile` and the DB commit; `putDocumentFile` memory behavior is unverified (not in chat).

### (2) Per-page PDF text, OCR fallback, legacy-font garbling
**Verdict: BUG / MISSING** — `backend/src/workers/document-extraction.js` → `extractDocumentPages`, `splitPdfTextIntoPages`

- Per-page: OK — `splitPdfTextIntoPages` splits `pdftotext` output on `\f`.
- OCR fallback: BUG — the trigger is document-level (`text.replace(/\s/g,'').length < 40`) and uses `ocrmypdf --skip-text`. A 500-page PDF with one text page, or a PDF with a *garbage* text layer (legacy font), never gets OCR'd.
- Legacy-font garbling (reversed / PUA / mojibake): MISSING — no bidi/reversal detection, no legacy encoding or PUA mapping, no `--force-ocr` / `--redo-ocr` path.

### (3) Persian normalization parity (index vs. query)
**Verdict: BUG** — `backend/src/services/search/search-normalization.js` → `normalizeSearchText`; `backend/src/services/search/opensearch.client.js` → `indexDocument`, `searchIndexedDocuments`

- Index time: applied (`chunkPages` normalizes `content`; `indexDocument` normalizes `title`/`description`). OK.
- Query time: **not applied** — `searchIndexedDocuments` passes raw `query` into `match`/`match_phrase`.
- The `fa_normalize` char filter only covers `ي/ك/ۀ/ة/ZWNJ`. It misses `ى` (U+0649), Persian/Arabic digits, diacritics, and NFKC — all of which the JS normalizer *does* change at index time. Result: digit and diacritic queries silently fail to match.

### (4) Chunk size and stored fields
**Verdict: BUG (size) / OK (fields)** — `backend/src/services/search/search-chunks.js` → `chunkPages`; `opensearch.client.js` → `indexDocument`

- Size: BUG — defaults are `chunkSize: 4000`, `overlap: 300`, far above the 800–1200 target. Slicing is fixed-offset with no paragraph/sentence boundary awareness, so chunks split mid-word.
- Fields: OK — `indexDocument` writes `documentId`, `pageNumber`, `chunkIndex`, `content` per chunk.

### (5) OpenSearch Persian mapping/analyzer and highlighting
**Verdict: OK (with gaps)** — `opensearch.client.js` → `ensureDocumentIndex`, `searchIndexedDocuments`

- Mapping/analyzer present (`fa_text` with `fa_normalize` char filter); `highlight` present on `title` and `content`. OK.
- Gaps: analyzer has no digit normalizer, no diacritic filter, no `ى` mapping, no stopwords; `title.keyword` has no `normalizer`; highlight returns *normalized* text (ASCII digits, ZWNJ removed, diacritics stripped) rather than source text; `request`'s "not configured" guard is dead code because `endpoint()` always returns a default.

```js
export async function getSearchDocumentsByIds(ids, user) {
  if (!ids.length) return [];
  const where = !user
    ? { id: { in: ids }, isActive: true, visibility: 'PUBLIC' }
    : user.role === 'ADMIN' || user.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN'
      ? { id: { in: ids }, isActive: true }
      : { id: { in: ids }, isActive: true, OR: [
        { visibility: 'PUBLIC' },
        ...(user.jobRole ? [{ visibility: 'ROLE_RESTRICTED', accessJobRoles: { has: user.jobRole } }] : []),
        { visibility: 'PRIVATE', ownerId: user.id },
      ] };
  const docs = await prisma.document.findMany({ where, select: PUBLIC_FIELDS });
  const byId = new Map(docs.map(doc => [doc.id, doc]));
  return ids.map(id => byId.get(id)).filter(Boolean);
}
```

```js
import { AppError } from '../utils/response.util.js';
import { ZodError } from 'zod';
import { PrismaClientKnownRequestError } from '@prisma/client/runtime/library';
import jwt from 'jsonwebtoken';

export function notFoundHandler(req, res, next) {
  next(new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'Resource not found'));
}

function sendError(res, req, status, code, message, details) {
  const error = { code, message };
  if (details !== undefined) error.details = details;
  if (req.requestId) error.requestId = req.requestId;
  return res.status(status).json({
    success: false,
    code,
    message,
    ...(details !== undefined ? { meta: details } : {}),
    error,
  });
}

export function errorHandler(err, req, res, next) {
  if (res.headersSent) {
    if (!res.destroyed) res.destroy(err);
    return;
  }
  if (err instanceof AppError) return sendError(res, req, err.status, err.code, err.message, err.details);
  if (err instanceof ZodError) return sendError(res, req, 400, 'VALIDATION_ERROR', 'Validation error', err.issues);
  if (err?.type === 'entity.too.large') ...
  if (err?.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE') ...
  if (err instanceof PrismaClientKnownRequestError) { P2002 -> 409, P2025 -> 404 }
  if (err instanceof jwt.TokenExpiredError) ...
  if (err instanceof jwt.JsonWebTokenError) ...
  console.error(...);
  return sendError(res, req, 500, 'INTERNAL_ERROR', 'Internal server error');
}
```

### backend/src/services/search/search-normalization.js

```js
export function normalizeSearchText(value = '') {
  return String(value)
    .normalize('NFKC')
    .replace(/[يى]/g, 'ی')
    .replace(/ك/g, 'ک')
    .replace(/[ۀة]/g, 'ه')
    .replace(/[\u064B-\u065F\u0670]/g, '')
    .replace(/\u200c/g, ' ')
    .replace(/[\u0660-\u0669]/g, digit => String(digit.charCodeAt(0) - 0x0660))
    .replace(/[\u06F0-\u06F9]/g, digit => String(digit.charCodeAt(0) - 0x06f0))
    .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
    .trim();
}
```

Observations:
- Handles `ي` (U+064A) and `ى` (U+0649) → `ی`. Good — earlier I said it misses `ى`; actually it includes `ى` in `[يى]`. Correction needed.
- `ك` → `ک`. Good.
- `ۀ` (U+06C0) and `ة` (U+0629) → `ه`. Good.
- Diacritics `\u064B-\u065F` and `\u0670` removed. Good.
- ZWNJ `\u200c` → space. Good.
- Arabic-Indic digits `\u0660-\u0669` → ASCII. Good.
- Persian digits `\u06F0-\u06F9` → ASCII. Good.
- Whitespace collapse. Good.
- **MISSING:** `\u200d` (ZWJ), `\u200e`/`\u200f` (LRM/RLM), `\u0640` (tatweel/kashida), `\u06CC` vs `\u0649` handled, but `\u06A9` vs `\u0643` handled. Also `\u06C1` (heh goal) not mapped. Minor.
- **BUG:** `normalize('NFKC')` on Persian text can decompose/combine some sequences; generally fine.
- **BUG (important):** This normalizer is applied at **index time** (`chunkPages` → `normalizeSearchText(page.text)`, `indexDocument` → `normalizeSearchText(document.title)`), but **not at query time** — `searchIndexedDocuments` passes raw `query`. So parity is broken. Confirmed.

### backend/src/workers/document-extraction.js

```js
export function splitPdfTextIntoPages(text, maxChars = 5_000_000) {
  const source = String(text ?? '').replace(/\u0000/g, '').slice(0, maxChars);
  const rawPages = source.split('\f');
  const pages = [];
  let remaining = maxChars;
  for (let index = 0; index < rawPages.length && remaining > 0; index += 1) {
    const pageText = rawPages[index].slice(0, remaining).trim();
    remaining -= pageText.length;
    if (pageText) pages.push({ pageNumber: index + 1, text: pageText });
  }
  return pages;
}
```

- Splits on `\f` (form feed) — correct for `pdftotext` output.
- **BUG:** `pageNumber: index + 1` — if a page is empty (no text), it's skipped, so subsequent page numbers are still correct (index-based). Good.
- **BUG:** `remaining -= pageText.length` — but `pageText` is trimmed, so `remaining` decrements by trimmed length, not raw. Minor.
- **BUG:** `slice(0, maxChars)` on the whole text before splitting — if the document exceeds `maxChars`, later pages are truncated. Acceptable.

```js
export async function readTextLimited(filePath, maxChars = 5_000_000) {
  const handle = await fs.open(filePath, 'r');
  try {
    const chunks = [];
    const maxBytes = maxChars * 4;
    let total = 0;
    const buffer = Buffer.alloc(64 * 1024);
    while (total < maxBytes) {
      const length = Math.min(buffer.length, maxBytes - total);
      const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(buffer, 0, length, total);
      if (!bytesRead) break;
      chunks.push(Buffer.from(buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead)));
      total += bytesRead;
    }
    return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8').replace(/\u0000/g, '').slice(0, maxChars);
  } finally {
    await handle.close();
  }
}
```

- Streams in 64KB chunks. OK.
- **BUG:** `maxBytes = maxChars * 4` — for UTF-8 Persian (2 bytes/char), this reads up to 4× the chars, then slices to `maxChars`. Fine.
- **BUG:** `Buffer.concat(chunks)` materializes the whole file in memory — up to `maxChars * 4` bytes = 20MB for 5M chars. Acceptable.
- **BUG:** `handle.read(buffer, 0, length, total)` — reads at position `total`. Correct.
- **BUG:** if `bytesRead < length`, loop continues but `total` advances by `bytesRead`; next read at `total`. Correct.
- **BUG:** `Buffer.from(buffer.subarray(0, bytesRead))` — copies. OK.

```js
export async function extractDocumentPages({ document, filePath, tempDir, run, maxChars, ocrLanguages }) {
  if (document.mimeType === 'text/plain' || document.mimeType === 'text/markdown') {
    const text = await readTextLimited(filePath, maxChars);
    return text.trim() ? [{ pageNumber: 1, text }] : [];
  }

  if (document.mimeType === 'application/pdf') {
    const textPath = path.join(tempDir, 'extracted.txt');
    try {
      await run('pdftotext', ['-enc', 'UTF-8', '-layout', filePath, textPath]);
      let text = await readTextLimited(textPath, maxChars);
      if (text.replace(/\s/g, '').length < 40) {
        const ocrPath = path.join(tempDir, 'ocr.pdf');
        await run('ocrmypdf', ['--skip-text', '--rotate-pages', '--deskew', '-l', ocrLanguages, filePath, ocrPath]);
        await run('pdftotext', ['-enc', 'UTF-8', '-layout', ocrPath, textPath]);
        text = await readTextLimited(textPath, maxChars);
      }
      return splitPdfTextIntoPages(text, maxChars);
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code === 'ENOENT') throw new Error('ابزار pdftotext یا ocrmypdf روی Worker نصب نیست');
      throw error;
    }
  }

  if (document.mimeType.startsWith('image/')) {
    try {
      const outputBase = path.join(tempDir, 'image-ocr');
      await run('tesseract', [filePath, outputBase, '-l', ocrLanguages, '--oem', '1', '--psm', '6']);
      const text = await readTextLimited(`${outputBase}.txt`, maxChars);
      return text.trim() ? [{ pageNumber: 1, text }] : [];
    } catch (error) {
      if (error.code === 'ENOENT') throw new Error('Tesseract روی Worker نصب نیست');
      throw error;
    }
  }

  throw new Error('نوع سند برای استخراج متن پشتیبانی نمی‌شود');
}
```

- Per-page: OK via `splitPdfTextIntoPages`.
- OCR fallback: **BUG** — document-level threshold (`text.replace(/\s/g,'').length < 40`). A 500-page PDF with one text page won't OCR. Also `--skip-text` means pages that already have *any* text layer (even garbage from legacy fonts) are skipped. So scanned pages mixed with text pages are not OCR'd.
- Legacy-font garbling: **MISSING** — no reversal detection, no PUA mapping, no `--force-ocr`/`--redo-ocr`. Confirmed.
- **BUG:** `ocrmypdf` output `ocr.pdf` is written but never cleaned up explicitly — `tempDir` is removed in the worker's `finally`. OK.
- **BUG:** `run('ocrmypdf', ...)` has a 180s timeout (from `run` in worker). Large PDFs will time out. BUG.
- **BUG:** `tesseract` for images uses `--psm 6` (assume uniform block) — poor for sparse text. Minor.
- **BUG:** `readTextLimited` on `extracted.txt` — if `pdftotext` fails silently (exit 0, empty file), `text` is empty, OCR triggers. OK.
- **BUG:** `error.code === 'ENOENT'` — `execFile` errors have `code: 'ENOENT'` when the binary is missing. OK.
- **MISSING:** no `pdftotext -raw` fallback for layout issues. Minor.

```js
async function claimJob() {
  const now = new Date();
  const staleBefore = new Date(now.getTime() - 10 * 60 * 1000);
  const job = await prisma.documentIndexJob.findFirst({
    where: {
      availableAt: { lte: now },
      OR: [
        { status: 'PENDING' },
        { status: 'RETRY' },
        { status: 'RUNNING', lockedAt: { lt: staleBefore } },
      ],
    },
    orderBy: [{ availableAt: 'asc' }, { createdAt: 'asc' }],
  });
  if (!job) return null;
  const claimed = await prisma.documentIndexJob.updateMany({
    where: { id: job.id, status: job.status, ...(job.status === 'RUNNING' ? { lockedAt: { lt: staleBefore } } : {}) },
    data: { status: 'RUNNING', lockedAt: now, attempts: { increment: 1 }, lastError: null },
  });
  return claimed.count === 1 ? { ...job, lockedAt: now, attempts: job.attempts + 1 } : null;
}
```

- Optimistic claim via `updateMany` with status guard. OK.
- **BUG:** `findFirst` + `updateMany` is not atomic — two workers can both `findFirst` the same job, but only one `updateMany` succeeds. The loser returns `null` and the loop sleeps. OK.
- **BUG:** `attempts: { increment: 1 }` — but the returned object uses `job.attempts + 1`. If the DB increment fails, mismatch. Minor.
- **BUG:** stale `RUNNING` jobs are reclaimed after 10 min, but the heartbeat updates `lockedAt` every 60s. If the heartbeat fails (DB down), the job is reclaimed while still running — double processing. Minor.

```js
function startJobHeartbeat(jobId, initialLock) {
  let currentLock = initialLock;
  const timer = setInterval(async () => {
    const nextLock = new Date();
    try {
      const result = await prisma.documentIndexJob.updateMany({
        where: { id: jobId, status: 'RUNNING', lockedAt: currentLock },
        data: { lockedAt: nextLock },
      });
      if (result.count === 1) currentLock = nextLock;
      else clearInterval(timer);
    } catch (error) { ... }
  }, 60_000);
  timer.unref?.();
  return () => clearInterval(timer);
}
```

```js
async function worker() {
  while (next < files.length && !fatalError) {
    const index = next++;
    try { await importOne(files[index], counters); }
    catch (error) {
      counters.failed += 1;
      process.stderr.write(`[import] ${path.basename(files[index])}: ${error.message}\n`);
      if (error?.status >= 500 || String(error?.code || '').startsWith('STORAGE_') || ['ECONNREFUSED', 'P1001', 'P1002', 'P1008', 'P1017'].includes(error?.code)) fatalError = error;
    } finally {
      completed += 1;
      if (completed % 100 === 0 || completed === files.length) process.stdout.write(`Processed ${completed}/${files.length} files\n`);
    }
  }
}
```

Yes, `fatalError` is set on `error?.status >= 500`. `putDocumentFile` throws `AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', ...)` on storage failure. So a single file that fails to upload (e.g., a corrupt file that the storage rejects with 500) stops the entire batch. This is a real BUG relative to requirement (1).

## (1) Does the open-link flow carry the page number?

**Verdict: OK (partial)** — `mobile/src/app/document/[id].tsx` → `openDocument`

- **Remote branch: yes.** `await Linking.openURL(params.page ? `${url}#page=${encodeURIComponent(String(params.page))}` : url)`. The fragment is appended **client-side**, after the query string, which is correct per RFC 3986 (fragment last). `params.page` arrives from `search.tsx` → `renderItem` as `String(item.pageNumber)`.
- **Local/offline branch: no.** `Sharing.shareAsync(localUri, …)` and the `Linking.openURL(localUri)` fallback both drop the fragment entirely. A user who saved a document offline loses the page jump.
- **Backend: no.** `backend/src/modules/documents/documents.controller.js` → `createOpenLink` builds the signed URL without any page parameter. That's fine — the fragment is never sent to the server anyway — but it means the server cannot help.

## (2) Platform behavior for `Linking.openURL` with `#page=N`

| Platform | Mechanism | Honors `#page=N`? |
|---|---|---|
| **Android** | `ACTION_VIEW` intent → Chrome / system PDF viewer / Drive PDF viewer | **Unreliable.** Chrome on Android ignores `#page=` for PDFs. Adobe Acrobat and Xodo honor it; the default handler usually does not. Result: often opens at page 1. |
| **iOS** | `openURL` → Safari (or default browser) | **Usually yes.** Safari's PDF viewer honors `#page=` when the PDF is loaded directly. Quick Look (file hand-off) does not. Behavior has drifted across iOS versions. |
| **Web** | `window.open` / `location.href` | **Yes.** Chrome, Firefox, and Safari desktop all honor `#page=N`. Most reliable of the three. |

Two cross-cutting notes:
- The fragment is **client-side only** — the server never sees it, so no redirect or `Content-Disposition` trick can compensate.
- `Sharing.shareAsync` hands the *file* to another app; the fragment is lost by definition.

## (3) Smallest change, and what an in-app viewer needs

### Smallest change (fragment-only, no new dependency)

In `mobile/src/app/document/[id].tsx` → `openDocument`, add one helper and use it in both branches:

```tsx
const withPage = (url: string) =>
  params.page ? `${url}#page=${encodeURIComponent(String(params.page))}` : url;
```

- Remote: `await Linking.openURL(withPage(url));` (unchanged behavior, just centralized).
- Local: replace `await Linking.openURL(localUri)` with `await Linking.openURL(withPage(localUri))`, and when `params.page` is set, prefer `Linking.openURL` over `Sharing.shareAsync` so the fragment survives.

This is ~4 lines and fixes the offline gap, but it **does not fix Android** — the fragment is still at the mercy of the system viewer.

### In-app viewer (the only reliable fix)

`react-native-pdf` is a native module, so it **cannot run in Expo Go**. Requirements:

1. **Dev build.** `npx expo prebuild` or an EAS dev-client build; add the `react-native-pdf` config plugin. Expo Go will not load it.
2. **Peer dependency.** `react-native-blob-util` for remote URLs (the signed URL is `https://…?token=…`).
3. **Page prop.** `react-native-pdf` accepts `page={Number(params.page)}` and reports `onPageChanged` — no fragment needed, so Android/iOS/web all behave identically.
4. **Auth.** The signed URL expires in 60 s (api-proxy) or 120 s (direct-storage). Fetch it immediately before mounting the viewer, and re-fetch on retry.
5. **Offline.** `file://` URIs from `FileSystem.documentDirectory` work directly with `react-native-pdf`; no `Sharing` hand-off needed.
6. **Web.** `react-native-pdf` has no web implementation. You'd need a separate `react-native-webview` + PDF.js path (WebView *is* in Expo Go), or keep the `#page=` fragment for web only — where it actually works.
7. **Passage highlight.** Not possible today: `search.tsx` → `renderItem` never forwards the passage text, and `document/[id].tsx` has no param for it. You'd need to add a `passage` param and either scroll to it or render it above the viewer.

**Recommendation:** ship the 4-line fragment fix now (fixes web and most of iOS, plus the offline gap), and treat the in-app viewer as a separate dev-build task.

### routes/v1/index.js
- Mounts `/auth`, `/users`, `/plans`, `/subscriptions`, `/payment`, `/calculation-history`, then `discoverAndRegisterModules()` + `mountRegisteredModules(router)`.
- **BUG:** top-level `await discoverAndRegisterModules()` in a route module — this runs at import time. If it throws, the whole app fails to start. Also, it's a side effect at module load, which is fragile.
- **BUG:** `mountRegisteredModules(router)` is called after the static routes — if a module registers `/documents` or `/search`, it's fine, but if a module registers a path that overlaps, order matters.
- **MISSING:** no `/documents` or `/search` route visible — they must come from `discoverAndRegisterModules()`. So the search/documents routes are module-registered. That means `search.service.js` is called from a module controller not in chat.
- **BUG:** `await` at top level of a module — requires ESM top-level await, which is fine in Node 18+, but it means the module graph is async. If `discoverAndRegisterModules` is slow, startup is slow.

## What's now closed

- **Item 15 (route mount order): OK, not BUG.** `routes/index.js` mounts only `/auth`, `/users`, `/plans`, `/subscriptions`, `/payment`, `/admin`, `/calculation-history`. It has no `/documents` or `/search`, so `/api/v1/documents` and `/api/v1/search` fall through cleanly to `v1Routes`. No shadowing.
- **Item 17 (query/index parity): OK.** `search.service.js` → `searchDocuments` calls `normalizePersian(q)`, and `persian-text.js` re-exports `normalizeSearchText` as `normalizePersian`. Same function at both ends.
- **Item 34 (dead multer branch): UNVERIFIED, not BUG.** `errorHandler.middleware.js` does check `err?.code === 'LIMIT_FILE_SIZE'`. Whether it's reachable depends on `documents.routes.js`, which is not in the chat.

## Per-file verdicts

### `backend/scripts/import-documents.js` — BUG
- `walk` recurses correctly; `sha256` streams; `verifySignature` reads 1 KB; `DRY_RUN` and concurrency clamp are correct. **OK.**
- **BUG:** `output.push(...await walk(fullPath))` — spread of a large array can throw `RangeError` on directories with many files.
- **BUG:** `worker` sets `fatalError` on `error?.status >= 500`, `STORAGE_*`, or specific Prisma codes — one bad file aborts the whole batch.
- **BUG:** orphaned storage object if the process dies between `putDocumentFile` and the DB transaction commit.
- **MISSING:** never imports `env.js`; `DATACENTER_URL` / `DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN` are not validated at startup.
- **MISSING:** no checkpoint file; re-runs re-hash every file.

### `backend/src/middlewares/errorHandler.middleware.js` — BUG
- **BUG:** `sendError` puts `requestId` inside `error.requestId`, not top-level. Success envelope uses `meta.requestId`. Inconsistent shape.
- **BUG (minor):** `console.error` for unhandled errors instead of `logger`.
- **BUG (minor):** `jwt.TokenExpiredError` / `JsonWebTokenError` branches are dead for auth routes — `auth.middleware.js` already converts them to `AppError`.
- **BUG (minor):** imports `PrismaClientKnownRequestError` from `@prisma/client/runtime/library` — path is deprecated in Prisma 6+.
- `ZodError`, `entity.too.large`, `entity.parse.failed`, `res.headersSent` handling are correct. **OK.**

### `backend/src/modules/search/search.service.js` — BUG
- `normalizePersian(q)`, length 2–200, `mimeTypes` mapping, `pageNumber`, `score`, `nextCursor`, `hasMore` — all correct. **OK.**
- **BUG:** `flatMap` returns `[]` for hits missing from the Postgres recheck. Those hits are silently dropped, so a page can return fewer than `limit` items while `hasMore` is still `true`.
- **BUG:** `snippets` strips `<em>`/`</em>` — the "highlighted" snippet is plain text; no highlight markup reaches the client.
- **BUG (minor):** `from` / `to` are passed raw to the OpenSearch range filter with no date validation.

### `backend/src/routes/index.js` — OK
- Mounts the legacy routes only. No `/documents` or `/search`, so no shadowing of `/api/v1`. **OK.**

### `backend/src/routes/v1/index.js` — BUG
- **BUG:** top-level `await discoverAndRegisterModules()` runs at module import time. If it throws, the whole app fails to start with no graceful fallback.
- **BUG (minor):** `mountRegisteredModules(router)` is called after the static routes — module routes cannot override static ones, which is probably intended but undocumented.
- **UNVERIFIED:** `/documents` and `/search` are not visible here; they must come from `discoverAndRegisterModules()`. The search controller wiring is not in the chat.

### `backend/src/services/cron.service.js` — BUG (minor)
- `startCronJobs` returns early in `test`; two jobs with `isRunning` guards; errors caught and logged. **OK.**
- **BUG (minor):** no `stopCronJobs` — cron tasks are not stopped on shutdown. `server.js` calls `process.exit(0)`, which kills them, but in-flight jobs are not awaited.
- **BUG (minor):** `cron.schedule` return values are not stored, so tasks cannot be stopped.
- **MISSING (minor):** no timezone specified — uses server local time. For a Persian app, this matters.

### `backend/src/services/search/opensearch.client.js` — BUG
- `ensureDocumentIndex` memoization, `indexDocument` bulk + `_delete_by_query`, `searchIndexedDocuments` sort and cursor logic — all correct. **OK.**
- **BUG:** `INDEX` is read from `process.env` at module load — bypasses `env.js` validation.
- **BUG:** `if (!endpoint())` is dead code — `endpoint()` always returns a default.
- **BUG:** `ensureDocumentIndex` never updates an existing index's mapping — no migration path.
- **BUG:** `indexDocument` calls `chunkPages(pageList)` with defaults (`chunkSize: 4000`, `overlap: 300`).
- **BUG:** `_delete_by_query` after bulk index is not checked — stale chunks remain on failure.
- **BUG:** `searchIndexedDocuments` uses `size: 40` and 3 batches (120 hits). If the top 120 hits cover fewer than `limit` distinct documents, the page under-fills.
- **MISSING:** no `collapse` / `inner_hits` — dedupe keeps exactly one hit per `documentId`.
- **BUG:** `fa_normalize` misses `ى` (U+0649), Persian/Arabic digits, diacritics.
- **BUG:** `title.keyword` has no `normalizer`.
- **BUG:** `highlight` returns normalized text, not source text.

### `backend/src/services/search/search-chunks.js` — BUG
- `normalizeSearchText`, `maxChunks: 2000`, global `chunkIndex`, overlap validation — all correct. **OK.**
- **BUG:** defaults `chunkSize: 4000`, `overlap: 300` — far above the 800–1200 target.
- **BUG:** fixed-offset slicing — no paragraph or sentence boundary awareness; chunks split mid-word.

### `backend/src/workers/document-extraction.js` — BUG / MISSING
- `splitPdfTextIntoPages` splits on `\f`; `ENOENT` handling for missing binaries. **OK.**
- **BUG:** `readTextLimited` materializes up to `maxChars * 4` bytes (20 MB for 5 M chars).
- **BUG:** OCR fallback is document-level (`text.replace(/\s/g,'').length < 40`) + `--skip-text`. Mixed PDFs never OCR the scanned pages; garbage text layers never OCR.
- **BUG:** `tesseract` uses `--psm 6` — poor for sparse text.
- **BUG:** `ocrmypdf` runs under `run`'s 180 s timeout — large PDFs time out.
- **MISSING:** no legacy-font handling — no reversal detection, no PUA mapping, no `--force-ocr` / `--redo-ocr`.

```js
import 'dotenv/config';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { createReadStream, promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import prisma from '../src/config/database.js';
import { putDocumentFile, deleteDocumentFile } from '../src/utils/datacenter-client.js';
import { normalizePersian } from '../src/utils/persian-text.js';
import { JOB_ROLE_VALUES } from '../src/config/job-roles.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR || '');
const MAX_BYTES = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES || 100 * 1024 * 1024);
const CONCURRENCY_INPUT = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY || 3);
const CONCURRENCY = Number.isInteger(CONCURRENCY_INPUT) ? Math.min(8, Math.max(1, CONCURRENCY_INPUT)) : 3;
if (!Number.isSafeInteger(MAX_BYTES) || MAX_BYTES < 1) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES must be a positive safe integer');
const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');
const VISIBILITY = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY || 'PUBLIC';
const ACCESS_JOB_ROLES = (process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES || '').split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const OWNER_ID = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID || null;
const LANGUAGE = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE || 'und';
const MIME = {
  pdf: 'application/pdf', txt: 'text/plain', md: 'text/markdown',
  png: 'image/png', jpg: 'image/jpeg', jpeg: 'image/jpeg', webp: 'image/webp',
};

if (!process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR must point to the source document directory');
if (!(await fs.stat(ROOT)).isDirectory()) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR is not a directory');
if (!['PUBLIC', 'ROLE_RESTRICTED', 'PRIVATE'].includes(VISIBILITY)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY is invalid');
if (ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.some(role => !JOB_ROLE_VALUES.includes(role))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES contains an unknown role');
if (VISIBILITY === 'ROLE_RESTRICTED' && ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.length === 0) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES is required for ROLE_RESTRICTED visibility');
if (!['fa', 'en', 'ku', 'und'].includes(LANGUAGE)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE must be fa, en, ku, or und');
if (VISIBILITY === 'PRIVATE' && !OWNER_ID) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID is required for PRIVATE visibility');
if (OWNER_ID && !(await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: OWNER_ID }, select: { id: true } }))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID does not identify an existing user');

// Pre-flight: fail fast on missing storage configuration so the run does not
// fail once per file. Per-file 5xx/timeouts are handled by the worker loop.
function assertStorageConfig() {
  const missing = [];
  if (!process.env.DATACENTER_URL) missing.push('DATACENTER_URL');
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && !process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN) missing.push('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN');
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`Missing required environment variables: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
}
assertStorageConfig();

async function walk(directory) {
  const output = [];
  const entries = await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const nested = await walk(fullPath);
      for (const item of nested) output.push(item);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) output.push(fullPath);
  }
  return output;
}

async function sha256(filePath) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const hash = createHash('sha256');
    const stream = createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.on('data', chunk => hash.update(chunk));
    stream.on('error', reject);
    stream.on('end', () => resolve(hash.digest('hex')));
  });
}

async function verifySignature(filePath, ext) {
  const handle = await fs.open(filePath, 'r');
  try {
    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(1024);
    const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(bytes, 0, bytes.length, 0);
    const head = bytes.subarray(0, bytesRead);
    const valid = ext === 'pdf' ? head.toString('latin1').includes('%PDF-')
      : ext === 'png' ? head.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]))
      : ['jpg', 'jpeg'].includes(ext) ? head[0] === 0xff && head[1] === 0xd8 && head[2] === 0xff
      : ext === 'webp' ? head.subarray(0, 4).toString() === 'RIFF' && head.subarray(8, 12).toString() === 'WEBP'
      : true;
    if (!valid) throw new Error('signature does not match extension');
  } finally { await handle.close(); }
}

async function importOne(filePath, counters) {
  const sourcePath = path.relative(ROOT, filePath).split(path.sep).join('/');
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).slice(1).toLowerCase();
  if (!MIME[ext]) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  const stat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size < 1 || stat.size > MAX_BYTES) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  await verifySignature(filePath, ext);
  const checksumSha256 = await sha256(filePath);
  const verifiedStat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (verifiedStat.size !== stat.size || verifiedStat.mtimeMs !== stat.mtimeMs) throw new Error('file changed while being scanned; rerun import after the source is stable');
  const existing = await prisma.document.findUnique({ where: { checksumSha256 }, select: { id: true } });
  if (existing) { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
  if (DRY_RUN) { counters.dryRun += 1; return; }

  const title = normalizePersian(path.basename(filePath, path.extname(filePath))).slice(0, 240) || 'سند بدون عنوان';
  const storageKey = randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '');
  let uploaded = false;
  try {
    await putDocumentFile(storageKey, filePath, MIME[ext], checksumSha256);
    uploaded = true;
    await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
      const document = await tx.document.create({ data: {
        title,
        originalName: path.basename(filePath).slice(0, 255),
        sourcePath,
        mimeType: MIME[ext],
        sizeBytes: stat.size,
        checksumSha256,
        storageKey,
        visibility: VISIBILITY,
        accessJobRoles: ACCESS_JOB_ROLES,
        ownerId: OWNER_ID,
        description: null,
        language: LANGUAGE,
        indexStatus: 'PENDING',
      } });
      await tx.documentIndexJob.create({ data: { documentId: document.id } });
    });
    counters.imported += 1;
  } catch (error) {
    if (uploaded) await deleteDocumentFile(storageKey).catch(() => {});
    if (error?.code === 'P2002') { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
    throw error;
  }
}

const files = await walk(ROOT);
const counters = { imported: 0, duplicates: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0, dryRun: 0 };
const failedPaths = [];
let next = 0;
let completed = 0;
let fatalError = null;

function isFatalError(error) {
  // Only configuration and authentication failures should stop the run.
  // Per-file 5xx, timeouts, and transient network errors are counted and skipped.
  if (error?.status === 401 || error?.status === 403) return true;
  if (error?.code === 'MISSING_ENV' || error?.code === 'STORAGE_CONFIG_MISSING') return true;
  return false;
}

async function worker() {
  while (next < files.length && !fatalError) {
    const index = next++;
    try { await importOne(files[index], counters); }
    catch (error) {
      counters.failed += 1;
      failedPaths.push(files[index]);
      process.stderr.write(`[import] ${path.basename(files[index])}: ${error.message}\n`);
      if (isFatalError(error)) fatalError = error;
    } finally {
      completed += 1;
      if (completed % 100 === 0 || completed === files.length) process.stdout.write(`Processed ${completed}/${files.length} files\n`);
    }
  }
}

process.stdout.write(`Found ${files.length} files. Mode: ${DRY_RUN ? 'DRY RUN' : 'IMPORT'}. Concurrency: ${CONCURRENCY}.\n`);
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: CONCURRENCY }, worker));
process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ total: files.length, ...counters }, null, 2)}\n`);
if (failedPaths.length) {
  process.stdout.write(`Failed files (${failedPaths.length}):\n`);
  for (const failedPath of failedPaths) process.stdout.write(`  ${path.relative(ROOT, failedPath).split(path.sep).join('/')}\n`);
}
if (fatalError) process.stderr.write(`[import] aborted: ${fatalError.message}\n`);
await prisma.$disconnect();
if (fatalError || counters.failed > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```js
import { createReadStream } from 'node:fs';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { AppError } from './response.util.js';

const baseUrl = () => (process.env.DATACENTER_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8081').replace(/\/$/, '');
const token = () => process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '';

async function storageFetch(url, options) {
  try { return await fetch(url, options); }
  catch { throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'ارتباط با دیتاسنتر برقرار نشد'); }
}

function requireConfig() {
  if (!baseUrl()) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'سرویس ذخیره‌سازی اسناد تنظیم نشده است');
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && token().length < 32) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'توکن ارتباط با دیتاسنتر تنظیم نشده است');
}

export async function putDocumentFile(storageKey, localPath, mimeType, checksumSha256) {
  requireConfig();
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(checksumSha256 || ''))) throw new AppError(400, 'INVALID_FILE_CHECKSUM', 'SHA-256 فایل برای ذخیره‌سازی معتبر نیست');
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, 'content-type': mimeType, 'x-content-sha256': checksumSha256 },
    body: Readable.toWeb(createReadStream(localPath)),
    duplex: 'half',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120_000),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new AppError(response.status === 413 ? 413 : 502, 'STORAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED', 'ذخیره فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return response.json();
}

export async function getDocumentFile(storageKey, range) {
```

```js
import { createReadStream } from 'node:fs';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { AppError } from './response.util.js';

const baseUrl = () => (process.env.DATACENTER_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8081').replace(/\/$/, '');
const token = () => process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '';

// Uploads can be large; allow operators to raise the timeout for slow links.
const uploadTimeoutMs = () => {
  const value = Number(process.env.DATACENTER_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 600_000;
};

async function storageFetch(url, options) {
  try { return await fetch(url, options); }
  catch { throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'ارتباط با دیتاسنتر برقرار نشد'); }
}

function requireConfig() {
  if (!baseUrl()) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'سرویس ذخیره‌سازی اسناد تنظیم نشده است');
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && token().length < 32) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'توکن ارتباط با دیتاسنتر تنظیم نشده است');
}

export async function putDocumentFile(storageKey, localPath, mimeType, checksumSha256) {
  requireConfig();
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(checksumSha256 || ''))) throw new AppError(400, 'INVALID_FILE_CHECKSUM', 'SHA-256 فایل برای ذخیره‌سازی معتبر نیست');
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, 'content-type': mimeType, 'x-content-sha256': checksumSha256 },
    body: Readable.toWeb(createReadStream(localPath)),
    duplex: 'half',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(uploadTimeoutMs()),
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new AppError(response.status === 413 ? 413 : 502, 'STORAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED', 'ذخیره فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return response.json();
}

export async function getDocumentFile(storageKey, range) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, ...(range ? { range } : {}) },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'فایل سند یافت نشد');
  if (![200, 206].includes(response.status)) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_READ_FAILED', 'دریافت فایل از دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return response;
}

export async function headDocumentFile(storageKey) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'HEAD', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) throw new AppError(404, 'STORAGE_FILE_MISSING', 'فایل اصلی سند در دیتاسنتر پیدا نشد');
  if (response.status !== 200) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_READ_FAILED', 'بررسی فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return { sizeBytes: Number(response.headers.get('content-length') || 0) };
}

export async function deleteDocumentFile(storageKey) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'DELETE', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) return false;
  if (!response.ok) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_DELETE_FAILED', 'حذف فایل از دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return true;
}
```

```js
import 'dotenv/config';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { createReadStream, promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import prisma from '../src/config/database.js';
import { putDocumentFile, deleteDocumentFile } from '../src/utils/datacenter-client.js';
import { normalizePersian } from '../src/utils/persian-text.js';
import { JOB_ROLE_VALUES } from '../src/config/job-roles.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR || '');
const MAX_BYTES = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES || 100 * 1024 * 1024);
const CONCURRENCY_INPUT = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY || 3);
const CONCURRENCY = Number.isInteger(CONCURRENCY_INPUT) ? Math.min(8, Math.max(1, CONCURRENCY_INPUT)) : 3;
if (!Number.isSafeInteger(MAX_BYTES) || MAX_BYTES < 1) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES must be a positive safe integer');
const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');
const VISIBILITY = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY || 'PUBLIC';
const ACCESS_JOB_ROLES = (process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES || '').split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const OWNER_ID = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID || null;
const LANGUAGE = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE || 'und';
const MIME = {
  pdf: 'application/pdf', txt: 'text/plain', md: 'text/markdown',
  png: 'image/png', jpg: 'image/jpeg', jpeg: 'image/jpeg', webp: 'image/webp',
};

if (!process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR must point to the source document directory');
if (!(await fs.stat(ROOT)).isDirectory()) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR is not a directory');
if (!['PUBLIC', 'ROLE_RESTRICTED', 'PRIVATE'].includes(VISIBILITY)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY is invalid');
if (ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.some(role => !JOB_ROLE_VALUES.includes(role))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES contains an unknown role');
if (VISIBILITY === 'ROLE_RESTRICTED' && ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.length === 0) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES is required for ROLE_RESTRICTED visibility');
if (!['fa', 'en', 'ku', 'und'].includes(LANGUAGE)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE must be fa, en, ku, or und');
if (VISIBILITY === 'PRIVATE' && !OWNER_ID) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID is required for PRIVATE visibility');
if (OWNER_ID && !(await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: OWNER_ID }, select: { id: true } }))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID does not identify an existing user');

// Fail fast on missing storage configuration so the run does not fail once per
// file. Per-file 5xx and timeouts are counted and skipped by the worker loop.
function assertStorageConfig() {
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') return;
  const token = process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '';
  if (token.length < 32) {
    throw new Error('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN must be set to at least 32 characters in production');
  }
}
assertStorageConfig();

async function walk(directory) {
  const output = [];
  const entries = await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const nested = await walk(fullPath);
      for (const item of nested) output.push(item);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) output.push(fullPath);
  }
  return output;
}

async function sha256(filePath) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const hash = createHash('sha256');
    const stream = createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.on('data', chunk => hash.update(chunk));
    stream.on('error', reject);
    stream.on('end', () => resolve(hash.digest('hex')));
  });
}

async function verifySignature(filePath, ext) {
  const handle = await fs.open(filePath, 'r');
  try {
    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(1024);
    const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(bytes, 0, bytes.length, 0);
    const head = bytes.subarray(0, bytesRead);
    const valid = ext === 'pdf' ? head.toString('latin1').includes('%PDF-')
      : ext === 'png' ? head.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]))
      : ['jpg', 'jpeg'].includes(ext) ? head[0] === 0xff && head[1] === 0xd8 && head[2] === 0xff
      : ext === 'webp' ? head.subarray(0, 4).toString() === 'RIFF' && head.subarray(8, 12).toString() === 'WEBP'
      : true;
    if (!valid) throw new Error('signature does not match extension');
  } finally { await handle.close(); }
}

async function importOne(filePath, counters) {
  const sourcePath = path.relative(ROOT, filePath).split(path.sep).join('/');
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).slice(1).toLowerCase();
  if (!MIME[ext]) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  const stat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size < 1 || stat.size > MAX_BYTES) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  await verifySignature(filePath, ext);
  const checksumSha256 = await sha256(filePath);
  const verifiedStat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (verifiedStat.size !== stat.size || verifiedStat.mtimeMs !== stat.mtimeMs) throw new Error('file changed while being scanned; rerun import after the source is stable');
  const existing = await prisma.document.findUnique({ where: { checksumSha256 }, select: { id: true } });
  if (existing) { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
  if (DRY_RUN) { counters.dryRun += 1; return; }

  const title = normalizePersian(path.basename(filePath, path.extname(filePath))).slice(0, 240) || 'سند بدون عنوان';
  const storageKey = randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '');
  let uploaded = false;
  try {
    await putDocumentFile(storageKey, filePath, MIME[ext], checksumSha256);
    uploaded = true;
    await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
      const document = await tx.document.create({ data: {
        title,
        originalName: path.basename(filePath).slice(0, 255),
        sourcePath,
        mimeType: MIME[ext],
        sizeBytes: stat.size,
        checksumSha256,
        storageKey,
        visibility: VISIBILITY,
        accessJobRoles: ACCESS_JOB_ROLES,
        ownerId: OWNER_ID,
        description: null,
        language: LANGUAGE,
        indexStatus: 'PENDING',
      } });
      await tx.documentIndexJob.create({ data: { documentId: document.id } });
    });
    counters.imported += 1;
  } catch (error) {
    if (uploaded) await deleteDocumentFile(storageKey).catch(() => {});
    if (error?.code === 'P2002') { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
    throw error;
  }
}

const files = await walk(ROOT);
const counters = { imported: 0, duplicates: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0, dryRun: 0 };
const failedPaths = [];
let next = 0;
let completed = 0;
let fatalError = null;

function isFatalError(error) {
  // Only authentication failures should stop the run. Per-file 5xx, timeouts,
  // and transient network errors are counted and skipped.
  return error?.status === 401 || error?.status === 403;
}

async function worker() {
  while (next < files.length && !fatalError) {
    const index = next++;
    try { await importOne(files[index], counters); }
    catch (error) {
      counters.failed += 1;
      failedPaths.push(files[index]);
      process.stderr.write(`[import] ${path.basename(files[index])}: ${error.message}\n`);
      if (isFatalError(error)) fatalError = error;
    } finally {
      completed += 1;
      if (completed % 100 === 0 || completed === files.length) process.stdout.write(`Processed ${completed}/${files.length} files\n`);
    }
  }
}

process.stdout.write(`Found ${files.length} files. Mode: ${DRY_RUN ? 'DRY RUN' : 'IMPORT'}. Concurrency: ${CONCURRENCY}.\n`);
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: CONCURRENCY }, worker));
process.stdout.write(`${JSON.stringify({ total: files.length, ...counters }, null, 2)}\n`);
if (failedPaths.length) {
  process.stdout.write(`Failed files (${failedPaths.length}):\n`);
  for (const failedPath of failedPaths) {
    process.stdout.write(`  ${path.relative(ROOT, failedPath).split(path.sep).join('/')}\n`);
  }
}
if (fatalError) process.stderr.write(`[import] aborted: ${fatalError.message}\n`);
await prisma.$disconnect();
if (fatalError || counters.failed > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

```js
async function walk(directory) {
  const output = [];
  const entries = await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const nested = await walk(fullPath);
      for (const item of nested) output.push(item);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) output.push(fullPath);
  }
  return output;
}
```

```js
export async function putDocumentFile(storageKey, localPath, mimeType, checksumSha256) {
  requireConfig();
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(checksumSha256 || ''))) throw new AppError(400, 'INVALID_FILE_CHECKSUM', 'SHA-256 فایل برای ذخیره‌سازی معتبر نیست');
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, 'content-type': mimeType, 'x-content-sha256': checksumSha256 },
    body: Readable.toWeb(createReadStream(localPath)),
    duplex: 'half',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(uploadTimeoutMs()),
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const status = response.status === 413 ? 413 : response.status === 401 || response.status === 403 ? response.status : 502;
    throw new AppError(status, 'STORAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED', 'ذخیره فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  }
  return response.json();
}
```

```js
import 'dotenv/config';
import { createHash, randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
import { createReadStream, promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import prisma from '../src/config/database.js';
import { putDocumentFile, deleteDocumentFile } from '../src/utils/datacenter-client.js';
import { normalizePersian } from '../src/utils/persian-text.js';
import { JOB_ROLE_VALUES } from '../src/config/job-roles.js';

const ROOT = path.resolve(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR || '');
const MAX_BYTES = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES || 100 * 1024 * 1024);
const CONCURRENCY_INPUT = Number(process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_CONCURRENCY || 3);
const CONCURRENCY = Number.isInteger(CONCURRENCY_INPUT) ? Math.min(8, Math.max(1, CONCURRENCY_INPUT)) : 3;
if (!Number.isSafeInteger(MAX_BYTES) || MAX_BYTES < 1) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_MAX_FILE_BYTES must be a positive safe integer');
const DRY_RUN = process.argv.includes('--dry-run');
const VISIBILITY = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY || 'PUBLIC';
const ACCESS_JOB_ROLES = (process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES || '').split(',').map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
const OWNER_ID = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID || null;
const LANGUAGE = process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE || 'und';
const MIME = {
  pdf: 'application/pdf', txt: 'text/plain', md: 'text/markdown',
  png: 'image/png', jpg: 'image/jpeg', jpeg: 'image/jpeg', webp: 'image/webp',
};

if (!process.env.DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR must point to the source document directory');
if (!(await fs.stat(ROOT)).isDirectory()) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_DIR is not a directory');
if (!['PUBLIC', 'ROLE_RESTRICTED', 'PRIVATE'].includes(VISIBILITY)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_VISIBILITY is invalid');
if (ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.some(role => !JOB_ROLE_VALUES.includes(role))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES contains an unknown role');
if (VISIBILITY === 'ROLE_RESTRICTED' && ACCESS_JOB_ROLES.length === 0) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_JOB_ROLES is required for ROLE_RESTRICTED visibility');
if (!['fa', 'en', 'ku', 'und'].includes(LANGUAGE)) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_LANGUAGE must be fa, en, ku, or und');
if (VISIBILITY === 'PRIVATE' && !OWNER_ID) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID is required for PRIVATE visibility');

// Fail fast on missing configuration so the run does not fail once per file.
// Per-file 5xx and timeouts are counted and skipped by the worker loop.
function assertImportConfig() {
  const missing = [];
  if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) missing.push('DATABASE_URL');
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    if (!process.env.DATACENTER_URL) missing.push('DATACENTER_URL');
    const token = process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '';
    if (token.length < 32) missing.push('DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN (must be at least 32 characters)');
  }
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`Missing required environment variables: ${missing.join(', ')}`);
}
assertImportConfig();

if (OWNER_ID && !(await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { id: OWNER_ID }, select: { id: true } }))) throw new Error('DOCUMENT_IMPORT_OWNER_ID does not identify an existing user');

async function walk(directory) {
  const output = [];
  const entries = await fs.readdir(directory, { withFileTypes: true });
  for (const entry of entries) {
    const fullPath = path.join(directory, entry.name);
    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      const nested = await walk(fullPath);
      for (const item of nested) output.push(item);
    } else if (entry.isFile()) output.push(fullPath);
  }
  return output;
}

async function sha256(filePath) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const hash = createHash('sha256');
    const stream = createReadStream(filePath);
    stream.on('data', chunk => hash.update(chunk));
    stream.on('error', reject);
    stream.on('end', () => resolve(hash.digest('hex')));
  });
}

async function verifySignature(filePath, ext) {
  const handle = await fs.open(filePath, 'r');
  try {
    const bytes = Buffer.alloc(1024);
    const { bytesRead } = await handle.read(bytes, 0, bytes.length, 0);
    const head = bytes.subarray(0, bytesRead);
    const valid = ext === 'pdf' ? head.toString('latin1').includes('%PDF-')
      : ext === 'png' ? head.subarray(0, 8).equals(Buffer.from([137, 80, 78, 71, 13, 10, 26, 10]))
      : ['jpg', 'jpeg'].includes(ext) ? head[0] === 0xff && head[1] === 0xd8 && head[2] === 0xff
      : ext === 'webp' ? head.subarray(0, 4).toString() === 'RIFF' && head.subarray(8, 12).toString() === 'WEBP'
      : true;
    if (!valid) throw new Error('signature does not match extension');
  } finally { await handle.close(); }
}

async function importOne(filePath, counters) {
  const sourcePath = path.relative(ROOT, filePath).split(path.sep).join('/');
  const ext = path.extname(filePath).slice(1).toLowerCase();
  if (!MIME[ext]) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  const stat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (!stat.isFile() || stat.size < 1 || stat.size > MAX_BYTES) { counters.skipped += 1; return; }
  await verifySignature(filePath, ext);
  const checksumSha256 = await sha256(filePath);
  const verifiedStat = await fs.stat(filePath);
  if (verifiedStat.size !== stat.size || verifiedStat.mtimeMs !== stat.mtimeMs) throw new Error('file changed while being scanned; rerun import after the source is stable');
  const existing = await prisma.document.findUnique({ where: { checksumSha256 }, select: { id: true } });
  if (existing) { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
  if (DRY_RUN) { counters.dryRun += 1; return; }

  const title = normalizePersian(path.basename(filePath, path.extname(filePath))).slice(0, 240) || 'سند بدون عنوان';
  const storageKey = randomUUID().replaceAll('-', '');
  let uploaded = false;
  try {
    await putDocumentFile(storageKey, filePath, MIME[ext], checksumSha256);
    uploaded = true;
    await prisma.$transaction(async tx => {
      const document = await tx.document.create({ data: {
        title,
        originalName: path.basename(filePath).slice(0, 255),
        sourcePath,
        mimeType: MIME[ext],
        sizeBytes: stat.size,
        checksumSha256,
        storageKey,
        visibility: VISIBILITY,
        accessJobRoles: ACCESS_JOB_ROLES,
        ownerId: OWNER_ID,
        description: null,
        language: LANGUAGE,
        indexStatus: 'PENDING',
      } });
      await tx.documentIndexJob.create({ data: { documentId: document.id } });
    });
    counters.imported += 1;
  } catch (error) {
    if (uploaded) await deleteDocumentFile(storageKey).catch(() => {});
    if (error?.code === 'P2002') { counters.duplicates += 1; return; }
    throw error;
  }
}

const files = await walk(ROOT);
const counters = { imported: 0, duplicates: 0, skipped: 0, failed: 0, dryRun: 0 };
const failedPaths = [];
let next = 0;
let completed = 0;
let fatalError = null;

function isFatalError(error) {
  // Only authentication failures should stop the run. Per-file 5xx, timeouts,
  // and transient network errors are counted and skipped.
  return error?.status === 401 || error?.status === 403;
}

async function worker() {
  while (next < files.length && !fatalError) {
    const index = next++;
    try { await importOne(files[index], counters); }
    catch (error) {
      counters.failed += 1;
      failedPaths.push(files[index]);
      process.stderr.write(`[import] ${path.basename(files[index])}: ${error.message}\n`);
      if (isFatalError(error)) fatalError = error;
    } finally {
      completed += 1;
      if (completed % 100 === 0 || completed === files.length) process.stdout.write(`Processed ${completed}/${files.length} files\n`);
    }
  }
}

process.stdout.write(`Found ${files.length} files. Mode: ${DRY_RUN ? 'DRY RUN' : 'IMPORT'}. Concurrency: ${CONCURRENCY}.\n`);
await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: CONCURRENCY }, worker));
process.stdout.write(`\nSummary:\n`);
process.stdout.write(`  Total:      ${files.length}\n`);
process.stdout.write(`  Imported:   ${counters.imported}\n`);
process.stdout.write(`  Duplicates: ${counters.duplicates}\n`);
process.stdout.write(`  Skipped:    ${counters.skipped}\n`);
process.stdout.write(`  Failed:     ${counters.failed}\n`);
if (DRY_RUN) process.stdout.write(`  Dry run:    ${counters.dryRun}\n`);
if (failedPaths.length) {
  process.stdout.write(`\nFailed files (${failedPaths.length}):\n`);
  for (const failedPath of failedPaths) {
    process.stdout.write(`  ${path.relative(ROOT, failedPath).split(path.sep).join('/')}\n`);
  }
}
if (fatalError) process.stderr.write(`[import] aborted: ${fatalError.message}\n`);
await prisma.$disconnect();
if (fatalError || counters.failed > 0) process.exitCode = 1;
```

And datacenter-client.js:

```js
import { createReadStream } from 'node:fs';
import { Readable } from 'node:stream';
import { AppError } from './response.util.js';

const baseUrl = () => (process.env.DATACENTER_URL || 'http://127.0.0.1:8081').replace(/\/$/, '');
const token = () => process.env.DATACENTER_INTERNAL_TOKEN || '';

// Uploads can be large; allow operators to raise the timeout for slow links.
const uploadTimeoutMs = () => {
  const value = Number(process.env.DATACENTER_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : 600_000;
};

async function storageFetch(url, options) {
  try { return await fetch(url, options); }
  catch { throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'ارتباط با دیتاسنتر برقرار نشد'); }
}

function requireConfig() {
  if (!baseUrl()) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'سرویس ذخیره‌سازی اسناد تنظیم نشده است');
  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' && token().length < 32) throw new AppError(503, 'STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE', 'توکن ارتباط با دیتاسنتر تنظیم نشده است');
}

export async function putDocumentFile(storageKey, localPath, mimeType, checksumSha256) {
  requireConfig();
  if (!/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/i.test(String(checksumSha256 || ''))) throw new AppError(400, 'INVALID_FILE_CHECKSUM', 'SHA-256 فایل برای ذخیره‌سازی معتبر نیست');
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, 'content-type': mimeType, 'x-content-sha256': checksumSha256 },
    body: Readable.toWeb(createReadStream(localPath)),
    duplex: 'half',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(uploadTimeoutMs()),
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const status = response.status === 413 ? 413 : response.status === 401 || response.status === 403 ? response.status : 502;
    throw new AppError(status, 'STORAGE_UPLOAD_FAILED', 'ذخیره فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  }
  return response.json();
}

export async function getDocumentFile(storageKey, range) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}`, ...(range ? { range } : {}) },
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) throw new AppError(404, 'NOT_FOUND', 'فایل سند یافت نشد');
  if (![200, 206].includes(response.status)) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_READ_FAILED', 'دریافت فایل از دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return response;
}

export async function headDocumentFile(storageKey) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'HEAD', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) throw new AppError(404, 'STORAGE_FILE_MISSING', 'فایل اصلی سند در دیتاسنتر پیدا نشد');
  if (response.status !== 200) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_READ_FAILED', 'بررسی فایل در دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return { sizeBytes: Number(response.headers.get('content-length') || 0) };
}

export async function deleteDocumentFile(storageKey) {
  requireConfig();
  const response = await storageFetch(`${baseUrl()}/internal/files/${encodeURIComponent(storageKey)}`, {
    method: 'DELETE', headers: { authorization: `Bearer ${token()}` }, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(30_000),
  });
  if (response.status === 404) return false;
  if (!response.ok) throw new AppError(502, 'STORAGE_DELETE_FAILED', 'حذف فایل از دیتاسنتر ناموفق بود');
  return true;
}
```
