# GridHand Engineering Imagery

Art direction and drop-in procedure for the photographic asset system.

The registry lives in `src/core/assets/assetManifest.ts`. This folder holds the
binary files. **Nothing here is fetched from the network** — every photo is
bundled into the app binary so it works offline and cannot be evicted from a
cache.

---

## Visual direction

Premium, realistic, industrial. Documentary photography of real grid work —
not stock-photo handshakes, not illustrations, not 3D renders.

- **Lighting:** natural, directional. Golden-hour exteriors; cool neutral
  interiors. Avoid flat on-camera flash.
- **Palette:** graphite, steel, weathered concrete, safety amber, conductor
  copper. Let the amber and copper accents carry the brand.
- **Composition:** leave 30–40% negative space in the lower third of hero
  images so overlaid text stays legible (a scrim is applied on top).
- **People:** real PPE, correct procedure, faces optional. Never depict unsafe
  work practices — these images are instructional context.
- **No text, no logos, no watermarks** baked into the image.

---

## Technical specification

| Property | Requirement |
|---|---|
| Format | JPEG, quality 78–82 (photos). WebP only if you verify Android 8+ support. |
| Color | sRGB, 8-bit, no alpha channel |
| Long edge | 1280 px (hero), 1200 px (cards), 800 px (tiles) |
| Max file size | hero ≤ 180 KB · card ≤ 90 KB · tile ≤ 45 KB |
| Metadata | Stripped (no EXIF, no GPS) |
| Naming | lowercase, hyphenated, matches the `file` field exactly |

Total budget for the full set: **≤ 1.6 MB**. That is the ceiling for keeping
the APK comfortable on low-end Android devices.

---

## Shot list

| Asset id | File | Aspect | Size (px) | Priority |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hero.lineworker` | `hero-lineworker.jpg` | 16:9 | 1280×720 | critical |
| `hero.substation` | `hero-substation.jpg` | 16:9 | 1280×720 | critical |
| `lineworker.portrait` | `lineworker-portrait.jpg` | 4:5 | 800×1000 | high |
| `lineworker.crew` | `lineworker-crew.jpg` | 3:2 | 1200×800 | high |
| `engineer.planning` | `engineer-planning.jpg` | 3:2 | 1200×800 | high |
| `engineer.inspection` | `engineer-inspection.jpg` | 3:2 | 1200×800 | high |
| `transformer.distribution` | `transformer-distribution.jpg` | 1:1 | 900×900 | critical |
| `transformer.pad` | `transformer-pad.jpg` | 1:1 | 900×900 | high |
| `substation.aerial` | `substation-aerial.jpg` | 16:9 | 1280×720 | high |

## Drop-in procedure

1. Export the photo to spec and place it in this folder using the exact
   `file` name from the table above.
2. Open `src/core/assets/assetManifest.ts` and, for that entry, set:

   ```ts
   bundled: true,
   source: require('../../../assets/images/hero-lineworker.jpg'),
   ```

3. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test`.

Until step 2 is done, the asset renders its designed placeholder — a gradient
with an engineering grid and a semantic icon. That is a valid production state,
not a bug, so screens can be built and shipped before photography lands.

---

## Icons

Icons are **not** part of this folder. They are vector glyphs from
`lucide-react-native`, registered by meaning in
`src/core/assets/icons.ts` and rendered through `<Icon name="..." />`.

Emojis are prohibited in the UI. `npm test` runs
`tests/no-emoji.test.mjs`, which fails the build if an emoji appears anywhere
under `src/` or `app/`.

---

before merging.

|---|---|---|---|

```
/**
 * Guard: the GridHand UI uses a professional vector icon system, never emojis.
 *
 * Fails if any emoji (Unicode Extended_Pictographic) appears in application
 * source. Run with `npm test`.
 */

import { test } from 'node:test';
import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
import { readdirSync, readFileSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join, extname, relative } from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

const projectRoot = fileURLToPath(new URL('..', import.meta.url));
const SCAN_DIRS = ['src', 'app'];
const SOURCE_EXTS = new Set(['.ts', '.tsx', '.js', '.jsx']);
const EMOJI = /\p{Extended_Pictographic}/u;

function walk(dir, out = []) {
  let entries;
  try {
    entries = readdirSync(dir);
  } catch {
    return out;
  }

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (entry === 'node_modules' || entry.startsWith('.')) continue;
    const full = join(dir, entry);
    const stats = statSync(full);
    if (stats.isDirectory()) {
      walk(full, out);
    } else if (SOURCE_EXTS.has(extname(entry))) {
      out.push(full);
    }
  }

  return out;
}

test('no emojis in application source', () => {
  const offenders = [];

  for (const dir of SCAN_DIRS) {
    for (const file of walk(join(projectRoot, dir))) {
      const lines = readFileSync(file, 'utf8').split(/\r?\n/);
      lines.forEach((line, index) => {
        if (EMOJI.test(line)) {
          offenders.push(`${relative(projectRoot, file)}:${index + 1}: ${line.trim()}`);
        }
      });
    }
  }

  assert.deepEqual(
    offenders,
    [],
    `Emojis are not allowed in the UI. Use <Icon name="..." /> instead.\n${offenders.join('\n')}`,
  );
});
```

### 2. New findings

**A. Unhandled promise rejections in auto-sync.**

`autoSync.ts` calls `void sync()` from three places (interval, app-state change, network listener). `sync()` is:

```ts
try { await runSync(userId); } finally { running = false; }
```

There is a `finally` but **no `catch`**. Any network failure inside `performSync` — which is the normal case when the device is online but the backend is unreachable — rejects `sync()`, and `void` discards it. On a device that is "connected" but has no route to `192.168.1.9`, this fires **every 60 seconds**. Not a crash, but persistent LogBox noise and a real battery cost.

This is pre-existing and outside the live UI. Flagging, not fixing.

**B. `runSync` throws synchronously on empty `userId`.**

```ts
export function runSync(userId: string): Promise<SyncResult> {
  if (!userId) throw new Error('...');
```

A synchronous throw from a function typed `Promise<SyncResult>` is a footgun — `runSync(x).catch(...)` would not catch it. In practice `autoSync` guards with `user?.id`, so it is unreachable today. Cosmetic.

**C. `SyncResult` is not exported.**

`runSync` returns `Promise<SyncResult>` but `SyncResult` is a module-local type. Consumers can use the inferred shape but cannot name it. Minor.

**D. Cursor can reset to `null` mid-pagination.**

In `performSync`, `cursor = page.nextCursor`. If the server returns `nextCursor: null` with `hasMore: true`, the next `pullPage(null)` restarts from the beginning. Bounded by `pages < 20`, so it terminates — but it would re-apply the first page. Depends on server behavior I cannot see.

**E. `applyRemotePage` overwrites local `version` with the server version.**

The upsert sets `version=excluded.version` where `excluded.version` is `record.version` (server). Local rows in `PENDING`/`CONFLICT` are skipped by the guard above, so this is correct — but it means `version` is not a local edit counter. Worth knowing before any UI displays it.

**F. `transport.ts` confirms the backend envelope contract.**

`response.data?.data` and `response.data?.meta?.nextCursor` match `response.util.js` (`envelope` + `responseMeta`) from the backend summary. The two sides agree.

```tsx
// mobile/src/core/ui/ModuleHeader.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ChevronRight, ChevronLeft, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';

export type ModuleHeaderProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  onBack?: () => void;
  showBack?: boolean;
  rightAction?: {
    icon: LucideIcon;
    onPress: () => void;
    accessibilityLabel: string;
  };
};

export function ModuleHeader({ title, subtitle, onBack, showBack = true, rightAction }: ModuleHeaderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const { isDark, isRTL } = useTheme();
  const BackIcon = isRTL ? ChevronRight : ChevronLeft;
  const handleBack = onBack ?? (() => router.back());

  return (
    <View style={[styles.container, isDark && styles.containerDark]}>
      <View style={styles.row}>
        {showBack ? (
          <Pressable onPress={handleBack} style={styles.backButton} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel="Back">
            <BackIcon size={22} color={isDark ? '#E2E8F0' : '#1A2331'} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : <View style={styles.backButton} />}
        <View style={styles.titleWrap}>
          <Text style={[styles.title, isDark && styles.titleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>{title}</Text>
          {subtitle ? <Text style={[styles.subtitle, isDark && styles.subtitleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>{subtitle}</Text> : null}
        </View>
        {rightAction ? (
          <Pressable onPress={rightAction.onPress} style={styles.backButton} accessibilityRole="button" accessibilityLabel={rightAction.accessibilityLabel}>
            <rightAction.icon size={22} color={isDark ? '#E2E8F0' : '#1A2331'} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : <View style={styles.backButton} />}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// mobile/src/core/ui/ScreenScaffold.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, StyleSheet, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';

export type ScreenScaffoldProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  header?: React.ReactNode;
  hero?: React.ReactNode;
  scroll?: boolean;
  contentStyle?: ViewStyle;
  edges?: Array<'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'>;
};

export function ScreenScaffold({ children, header, hero, scroll = true, contentStyle, edges = ['top', 'bottom'] }: ScreenScaffoldProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const bg = isDark ? '#0A0F16' : '#F1F5F9';

  const body = (
    <>
      {hero}
      <View style={[styles.content, contentStyle]}>{children}</View>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: bg }]} edges={edges}>
      {header}
      {scroll ? (
        <ScrollView contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent} showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}>
          {body}
        </ScrollView>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.flex}>{body}</View>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// mobile/src/core/ui/HeroBanner.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ImageBackground, StyleSheet, Text, View, type ImageSourcePropType } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type HeroBannerProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  gradient?: readonly [string, string];
  imageSource?: ImageSourcePropType;
  height?: number;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export function HeroBanner({ title, subtitle, icon: Icon, gradient = ['#0A0F16', '#1E3A5F'], imageSource, height = 200, children }: HeroBannerProps) {
  const content = (
    <>
      <LinearGradient colors={gradient} start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }} end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} />
      {Icon ? (
        <View style={styles.iconWrap} pointerEvents="none">
          <Icon size={72} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.18)" strokeWidth={1.25} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <LinearGradient colors={['rgba(10,15,22,0)', 'rgba(10,15,22,0.85)']} start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }} end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }} style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill} />
      <View style={styles.textWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.title} numberOfLines={2}>{title}</Text>
        {subtitle ? <Text style={styles.subtitle} numberOfLines={3}>{subtitle}</Text> : null}
        {children}
      </View>
    </>
  );

  if (imageSource) {
    return (
      <ImageBackground source={imageSource} style={[styles.container, { height }]} resizeMode="cover">
        {content}
      </ImageBackground>
    );
  }

  return <View style={[styles.container, { height }]}>{content}</View>;
}
```

import React from 'react';
import { I18nManager, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type ModuleHeaderAction = {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  onPress: () => void;
  accessibilityLabel: string;
};

export type ModuleHeaderProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  onBack?: () => void;
  showBack?: boolean;
  rightAction?: ModuleHeaderAction;
};

export function ModuleHeader({ title, subtitle, onBack, showBack = true, rightAction }: ModuleHeaderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';
  const isRTL = I18nManager.isRTL;
  const BackIcon = isRTL ? ChevronRight : ChevronLeft;
  const handleBack = onBack ?? (() => router.back());
  const iconColor = isDark ? '#E2E8F0' : '#1A2331';

  return (
    <View style={[styles.container, isDark && styles.containerDark]}>
      <View style={styles.row}>
        {showBack ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.iconButton, pressed && styles.pressed]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Back"
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <BackIcon size={22} color={iconColor} strokeWidth={2} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.iconButton} />
        )}

        <View style={styles.titleWrap}>
          <Text style={[styles.title, isDark && styles.titleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          {subtitle ? (
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, isDark && styles.subtitleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {subtitle}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {rightAction ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={rightAction.onPress}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.iconButton, pressed && styles.pressed]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={rightAction.accessibilityLabel}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <rightAction.icon size={22} color={iconColor} strokeWidth={2} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.iconButton} />
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingVertical: 12,
    backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9',
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1',
  },
  containerDark: {
    backgroundColor: '#0A0F16',
    borderBottomColor: '#243040',
  },

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ImageBackground, StyleSheet, Text, View, type ImageSourcePropType } from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type HeroBannerProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  gradient?: readonly [string, string];
  imageSource?: ImageSourcePropType;
  height?: number;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export function HeroBanner({
  title,
  subtitle,
  icon: Icon,
  gradient = ['#0A0F16', '#1E3A5F'],
  imageSource,
  height = 200,
  children,
}: HeroBannerProps) {
  const content = (
    <>
      <LinearGradient
        colors={gradient}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
      />
      {Icon ? (
        <View style={styles.iconWrap} pointerEvents="none">
          <Icon size={96} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.14)" strokeWidth={1.25} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <LinearGradient
        colors={['rgba(10,15,22,0)', 'rgba(10,15,22,0.88)']}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
        end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
      />
      <View style={styles.textWrap}>
        <Text style={styles.title} numberOfLines={2}>{title}</Text>
        {subtitle ? <Text style={styles.subtitle} numberOfLines={3}>{subtitle}</Text> : null}
        {children}
      </View>
    </>
  );

  if (imageSource) {
    return (
      <ImageBackground source={imageSource} style={[styles.container, { height }]} resizeMode="cover">
        {content}
      </ImageBackground>
    );
  }

  return <View style={[styles.container, { height }]}>{content}</View>;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    overflow: 'hidden',
    justifyContent: 'flex-end',
  },
  iconWrap: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  textWrap: {
    padding: 20,
  },
  title: {
    color: '#FFFFFF',
    fontSize: 24,
    fontWeight: '800',
    lineHeight: 30,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.82)',
    fontSize: 13,
    lineHeight: 20,
    marginTop: 6,
  },
});
```

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, StyleSheet, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';

export type ScreenScaffoldProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  header?: React.ReactNode;
  hero?: React.ReactNode;
  scroll?: boolean;
  contentStyle?: ViewStyle;
  edges?: Array<'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'>;
};

export function ScreenScaffold({
  children,
  header,
  hero,
  scroll = true,
  contentStyle,
  edges = ['top', 'bottom'],
}: ScreenScaffoldProps) {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';
  const bg = isDark ? '#0A0F16' : '#F1F5F9';

  const body = (
    <>
      {hero}
      <View style={[styles.content, contentStyle]}>{children}</View>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: bg }]} edges={edges}>
      {header}
      {scroll ? (
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {body}
        </ScrollView>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.flex}>{body}</View>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  flex: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  scrollContent: {
    paddingBottom: 32,
  },
  content: {
    flex: 1,
  },
});
```

}

      <ThemeProvider>

  );
}

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';
import { Stack } from 'expo-router';
import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { ThemeProvider } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';
import '../global.css';

function AppNavigator() {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';

  return (
    <>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />
      <Stack
        screenOptions={{
          headerShown: false,
          animation: 'slide_from_right',
          gestureEnabled: true,
          contentStyle: { backgroundColor: isDark ? '#0A0F16' : '#F1F5F9' },
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <AppNavigator />
      </ThemeProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}

// mobile/src/core/ui/SectionHeader.tsx
import React from 'react';
import { Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, View } from 'react-native';
import { useColorScheme } from 'react-native';

export type SectionHeaderProps = {
  title: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  onAction?: () => void;
};

export function SectionHeader({ title, actionLabel, onAction }: SectionHeaderProps) {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';

  return (
    <View style={styles.container}>
      <Text style={[styles.title, isDark && styles.titleDark]}>{title}</Text>
      {actionLabel && onAction ? (
        <Pressable onPress={onAction} hitSlop={8}>
          <Text style={styles.action}>{actionLabel}</Text>
        </Pressable>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    marginTop: 24,
    marginBottom: 12,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: 16,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#1A2331',
  },
  titleDark: {
    color: '#F1F5F9',
  },
  action: {
    fontSize: 13,
    fontWeight: '600',
    color: '#0E7490',
  },
});
```

import React from 'react';
import { I18nManager, Pressable, StyleSheet, Text, useColorScheme, View } from 'react-native';
import { useRouter } from 'expo-router';
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type ModuleHeaderAction = {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  onPress: () => void;
  accessibilityLabel: string;
};

export type ModuleHeaderProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  onBack?: () => void;
  showBack?: boolean;
  rightAction?: ModuleHeaderAction;
};

export function ModuleHeader({
  title,
  subtitle,
  onBack,
  showBack = true,
  rightAction,
}: ModuleHeaderProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';
  const isRTL = I18nManager.isRTL;
  const BackIcon = isRTL ? ChevronRight : ChevronLeft;
  const RightIcon = rightAction?.icon;
  const iconColor = isDark ? '#E2E8F0' : '#1A2331';
  const handleBack = onBack ?? (() => router.back());

  return (
    <View style={[styles.container, isDark && styles.containerDark]}>
      <View style={styles.row}>
        {showBack ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={handleBack}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.iconButton, pressed && styles.pressed]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel="Back"
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <BackIcon size={22} color={iconColor} strokeWidth={2} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.iconButton} />
        )}

        <View style={styles.titleWrap}>
          <Text style={[styles.title, isDark && styles.titleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>
            {title}
          </Text>
          {subtitle ? (
            <Text style={[styles.subtitle, isDark && styles.subtitleDark]} numberOfLines={1}>
              {subtitle}
            </Text>
          ) : null}
        </View>

        {rightAction && RightIcon ? (
          <Pressable
            onPress={rightAction.onPress}
            style={({ pressed }) => [styles.iconButton, pressed && styles.pressed]}
            accessibilityRole="button"
            accessibilityLabel={rightAction.accessibilityLabel}
            hitSlop={8}
          >
            <RightIcon size={22} color={iconColor} strokeWidth={2} />
          </Pressable>
        ) : (
          <View style={styles.iconButton} />
        )}
      </View>
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    paddingHorizontal: 16,
    paddingVertical: 12,
    backgroundColor: '#F1F5F9',
    borderBottomWidth: StyleSheet.hairlineWidth,
    borderBottomColor: '#CBD5E1',
  },
  containerDark: {
    backgroundColor: '#0A0F16',
    borderBottomColor: '#243040',
  },
  row: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'space-between',
  },
  iconButton: {
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    borderRadius: 20,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  pressed: {
    opacity: 0.6,
  },
  titleWrap: {
    flex: 1,
    alignItems: 'center',
    paddingHorizontal: 8,
  },
  title: {
    fontSize: 17,
    fontWeight: '700',
    color: '#1A2331',
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  titleDark: {
    color: '#F1F5F9',
  },
  subtitle: {
    fontSize: 12,
    color: '#64748B',
    marginTop: 2,
    textAlign: 'center',
  },
  subtitleDark: {
    color: '#94A3B8',
  },
});
```

For `HeroBanner`:

```tsx
import React from 'react';
import {
  I18nManager,
  ImageBackground,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
  type ImageSourcePropType,
} from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import type { LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';

export type HeroBannerProps = {
  title: string;
  subtitle?: string;
  icon?: LucideIcon;
  gradient?: readonly [string, string];
  imageSource?: ImageSourcePropType;
  height?: number;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export function HeroBanner({
  title,
  subtitle,
  icon: Icon,
  gradient = ['#0A0F16', '#1E3A5F'],
  imageSource,
  height = 200,
  children,
}: HeroBannerProps) {
  const isRTL = I18nManager.isRTL;
  const textAlign = isRTL ? 'right' : 'left';

  const content = (
    <>
      <LinearGradient
        colors={gradient}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
        end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
      />
      {Icon ? (
        <View style={styles.iconWrap} pointerEvents="none">
          <Icon size={96} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.14)" strokeWidth={1.25} />
        </View>
      ) : null}
      <LinearGradient
        colors={['rgba(10,15,22,0)', 'rgba(10,15,22,0.88)']}
        start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
        end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
        style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
      />
      <View style={styles.textWrap}>
        <Text style={[styles.title, { textAlign }]} numberOfLines={2}>
          {title}
        </Text>
        {subtitle ? (
          <Text style={[styles.subtitle, { textAlign }]} numberOfLines={3}>
            {subtitle}
          </Text>
        ) : null}
        {children}
      </View>
    </>
  );

  if (imageSource) {
    return (
      <ImageBackground
        source={imageSource}
        style={[styles.container, { height }]}
        resizeMode="cover"
      >
        {content}
      </ImageBackground>
    );
  }

  return <View style={[styles.container, { height }]}>{content}</View>;
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  container: {
    overflow: 'hidden',
    justifyContent: 'flex-end',
  },
  iconWrap: {
    ...StyleSheet.absoluteFillObject,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  textWrap: {
    padding: 20,
  },
  title: {
    color: '#FFFFFF',
    fontSize: 24,
    fontWeight: '800',
    lineHeight: 30,
  },
  subtitle: {
    color: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.82)',
    fontSize: 13,
    lineHeight: 20,
    marginTop: 6,
  },
});
```

import React from 'react';
import { ScrollView, StyleSheet, useColorScheme, View, type ViewStyle } from 'react-native';
import { SafeAreaView } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';

export type ScreenScaffoldProps = {
  children: React.ReactNode;
  header?: React.ReactNode;
  hero?: React.ReactNode;
  scroll?: boolean;
  contentStyle?: ViewStyle;
  edges?: Array<'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right'>;
};

export function ScreenScaffold({
  children,
  header,
  hero,
  scroll = true,
  contentStyle,
  edges = ['top', 'bottom'],
}: ScreenScaffoldProps) {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';
  const bg = isDark ? '#0A0F16' : '#F1F5F9';

  const body = (
    <>
      {hero}
      <View style={[styles.content, contentStyle]}>{children}</View>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <SafeAreaView style={[styles.safe, { backgroundColor: bg }]} edges={edges}>
      {header}
      {scroll ? (
        <ScrollView
          contentContainerStyle={styles.scrollContent}
          showsVerticalScrollIndicator={false}
        >
          {body}
        </ScrollView>
      ) : (
        <View style={styles.flex}>{body}</View>
      )}
    </SafeAreaView>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  safe: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  flex: {
    flex: 1,
  },
  scrollContent: {
    paddingBottom: 32,
  },
  content: {
    flex: 1,
  },
});
```

import { StatusBar } from 'expo-status-bar';
import { SafeAreaProvider } from 'react-native-safe-area-context';
import { ThemeProvider } from '../src/core/theme/ThemeContext';
import '../global.css';

function AppNavigator() {
  const scheme = useColorScheme();
  const isDark = scheme === 'dark';

  return (
    <>
      <StatusBar style={isDark ? 'light' : 'dark'} />
      <Stack
        screenOptions={{
          headerShown: false,
          animation: 'slide_from_right',
          gestureEnabled: true,
          contentStyle: { backgroundColor: isDark ? '#0A0F16' : '#F1F5F9' },
        }}
      />
    </>
  );
}

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <SafeAreaProvider>
      <ThemeProvider>
        <AppNavigator />
      </ThemeProvider>
    </SafeAreaProvider>
  );
}

Let me write the caching hook:

```ts
import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

const CACHE_DIR = `${FileSystem.cacheDirectory}engineering-images/`;

async function ensureCacheDir() {
  const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(CACHE_DIR);
  if (!info.exists) await FileSystem.makeDirectoryAsync(CACHE_DIR, { intermediates: true });
}

function fileNameFor(url: string) {
  // simple hash
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < url.length; i++) hash = (hash * 31 + url.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  return `img_${Math.abs(hash)}.img`;
}

export function useCachedImage(remoteUrl?: string | null) {
  const [uri, setUri] = useState<string | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let active = true;
    if (!remoteUrl) { setUri(null); return; }
    (async () => {
      try {
        await ensureCacheDir();
        const path = CACHE_DIR + fileNameFor(remoteUrl);
        const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(path);
        if (info.exists) { if (active) setUri(path); return; }
        const dl = await FileSystem.downloadAsync(remoteUrl, path);
        if (active) setUri(dl.uri);
      } catch {
        if (active) setUri(remoteUrl); // fallback to remote
      }
    })();
    return () => { active = false; };
  }, [remoteUrl]);
  return uri;
}
```

This gives offline availability after first download. Good.

import React from 'react';
import { type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';
import { getSemanticColors } from '../theme/tokens';

export type AppIconVariant =
  | 'default'
  | 'primary'
  | 'success'
  | 'warning'
  | 'danger'
  | 'accent'
  | 'muted'
  | 'inverse';

export type AppIconProps = {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  size?: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  variant?: AppIconVariant;
  color?: string;
  accessibilityLabel?: string;
};

function resolveVariantColor(variant: AppIconVariant, isDark: boolean): string {
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  switch (variant) {
    case 'primary':
      return colors.primary;
    case 'success':
      return colors.success;
    case 'warning':
      return colors.warning;
    case 'danger':
      return colors.danger;
    case 'accent':
      return colors.accent;
    case 'muted':
      return colors.textMuted;
    case 'inverse':
      return colors.textInverse;
    case 'default':
    default:
      return colors.textPrimary;
  }
}

export function AppIcon({
  icon: Icon,
  size = 20,
  strokeWidth = 2,
  variant = 'default',
  color,
  accessibilityLabel,
}: AppIconProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const resolvedColor = color ?? resolveVariantColor(variant, isDark);

  return (
    <Icon
      size={size}
      color={resolvedColor}
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      accessibilityLabel={accessibilityLabel}
    />
  );
}

export default AppIcon;

Let me write the hook:

```ts
// mobile/src/core/hooks/useCachedImage.ts
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy';

const CACHE_DIR = `${FileSystem.cacheDirectory}gridhand-engineering/`;

let cacheDirReady: Promise<void> | null = null;

async function ensureCacheDir(): Promise<void> {
  if (!cacheDirReady) {
    cacheDirReady = (async () => {
      const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(CACHE_DIR);
      if (!info.exists) {
        await FileSystem.makeDirectoryAsync(CACHE_DIR, { intermediates: true });
      }
    })().catch(() => {
      cacheDirReady = null;
    });
  }
  return cacheDirReady;
}

function hashUrl(url: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < url.length; i += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + url.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return Math.abs(hash).toString(36);
}

function extensionFor(url: string): string {
  const match = /\.(jpe?g|png|webp|gif)(?:\?|$)/i.exec(url);
  return match ? `.${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : '.img';
}

export type CachedImageState = {
  uri: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
};

export function useCachedImage(remoteUrl?: string | null): CachedImageState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CachedImageState>({
    uri: null,
    loading: Boolean(remoteUrl),
    error: false,
  });
  const mounted = useRef(true);

  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      mounted.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!remoteUrl) {
      setState({ uri: null, loading: false, error: false });
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    setState({ uri: null, loading: true, error: false });

    (async () => {
      try {
        await ensureCacheDir();
        const path = `${CACHE_DIR}${hashUrl(remoteUrl)}${extensionFor(remoteUrl)}`;
        const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(path);
        if (info.exists) {
          if (active && mounted.current) setState({ uri: path, loading: false, error: false });
          return;
        }
        const download = await FileSystem.downloadAsync(remoteUrl, path);
        if (active && mounted.current) setState({ uri: download.uri, loading: false, error: false });
      } catch {
        if (active && mounted.current) {
          // Fall back to the remote URL; the native image loader still caches it.
          setState({ uri: remoteUrl, loading: false, error: false });
        }
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [remoteUrl]);

  return state;
}
```

Let me write the component:

```tsx
export function EngineeringImage({
  imageKey,
  definition: definitionProp,
  aspectRatio,
  radius = 'lg',
  style,
  imageStyle,
  overlay = false,
  overlayColors,
  overlayOpacity = 0.55,
  showLabel = false,
  label,
  children,
  testID,
}: EngineeringImageProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  const definition = definitionProp ?? (imageKey ? engineeringImages[imageKey] : undefined);

  const remoteUrl = definition && !definition.local ? definition.remote ?? null : null;
  const cached = useCachedImage(remoteUrl);

  const resolvedAspectRatio = aspectRatio ?? definition?.aspectRatio ?? 16 / 9;
  const gradient = engineeringGradients[definition?.gradient ?? 'hero'];
  const borderRadius = radius === 'none' ? 0 : radiusTokens[radius];

  const source = useMemo(() => {
    if (!definition) return null;
    if (definition.local) return definition.local;
    if (cached.uri) return { uri: cached.uri };
    return null;
  }, [definition, cached.uri]);

  const showPlaceholder = !source || failed;
  const showSpinner = !showPlaceholder && cached.loading && !definition?.local;

  return (
    <View
      testID={testID}
      style={[{ aspectRatio: resolvedAspectRatio, borderRadius, overflow: 'hidden' }, style]}
    >
      {showPlaceholder ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={gradient as unknown as [string, string]}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
        >
          <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center">
            <AppIcon icon={ImageOff} size={28} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" />
            {showLabel && (label ?? definition?.title) ? (
              <Text className="mt-2 px-4 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-white/90">
                {label ?? definition?.title}
              </Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </LinearGradient>
      ) : (
        <Image
          source={source}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, imageStyle]}
          resizeMode="cover"
          fadeDuration={0}
          progressiveRenderingEnabled
          onError={() => setFailed(true)}
        />
      )}

      {showSpinner ? (
        <View className="absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.textInverse} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {overlay ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={(overlayColors ?? ['transparent', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)']) as unknown as [string, string]}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { opacity: overlayOpacity }]}
          pointerEvents="none"
        />
      ) : null}

      {children ? <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}>{children}</View> : null}
    </View>
  );
}
```

Let me write the hook carefully:

```ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy';

const CACHE_DIR = FileSystem.cacheDirectory
  ? `${FileSystem.cacheDirectory}gridhand-engineering/`
  : null;

async function ensureCacheDir(): Promise<void> {
  if (!CACHE_DIR) return;
  try {
    const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(CACHE_DIR);
    if (!info.exists) {
      await FileSystem.makeDirectoryAsync(CACHE_DIR, { intermediates: true });
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore; the download step will fall back to the remote URL.
  }
}

function hashUrl(url: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < url.length; i += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + url.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return Math.abs(hash).toString(36);
}

function extensionFor(url: string): string {
  const match = /\.(jpe?g|png|webp|gif)(?:\?|#|$)/i.exec(url);
  return match ? `.${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : '.img';
}

export type CachedImageState = {
  uri: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
};

export function useCachedImage(remoteUrl?: string | null): CachedImageState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CachedImageState>({
    uri: null,
    loading: Boolean(remoteUrl),
    error: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!remoteUrl) {
      setState({ uri: null, loading: false, error: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!CACHE_DIR) {
      // Web or unsupported platform: rely on the native image loader cache.
      setState({ uri: remoteUrl, loading: false, error: false });
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    setState({ uri: null, loading: true, error: false });

    (async () => {
      try {
        await ensureCacheDir();
        const path = `${CACHE_DIR}${hashUrl(remoteUrl)}${extensionFor(remoteUrl)}`;
        const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(path);
        if (info.exists) {
          if (active) setState({ uri: path, loading: false, error: false });
          return;
        }
        const download = await FileSystem.downloadAsync(remoteUrl, path);
        if (download.status && download.status >= 400) {
          await FileSystem.deleteAsync(path, { idempotent: true }).catch(() => {});
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${download.status}`);
        }
        if (active) setState({ uri: download.uri, loading: false, error: false });
      } catch {
        if (active) setState({ uri: remoteUrl, loading: false, error: false });
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [remoteUrl]);

  return state;
}
```

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
  type ImageStyle,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { ImageOff } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';
import { engineeringGradients, getSemanticColors, radius as radiusTokens } from '../theme/tokens';
import {
  engineeringImages,
  type EngineeringImageDefinition,
  type EngineeringImageKey,
} from '../assets/engineeringImages';
import { useCachedImage } from '../hooks/useCachedImage';
import { AppIcon } from './AppIcon';

export type EngineeringImageRadius = 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl' | 'full';

export type EngineeringImageProps = {
  imageKey?: EngineeringImageKey;
  definition?: EngineeringImageDefinition;
  aspectRatio?: number;
  radius?: EngineeringImageRadius;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  imageStyle?: StyleProp<ImageStyle>;
  overlay?: boolean;
  overlayColors?: readonly [string, string];
  overlayOpacity?: number;
  showLabel?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  testID?: string;
};

export function EngineeringImage({
  imageKey,
  definition: definitionProp,
  aspectRatio,
  radius = 'lg',
  style,
  imageStyle,
  overlay = false,
  overlayColors,
  overlayOpacity = 0.55,
  showLabel = false,
  label,
  children,
  testID,
}: EngineeringImageProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  const definition = definitionProp ?? (imageKey ? engineeringImages[imageKey] : undefined);

  const remoteUrl = definition && !definition.local ? definition.remote ?? null : null;
  const cached = useCachedImage(remoteUrl);

  const resolvedAspectRatio = aspectRatio ?? definition?.aspectRatio ?? 16 / 9;
  const gradient = engineeringGradients[definition?.gradient ?? 'hero'];
  const borderRadius = radius === 'none' ? 0 : radiusTokens[radius];

  const source = useMemo(() => {
    if (!definition) return null;
    if (definition.local) return definition.local;
    if (cached.uri) return { uri: cached.uri };
    return null;
  }, [definition, cached.uri]);

  const showPlaceholder = !source || failed;
  const showSpinner = cached.loading && !definition?.local && !failed;
  const resolvedLabel = label ?? definition?.title;

  return (
    <View
      testID={testID}
      accessibilityRole="image"
      accessibilityLabel={resolvedLabel}
      style={[{ aspectRatio: resolvedAspectRatio, borderRadius, overflow: 'hidden' }, style]}
    >
      {showPlaceholder ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={gradient}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
        >
          <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-4">
            <AppIcon icon={ImageOff} size={28} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" />
            {showLabel && resolvedLabel ? (
              <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-white/90">
                {resolvedLabel}
              </Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </LinearGradient>
      ) : (
        <Image
          source={source}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, imageStyle]}
          resizeMode="cover"
          resizeMethod="resize"
          fadeDuration={0}
          progressiveRenderingEnabled
          onError={() => setFailed(true)}
        />
      )}

      {showSpinner ? (
        <View className="absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.textInverse} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {overlay ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={overlayColors ?? ['transparent', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)']}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { opacity: overlayOpacity }]}
          pointerEvents="none"
        />
      ) : null}

      {children ? <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}>{children}</View> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

export default EngineeringImage;

import React from 'react';
import { type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';
import { getSemanticColors } from '../theme/tokens';

export type AppIconVariant =
  | 'default'
  | 'primary'
  | 'success'
  | 'warning'
  | 'danger'
  | 'accent'
  | 'muted'
  | 'inverse';

export type AppIconProps = {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  size?: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  variant?: AppIconVariant;
  color?: string;
};

function resolveVariantColor(variant: AppIconVariant, isDark: boolean): string {
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  switch (variant) {
    case 'primary':
      return colors.primary;
    case 'success':
      return colors.success;
    case 'warning':
      return colors.warning;
    case 'danger':
      return colors.danger;
    case 'accent':
      return colors.accent;
    case 'muted':
      return colors.textMuted;
    case 'inverse':
      return colors.textInverse;
    case 'default':
    default:
      return colors.textPrimary;
  }
}

export function AppIcon({
  icon: Icon,
  size = 20,
  strokeWidth = 2,
  variant = 'default',
  color,
}: AppIconProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const resolvedColor = color ?? resolveVariantColor(variant, isDark);

  return <Icon size={size} color={resolvedColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />;
}

export default AppIcon;

I reviewed the files you added and will implement the visual asset system as **new, additive files only** — no home screen layouts, no bottom navigation, and no changes to existing components. The new pieces reconcile with the existing `ThemeContext` (`isDark`) and the Tailwind palette already used across the app, so there is no second design system.

What I'm adding:

1. `mobile/src/core/theme/tokens.ts` — a JS-side mirror of the existing Tailwind palette plus semantic colors, engineering gradients, spacing, radius, typography, and shadows. Used only where a JS value is required (Lucide `color`, `LinearGradient` `colors`, shadow objects). `className` styling stays NativeWind.
2. `mobile/src/core/components/AppIcon.tsx` — a thin, theme-aware wrapper around `LucideIcon` (the same type already imported in `DeputyCards.tsx`). It does not re-export icons, so it stays compatible with whatever Lucide version is installed.
3. `mobile/src/core/assets/engineeringImages.ts` — a typed registry of professional industrial imagery (lineworkers, engineers, transformers, substations, distribution equipment) with `local` (bundled, best for offline), `remote` (cached), gradient fallback, aspect ratio, and placeholder color.
4. `mobile/src/core/hooks/useCachedImage.ts` — downloads remote images once into `expo-file-system` cache (legacy API, matching the existing `document/[id].tsx` usage) so they remain available offline. Falls back to the remote URL on web/unsupported platforms.
5. `mobile/src/core/components/EngineeringImage.tsx` — the reusable image component. It prefers bundled assets, then cached remote, then a premium gradient + icon placeholder. It uses `resizeMethod="resize"`, `fadeDuration={0}`, and `progressiveRenderingEnabled` for low-end Android, and supports overlays/children for future cards.

Note on assets: I cannot generate binary image files here. The registry ships with best-effort Unsplash URLs and a graceful gradient fallback. For guaranteed offline + best performance, drop optimized WebP files (≤ 120 KB, ≤ 1280 px wide) into `mobile/assets/images/engineering/` and set `local: require('...')` on the matching registry entry — the component will automatically prefer them.

import React from 'react';
import { type LucideIcon } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';
import { getSemanticColors } from '../theme/tokens';

export type AppIconVariant =
  | 'default'
  | 'primary'
  | 'success'
  | 'warning'
  | 'danger'
  | 'accent'
  | 'muted'
  | 'inverse';

export type AppIconProps = {
  icon: LucideIcon;
  size?: number;
  strokeWidth?: number;
  variant?: AppIconVariant;
  color?: string;
};

function resolveVariantColor(variant: AppIconVariant, isDark: boolean): string {
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  switch (variant) {
    case 'primary':
      return colors.primary;
    case 'success':
      return colors.success;
    case 'warning':
      return colors.warning;
    case 'danger':
      return colors.danger;
    case 'accent':
      return colors.accent;
    case 'muted':
      return colors.textMuted;
    case 'inverse':
      return colors.textInverse;
    case 'default':
    default:
      return colors.textPrimary;
  }
}

/**
 * Theme-aware wrapper around a Lucide icon.
 *
 * Icons are passed in by the consumer (e.g. `AppIcon icon={Zap} variant="success" />`)
 * so this component stays compatible with whatever Lucide version is installed.
 * Only icons already used in the codebase (Zap, User, Play, Headphones, Network,
 * TowerControl) plus standard Lucide exports should be passed in.
 */
export function AppIcon({
  icon: Icon,
  size = 20,
  strokeWidth = 2,
  variant = 'default',
  color,
}: AppIconProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const resolvedColor = color ?? resolveVariantColor(variant, isDark);

  return <Icon size={size} color={resolvedColor} strokeWidth={strokeWidth} />;
}

export default AppIcon;

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import * as FileSystem from 'expo-file-system/legacy';

/**
 * Caches remote engineering images on device so they remain available offline
 * after the first successful load. Uses the legacy expo-file-system API, which
 * matches the existing usage in `mobile/src/app/document/[id].tsx`.
 *
 * On platforms without a cache directory (e.g. web), it falls back to the
 * remote URL and relies on the native image loader cache.
 */

const CACHE_DIR = FileSystem.cacheDirectory
  ? `${FileSystem.cacheDirectory}gridhand-engineering/`
  : null;

async function ensureCacheDir(): Promise<void> {
  if (!CACHE_DIR) return;
  try {
    const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(CACHE_DIR);
    if (!info.exists) {
      await FileSystem.makeDirectoryAsync(CACHE_DIR, { intermediates: true });
    }
  } catch {
    // Ignore; the download step will fall back to the remote URL.
  }
}

function hashUrl(url: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < url.length; i += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + url.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return Math.abs(hash).toString(36);
}

function extensionFor(url: string): string {
  const match = /\.(jpe?g|png|webp|gif)(?:\?|#|$)/i.exec(url);
  return match ? `.${match[1].toLowerCase()}` : '.img';
}

export type CachedImageState = {
  uri: string | null;
  loading: boolean;
  error: boolean;
};

export function useCachedImage(remoteUrl?: string | null): CachedImageState {
  const [state, setState] = useState<CachedImageState>({
    uri: null,
    loading: Boolean(remoteUrl),
    error: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!remoteUrl) {
      setState({ uri: null, loading: false, error: false });
      return;
    }

    if (!CACHE_DIR) {
      // Web or unsupported platform: rely on the native image loader cache.
      setState({ uri: remoteUrl, loading: false, error: false });
      return;
    }

    let active = true;
    setState({ uri: null, loading: true, error: false });

    (async () => {
      try {
        await ensureCacheDir();
        const path = `${CACHE_DIR}${hashUrl(remoteUrl)}${extensionFor(remoteUrl)}`;
        const info = await FileSystem.getInfoAsync(path);
        if (info.exists) {
          if (active) setState({ uri: path, loading: false, error: false });
          return;
        }
        const download = await FileSystem.downloadAsync(remoteUrl, path);
        if (download.status && download.status >= 400) {
          await FileSystem.deleteAsync(path, { idempotent: true }).catch(() => {});
          throw new Error(`HTTP ${download.status}`);
        }
        if (active) setState({ uri: download.uri, loading: false, error: false });
      } catch {
        if (active) setState({ uri: remoteUrl, loading: false, error: false });
      }
    })();

    return () => {
      active = false;
    };
  }, [remoteUrl]);

  return state;
}

import React, { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  ActivityIndicator,
  Image,
  StyleSheet,
  Text,
  View,
  type ImageStyle,
  type StyleProp,
  type ViewStyle,
} from 'react-native';
import { LinearGradient } from 'expo-linear-gradient';
import { ImageOff } from 'lucide-react-native';
import { useTheme } from '../theme/ThemeContext';
import { engineeringGradients, getSemanticColors, radius as radiusTokens } from '../theme/tokens';
import {
  engineeringImages,
  type EngineeringImageDefinition,
  type EngineeringImageKey,
} from '../assets/engineeringImages';
import { useCachedImage } from '../hooks/useCachedImage';
import { AppIcon } from './AppIcon';

export type EngineeringImageRadius = 'none' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl' | '2xl' | '3xl' | 'full';

export type EngineeringImageProps = {
  imageKey?: EngineeringImageKey;
  definition?: EngineeringImageDefinition;
  aspectRatio?: number;
  radius?: EngineeringImageRadius;
  style?: StyleProp<ViewStyle>;
  imageStyle?: StyleProp<ImageStyle>;
  overlay?: boolean;
  overlayColors?: readonly [string, string];
  overlayOpacity?: number;
  showLabel?: boolean;
  label?: string;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  testID?: string;
};

/**
 * Reusable engineering image component.
 *
 * - Prefers bundled `local` assets (best for offline + low-end devices).
 * - Falls back to a cached remote image (see useCachedImage).
 * - Falls back to a premium gradient + icon placeholder when no image is
 *   available or the image fails to load.
 * - Uses Android-friendly props (resizeMethod, fadeDuration, progressive
 *   rendering) to keep memory and jank low on low-end devices.
 */
export function EngineeringImage({
  imageKey,
  definition: definitionProp,
  aspectRatio,
  radius = 'lg',
  style,
  imageStyle,
  overlay = false,
  overlayColors,
  overlayOpacity = 0.55,
  showLabel = false,
  label,
  children,
  testID,
}: EngineeringImageProps) {
  const { isDark } = useTheme();
  const colors = getSemanticColors(isDark);
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  const definition = definitionProp ?? (imageKey ? engineeringImages[imageKey] : undefined);

  const remoteUrl = definition && !definition.local ? definition.remote ?? null : null;
  const cached = useCachedImage(remoteUrl);

  const resolvedAspectRatio = aspectRatio ?? definition?.aspectRatio ?? 16 / 9;
  const gradient = engineeringGradients[definition?.gradient ?? 'hero'];
  const borderRadius = radius === 'none' ? 0 : radiusTokens[radius];

  const source = useMemo(() => {
    if (!definition) return null;
    if (definition.local) return definition.local;
    if (cached.uri) return { uri: cached.uri };
    return null;
  }, [definition, cached.uri]);

  const showPlaceholder = !source || failed;
  const showSpinner = cached.loading && !definition?.local && !failed;
  const resolvedLabel = label ?? definition?.title;

  return (
    <View
      testID={testID}
      accessibilityRole="image"
      accessibilityLabel={resolvedLabel}
      style={[{ aspectRatio: resolvedAspectRatio, borderRadius, overflow: 'hidden' }, style]}
    >
      {showPlaceholder ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={gradient}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 1, y: 1 }}
          style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}
        >
          <View className="flex-1 items-center justify-center px-4">
            <AppIcon icon={ImageOff} size={28} color="rgba(255,255,255,0.85)" />
            {showLabel && resolvedLabel ? (
              <Text className="mt-2 text-center text-xs font-semibold text-white/90">
                {resolvedLabel}
              </Text>
            ) : null}
          </View>
        </LinearGradient>
      ) : (
        <Image
          source={source}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, imageStyle]}
          resizeMode="cover"
          resizeMethod="resize"
          fadeDuration={0}
          progressiveRenderingEnabled
          onError={() => setFailed(true)}
        />
      )}

      {showSpinner ? (
        <View className="absolute inset-0 items-center justify-center">
          <ActivityIndicator color={colors.textInverse} />
        </View>
      ) : null}

      {overlay ? (
        <LinearGradient
          colors={overlayColors ?? (['transparent', 'rgba(0,0,0,0.75)'] as const)}
          start={{ x: 0, y: 0 }}
          end={{ x: 0, y: 1 }}
          style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, { opacity: overlayOpacity }]}
          pointerEvents="none"
        />
      ) : null}

      {children ? <View style={StyleSheet.absoluteFill}>{children}</View> : null}
    </View>
  );
}

export default EngineeringImage;
```
